Show that a labelled transition from a well-typed linear π-calculus process preserves typing under the stated premises.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `sr`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.

Section PairOperations.

Section ListOperations.

Fixpoint disjoint {A} (l1 l2 : list A) : Prop :=
    match l1 with
    | nil => True
    | x::t1 => ((In x l2) -> False) /\ disjoint t1 l2
    end.

Inductive  disjoint_2 {A}: list A -> list A -> Prop :=
  | dis_nil : forall l : list A, disjoint_2 nil l

    (fst p1 =? fst p2) && (snd p1 =? snd p2).

    match l with
    | nil => false
    | b :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then true else In2 a m

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Notation name  := nat.

Section ProcessDefinitions.

Inductive dproc : Set :=
  | dZero : dproc
  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.

Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p
    | dNu h i  p =>  secLabs p ++ (h, i) :: nil
    end.

Fixpoint fn (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      fn p1 ++  fn p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      (x1, x2) :: (y1, y2) :: fn p
    end.

Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>
      nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      (y1, y2) :: bv p
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      bv p1 ++  bv p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      bv p
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      bv p
    end.

Definition wf (p : dproc) : Prop :=
    NoDup (secLabs p) /\ disjoint (fn p) (secLabs p).

Definition pos l := forall x1 x2 : nat,
      In (x1, x2) l-> x2 > 0.

Definition sl_pos p := pos (secLabs p).

Definition mv (py pz pv : name * name)  :=
    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in
    if (y1 =? z1) && (y2 =? z2)
    then (v1, v2)
    else (y1, y2).

Fixpoint pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2 :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>  p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dBang (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2 (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dInp (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2  (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      let r1 := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      let r2 := mv (y1, y2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dOut  (fst r1) (snd r1) (fst r2) (snd r2) (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dPar p q =>
      dPar (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2) (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dNu h i q =>
      dNu h i (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    end.

Definition map_nat_nat := list (nat * nat).

Fixpoint  domain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (k, _) :: t => k :: (domain_projection t)
    end.

Fixpoint  codomain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (_, v) :: t => v :: (codomain_projection t)
    end.

Definition structure_is_map (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    NoDup (domain_projection m).

Fixpoint max (l :list (nat*nat)) : nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => 0
    | (_, x) :: t => let m := max t in
                     if x <? m then m else x
    end.

Notation dp := domain_projection.

Notation cp := codomain_projection.

Local Definition no_dup_cont (h : nat * nat) (t : list (nat * nat))
    (pf : NoDup (h :: t)) : NoDup t := ltac:(inversion pf; assumption).

Local Opaque no_dup_cont.

Fixpoint dep_map_gen_r (l :list (name * name)) (m : nat) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => fun _ => nil
    | h :: t =>
      fun pf : NoDup (h :: t)  =>
        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
    end.

Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).

Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
    match p with
    | dZero   => fun _  => p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
    | dPar p q =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
    | dNu h i p =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
    end.

End ProcessDefinitions.

Section Facts.

End Facts.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,

  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid

  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->

      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->

      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->

      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->

      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->

    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil

      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m

    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=

    | nil => nil

       ill_proj m
    end.

End TypeSystem.

    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,

    match p1, p2 with

    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>

      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)

Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInU : forall u p t x q pf1 pf2,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf2 ->
      typeCheck ( (x, vis, t) :: g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dBang (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q).

End TypeSystemRules.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section Semantics.

Inductive action : Set :=
  | aIn : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aOut : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aTau : nat -> nat -> action.

Fixpoint InB a g : ((flag * piType) * bool) :=
    match g with
    | nil => ((ill, Top), false)
    | (b, f, t) :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then ((f, t), true) else InB a m
    end.

Fixpoint newEntries (g : typeEnv) (l : list (name * name)) (max : nat) : typeEnv :=
    match l with
    | (a1, a2) :: tail =>
      let (_, notNew) := InB (a1, a2) g in
      if notNew
      then newEntries g tail max
      else
        let (pair, _) := InB (a1, a2 - max) g in
        ((a1, a2), fst pair, snd pair) :: newEntries g tail max
    | nil => nil
    end.

Definition notHidden c1 c2 act :=
    match act with
    | aIn a1 a2 b1 b2
    | aOut a1 a2 b1 b2 =>
      (a1, a2)<> (c1, c2) /\ (b1, b2) <> (c1, c2)
    | aTau _ _ => True
    end.

Inductive lts (g : typeEnv) :
    dproc ->  action -> typeEnv -> dproc -> NoDup (domain g) -> Prop :=
  | parL : forall p1 a g' q p2 pf,
      lts g p1 a g' p2 pf ->
      lts g (dPar p1 q) a g' (dPar p2 q) pf
  | lOut : forall p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin out t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
             :: ((b1, b2), vis, t2)
             :: (removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g))) p pf
  | uOut : forall pol p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
      pol = out \/ pol = io ->
      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g) p pf
  | lIn : forall p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
      type_plus t1 t t2->
      f <> hid ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin inp t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
      lts g (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
             :: ((b1, b2), vis, t2)
             :: (removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g)))
          (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2) pf
  | uIn : forall pol p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
      pol = inp \/ pol = io ->
      type_plus t1 t t2 ->
      f <> hid ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
      lts g (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g)
          (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2) pf
  | uRin : forall pol p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
      pol = inp \/ pol = io ->
      type_plus t1 t t2 ->
      f <> hid ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
      let q := dep_relabel p (domain g) pf in
      lts g (dBang a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
          ((newEntries g (secLabs q) (max (domain g)))
             ++ (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g))
          (dPar (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2) (dBang a1 a2 x1 x2 q)) pf
  | lcomL : forall p1 p2 q1 q2 a1 a2 b1 b2 s s1 t
                   pf pf1 pf2,
      let g0 := removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g) in
      type_remove s t s1 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin io t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, s) g ->
      lts
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin out t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s)
           :: g0)
        p1
        (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s1)
           :: g0)
        p2
        pf1 ->
      lts
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin inp t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s1)
           :: g0)
        q1
        (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s)
           :: g0)
        q2
        pf2 ->
      lts g (dPar p1 q1) (aTau a1 a2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)

typeCheck
     : forall g : typeEnv, isMap g -> dproc -> Prop
lts
     : forall g : typeEnv,
       dproc -> action -> typeEnv -> dproc -> List.NoDup (domain g) -> Prop
tEnv_split
     : forall g1 g2 g3 : typeEnv, isMap g1 -> isMap g2 -> isMap g3 -> Prop
removeEntry
     : name * name -> typeEnv -> list (name * name * flag * piType)
Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
    Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall (n : name * name) (pf' : isMap (removeEntry n g)),
             typeOf g n Top -> cons (removeEntry n g) pf' -> cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall (n : name * name) (p : pol) (t : piType)
              (pf' : isMap (removeEntry n g)),
            typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
            cons (removeEntry n g) pf' -> cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall (n : name * name) (t : piType)
               (pf' : isMap (removeEntry n g)),
             typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
             cons (removeEntry n g) pf' -> cons g pf.

Arguments cons g pf
Arguments Co_nil g pf _
Arguments Co_top g pf n pf' _ _
Arguments Co_un g pf n p t pf' _ _
Arguments Co_lin g pf n t pf' _ _

Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.
Require Import List Lia Bool PeanoNat.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; auto.
  - split; [intros _ H; apply pair_eq_true in H; discriminate|auto].
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|[x f t] tl IH]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H; simpl; auto.
    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g x f t,
    In (x,f,t) (removeEntry y g) -> In (x,f,t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|[z fz tz] tl IH]; simpl; intros x f t H; auto.
  destruct (pair_eq z y); auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g x f t,
    x <> y -> In (x,f,t) g -> In (x,f,t) (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|[z fz tz] tl IH]; simpl; intros x f t Hne Hin.
  - auto.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E; contradiction.
      * left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y); [right|right]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|[z fz tz] tl IH]; simpl; intros x H; auto.
  destruct (pair_eq z y); simpl in *; auto.
  destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_neq : forall y g x,
    x <> y -> In x (domain g) -> In x (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|[z fz tz] tl IH]; simpl; intros x Hne Hin.
  - auto.
  - destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
    + destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E. apply pair_eq_true in E; contradiction.
      left; auto.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y); [right|right]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_domain_removeEntry : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|[z fz tz] tl IH]; simpl; intros Hnd; auto.
  apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
  destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
  - subst; auto.
  - apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; auto. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_removeEntry_still : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> In y (domain g) -> ~ In y (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|[z fz tz] tl IH]; intros Hnd Hin.
  - auto.
  - simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst. simpl. destruct (pair_eq z z) eqn:E.
      * intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
      * apply pair_eq_true in E; discriminate.
    + simpl. destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. simpl. right; apply Hc.
      * intro Hc. apply IH; auto. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [->|Hc]; auto. subst; contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_removeEntry : forall y g, isMap g -> isMap (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply Hm. split; eapply in_removeEntry_elim; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_sub : forall g1 g2, isMap g2 ->
    (forall x f t, In (x,f,t) g1 -> In (x,f,t) g2) -> isMap g1.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 Hm Hsub. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply Hm. split; auto.
Qed.

(* lookup *)
Fixpoint lookup (n : name * name) (g : typeEnv) : option (flag * piType) :=
  match g with
  | nil => None
  | (x,f,t) :: tl => if pair_eq x n then Some (f,t) else lookup n tl
  end.

Lemma lookup_Some_In : forall n g f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t) -> In (n,f,t) g.
Proof.
  intros n g. induction g as [|[x fx tx] tl IH]; simpl; intros f t H; try discriminate.
  destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E; [|apply IH]; auto.
  apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; left; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_None_notin : forall n g, lookup n g = None -> ~ In n (domain g).
Proof.
  intros n g. induction g as [|[x fx tx] tl IH]; simpl; intros H.
  - auto.
  - destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + discriminate.
    + intros [Heq|Hin]; [|apply IH; auto].
      apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma In_lookup_Some : forall n g, In n (domain g) -> exists f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t).
Proof.
  intros n g. induction g as [|[x fx tx] tl IH]; simpl; intros H.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst. destruct (pair_eq x x) eqn:E; [exists fx, tx; auto|apply pair_eq_true in E; discriminate].
    + destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
      * exists fx, tx; auto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_irrel : forall n g f1 t1 f2 t2,
    lookup n g = Some (f1,t1) -> lookup n g = Some (f2,t2) -> f1=f2 /\ t1=t2.
Proof. intros; rewrite H in H0; inversion H0; auto. Qed.
EOF

Section Utilities.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
  - split.
    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
    + intros _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
Proof.

  - simpl. auto.

Lemma pol_cup_io_inp : forall p q, p = io \/ p = inp -> pol_cup p q = io \/ pol_cup p q = inp.
Proof.
  intros p q Hp. destruct Hp as [Heq|Heq]; subst p; destruct q; simpl; auto.
Qed.
Lemma cons_proj_perm : forall g g' pf pf', Permutation g g' ->
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf -> cons (vis_proj g' ++ ill_proj g') pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hp Hc.
  apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply In_vis_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hing Hf].

    { subst f. apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj. split; auto. }
    exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t Hproj).
  - apply In_ill_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hing Hf].
    assert (Hing' : In ((n,f),t) g) by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hing)).
    assert (Hproj : In ((n,f),t) (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)).
    { subst f. apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj. split; auto. }
    exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t Hproj).
Qed.
Lemma consumable_plus : forall t1 t t2, consumable t1 -> consumable t -> type_plus t1 t t2 -> consumable t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t t2 H1 H2 Hp.
  destruct H1 as [-> | [[p1 [u1 ->]] | [u1 ->]]];
  destruct H2 as [-> | [[p2 [u2 ->]] | [u2 ->]]];
  inversion Hp; subst; simpl; auto using consumable_top, consumable_un, consumable_lin_empty.
  all: try (inversion H4; subst; auto using consumable_lin_empty).
Qed.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section Semantics.

Inductive action : Set :=
  | aIn : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aOut : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aTau : nat -> nat -> action.

Fixpoint InB a g : ((flag * piType) * bool) :=
    match g with
    | nil => ((ill, Top), false)
    | (b, f, t) :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then ((f, t), true) else InB a m
    end.

Fixpoint newEntries (g : typeEnv) (l : list (name * name)) (max : nat) : typeEnv :=
    match l with
    | (a1, a2) :: tail =>
      let (_, notNew) := InB (a1, a2) g in
      if notNew
      then newEntries g tail max
      else
        let (pair, _) := InB (a1, a2 - max) g in
        ((a1, a2), fst pair, snd pair) :: newEntries g tail max
    | nil => nil
    end.

Definition notHidden c1 c2 act :=
    match act with
    | aIn a1 a2 b1 b2
    | aOut a1 a2 b1 b2 =>
      (a1, a2)<> (c1, c2) /\ (b1, b2) <> (c1, c2)
    | aTau _ _ => True
    end.

Inductive lts (g : typeEnv) :
    dproc ->  action -> typeEnv -> dproc -> NoDup (domain g) -> Prop :=
  | parL : forall p1 a g' q p2 pf,
      lts g p1 a g' p2 pf ->
      lts g (dPar p1 q) a g' (dPar p2 q) pf
  | lOut : forall p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin out t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
             :: ((b1, b2), vis, t2)
             :: (removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g))) p pf
  | uOut : forall pol p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
      pol = out \/ pol = io ->
      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g) p pf
  | lIn : forall p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
      type_plus t1 t t2->
      f <> hid ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin inp t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
      lts g (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
             :: ((b1, b2), vis, t2)
             :: (removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g)))
          (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2) pf
  | uIn : forall pol p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
      pol = inp \/ pol = io ->
      type_plus t1 t t2 ->
      f <> hid ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
      lts g (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g)
          (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2) pf
  | uRin : forall pol p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
      pol = inp \/ pol = io ->
      type_plus t1 t t2 ->
      f <> hid ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
      let q := dep_relabel p (domain g) pf in
      lts g (dBang a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
          ((newEntries g (secLabs q) (max (domain g)))
             ++ (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g))
          (dPar (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2) (dBang a1 a2 x1 x2 q)) pf
  | lcomL : forall p1 p2 q1 q2 a1 a2 b1 b2 s s1 t

      let g0 := removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g) in
      type_remove s t s1 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin io t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, s) g ->
      lts
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin out t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s)
           :: g0)
        p1
        (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s1)
           :: g0)
        p2
        pf1 ->
      lts
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin inp t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s1)
           :: g0)
        q1
        (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
        (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
           :: ((b1, b2), vis, s)
           :: g0)
        q2
        pf2 ->
      lts g (dPar p1 q1) (aTau a1 a2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
             :: ((b1, b2), vis, s)
             :: g0) (dPar p2 q2) pf
  | lclsL : forall p1 p2 q1 q2 a1 a2 b1 b2 s s1 t
                   pf pf1 pf2,

I made progress on the relabelling/weakening infrastructure but also identified a necessary strengthening of the statement.

Implemented and verified in `SubstDev.v`:
- `wk_type`, `type_plus_wk`, `consumable_wk` — the canonical “consumable self-weakening” type with `type_plus (wk_type t) t t`.
- `cons_insert`, `cons_proj_insert` — extending `cons` environments and projection-cons with a new consumable entry.
- `ecomb_self_consumable`, `esplit_insert_common` — extending an `esplit` by a common consumable entry in both halves and the result.
- The `TNil`, `TNew`, and `TPar` cases of a `typeCheck_weaken` lemma. The `TPar` case reuses `tEnv_split_esplit` to derive freshness of the new name in both halves and constructs the extended split via `esplit_tEnv_split` + `esplit_insert_common`.

Important correction found while proving the binder cases: a weakening/renaming lemma cannot hold for an arbitrary fresh name `b`, because `b` may coincide with a binder already present in the process (even if `b ∉ domain g`). The correct statement must carry the invariant `~ In b (bv q)` (or an equivalent shifted-binder invariant). This matches the intended `dep_relabel` use: shifted binders are `(h, i + max)` and are distinct from the new binder image by injectivity of the shifting map.

So the revised next lemma is:

```coq
Lemma typeCheck_weaken : forall g pf q,
  NoDup (domain g) ->
  typeCheck g pf q ->
  forall b tb,
    ~ In b (domain g) ->
    ~ In b (bv q) ->
    consumable tb ->
    forall pf', typeCheck ((b,vis,tb)::g) pf' q.
```

The `TNil`/`TNew`/`TPar` proofs carry over with the extra `bv` hypothesis (the `TNew` case uses `bv (dNu n p) = bv p`, the `TPar` case the append decomposition). The remaining binder cases (`TInL`, `TInUn`, `TInU`, `TOutL`, `TOutUn`) use this invariant to exclude binder capture. After weakening, `pmap_rename_fresh` follows from `pmap_typing` with `tb = wk_type t`; then `dep_relabel`/`newEntries` and the `lts` induction remain.

Lemma InB_complete : forall g a f t,
  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((a,f),t) g -> InB a g = ((f,t),true).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH]; intros a f t Hnd Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. contradiction.
  - destruct h as [[b fb] tb]. simpl in *.
    destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
    + inversion Hin as [Heq|Hin_tl].
      * inversion Heq; subst. reflexivity.
      * exfalso. apply pair_eq_true in E. subst a.
        apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. apply (proj1 Hnd).
        exact (in_dom_entry tl b f t Hin_tl).
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hb Hnd].
      destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin_tl].
      * exfalso. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * apply (IH a f t Hnd Hin_tl).
Qed.

Lemma shifted_not_in_g : forall g a1 a2 m,
  a2 > 0 -> m >= max (domain g) -> ~ In (a1, a2 + m) (domain g).
Proof.
  intros g a1 a2 m Hpos Hm Hin.
  pose proof (proj1 (max_le_spec (domain g) (max (domain g))) (le_n (max (domain g)))
                a1 (a2 + m) Hin).
  lia.
Qed.

Lemma In_newEntries : forall g l m a f t,
  In a l -> ~ In a (domain g) ->
  InB (fst a, snd a - m) g = ((f,t),true) ->
  In ((a,f),t) (newEntries g l m).
Proof.
  intros g l. induction l as [|h tl IH]; intros m a f t Hin Hnot Hlook.
  - contradiction.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].

      destruct b.
      * apply (IH m a f t Hin Hnot Hlook).
      * simpl. right. apply (IH m a f t Hin Hnot Hlook).

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.

Section Utilities.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
  - split.
    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
    + intros _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Section PairEq.

Definition pair_eq (p1 p2 : name * name) :=
    (fst p1 =? fst p2) && (snd p1 =? snd p2).

Fixpoint In2 a l :=
    match l with
    | nil => false
    | b :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then true else In2 a m
    end.

End PairEq.

Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInU : forall u p t x q pf1 pf2,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf2 ->
      typeCheck ( (x, vis, t) :: g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dBang (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q).

End TypeSystemRules.

Lemma pmap_typing : forall q,
  (forall g x b t t1 t2 f pf pf',
    x <> b -> f <> hid -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
    snd x < max (domain ((b,f,t1) :: g)) ->
    NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t) :: (b,f,t1) :: g)) ->
    typeCheck ((x,vis,t) :: (b,f,t1) :: g) pf q ->
    typeCheck ((b,vis,t2) :: g) pf' (pmap q (fst x) (snd x) (fst b) (snd b))).
Proof.
  induction q as [| u1 u2 z1 z2 q IHq | q1 IH1 q2 IH2 | n1 n2 q IHq | u1 u2 z1 z2 q IHq | u1 u2 v1 v2 q IHq];
    intros g x b t t1 t2 f pf pf' Hxb Hf Htp Hmx Hnd Hty.
  - (* dZero *)
    simpl. inversion Hty; subst. apply TNil. apply cons_spec. intros n f0 t0 Hin.
    simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. apply (consumable_plus t1 t).
      * eapply cons_entry; [exact H | simpl; right; left; reflexivity].
      * eapply cons_entry; [exact H | simpl; left; reflexivity].
      * exact Htp.
    + apply (cons_entry _ _ H n f0 t0). simpl; right; right; exact Hin.
  - (* dBang *)
    inversion Hty; subst.
    match goal with H : typeCheck ((x0,vis,t0)::(x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) _ q |- _ => rename H into Hbody end.
    match goal with H : cons (vis_proj ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) ++ ill_proj ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) _ |- _ => rename H into Hcons end.
    match goal with H : snd x0 < max (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) |- _ => rename H into Hmax0 end.
    match goal with H : ~ In x0 (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) |- _ => rename H into Hfresh end.
    match goal with H : In (u,vis,Chan un p t0) ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) |- _ => rename H into Hin end.
    match goal with H : isMap ((x0,vis,t0)::(x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) |- _ => rename H into Hpf1 end.
    match goal with H : p = io \/ p = inp |- _ => rename H into Hpol end.
    destruct (pair_eq u x) eqn:Eux.
    + (* u = x *)
      apply pair_eq_true in Eux; subst u.
      assert (Ht : t = Chan un p t0).
      { assert (He : ((x,vis),t) = ((x,vis),Chan un p t0)).
        { apply (nodup_entry_unique ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) x vis t x vis (Chan un p t0) Hnd
                  (or_introl eq_refl) Hin eq_refl). }
        exact (f_equal (fun e : ((name*name)*flag)*piType => snd e) He). }
      subst t.
      destruct (type_plus_second_un t1 p t0 t2 Htp) as [q0 [Et1 Et2]]. subst t1 t2.
      simpl.
      assert (Hmv : mv (fst x, snd x) (fst x, snd x) (fst b, snd b) = (fst b, snd b))
        by (apply mv_eq; apply pair_eq_refl).
      rewrite Hmv. simpl.
      destruct (nodup_E_bounds x b g (Chan un p t0) f (Chan un q0 t0) Hnd) as [Hnotxg Hnotbg].
      assert (Hndg : NoDup (domain g)).
      { pose proof Hnd as H'. simpl in H'. apply NoDup_cons_iff in H'. destruct H' as [_ H'].
        apply NoDup_cons_iff in H'. exact (proj2 H'). }
      assert (ndW : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,Chan un (pol_cup q0 p) t0)::g))).
      { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hnotbg|exact Hndg]. }
      assert (Hx0b : x0 <> b).
Lemma pmap_rename_fresh : forall q,
  (forall g x b t pf pf',
    x <> b ->
    ~ In b (domain g) ->
    ~ In b (bv q) ->
    NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::g)) ->
    snd x < max (domain ((b,vis,wk_type t)::g)) ->
    typeCheck ((x,vis,t)::g) pf q ->
    typeCheck ((b,vis,t)::g) pf' (pmap q (fst x) (snd x) (fst b) (snd b))).
Proof.
  intros q g x b t pf pf' Hxb Hb Hbv Hnd Hmx Hty.
  assert (Hbx : b <> x) by (intro Heq; apply Hxb; symmetry; exact Heq).
  assert (Hb_xenv : ~ In b (domain ((x,vis,t)::g))).
  { intro Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
    - apply Hxb. exact Heq.
    - exact (Hb Hc). }
  assert (ndB : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,wk_type t)::(x,vis,t)::g))).
  { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb_xenv|exact Hnd]. }
  assert (Hweak : typeCheck ((b,vis,wk_type t)::(x,vis,t)::g) (isMap_nodup _ ndB) q)
    by (exact (typeCheck_weaken ((x,vis,t)::g) pf q Hnd Hty b (wk_type t) Hb_xenv Hbv (consumable_wk t) (isMap_nodup _ ndB))).
  assert (P : Permutation ((b,vis,wk_type t)::(x,vis,t)::g) ((x,vis,t)::(b,vis,wk_type t)::g))
    by (apply perm_swap).
  assert (ndX : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,vis,wk_type t)::g)))
    by (apply (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ P); exact ndB).
  assert (HX : typeCheck ((x,vis,t)::(b,vis,wk_type t)::g) (isMap_nodup _ ndX) q)
    by (apply (typeCheck_perm ((b,vis,wk_type t)::(x,vis,t)::g)
                 ((x,vis,t)::(b,vis,wk_type t)::g) q
                 (isMap_nodup _ ndB) (isMap_nodup _ ndX) ndB P Hweak)).
  exact (pmap_typing q g x b t (wk_type t) t vis
           (isMap_nodup _ ndX) pf' Hxb (fun Hh => match Hh with end) (type_plus_wk t) Hmx ndX HX).
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_add_entry_consumable : forall g pf p,

    ~ In xn (bv p) ->
    forall pf', typeCheck ((xn,fx,tx)::g) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g pf p Hnd H. induction H; intros xn fx tx Hc Hx Hbv pf'.
  - (* TNil *) apply TNil. apply (cons_insert_flag g pf xn fx tx H Hc pf').
  - (* TNew *)
    assert (Hn_g : In n (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid)(t:=t); exact H).
    assert (Hnx : xn <> n).
    { intro Heq. apply Hx. rewrite Heq. exact Hn_g. }
    assert (Hx_rem : ~ In xn (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. apply Hx.
      exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g xn) Hcc)). }
    assert (Hn_not_rem : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. exact (proj2 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g n) Hcc) eq_refl). }
    assert (ndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd).

Definition wk_type (t : piType) : piType :=
  match t with
  | Chan lin p t0 => Chan lin empty t0
  | Chan un p t0 => Chan un p t0
  | Top => Top
  end.

Lemma type_plus_wk : forall t, type_plus (wk_type t) t t.
Proof.
  intros t. destruct t as [m p t0|]; simpl.
  - destruct m.
    + apply Tp_LinPlus. apply Pp_emptyL.
    + assert (H : type_plus (Chan un p t0) (Chan un p t0) (Chan un (pol_cup p p) t0))
        by apply Tp_UnPlus.
      rewrite (pol_cup_idem p) in H. exact H.
  - apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma consumable_wk : forall t, consumable (wk_type t).
Proof.
  intros t. destruct t as [m p t0|]; simpl.
  - destruct m; [apply consumable_lin_empty | apply consumable_un].

Lemma esplit_tEnv_split : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
    NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
    esplit g1 g2 g3 -> tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.
Proof.
  intros g1. induction g1 as [|e tl IH]; intros g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 nd1 nd2 nd3 Hes.
  - (* g1 = nil *)
    destruct Hes as [HA [HB HC]].
    destruct g2 as [|h2 t2].
    + destruct g3 as [|h3 t3].
      * apply SpNil; auto.
      * exfalso. destruct h3 as [[x fx] tx]. simpl in HB.
        assert (Hin : In x (domain (((x,fx),tx)::t3))) by (simpl; left; auto).
        assert (Hin0 : In x (domain nil)) by (apply (proj2 (HB x)); exact Hin).
        simpl in Hin0. exact Hin0.
    + exfalso. destruct h2 as [[x fx] tx].
      assert (Hin : In x (domain (((x,fx),tx)::t2))) by (simpl; left; auto).
      assert (Hin0 : In x (domain nil)) by (apply (proj2 (HA x)); exact Hin).
      simpl in Hin0. exact Hin0.
  - (* g1 = e :: tl *)
    destruct e as [[n f] t].
    simpl in nd1. apply NoDup_cons_iff in nd1. destruct nd1 as [Hnotn Hndtl].
    destruct Hes as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (Hn1 : In n (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
    assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hn1).
    assert (Hn3 : In n (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hn2).
    destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g2 n Hn2) as [f2 [t2 H2]].
    destruct (HC n f t f2 t2 (or_introl eq_refl) H2) as [f3 [t3 [H3 Hcomb]]].
    (* restricted esplit *)
    assert (Hes' : esplit tl (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3)).
    { unfold esplit. split.
      - intros x; split; intro Hx.
        + assert (Hx1 : In x (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; right; exact Hx).
          assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (Hnotn Hx)).
          assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA x)); exact Hx1).
          apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x)). split; auto.
        + assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact Hx).
          assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g2 nd2 Hn2 Hx)).
          assert (Hx1 : In x (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (apply (proj2 (HA x)); exact Hx2).
          simpl in Hx1. destruct Hx1 as [Hxn'|Hxt]; [exfalso; apply Hxn; symmetry; exact Hxn'|exact Hxt].
      - split.
        + intros x; split; intro Hx.
          * assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact Hx).
            assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g2 nd2 Hn2 Hx)).
            assert (Hx3 : In x (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB x)); exact Hx2).
            apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g3 nd3 Hn3 x)). split; auto.
          * assert (Hx3 : In x (domain g3)) by (apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact Hx).
            assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g3 nd3 Hn3 Hx)).
            assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply (proj2 (HB x)); exact Hx3).
            apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x)). split; auto.
        + intros x a1 b1 a2 b2 He1 He2.
          assert (He1' : In ((x,a1),b1) (((n,f),t)::tl)) by (simpl; right; exact He1).
          assert (He2' : In ((x,a2),b2) g2) by (eapply in_removeEntry_elim; eauto).

Lemma max_le_spec : forall l m, max l <= m <-> (forall a x, In (a,x) l -> x <= m).
Proof.
  intros l. induction l as [|h t IH]; intros m.
  - simpl. split; intros HH. { intros a x Hin; simpl in Hin; destruct Hin. } lia.
  - destruct h as [a x]. simpl.
    remember (max t) as mt eqn:E.
    destruct (x <? mt) eqn:Elt.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in Elt.
      split.
      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
      * intros H. apply (proj2 (IH m)). intros a0 x0 Hin. apply (H a0 x0). right; exact Hin.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in Elt.
      split.
      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
      * intros H. apply (H a x). left; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma max_perm : forall l l', Permutation l l' -> max l = max l'.
Proof.
  intros l l' Hp. apply Nat.le_antisymm.
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l (max l'))). intros a x Hin.
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l' (max l')) (le_n (max l')) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) Hp Hin)).
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l' (max l))). intros a x Hin.
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l (max l)) (le_n (max l)) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hin)).
Qed.

Lemma max_cons_lt : forall (x:name*name) l, snd x < max l -> max (x :: l) = max l.
Proof.
  intros [x1 x2] l H. cbn in H. cbn [max].
  destruct (x2 <? max l) eqn:E.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply Nat.ltb_ge in E. exfalso. lia.
Qed.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with

Lemma nodup_cons_step : forall n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf1 pf2 pf3,
  NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In n (domain g1) -> In n (domain g2) -> In n (domain g3) ->
  NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g1)) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g2)) ->
  tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
  NoDup (domain g1) /\ NoDup (domain g2).
Proof.
  intros n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf1 pf2 pf3 Hnd3 Hn1 Hn2 Hn3 Hndr1 Hndr2 Hspl Hrem.
  assert (Hnd3' : NoDup (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3).
  assert (Hnotin3 : ~ In n (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_removeEntry_still; auto).
  pose proof (tEnv_split_esplit _ _ _ _ _ _ Hspl) as Hes.
  destruct Hes as [HA [HB HC]].
  assert (Hnot1 : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g1))).
  { intro Hc. apply Hnotin3. apply (proj1 (HB n)). apply (proj1 (HA n) Hc). }
  assert (Hnot2 : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g2))).
  { intro Hc. apply Hnotin3. apply (proj1 (HB n)). exact Hc. }
  split.
  - apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (n :: domain (removeEntry n g1)) (domain g1)).
    + apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hn1.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; auto.
  - apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (n :: domain (removeEntry n g2)) (domain g2)).
    + apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hn2.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_nodup : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
  NoDup (domain g1) /\ NoDup (domain g2).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 H.
  induction H as [g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Eg1 Eg2 Eg3
                  | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hpq Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
                  | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
                  | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty]; intro Hnd3.
  - subst. split; constructor.
  - (* SpLin *) 
    apply (nodup_cons_step n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hnd3).
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Chan lin p t); exact Hi1.
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=g) (t:=Chan lin q t); exact Hi2.
    + destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n (Chan lin p' t) Hty) as [fz Hz]; apply in_dom_entry with (f:=fz) (t:=Chan lin p' t); exact Hz.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + exact Hrec.
    + exact Hrem.
  - (* SpUn *)
    apply (nodup_cons_step n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hnd3).
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Chan un p t); exact Hi1.
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=g) (t:=Chan un p t); exact Hi2.
    + destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n (Chan un p t) Hty) as [fz Hz]; apply in_dom_entry with (f:=fz) (t:=Chan un p t); exact Hz.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + exact Hrec.
    + exact Hrem.
  - (* SpTop *)
    apply (nodup_cons_step n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hnd3).
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Top); exact Hi1.
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=g) (t:=Top); exact Hi2.
    + destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n Top Hty) as [fz Hz]; apply in_dom_entry with (f:=fz) (t:=Top); exact Hz.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + exact Hrec.
    + exact Hrem.
Qed.

Require Export compat.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat Classical.

Section PairOperations.

End PairOperations.

Section ListOperations.

Fixpoint disjoint {A} (l1 l2 : list A) : Prop :=
    match l1 with
    | nil => True
    | x::t1 => ((In x l2) -> False) /\ disjoint t1 l2
    end.

Inductive  disjoint_2 {A}: list A -> list A -> Prop :=
  | dis_nil : forall l : list A, disjoint_2 nil l
  | dis_cons : forall (x:A) (l1 l2 : list A),
      (~ In x l2 /\ disjoint_2 l1 l2) -> disjoint_2 (x::l1) l2.

End  ListOperations.

26	    end.
27	
28	Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
29	    match m1, m2 with
30	    | lin, lin | un, un => true
31	    | _, _ => false
32	    end.
33	
34	Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
35	    match t1, t2 with
36	    | Top, Top => true
37	    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
38	      if mode_eq m1 m2
39	      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
40	      else false
41	    | _, _ => false
42	    end.
43	
44	Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
45	    match f1, f2 with
46	    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
47	    | _, _  => false
48	    end.
49	
50	Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
51	    match g with
52	    | nil => nil
53	    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
54	      if pair_eq x y
55	      then
56	        tail
57	      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
58	    end.
59	
60	Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
61	  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
62	      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.
63	
64	Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
65	  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
66	      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.
67	
68	Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
69	    match p1, p2 with
70	    | empty, _ => p2
71	    | io, _ => io
72	    | _, io => io
73	    | out, inp => io
74	    | out, _ => out
75	    | inp, out => io
76	    | inp, _ => inp
77	    end.
78	
79	Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
80	  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
81	  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
82	  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
83	  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.
84	
85	Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
86	  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
87	  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
88	      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
89	      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
90	  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
91	      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).
92	
93	Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
94	    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.
95	
96	Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
97	    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.
98	
99	Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
100	  | Ts_id : forall t,
101	      type_sub t t
102	  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
103	      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
104	  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
105	      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
106	  | Ts_out : forall m t,
107	      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).
108	
109	Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
110	    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).
111	
112	Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
113	  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
114	  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
115	  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
116	  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.
117	
118	Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
119	            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
120	  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
121	            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
122	  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
123	      flag_plus f g f'->
124	      pol_plus p q p' ->
125	      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
126	      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
127	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
128	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
129	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
130	      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
131	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
132	  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
133	      flag_plus f g f'->
134	      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
135	      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
136	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
137	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
138	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
139	      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
140	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
141	  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
142	      flag_plus f g f'->
143	      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
144	      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
145	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
146	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
147	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
148	      typeOf g3 n Top ->
149	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.
150	
151	Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
152	    match g with
153	    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
154	    | nil => nil
155	    end.
156	
157	Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
158	    match g with
159	    | nil => nil
160	    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
161	      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
162	    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
163	       hid_proj m
164	    end.
165	
166	Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
167	    match g with
168	    | nil => nil
169	    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
170	      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
171	    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
172	       vis_proj m
173	    end.
174	
175	Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
176	    match g with
177	    | nil => nil
178	    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>
179	      (a1, a2, ill, t) :: ill_proj m
180	    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
181	       ill_proj m
182	    end.
183	
184	End TypeSystem.

5	Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
6	  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
7	  | Co_top : forall n pf',
8	      typeOf g n Top ->
9	      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
10	      cons g pf
11	  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',

14	      cons g pf
15	  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',

17	      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
18	      cons g pf.
19	
20	Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
21	  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
22	  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
23	      In (n, hid, t) g ->
24	      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
25	      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
26	  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
27	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
28	      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
29	      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
30	      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
31	  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
32	      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
33	      type_remove t' t t2 ->
34	      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->

36	      typeCheck
37	        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
38	      typeCheck
39	        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
40	  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
41	      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
42	      type_remove t' t t2 ->
43	      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
44	      In (v, vis, t') g ->
45	      typeCheck
46	        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
47	      typeCheck
48	        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)

52	      ~In x (domain g) ->
53	      snd x < max (domain g) ->
54	      typeCheck
55	        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
56	      typeCheck

59	      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
60	      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
61	      ~In x (domain g) ->
62	      snd x < max (domain g) ->
63	      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
64	      typeCheck
65	        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)

1	Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
2	From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
3	Require Import pairEq operations header.
4	Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.
5	
6	Section Utilities.
7	
8	Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
9	Proof.
10	  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
11	  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
12	Qed.
13	
14	Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
15	Proof.
16	  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
17	  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
18	  - split.
19	    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
20	    + intros _; reflexivity.
21	Qed.
22	
23	Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
24	Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.
25	
26	Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
27	Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.
28	
29	Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
30	Proof.
31	  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
32	  - simpl. auto.
33	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
34	    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
35	    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
36	    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
37	Qed.
38	
39	Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
40	Proof.
41	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
42	  - simpl. reflexivity.
43	  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
44	    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
45	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
46	    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
47	Qed.
48	
49	Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
50	    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
51	Proof.
52	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
53	  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
54	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
55	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
56	    + simpl. right; exact H.
57	    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
58	      * left; exact Heq.
59	      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
60	Qed.
61	
62	Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
63	    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
64	Proof.
65	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
66	  - simpl. auto.
67	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
68	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
69	    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
70	      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
71	      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
72	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
73	      * exact Hin.
74	      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
75	Qed.
76	
77	Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
78	    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
79	Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.
80	
81	Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
82	    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
83	Proof.
84	  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
85	Qed.
86	
87	Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
88	    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
89	Proof.
90	  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
91	  - reflexivity.
92	  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
93	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
94	    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
95	      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
96	      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
97	      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
98	    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
99	      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
100	      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
101	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
102	        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
103	        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
104	      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
105	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
106	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
107	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
108	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
109	        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
110	Qed.
111	
112	Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
113	    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
114	Proof.
115	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
116	  - simpl. auto.
117	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x H.
118	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E; simpl in *.
119	    + auto.
120	    + destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.
121	Qed.
122	
123	Lemma domain_removeEntry_neq : forall y g x,
124	    x <> y -> In x (domain g) -> In x (domain (removeEntry y g)).
125	Proof.
126	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
127	  - simpl. auto.
128	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x Hne Hin.
129	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
130	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
131	      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. rewrite <- Heq. exact E.
132	      * simpl. left. exact Heq.
133	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
134	      * exact Hin.
135	      * simpl. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec z x) as [Heq2|Hne2].
136	        -- left; exact Heq2.
137	        -- right. apply IH; auto.
138	Qed.
139	
140	Lemma NoDup_domain_removeEntry : forall y g,
141	    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry y g)).
142	Proof.
143	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
144	  - simpl. auto.
145	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intro Hnd.
146	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
147	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
148	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; auto.
149	    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
150	      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. eapply domain_removeEntry_sub; eauto.
151	      * apply IH; auto.
152	Qed.
153	
154	Lemma NoDup_removeEntry_still : forall y g,
155	    NoDup (domain g) -> In y (domain g) -> ~ In y (domain (removeEntry y g)).
156	Proof.
157	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
158	  - simpl. auto.
159	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros Hnd Hin.
160	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
161	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
162	    + subst. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
163	    + simpl. destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
164	      * apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
165	      * intro Hc. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
166	        -- apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
167	        -- exact (IH Hnd Hin Hc).
168	Qed.
169	
170	Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
171	    NoDup (domain g) ->
172	    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
173	    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
174	Proof.
175	  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
176	  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
177	  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
178	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
179	    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
180	    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
181	    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
182	      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
183	      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
184	    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
185	      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
186	      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
187	    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.
188	Qed.
189	
190	Lemma isMap_nodup : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> isMap g.
191	Proof.
192	  intros g Hnd. unfold isMap. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
193	  assert (H := nodup_entry_unique g x f1 t1 x f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 eq_refl).
194	  inversion H. auto.
195	Qed.
196	
197	Lemma isMap_removeEntry : forall y g, isMap g -> isMap (removeEntry y g).
198	Proof.
199	  intros y g Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
200	  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
201	  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f1 t1 H1).
202	  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f2 t2 H2).
203	Qed.
204	
205	Lemma isMap_sub : forall g1 g2, isMap g2 ->
206	    (forall x f t, In ((x,f),t) g1 -> In ((x,f),t) g2) -> isMap g1.
207	Proof.
208	  intros g1 g2 Hm Hsub. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
209	  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split; auto.
210	Qed.
211	
212	Fixpoint lookup (n : name * name) (g : typeEnv) : option (flag * piType) :=
213	  match g with
214	  | nil => None
215	  | (x,f,t) :: tl => if pair_eq x n then Some (f,t) else lookup n tl
216	  end.
217	
218	Lemma lookup_Some_In : forall n g f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
219	Proof.
220	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
221	  - simpl. intros f t H; discriminate.
222	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intros f t H.
223	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
224	    + inversion H; subst. apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. simpl. left; auto.
225	    + simpl. right. apply IH; exact H.
226	Qed.
227	
228	Lemma lookup_None_notin : forall n g, lookup n g = None -> ~ In n (domain g).
229	Proof.
230	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
231	  - simpl. auto.
232	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intro H.
233	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
234	    + discriminate.
235	    + simpl. intros [Heq|Hin].
236	      * apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
237	      * apply IH; auto.
238	Qed.
239	
240	Lemma In_lookup_Some : forall n g, In n (domain g) -> exists f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t).
241	Proof.
242	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
243	  - intros H. simpl in H. exfalso; exact H.
244	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intros [Heq|Hin].
245	    + rewrite <- Heq. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. eauto.
246	    + destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
247	      * exists fx, tx; auto.
248	      * apply IH; auto.

295	Lemma cons_entry : forall g pf, cons g pf ->
296	    forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t.
297	Proof.
298	  intros g pf H.
299	  induction H as [g pf Eg | g pf n pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n p t pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n t pf' Ht Hc IH].
300	  - subst; intros; contradiction.
301	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
302	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
303	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
304	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n Top Ht) as [f0 Htop].
305	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
306	      unfold isMap in Him.
307	      destruct (Him n f0 Top f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
308	      subst t0. apply consumable_top.
309	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
310	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
311	      * exact Hin.
312	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
313	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
314	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
315	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan un p t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
316	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
317	      unfold isMap in Him.
318	      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan un p t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
319	      subst t0. apply consumable_un.
320	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
321	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
322	      * exact Hin.
323	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
324	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
325	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
326	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan lin empty t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
327	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
328	      unfold isMap in Him.
329	      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan lin empty t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
330	      subst t0. apply consumable_lin_empty.
331	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
332	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
333	      * exact Hin.
334	Qed.

336	Lemma entry_cons : forall g pf,
337	    (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t) -> cons g pf.
338	Proof.
339	  intros g. remember (length g) as k eqn:Ek. revert g Ek.
340	  induction k as [|k IH]; intros g Ek pf Hall.
341	  - destruct g as [|h tl].
342	    + apply Co_nil; auto.
343	    + simpl in Ek. discriminate.
344	  - destruct g as [|h tl].
345	    + apply Co_nil; auto.
346	    + destruct h as [[n f] t].
347	      pose proof (Hall n f t (or_introl eq_refl)) as Hc.
348	      assert (Hin : In n (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
349	      assert (Hpf' : isMap (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (apply isMap_removeEntry; exact pf).
350	      assert (Hlen : length (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) = k).
351	      { rewrite length_removeEntry; [|exact Hin]. simpl in Ek. simpl. lia. }
352	      assert (Hall' : forall n0 f0 t0, In ((n0,f0),t0) (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) -> consumable t0).
353	      { intros n0 f0 t0 H0. apply (Hall n0 f0 t0). apply in_removeEntry_elim with (y:=n). exact H0. }
354	      assert (Hrec : cons (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) Hpf').
355	      { apply (IH (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) (eq_sym Hlen) Hpf' Hall'). }
356	      destruct Hc as [Ht | [[p [t' Ht]] | [t' Ht]]].
357	      * subst t.
358	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Top)::tl) n Top).
359	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Top)::tl) n f Top). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
360	        exact (Co_top (((n,f),Top)::tl) pf n Hpf' HTy Hrec).
361	      * subst t.
362	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n (Chan un p t')).
363	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n f (Chan un p t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
364	        exact (Co_un (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) pf n p t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
365	      * subst t.
366	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n (Chan lin empty t')).
367	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n f (Chan lin empty t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
368	        exact (Co_lin (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) pf n t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
369	Qed.

615	  forall (f1 f2 f : flag) ta ta' tb1 tb2 t t1 t2,
616	    ecomb (vis,ta) (vis,ta') (vis,t) ->
617	    ecomb (f1,tb1) (f2,tb2) (f,t1) ->
618	    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
619	    exists t21 t22, type_plus tb1 ta t21 /\ type_plus tb2 ta' t22 /\ type_plus t21 t22 t2 /\ ecomb (vis,t21) (vis,t22) (vis,t2).

666	Lemma removeEntry_perm : forall n g g', Permutation g g' -> NoDup (domain g) ->
667	  Permutation (removeEntry n g) (removeEntry n g').
668	Proof.
669	  intros n g g' Hp. induction Hp as [|x l l' Hp IH | x y l | l l' l'' Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2]; intro Hnd.
670	  - apply perm_nil.
671	  - destruct x as [[a f] t]. cbn [removeEntry].
672	    destruct (pair_eq a n) eqn:E.
673	    + exact Hp.
674	    + apply perm_skip. apply IH. simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; exact (proj2 Hnd).
675	  - destruct x as [[ax fx] tx], y as [[ay fy] ty]. cbn [removeEntry].
676	    simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; destruct Hnd as [Hnoty Hnd].
677	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; destruct Hnd as [Hnotx Hndl].
678	    destruct (pair_eq ay n) eqn:Ey; destruct (pair_eq ax n) eqn:Ex; simpl.
679	    + exfalso. apply Hnoty. simpl. left.
680	      apply pair_eq_true in Ey. apply pair_eq_true in Ex.
681	      rewrite Ex, <- Ey. reflexivity.
682	    + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_refl.
683	    + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_refl.
684	    + apply perm_swap.
685	  - apply perm_trans with (l' := removeEntry n l').
686	    + apply IH1; exact Hnd.
687	    + apply IH2. apply (NoDup_domain_perm l l' Hp1 Hnd).
688	Qed.

711	Lemma max_le_spec : forall l m, max l <= m <-> (forall a x, In (a,x) l -> x <= m).
712	Proof.
713	  intros l. induction l as [|h t IH]; intros m.
714	  - simpl. split; intros HH. { intros a x Hin; simpl in Hin; destruct Hin. } lia.
715	  - destruct h as [a x]. simpl.
716	    remember (max t) as mt eqn:E.
717	    destruct (x <? mt) eqn:Elt.
718	    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in Elt.
719	      split.
720	      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
721	        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
722	        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
723	           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
724	      * intros H. apply (proj2 (IH m)). intros a0 x0 Hin. apply (H a0 x0). right; exact Hin.
725	    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in Elt.
726	      split.
727	      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
728	        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
729	        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
730	           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
731	      * intros H. apply (H a x). left; reflexivity.
732	Qed.

737	    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l' (max l')) (le_n (max l')) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) Hp Hin)).
738	  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l' (max l))). intros a x Hin.
739	    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l (max l)) (le_n (max l)) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hin)).

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task.

(* flag_plus can produce `ill` only from ill+ill *)
Lemma flag_plus_ill_result : forall f1 f2 : flag,
    flag_plus f1 f2 ill -> f1 = ill /\ f2 = ill.
Proof.
  intros f1 f2 H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

(* The type produced by an ecomb is the type_plus of its two components. *)
Lemma ecomb_type_plus : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> type_plus t1 t2 t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t H.
  destruct H as [a1 a2 a3 Hfp | a1 a2 a3 p q Hfp | a1 a2 a3 p1 p2 p q Hfp Hpp].
  - apply Tp_Base.
  - pose proof (Tp_UnPlus p p q) as Htp. rewrite pol_cup_idem in Htp. exact Htp.
  - apply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hpp.
Qed.

(* Consumability is preserved by combining two consumable components. *)
Lemma ecomb_consumable : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) ->
    consumable t1 -> consumable t2 -> consumable t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t Hec H1 H2.
  apply (consumable_plus t1 t2 t H1 H2).
  apply ecomb_type_plus with (f1:=f1) (f2:=f2) (f:=f). exact Hec.
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_ill_consumable : forall g pf p,
    typeCheck g pf p ->
    forall n t, In ((n,ill),t) g -> consumable t.
Proof.

    | g pf pb n t pf1 Hi Hbody IHb
    | g pf g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2 Hspl Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t1 t2 pf1 Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t2 pf1 Hpol Hr Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q t1 pf1 Hr Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb

Lemma typeCheck_add_entries_consumable : forall es g pf p,
  NoDup (domain (es ++ g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g) ->
  typeCheck g pf p ->
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) es -> consumable t) ->
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) es -> ~ In n (domain g)) ->
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) es -> ~ In n (bv p)) ->
  forall pf', typeCheck (es ++ g) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros es. induction es as [|[ [n f] t] tl IH]; intros g pf p HndAll Hndg Hty Hcons Hfresh Hfreshbv pf'.
  - simpl. exact Hty.
  - simpl in HndAll. apply NoDup_cons_iff in HndAll. destruct HndAll as [Hnotin Hndtail].
    assert (Htytl : typeCheck (tl ++ g) pf p).
    { apply (IH g pf p Hndtail Hndg Hty).
      - intros n0 f0 t0 Hin. apply Hcons with (n:=n0)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin.
      - intros n0 f0 t0 Hin. apply Hfresh with (n:=n0)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin.
      - intros n0 f0 t0 Hin. apply Hfreshbv with (n:=n0)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin. }
    apply (typeCheck_add_entry_consumable (tl ++ g) pf p Hndtail Htytl n f t).
    + apply Hcons with (n:=n)(f:=f)(t:=t). left; reflexivity.
    + exact Hnotin.
    + apply Hfreshbv with (n:=n)(f:=f)(t:=t). left; reflexivity.
    + exact pf'.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma weakenEnv_cons_proj : forall g pf,
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> f <> hid -> consumable t) ->
  cons (vis_proj (weakenEnv g) ++ ill_proj (weakenEnv g)) pf.
Proof.
  intros g pf Hc. apply cons_proj_of. intros n f t Hin Hf.
  destruct (In_weakenEnv_cases g n f t Hin) as [[Hing Hfh]|Hcase].
  - apply (Hc n f t Hing Hfh).
  - destruct Hcase as [t0 [Ef [Et Hing]]]. subst f t. apply consumable_wk.
Qed.
Lemma ecomb_hid_l : forall t1 f2 t2 f t,
  ecomb (hid,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> f = hid.
Proof.
  intros t1 f2 t2 f t H. inversion H; subst.
  all: match goal with Hf : flag_plus hid ?a ?b |- _ => inversion Hf; subst; reflexivity end.
