1	Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.
2	
3	Notation name  := nat.
4	
5	Section ProcessDefinitions.
6	
7	Inductive dproc : Set :=
8	  | dZero : dproc
9	  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
10	  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
11	  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
12	  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
13	  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.
14	
15	Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
16	    match p with
17	    | dZero  => nil
18	    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
19	    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p
20	    | dNu h i  p =>  secLabs p ++ (h, i) :: nil
21	    end.
22	
23	Fixpoint fn (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
24	    match p with
25	    | dZero  => nil
26	    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
27	    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
28	      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)
29	    | dPar p1 p2 =>
30	      fn p1 ++  fn p2
31	    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
32	      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
33	    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
34	      (x1, x2) :: (y1, y2) :: fn p
35	    end.
36	
37	Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
38	    match p with
39	    | dZero  =>
40	      nil
41	    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
42	    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
43	      (y1, y2) :: bv p
44	    | dPar p1 p2 =>
45	      bv p1 ++  bv p2
46	    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
47	      bv p
48	    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
49	      bv p
50	    end.
51	
52	Definition wf (p : dproc) : Prop :=
53	    NoDup (secLabs p) /\ disjoint (fn p) (secLabs p).
54	
55	Definition pos l := forall x1 x2 : nat,
56	      In (x1, x2) l-> x2 > 0.
57	
58	Definition sl_pos p := pos (secLabs p).
59	
60	Definition mv (py pz pv : name * name)  :=
61	    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
62	    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
63	    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in
64	    if (y1 =? z1) && (y2 =? z2)
65	    then (v1, v2)
66	    else (y1, y2).
67	
68	Fixpoint pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2 :=
69	    match p with
70	    | dZero  =>  p
71	    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 q =>
72	      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
73	      dBang (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2 (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
74	    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  q =>
75	      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
76	      dInp (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2  (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
77	    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
78	      let r1 := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
79	      let r2 := mv (y1, y2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
80	      dOut  (fst r1) (snd r1) (fst r2) (snd r2) (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2)
81	    | dPar p q =>
82	      dPar (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2) (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
83	    | dNu h i q =>
84	      dNu h i (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
85	    end.
86	
87	Definition map_nat_nat := list (nat * nat).
88	
89	Fixpoint  domain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
90	    match m with
91	    | nil => nil
92	    | (k, _) :: t => k :: (domain_projection t)
93	    end.
94	
95	Fixpoint  codomain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
96	    match m with
97	    | nil => nil
98	    | (_, v) :: t => v :: (codomain_projection t)
99	    end.
100	
101	Definition structure_is_map (m : map_nat_nat) :=
102	    NoDup (domain_projection m).
103	
104	Fixpoint max (l :list (nat*nat)) : nat :=
105	    match l with
106	    | nil => 0
107	    | (_, x) :: t => let m := max t in
108	                     if x <? m then m else x
109	    end.
110	
111	Notation dp := domain_projection.
112	
113	Notation cp := codomain_projection.
114	
115	Local Definition no_dup_cont (h : nat * nat) (t : list (nat * nat))
116	    (pf : NoDup (h :: t)) : NoDup t := ltac:(inversion pf; assumption).
117	
118	Local Opaque no_dup_cont.
119	
120	Fixpoint dep_map_gen_r (l :list (name * name)) (m : nat) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
121	    match l with
122	    | nil => fun _ => nil
123	    | h :: t =>
124	      fun pf : NoDup (h :: t)  =>
125	        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
126	    end.
127	
128	Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
129	    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).
130	
131	Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
132	    match p with
133	    | dZero   => fun _  => p
134	    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
135	      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
136	    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
137	      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
138	    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
139	      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
140	    | dPar p q =>
141	      fun pf : NoDup s =>
142	        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
143	    | dNu h i p =>
144	      fun pf : NoDup s =>
145	        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
146	    end.
147	
148	End ProcessDefinitions.
149

1	Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.
2	
3	Section TypeSystem.
4	
5	Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.
6	
7	Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.
8	
9	Inductive piType : Set :=
10	  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
11	  | Top : piType.
12	
13	Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.
14	
15	Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
16	    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
17	      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
18	      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.
19	
20	Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).
21	
22	Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
23	    match p1, p2 with
24	    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
25	    | _, _  => false
26	    end.
27	
28	Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
29	    match m1, m2 with
30	    | lin, lin | un, un => true
31	    | _, _ => false
32	    end.
33	
34	Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
35	    match t1, t2 with
36	    | Top, Top => true
37	    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
38	      if mode_eq m1 m2
39	      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
40	      else false
41	    | _, _ => false
42	    end.
43	
44	Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
45	    match f1, f2 with
46	    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
47	    | _, _  => false
48	    end.
49	
50	Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
51	    match g with
52	    | nil => nil
53	    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
54	      if pair_eq x y
55	      then
56	        tail
57	      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
58	    end.
59	
60	Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
61	  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
62	      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.
63	
64	Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
65	  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
66	      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.
67	
68	Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
69	    match p1, p2 with
70	    | empty, _ => p2
71	    | io, _ => io
72	    | _, io => io
73	    | out, inp => io
74	    | out, _ => out
75	    | inp, out => io
76	    | inp, _ => inp
77	    end.
78	
79	Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
80	  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
81	  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
82	  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
83	  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.
84	
85	Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
86	  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
87	  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
88	      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
89	      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
90	  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
91	      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).
92	
93	Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
94	    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.
95	
96	Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
97	    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.
98	
99	Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
100	  | Ts_id : forall t,
101	      type_sub t t
102	  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
103	      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
104	  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
105	      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
106	  | Ts_out : forall m t,
107	      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).
108	
109	Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
110	    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).
111	
112	Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
113	  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
114	  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
115	  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
116	  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.
117	
118	Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
119	            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
120	  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
121	            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
122	  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
123	      flag_plus f g f'->
124	      pol_plus p q p' ->
125	      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
126	      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
127	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
128	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
129	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
130	      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
131	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
132	  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
133	      flag_plus f g f'->
134	      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
135	      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
136	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
137	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
138	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
139	      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
140	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
141	  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
142	      flag_plus f g f'->
143	      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
144	      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
145	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
146	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
147	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
148	      typeOf g3 n Top ->
149	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.
150	
151	Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
152	    match g with
153	    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
154	    | nil => nil
155	    end.
156	
157	Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
158	    match g with
159	    | nil => nil
160	    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
161	      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
162	    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
163	       hid_proj m
164	    end.
165	
166	Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
167	    match g with
168	    | nil => nil
169	    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
170	      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
171	    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
172	       vis_proj m
173	    end.
174	
175	Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
176	    match g with
177	    | nil => nil
178	    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>
179	      (a1, a2, ill, t) :: ill_proj m
180	    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
181	       ill_proj m
182	    end.
183	
184	End TypeSystem.

1	Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
2	From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
3	Require Import pairEq operations header.
4	Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.
5	
6	Section Utilities.
7	
8	Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
9	Proof.
10	  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
11	  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
12	Qed.
13	
14	Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
15	Proof.
16	  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
17	  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
18	  - split.
19	    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
20	    + intros _; reflexivity.
21	Qed.
22	
23	Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
24	Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.
25	
26	Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
27	Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.
28	
29	Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
30	Proof.
31	  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
32	  - simpl. auto.
33	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
34	    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
35	    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
36	    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
37	Qed.
38	
39	Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
40	Proof.
41	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
42	  - simpl. reflexivity.
43	  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
44	    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
45	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
46	    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
47	Qed.
48	
49	Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
50	    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
51	Proof.
52	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
53	  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
54	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
55	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
56	    + simpl. right; exact H.
57	    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
58	      * left; exact Heq.
59	      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
60	Qed.
61	
62	Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
63	    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
64	Proof.
65	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
66	  - simpl. auto.
67	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
68	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
69	    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
70	      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
71	      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
72	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
73	      * exact Hin.
74	      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
75	Qed.
76	
77	Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
78	    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
79	Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.
80	
81	Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
82	    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
83	Proof.
84	  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
85	Qed.
86	
87	Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
88	    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
89	Proof.
90	  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
91	  - reflexivity.
92	  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
93	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
94	    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
95	      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
96	      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
97	      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
98	    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
99	      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
100	      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
101	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
102	        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
103	        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
104	      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
105	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
106	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
107	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
108	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
109	        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
110	Qed.
111	
112	Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
113	    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
114	Proof.
115	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
116	  - simpl. auto.
117	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x H.
118	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E; simpl in *.
119	    + auto.
120	    + destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.
121	Qed.
122	
123	Lemma domain_removeEntry_neq : forall y g x,
124	    x <> y -> In x (domain g) -> In x (domain (removeEntry y g)).
125	Proof.
126	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
127	  - simpl. auto.
128	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x Hne Hin.
129	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
130	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
131	      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. rewrite <- Heq. exact E.
132	      * simpl. left. exact Heq.
133	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
134	      * exact Hin.
135	      * simpl. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec z x) as [Heq2|Hne2].
136	        -- left; exact Heq2.
137	        -- right. apply IH; auto.
138	Qed.
139	
140	Lemma NoDup_domain_removeEntry : forall y g,
141	    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry y g)).
142	Proof.
143	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
144	  - simpl. auto.
145	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intro Hnd.
146	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
147	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
148	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; auto.
149	    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
150	      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. eapply domain_removeEntry_sub; eauto.
151	      * apply IH; auto.
152	Qed.
153	
154	Lemma NoDup_removeEntry_still : forall y g,
155	    NoDup (domain g) -> In y (domain g) -> ~ In y (domain (removeEntry y g)).
156	Proof.
157	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
158	  - simpl. auto.
159	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros Hnd Hin.
160	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
161	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
162	    + subst. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
163	    + simpl. destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
164	      * apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
165	      * intro Hc. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
166	        -- apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
167	        -- exact (IH Hnd Hin Hc).
168	Qed.
169	
170	Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
171	    NoDup (domain g) ->
172	    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
173	    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
174	Proof.
175	  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
176	  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
177	  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
178	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
179	    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
180	    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
181	    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
182	      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
183	      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
184	    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
185	      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
186	      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
187	    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.
188	Qed.
189	
190	Lemma isMap_nodup : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> isMap g.
191	Proof.
192	  intros g Hnd. unfold isMap. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
193	  assert (H := nodup_entry_unique g x f1 t1 x f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 eq_refl).
194	  inversion H. auto.
195	Qed.
196	
197	Lemma isMap_removeEntry : forall y g, isMap g -> isMap (removeEntry y g).
198	Proof.
199	  intros y g Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
200	  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
201	  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f1 t1 H1).
202	  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f2 t2 H2).
203	Qed.
204	
205	Lemma isMap_sub : forall g1 g2, isMap g2 ->
206	    (forall x f t, In ((x,f),t) g1 -> In ((x,f),t) g2) -> isMap g1.
207	Proof.
208	  intros g1 g2 Hm Hsub. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
209	  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split; auto.
210	Qed.
211	
212	Fixpoint lookup (n : name * name) (g : typeEnv) : option (flag * piType) :=
213	  match g with
214	  | nil => None
215	  | (x,f,t) :: tl => if pair_eq x n then Some (f,t) else lookup n tl
216	  end.
217	
218	Lemma lookup_Some_In : forall n g f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
219	Proof.
220	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
221	  - simpl. intros f t H; discriminate.
222	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intros f t H.
223	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
224	    + inversion H; subst. apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. simpl. left; auto.
225	    + simpl. right. apply IH; exact H.
226	Qed.
227	
228	Lemma lookup_None_notin : forall n g, lookup n g = None -> ~ In n (domain g).
229	Proof.
230	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
231	  - simpl. auto.
232	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intro H.
233	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
234	    + discriminate.
235	    + simpl. intros [Heq|Hin].
236	      * apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
237	      * apply IH; auto.
238	Qed.

240	Lemma In_lookup_Some : forall n g, In n (domain g) -> exists f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t).
241	Proof.
242	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
243	  - intros H. simpl in H. exfalso; exact H.
244	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intros [Heq|Hin].
245	    + rewrite <- Heq. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. eauto.
246	    + destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
247	      * exists fx, tx; auto.
248	      * apply IH; auto.
249	Qed.

251	Lemma lookup_isMap : forall g, isMap g -> forall n f1 t1 f2 t2,
252	    lookup n g = Some (f1,t1) -> lookup n g = Some (f2,t2) -> f1=f2 /\ t1=t2.
253	Proof.
254	  intros g Him n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
255	  apply (Him n f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
256	  - apply lookup_Some_In in H1; exact H1.
257	  - apply lookup_Some_In in H2; exact H2.
258	Qed.
259	
260	Lemma length_removeEntry : forall n g, In n (domain g) -> length (removeEntry n g) = length g - 1.
261	Proof.
262	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
263	  - simpl. intros H; destruct H.
264	  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intros H.
265	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
266	    + simpl. lia.
267	    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
268	      * apply pair_eq_false in E. contradiction.
269	      * assert (Hpos : length tl >= 1) by (destruct tl as [|h2 tl2]; simpl in *; [contradiction| simpl; lia]).
270	        specialize (IH Hin). simpl. rewrite IH. lia.
271	Qed.
272	
273	End Utilities.
274	
275	Section ConsSpec.
276	
277	Definition consumable (t : piType) : Prop :=
278	  t = Top \/ (exists p t', t = Chan un p t') \/ (exists t', t = Chan lin empty t').
279

295	Lemma cons_entry : forall g pf, cons g pf ->
296	    forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t.
297	Proof.
298	  intros g pf H.
299	  induction H as [g pf Eg | g pf n pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n p t pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n t pf' Ht Hc IH].
300	  - subst; intros; contradiction.
301	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
302	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
303	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
304	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n Top Ht) as [f0 Htop].
305	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
306	      unfold isMap in Him.
307	      destruct (Him n f0 Top f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
308	      subst t0. apply consumable_top.
309	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
310	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
311	      * exact Hin.
312	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
313	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
314	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
315	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan un p t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
316	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
317	      unfold isMap in Him.
318	      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan un p t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
319	      subst t0. apply consumable_un.
320	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
321	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
322	      * exact Hin.
323	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
324	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
325	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
326	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan lin empty t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
327	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
328	      unfold isMap in Him.
329	      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan lin empty t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
330	      subst t0. apply consumable_lin_empty.
331	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
332	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
333	      * exact Hin.
334	Qed.

336	Lemma entry_cons : forall g pf,
337	    (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t) -> cons g pf.
338	Proof.
339	  intros g. remember (length g) as k eqn:Ek. revert g Ek.
340	  induction k as [|k IH]; intros g Ek pf Hall.
341	  - destruct g as [|h tl].
342	    + apply Co_nil; auto.
343	    + simpl in Ek. discriminate.
344	  - destruct g as [|h tl].
345	    + apply Co_nil; auto.
346	    + destruct h as [[n f] t].
347	      pose proof (Hall n f t (or_introl eq_refl)) as Hc.
348	      assert (Hin : In n (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
349	      assert (Hpf' : isMap (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (apply isMap_removeEntry; exact pf).
350	      assert (Hlen : length (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) = k).
351	      { rewrite length_removeEntry; [|exact Hin]. simpl in Ek. simpl. lia. }
352	      assert (Hall' : forall n0 f0 t0, In ((n0,f0),t0) (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) -> consumable t0).
353	      { intros n0 f0 t0 H0. apply (Hall n0 f0 t0). apply in_removeEntry_elim with (y:=n). exact H0. }
354	      assert (Hrec : cons (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) Hpf').
355	      { apply (IH (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) (eq_sym Hlen) Hpf' Hall'). }
356	      destruct Hc as [Ht | [[p [t' Ht]] | [t' Ht]]].
357	      * subst t.
358	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Top)::tl) n Top).
359	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Top)::tl) n f Top). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
360	        exact (Co_top (((n,f),Top)::tl) pf n Hpf' HTy Hrec).
361	      * subst t.
362	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n (Chan un p t')).
363	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n f (Chan un p t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
364	        exact (Co_un (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) pf n p t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
365	      * subst t.
366	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n (Chan lin empty t')).
367	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n f (Chan lin empty t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
368	        exact (Co_lin (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) pf n t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
369	Qed.

614	Lemma ecomb_redistribute :
615	  forall (f1 f2 f : flag) ta ta' tb1 tb2 t t1 t2,
616	    ecomb (vis,ta) (vis,ta') (vis,t) ->
617	    ecomb (f1,tb1) (f2,tb2) (f,t1) ->
618	    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
619	    exists t21 t22, type_plus tb1 ta t21 /\ type_plus tb2 ta' t22 /\ type_plus t21 t22 t2 /\ ecomb (vis,t21) (vis,t22) (vis,t2).
620	Proof.
621	  intros f1 f2 f ta ta' tb1 tb2 t t1 t2 Hx Hb Htp.
622	  destruct t as [m p t0 | ].
623	  - destruct m.
624	    + (* lin *)
625	      destruct (ecomb_third_lin vis ta vis ta' vis p t0 Hx) as [p1 [p2 [Eta [Eta' Hpp]]]].
626	      subst ta ta'.
627	      destruct (type_plus_second_lin t1 p t0 t2 Htp) as [p0 [p4 [Et1 [Et2 H3]]]].
628	      subst t1 t2.
629	      destruct (ecomb_third_lin f1 tb1 f2 tb2 f p0 t0 Hb) as [q1 [q2 [Etb1 [Etb2 Hqq]]]].
630	      subst tb1 tb2.
631	      destruct (pol_plus_exchange q1 q2 p0 p1 p2 p p4 Hqq Hpp H3) as (r1 & r2 & Hr1 & Hr2 & Hr).
632	      exists (Chan lin r1 t0), (Chan lin r2 t0). split.
633	      * apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr1.
634	      * split.
635	        -- apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr2.
636	        -- split.
637	           ++ apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr.
638	           ++ apply ec_lin; [exact Fp_vv | exact Hr].
639	    + (* un *)
640	      destruct (ecomb_third_un vis ta vis ta' vis p t0 Hx) as [Eta Eta'].
641	      subst ta ta'.
642	      destruct (type_plus_second_un t1 p t0 t2 Htp) as [p0 [Et1 Et2]].
643	      subst t1 t2.
644	      destruct (ecomb_third_un f1 tb1 f2 tb2 f p0 t0 Hb) as [Etb1 Etb2].

666	Lemma removeEntry_perm : forall n g g', Permutation g g' -> NoDup (domain g) ->
667	  Permutation (removeEntry n g) (removeEntry n g').
668	Proof.
669	  intros n g g' Hp. induction Hp as [|x l l' Hp IH | x y l | l l' l'' Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2]; intro Hnd.
670	  - apply perm_nil.
671	  - destruct x as [[a f] t]. cbn [removeEntry].
672	    destruct (pair_eq a n) eqn:E.
673	    + exact Hp.
674	    + apply perm_skip. apply IH. simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; exact (proj2 Hnd).
675	  - destruct x as [[ax fx] tx], y as [[ay fy] ty]. cbn [removeEntry].
676	    simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; destruct Hnd as [Hnoty Hnd].
677	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; destruct Hnd as [Hnotx Hndl].
678	    destruct (pair_eq ay n) eqn:Ey; destruct (pair_eq ax n) eqn:Ex; simpl.
679	    + exfalso. apply Hnoty. simpl. left.
680	      apply pair_eq_true in Ey. apply pair_eq_true in Ex.
681	      rewrite Ex, <- Ey. reflexivity.
682	    + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_refl.
683	    + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_refl.
684	    + apply perm_swap.
685	  - apply perm_trans with (l' := removeEntry n l').
686	    + apply IH1; exact Hnd.
687	    + apply IH2. apply (NoDup_domain_perm l l' Hp1 Hnd).
688	Qed.

711	Lemma max_le_spec : forall l m, max l <= m <-> (forall a x, In (a,x) l -> x <= m).
712	Proof.
713	  intros l. induction l as [|h t IH]; intros m.
714	  - simpl. split; intros HH. { intros a x Hin; simpl in Hin; destruct Hin. } lia.
715	  - destruct h as [a x]. simpl.
716	    remember (max t) as mt eqn:E.
717	    destruct (x <? mt) eqn:Elt.
718	    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in Elt.
719	      split.
720	      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
721	        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
722	        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
723	           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
724	      * intros H. apply (proj2 (IH m)). intros a0 x0 Hin. apply (H a0 x0). right; exact Hin.
725	    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in Elt.
726	      split.

728	        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
729	        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
730	           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).

300	Lemma type_remove_plus : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
301	  type_remove t t0 t3 -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
302	  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_remove t2 t0 t2v.
303	Proof.
304	  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htr Htp.
305	  unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub [Hplus Hcond]].
306	  destruct (type_plus_mid t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htp Hplus) as [t2v [Htv Hrest]].
307	  exists t2v. split; [exact Htv|].
308	  unfold type_remove. split.
309	  - eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hsub|apply (type_plus_sub_r _ _ _ Htp)].
310	  - split; [exact Hrest|].
311	    intro Hun2.
312	    assert (Hun_t : is_unrestricted t) by (eapply type_plus_unrestricted_r; eauto).
313	    assert (Hteq : t3 = t) by (eapply Hcond; exact Hun_t).
314	    rewrite Hteq in Htv.
315	    exact (type_plus_det t1 t t2v t2 Htv Htp).

Proof.
  intros p q1 q2 r H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; auto.

  pol_plus inp a b -> pol_plus b c d -> pol_plus inp e d -> pol_plus a c e.

Lemma tEnv_split_perm : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 g',
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 -> Permutation g3 g' ->
  NoDup (domain g3) -> NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
  forall pf3', tEnv_split g1 g2 g' pf1 pf2 pf3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 g' Hs Hp Hnd3 nd1 nd2 pf3'.
  destruct (tEnv_split_esplit _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs) as [HA [HB HC]].

  assert (Hndg' : NoDup (domain g')) by (apply (NoDup_domain_perm g3 g' Hp); exact Hnd3).

1	Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
2	From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
3	Require Import pairEq operations header.
4	Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.
5	
6	Section Utilities.
7	
8	Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
9	Proof.
10	  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
11	  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
12	Qed.
13	
14	Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
15	Proof.
16	  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
17	  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
18	  - split.
19	    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
20	    + intros _; reflexivity.
21	Qed.
22	
23	Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
24	Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.
25	
26	Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
27	Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.
28	
29	Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
30	Proof.
31	  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
32	  - simpl. auto.
33	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
34	    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
35	    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
36	    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
37	Qed.
38	
39	Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
40	Proof.
41	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
42	  - simpl. reflexivity.
43	  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
44	    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
45	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
46	    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
47	Qed.
48	
49	Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
50	    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
51	Proof.
52	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
53	  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
54	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
55	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
56	    + simpl. right; exact H.
57	    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
58	      * left; exact Heq.
59	      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
60	Qed.
61	
62	Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
63	    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
64	Proof.
65	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
66	  - simpl. auto.
67	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
68	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
69	    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
70	      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
71	      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
72	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
73	      * exact Hin.
74	      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
75	Qed.
76	
77	Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
78	    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
79	Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.
80	
81	Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
82	    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
83	Proof.
84	  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
85	Qed.
86	
87	Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
88	    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
89	Proof.
90	  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
91	  - reflexivity.
92	  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
93	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
94	    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
95	      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
96	      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
97	      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
98	    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
99	      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
100	      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
101	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
102	        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
103	        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
104	      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
105	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
106	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
107	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
108	        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
109	        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
110	Qed.
111	
112	Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
113	    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
114	Proof.
115	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
116	  - simpl. auto.
117	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x H.
118	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E; simpl in *.
119	    + auto.
120	    + destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.
121	Qed.
122	
123	Lemma domain_removeEntry_neq : forall y g x,
124	    x <> y -> In x (domain g) -> In x (domain (removeEntry y g)).
125	Proof.
126	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
127	  - simpl. auto.
128	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x Hne Hin.
129	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
130	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
131	      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. rewrite <- Heq. exact E.
132	      * simpl. left. exact Heq.
133	    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
134	      * exact Hin.
135	      * simpl. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec z x) as [Heq2|Hne2].
136	        -- left; exact Heq2.
137	        -- right. apply IH; auto.
138	Qed.
139	
140	Lemma NoDup_domain_removeEntry : forall y g,
141	    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry y g)).
142	Proof.
143	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
144	  - simpl. auto.
145	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intro Hnd.
146	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
147	    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
148	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; auto.
149	    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
150	      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. eapply domain_removeEntry_sub; eauto.
151	      * apply IH; auto.
152	Qed.
153	
154	Lemma NoDup_removeEntry_still : forall y g,
155	    NoDup (domain g) -> In y (domain g) -> ~ In y (domain (removeEntry y g)).
156	Proof.
157	  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
158	  - simpl. auto.
159	  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros Hnd Hin.
160	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
161	    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
162	    + subst. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
163	    + simpl. destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
164	      * apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
165	      * intro Hc. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
166	        -- apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
167	        -- exact (IH Hnd Hin Hc).
168	Qed.
169	
170	Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
171	    NoDup (domain g) ->
172	    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
173	    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
174	Proof.
175	  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
176	  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
177	  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
178	    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
179	    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
180	    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
181	    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
182	      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
183	      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
184	    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
185	      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
186	      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
187	    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.
188	Qed.
189	
190	Lemma isMap_nodup : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> isMap g.
191	Proof.
192	  intros g Hnd. unfold isMap. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
193	  assert (H := nodup_entry_unique g x f1 t1 x f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 eq_refl).
194	  inversion H. auto.
195	Qed.
196	
197	Lemma isMap_removeEntry : forall y g, isMap g -> isMap (removeEntry y g).
198	Proof.
199	  intros y g Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
200	  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
201	  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f1 t1 H1).
202	  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f2 t2 H2).
203	Qed.
204	
205	Lemma isMap_sub : forall g1 g2, isMap g2 ->
206	    (forall x f t, In ((x,f),t) g1 -> In ((x,f),t) g2) -> isMap g1.
207	Proof.
208	  intros g1 g2 Hm Hsub. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
209	  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split; auto.
210	Qed.
211	
212	Fixpoint lookup (n : name * name) (g : typeEnv) : option (flag * piType) :=
213	  match g with
214	  | nil => None
215	  | (x,f,t) :: tl => if pair_eq x n then Some (f,t) else lookup n tl
216	  end.
217	
218	Lemma lookup_Some_In : forall n g f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
219	Proof.
220	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
221	  - simpl. intros f t H; discriminate.
222	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intros f t H.
223	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
224	    + inversion H; subst. apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. simpl. left; auto.
225	    + simpl. right. apply IH; exact H.
226	Qed.
227	
228	Lemma lookup_None_notin : forall n g, lookup n g = None -> ~ In n (domain g).
229	Proof.
230	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
231	  - simpl. auto.
232	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intro H.
233	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
234	    + discriminate.
235	    + simpl. intros [Heq|Hin].
236	      * apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
237	      * apply IH; auto.
238	Qed.
239	
240	Lemma In_lookup_Some : forall n g, In n (domain g) -> exists f t, lookup n g = Some (f,t).
241	Proof.
242	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
243	  - intros H. simpl in H. exfalso; exact H.
244	  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. simpl. intros [Heq|Hin].
245	    + rewrite <- Heq. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. eauto.
246	    + destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
247	      * exists fx, tx; auto.
248	      * apply IH; auto.
249	Qed.
250	
251	Lemma lookup_isMap : forall g, isMap g -> forall n f1 t1 f2 t2,
252	    lookup n g = Some (f1,t1) -> lookup n g = Some (f2,t2) -> f1=f2 /\ t1=t2.
253	Proof.
254	  intros g Him n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
255	  apply (Him n f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
256	  - apply lookup_Some_In in H1; exact H1.
257	  - apply lookup_Some_In in H2; exact H2.
258	Qed.
259	
260	Lemma length_removeEntry : forall n g, In n (domain g) -> length (removeEntry n g) = length g - 1.
261	Proof.
262	  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
263	  - simpl. intros H; destruct H.
264	  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intros H.
265	    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
266	    + simpl. lia.
267	    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
268	      * apply pair_eq_false in E. contradiction.
269	      * assert (Hpos : length tl >= 1) by (destruct tl as [|h2 tl2]; simpl in *; [contradiction| simpl; lia]).
270	        specialize (IH Hin). simpl. rewrite IH. lia.
271	Qed.
272	
273	End Utilities.
274	
275	Section ConsSpec.
276	
277	Definition consumable (t : piType) : Prop :=
278	  t = Top \/ (exists p t', t = Chan un p t') \/ (exists t', t = Chan lin empty t').
279	
280	Lemma consumable_top : consumable Top.
281	Proof. left; auto. Qed.
282	
283	Lemma consumable_un : forall p t, consumable (Chan un p t).
284	Proof. intros; right; left; eauto. Qed.
285	
286	Lemma consumable_lin_empty : forall t, consumable (Chan lin empty t).
287	Proof. intros; right; right; eauto. Qed.
288	
289	Lemma typeOf_inv : forall g n t, typeOf g n t -> exists f, In ((n,f),t) g.
290	Proof. intros g n t H. destruct H as [g' n' f t' Hin]. exists f. exact Hin. Qed.
291	
292	Lemma flagOf_inv : forall g n f, flagOf g n f -> exists t, In ((n,f),t) g.
293	Proof. intros g n f H. destruct H as [g' n' f' t' Hin]. exists t'. exact Hin. Qed.
294	
295	Lemma cons_entry : forall g pf, cons g pf ->
296	    forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t.
297	Proof.
298	  intros g pf H.
299	  induction H as [g pf Eg | g pf n pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n p t pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n t pf' Ht Hc IH].
300	  - subst; intros; contradiction.
301	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
302	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
303	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
304	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n Top Ht) as [f0 Htop].
305	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
306	      unfold isMap in Him.
307	      destruct (Him n f0 Top f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
308	      subst t0. apply consumable_top.
309	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
310	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
311	      * exact Hin.
312	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
313	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
314	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
315	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan un p t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
316	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
317	      unfold isMap in Him.
318	      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan un p t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
319	      subst t0. apply consumable_un.
320	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
321	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
322	      * exact Hin.
323	  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
324	    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
325	    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
326	      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan lin empty t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
327	      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
328	      unfold isMap in Him.
329	      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan lin empty t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
330	      subst t0. apply consumable_lin_empty.
331	    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
332	      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
333	      * exact Hin.
334	Qed.
335	
336	Lemma entry_cons : forall g pf,
337	    (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t) -> cons g pf.
338	Proof.
339	  intros g. remember (length g) as k eqn:Ek. revert g Ek.
340	  induction k as [|k IH]; intros g Ek pf Hall.
341	  - destruct g as [|h tl].
342	    + apply Co_nil; auto.
343	    + simpl in Ek. discriminate.
344	  - destruct g as [|h tl].
345	    + apply Co_nil; auto.
346	    + destruct h as [[n f] t].
347	      pose proof (Hall n f t (or_introl eq_refl)) as Hc.
348	      assert (Hin : In n (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
349	      assert (Hpf' : isMap (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (apply isMap_removeEntry; exact pf).
350	      assert (Hlen : length (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) = k).
351	      { rewrite length_removeEntry; [|exact Hin]. simpl in Ek. simpl. lia. }
352	      assert (Hall' : forall n0 f0 t0, In ((n0,f0),t0) (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) -> consumable t0).
353	      { intros n0 f0 t0 H0. apply (Hall n0 f0 t0). apply in_removeEntry_elim with (y:=n). exact H0. }
354	      assert (Hrec : cons (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) Hpf').
355	      { apply (IH (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) (eq_sym Hlen) Hpf' Hall'). }
356	      destruct Hc as [Ht | [[p [t' Ht]] | [t' Ht]]].
357	      * subst t.
358	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Top)::tl) n Top).
359	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Top)::tl) n f Top). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
360	        exact (Co_top (((n,f),Top)::tl) pf n Hpf' HTy Hrec).
361	      * subst t.
362	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n (Chan un p t')).
363	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n f (Chan un p t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
364	        exact (Co_un (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) pf n p t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
365	      * subst t.
366	        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n (Chan lin empty t')).
367	        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n f (Chan lin empty t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
368	        exact (Co_lin (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) pf n t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
369	Qed.

614	Lemma ecomb_redistribute :
615	  forall (f1 f2 f : flag) ta ta' tb1 tb2 t t1 t2,
616	    ecomb (vis,ta) (vis,ta') (vis,t) ->
617	    ecomb (f1,tb1) (f2,tb2) (f,t1) ->
618	    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
619	    exists t21 t22, type_plus tb1 ta t21 /\ type_plus tb2 ta' t22 /\ type_plus t21 t22 t2 /\ ecomb (vis,t21) (vis,t22) (vis,t2).
620	Proof.
621	  intros f1 f2 f ta ta' tb1 tb2 t t1 t2 Hx Hb Htp.
622	  destruct t as [m p t0 | ].
623	  - destruct m.
624	    + (* lin *)
625	      destruct (ecomb_third_lin vis ta vis ta' vis p t0 Hx) as [p1 [p2 [Eta [Eta' Hpp]]]].
626	      subst ta ta'.
627	      destruct (type_plus_second_lin t1 p t0 t2 Htp) as [p0 [p4 [Et1 [Et2 H3]]]].
628	      subst t1 t2.
629	      destruct (ecomb_third_lin f1 tb1 f2 tb2 f p0 t0 Hb) as [q1 [q2 [Etb1 [Etb2 Hqq]]]].
630	      subst tb1 tb2.
631	      destruct (pol_plus_exchange q1 q2 p0 p1 p2 p p4 Hqq Hpp H3) as (r1 & r2 & Hr1 & Hr2 & Hr).
632	      exists (Chan lin r1 t0), (Chan lin r2 t0). split.
633	      * apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr1.
634	      * split.
635	        -- apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr2.
636	        -- split.
637	           ++ apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr.
638	           ++ apply ec_lin; [exact Fp_vv | exact Hr].
639	    + (* un *)
640	      destruct (ecomb_third_un vis ta vis ta' vis p t0 Hx) as [Eta Eta'].
641	      subst ta ta'.
642	      destruct (type_plus_second_un t1 p t0 t2 Htp) as [p0 [Et1 Et2]].
643	      subst t1 t2.
644	      destruct (ecomb_third_un f1 tb1 f2 tb2 f p0 t0 Hb) as [Etb1 Etb2].
645	      subst tb1 tb2.
646	      exists (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p) t0), (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p) t0). split.
647	      * apply Tp_UnPlus.
648	      * split.
649	        -- apply Tp_UnPlus.
650	        -- split.
651	           ++ pose proof (Tp_UnPlus (pol_cup p0 p) (pol_cup p0 p) t0) as Hself.
652	              rewrite pol_cup_idem in Hself. exact Hself.
653	           ++ apply ec_un; exact Fp_vv.
654	  - (* Top *)
655	    destruct (ecomb_third_top vis ta vis ta' vis Hx) as [Eta Eta'].
656	    subst ta ta'.
657	    destruct (type_plus_second_top t1 t2 Htp) as [Et1 Et2].
658	    subst t1 t2.
659	    destruct (ecomb_third_top f1 tb1 f2 tb2 f Hb) as [Etb1 Etb2].
660	    subst tb1 tb2.
661	    exists Top, Top. split; [apply Tp_Base | split; [apply Tp_Base | split; [apply Tp_Base | apply ec_top; exact Fp_vv]]].
662	Qed.

711	Lemma max_le_spec : forall l m, max l <= m <-> (forall a x, In (a,x) l -> x <= m).
712	Proof.
713	  intros l. induction l as [|h t IH]; intros m.
714	  - simpl. split; intros HH. { intros a x Hin; simpl in Hin; destruct Hin. } lia.
715	  - destruct h as [a x]. simpl.
716	    remember (max t) as mt eqn:E.
717	    destruct (x <? mt) eqn:Elt.
718	    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in Elt.
719	      split.
720	      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
721	        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
722	        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
723	           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
724	      * intros H. apply (proj2 (IH m)). intros a0 x0 Hin. apply (H a0 x0). right; exact Hin.
725	    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in Elt.
726	      split.
727	      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
728	        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
729	        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
730	           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
731	      * intros H. apply (H a x). left; reflexivity.
732	Qed.
733	Lemma max_perm : forall l l', Permutation l l' -> max l = max l'.
734	Proof.

736	  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l (max l'))). intros a x Hin.
737	    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l' (max l')) (le_n (max l')) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) Hp Hin)).
738	  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l' (max l))). intros a x Hin.
739	    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l (max l)) (le_n (max l)) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hin)).

Require Export compat.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.

Notation name  := nat.

Definition nat_pair_eq_dec : forall n m : name * name, {n = m} + {n <> m} :=
  ltac:(decide equality; decide equality; decide equality).

Opaque nat_pair_eq_dec.
Require Export compat.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat Classical.

Section PairOperations.

End PairOperations.

Section ListOperations.

Fixpoint disjoint {A} (l1 l2 : list A) : Prop :=
    match l1 with
    | nil => True
    | x::t1 => ((In x l2) -> False) /\ disjoint t1 l2
    end.

Inductive  disjoint_2 {A}: list A -> list A -> Prop :=
  | dis_nil : forall l : list A, disjoint_2 nil l
  | dis_cons : forall (x:A) (l1 l2 : list A),
      (~ In x l2 /\ disjoint_2 l1 l2) -> disjoint_2 (x::l1) l2.

End  ListOperations.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Section PairEq.

Definition pair_eq (p1 p2 : name * name) :=
    (fst p1 =? fst p2) && (snd p1 =? snd p2).

Fixpoint In2 a l :=
    match l with
    | nil => false
    | b :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then true else In2 a m
    end.

End PairEq.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Notation name  := nat.

Section ProcessDefinitions.

Inductive dproc : Set :=
  | dZero : dproc
  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.

Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p
    | dNu h i  p =>  secLabs p ++ (h, i) :: nil
    end.

Fixpoint fn (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      fn p1 ++  fn p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      (x1, x2) :: (y1, y2) :: fn p
    end.

Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>
      nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      (y1, y2) :: bv p
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      bv p1 ++  bv p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      bv p
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      bv p
    end.

Definition wf (p : dproc) : Prop :=
    NoDup (secLabs p) /\ disjoint (fn p) (secLabs p).

Definition pos l := forall x1 x2 : nat,
      In (x1, x2) l-> x2 > 0.

Definition sl_pos p := pos (secLabs p).

Definition mv (py pz pv : name * name)  :=
    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in
    if (y1 =? z1) && (y2 =? z2)
    then (v1, v2)
    else (y1, y2).

Fixpoint pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2 :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>  p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dBang (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2 (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dInp (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2  (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      let r1 := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      let r2 := mv (y1, y2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dOut  (fst r1) (snd r1) (fst r2) (snd r2) (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dPar p q =>
      dPar (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2) (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dNu h i q =>
      dNu h i (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    end.

Definition map_nat_nat := list (nat * nat).

Fixpoint  domain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (k, _) :: t => k :: (domain_projection t)
    end.

Fixpoint  codomain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (_, v) :: t => v :: (codomain_projection t)
    end.

Definition structure_is_map (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    NoDup (domain_projection m).

Fixpoint max (l :list (nat*nat)) : nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => 0
    | (_, x) :: t => let m := max t in
                     if x <? m then m else x
    end.

Notation dp := domain_projection.

Notation cp := codomain_projection.

Local Definition no_dup_cont (h : nat * nat) (t : list (nat * nat))
    (pf : NoDup (h :: t)) : NoDup t := ltac:(inversion pf; assumption).

Local Opaque no_dup_cont.

Fixpoint dep_map_gen_r (l :list (name * name)) (m : nat) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => fun _ => nil
    | h :: t =>
      fun pf : NoDup (h :: t)  =>
        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
    end.

Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).

Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
    match p with
    | dZero   => fun _  => p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
    | dPar p q =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
    | dNu h i p =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
    end.

End ProcessDefinitions.

Section Facts.

End Facts.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).

Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>

    end.

End TypeSystem.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.

Lemma InB_first_consumable : forall g,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> consumable t) ->
  forall a, consumable (snd (fst (InB a g))).
Proof.
  intros g Hc. induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros a.
  - simpl. apply consumable_top.
  - simpl. destruct (pair_eq a x) eqn:E.
    + apply Hc with (n:=x)(f:=f)(t:=t). left; reflexivity.
    + apply IH. intros n f0 t0 Hin. apply Hc with (n:=n)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma newEntries_cons : forall g L m,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> consumable t) ->
  forall e, In e (newEntries g L m) -> consumable (snd e).
Proof.
  intros g L. induction L as [|h tl IH]; intros m Hc e Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - destruct h as [h1 h2]. simpl in Hin.
    destruct (InB (h1,h2) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.
    destruct b; simpl in Hin.
    + apply (IH m Hc e Hin).
    + destruct (InB (h1,h2-m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1] eqn:Eb1; simpl in Hin.
      destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst e. simpl.
        pose proof (InB_first_consumable g Hc (h1,h2-m)) as Hcons.
        rewrite Eb1 in Hcons. simpl in Hcons. exact Hcons.
      * apply (IH m Hc e Hin).
Qed.

Lemma weakenEnv_cons : forall g,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> consumable t) ->
  forall e, In e (weakenEnv g) -> consumable (snd e).
Proof.
  intros g Hc e Hin. destruct e as [[n f] t]. apply In_weakenEnv_iff in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [f0 [t0 [Hg Heq]]]. simpl in Heq.
  apply Hc with (n:=n)(f:=f0)(t:=t0) in Hg.
  destruct f0.
  - (* hid *) inversion Heq; subst f t. simpl. apply consumable_wk.
  - inversion Heq; subst f t. exact Hg.
  - inversion Heq; subst f t. exact Hg.
Qed.

Lemma newEntries_cons_proj : forall g L m,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> f <> hid -> consumable t) ->
  forall n f t, In (n,f,t) (newEntries g L m) -> f <> hid -> consumable t.
Proof.
  intros g L. induction L as [|h tl IH]; intros m Hc n f t Hin Hf.

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.
Require Import Task.

Lemma pol_plus_det_r : forall p q1 q2 r, pol_plus p q1 r -> pol_plus p q2 r -> q1 = q2.
Proof.
  intros p q1 q2 r H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid : forall a b c d e,
  pol_plus inp a b -> pol_plus b c d -> pol_plus inp e d -> pol_plus a c e.
Proof.
  intros a b c d e H1 H2 H3.
  destruct (pol_plus_assoc inp a b c d H1 H2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
  assert (f = e) by (eapply pol_plus_det_r; eauto). subst. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid_sym : forall q p p1 p2 q2,
  pol_plus inp q p -> pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus inp q2 p2 -> pol_plus p1 q q2.
Proof.
  intros q p p1 p2 q2 H1 H2 H3.
  destruct (pol_plus_assoc inp q p p1 p2 H1 (pol_plus_sym _ _ _ H2)) as [f [Hf Hg]].
  assert (f = q2) by (eapply pol_plus_det_r; eauto). subst.
  apply pol_plus_sym. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid_direct : forall q p1 p p2 q2,
  pol_plus inp q p1 -> pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus inp q2 p2 -> pol_plus q p q2.
Proof.
  intros q p1 p p2 q2 H1 H2 H3.
  destruct (pol_plus_assoc inp q p1 p p2 H1 H2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
  assert (f = q2) by (eapply pol_plus_det_r; eauto). subst. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_reassoc_lin : forall t0 p1 p2 p3 q q2,
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin p3 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin p3 t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q2 t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin q2 t0).
Proof.
  intros t0 p1 p2 p3 q q2 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst. inversion H3; subst.
  eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_sym; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_reassoc_lin2 : forall t0 q p1 p p2 q2,
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin p1 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin p t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q2 t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin p t0) (Chan lin q2 t0).
Proof.
  intros t0 q p1 p p2 q2 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst. inversion H3; subst.
  eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_direct; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_lin_inp : forall t0 p,
  type_sub (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin p t0) -> p = inp \/ p = io.
Proof.
  intros t0 p H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_io_r : forall p1 p p2,
  pol_plus p1 p p2 -> (p = inp \/ p = io) -> (p2 = inp \/ p2 = io).
Proof.
  intros p1 p p2 H Hp.
  destruct p.
  - destruct Hp as [Hc|Hc]; discriminate Hc.
  - inversion H; subst; auto.
  - destruct Hp as [Hc|Hc]; discriminate Hc.
  - inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_inp_exists : forall p, p = inp \/ p = io ->
  exists q, pol_plus inp q p.
Proof.
  intros p [Hpe|Hpe]; subst p.
  - exists empty. apply Pp_emptyR.
  - exists out. apply Pp_inpL.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_lin_inp : forall t0 p2 t1'',
  (p2 = inp \/ p2 = io) ->
  (exists q2, t1'' = Chan lin q2 t0 /\ pol_plus inp q2 p2) ->
  type_remove (Chan lin p2 t0) (Chan lin inp t0) t1''.
Proof.
  intros t0 p2 t1'' Hp2 [q2 [Heq Hpol]]. subst t1''.
  unfold type_remove. split.
  - destruct Hp2 as [Hp2c|Hp2c]; subst p2; constructor.
  - split.
    + eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hpol.
    + intro H; destruct H as [p' [t' Heq']]; inversion Heq'.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_remove_dist_r : forall t0 p t3 t1 t2 t1'',
  type_sub (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin p t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) t3 (Chan lin p t0) ->
  type_plus t1 (Chan lin p t0) t2 ->
  type_remove t2 (Chan lin inp t0) t1'' ->
  type_plus t1 t3 t1''.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t3 t1 t2 t1'' Hsub Hplus Htp Htr.
  destruct (type_sub_lin_inp t0 p Hsub) as [Hp|Hp]; subst p.
  - inversion Hplus; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?qq inp |- _ =>
      assert (Hqq : qq = empty) by (inversion Hh; subst; auto); subst qq; clear Hh end.
    inversion Htp; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus ?a inp ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol1 end.
    unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub2 [Hplus2 Hcond2]].
    inversion Hplus2; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?q ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol2 end.
    eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_sym; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
  - inversion Hplus; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?qq io |- _ =>
      assert (Hqq : qq = out) by (inversion Hh; subst; auto); subst qq; clear Hh end.
    inversion Htp; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus ?a io ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol1 end.
    unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub2 [Hplus2 Hcond2]].

    { intro Hcc. exact (proj2 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g n) Hcc) eq_refl). }
    assert (ndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd).

    { intro Hcc. destruct Hcc as [Heq|Hcc].
      - apply Hnb. symmetry. exact Heq.
      - exact (Hb_rem Hcc). }
    assert (ndSource : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb_nrem|exact ndNrem]. }
    assert (P : Permutation ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
                         ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((b,vis,tb)::g))).
    { rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq b n vis tb g); [| intro Hneq; apply Hnb; exact Hneq]. apply perm_swap. }
    eapply TNew with (n := n) (t := t).
    + simpl. right. exact H.

    { intro Hx. apply Hb. exact (proj1 (HB b) Hx). }
    assert (Hbv1 : ~ In b (bv p1)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hbv. simpl. apply in_or_app. left. exact Hx. }

input.content:
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task.
Require Import SubstDev.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic list/permutation helpers                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma perm_cons_mid : forall (A : Type) (l1 l2 : list A) (x : A),
  Permutation (l1 ++ x :: l2) (x :: l1 ++ l2).
Proof.
  intros. apply Permutation_sym. apply Permutation_middle.
Qed.

Lemma perm_cons_cons_mid : forall (A : Type) (l1 l2 : list A) (x y : A),
  Permutation (l1 ++ x :: y :: l2) (x :: y :: (l1 ++ l2)).
Proof.
  intros. apply Permutation_sym.
  eapply perm_trans.
  - apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_middle.
  - apply Permutation_middle.
Qed.

(* weakenEnv commutes with removeEntry *)
Lemma weakenEnv_removeEntry : forall n g,
  weakenEnv (removeEntry n g) = removeEntry n (weakenEnv g).
Proof.
  intros n g. induction g as [|[x f] t tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + destruct f; simpl; rewrite E; reflexivity.
    + destruct f; simpl; rewrite E; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma In_weakenEnv_pres : forall g n f t,
  In ((n,f),t) g -> f <> hid -> In ((n,f),t) (weakenEnv g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[x fx] tx tl IH]; intros n f t Hin Hf.
  - destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct f; [contradiction | simpl; left; reflexivity | simpl; left; reflexivity].
    + destruct fx; simpl; right; apply IH; auto.
Qed.

(* Inserting the weakened version of a hidden entry at the front *)
Lemma Permutation_weakenEnv_insert_hid : forall g n t,
  In ((n,hid),t) g -> NoDup (domain g) ->
  Permutation (weakenEnv g) ((n,ill,wk_type t) :: weakenEnv (removeEntry n g)).
Proof.
  intros g n t Hin Hnd.
  assert (Hing : In ((n,ill),wk_type t) (weakenEnv g)).
  { apply In_weakenEnv_iff. exists hid, t. split; auto. reflexivity. }
  assert (HndW : NoDup (domain (weakenEnv g)))
    by (rewrite domain_weakenEnv_eq; exact Hnd).
  pose proof (Permutation_cons_removeEntry (weakenEnv g) n ill (wk_type t) Hing HndW) as P.
  rewrite weakenEnv_removeEntry in P.
  apply Permutation_sym. exact P.
Qed.

(* newEntries ignores an entry whose name is not relevant *)
Lemma newEntries_cons_ignore : forall g n f tv l m,
  (forall a, In a l -> a <> n) ->
  (forall a, In a l -> (fst a, snd a - m) <> n) ->
  newEntries ((n,f,tv)::g) l m = newEntries g l m.
Proof.
  intros g n f tv l. induction l as [|[a1 a2] tl IH]; intros m Ha Hb.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl.
    rewrite (pair_eq_neq (a1,a2) n (Ha (a1,a2) (or_introl eq_refl))).
    rewrite (pair_eq_neq (a1,a2-m) n (Hb (a1,a2) (or_introl eq_refl))).
    destruct (InB (a1,a2) g) as [[f0 t0] b0] eqn:Eb0.
    destruct b0; simpl.
    + apply (IH m).
      * intros a H; apply Ha; simpl; auto.
      * intros a H; apply Hb; simpl; auto.
    + destruct (InB (a1,a2-m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1] eqn:Eb1; simpl.
      apply f_equal. apply (IH m).
      * intros a H; apply Ha; simpl; auto.
      * intros a H; apply Hb; simpl; auto.
Qed.

(* newEntries ignores removed entries whose name is not relevant *)
Lemma newEntries_removeEntry : forall g n l m,
  (forall a, In a l -> a <> n) ->
  (forall a, In a l -> (fst a, snd a - m) <> n) ->
  newEntries (removeEntry n g) l m = newEntries g l m.
Proof.
  intros g n l. induction l as [|[a1 a2] tl IH]; intros m Ha Hb.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl.
    rewrite (InB_removeEntry_neq (a1,a2) n g (Ha (a1,a2) (or_introl eq_refl))).
    rewrite (InB_removeEntry_neq (a1,a2-m) n g (Hb (a1,a2) (or_introl eq_refl))).
    destruct (InB (a1,a2) g) as [[f0 t0] b0] eqn:Eb0.
    destruct b0; simpl.
    + apply (IH m).
      * intros a H; apply Ha; simpl; auto.
      * intros a H; apply Hb; simpl; auto.
    + destruct (InB (a1,a2-m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1] eqn:Eb1; simpl.
      apply f_equal. apply (IH m).
      * intros a H; apply Ha; simpl; auto.
      * intros a H; apply Hb; simpl; auto.
Qed.

(* the value returned by InB when it reports "not present" *)
Lemma InB_false_eq : forall a g f t,
  InB a g = ((f,t), false) -> f = ill /\ t = Top.
Proof.
  intros a g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros f t H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H. auto.
  - simpl in H. destruct (pair_eq a x) eqn:E.
    + discriminate.
    + apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* the second argument being hid forces the first flag to be ill *)
Lemma ecomb_hid_second : forall f1 t1 t2 f t,
  ecomb (f1,t1) (hid,t2) (f,t) -> f1 = ill.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 t2 f t H. inversion H; subst.
  all: match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?a hid ?b |- _ => inversion Hf; subst; reflexivity end.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Facts about shifted section labels                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift : forall p s pf a,
  In a (secLabs (dep_relabel p s pf)) ->
  exists b, In b (secLabs p) /\ a = shift_name (max s) b.
Proof.
  intros p s pf a H.
  rewrite secLabs_dep_relabel_map in H.
  apply In_shift_name in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma In_secLabs_dep_relabel_snd_gt : forall p s pf a,
  sl_pos p ->
  In a (secLabs (dep_relabel p s pf)) ->
  snd a > max s.
Proof.
  intros p s pf a Hpos Hin.
  destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift p s pf a Hin) as [b [Hb Heq]].
  subst a. destruct b as [b1 b2]. unfold shift_name. simpl.
  pose proof (sl_pos_In p b1 b2 Hpos Hb). simpl in H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma secLabs_dep_relabel_notin : forall p s pf g a,
  sl_pos p ->
  max (domain g) <= max s ->
  In a (secLabs (dep_relabel p s pf)) ->
  ~ In a (domain g).
Proof.
  intros p s pf g a Hpos Hm Hin.
  destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift p s pf a Hin) as [[b1 b2] [Hb Heq]].
  subst a. unfold shift_name. simpl.
  apply (shifted_not_in_g g b1 b2 (max s)).
  - pose proof (sl_pos_In p b1 b2 Hpos Hb). simpl in H. exact H.
  - exact Hm.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Consumability of the entries added when splitting for dPar          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma newEntries_consumable_hid : forall gA gB g pfA pfB pf pA pB,
  tEnv_split gA gB g pfA pfB pf ->
  typeCheck gA pfA pA ->
  typeCheck gB pfB pB ->
  NoDup (domain gA) ->
  (forall b, In b (domain gB) -> In b (domain gA)) ->
  forall s Hnds,
    sl_pos pB ->
    max (domain g) <= max s ->
    max (domain gA) <= max s ->
    forall n f t,
      In (n,f,t) (newEntries gA (secLabs (dep_relabel pB s Hnds)) (max s)) ->
      consumable t.
Proof.

        ill_proj (newEntries g L m ++ weakenEnv g)) pf'.

  apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply In_vis_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [HE Hf]. subst f.
    apply in_app_or in HE. destruct HE as [HA|HW].
    + (* entry of newEntries, flag vis *)
      assert (HnL : In n L)
        by (apply (domain_newEntries_sub g L m); apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis)(t:=t); exact HA).
      assert (Hng : ~ In n (domain g)) by (apply Hfresh; exact HnL).
      destruct (In_newEntries_exact_iff g L m n vis t HndL Hng) as [E1 _].
      destruct (E1 HA) as [_ Heq].
      destruct (InB (fst n, snd n - m) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.
      simpl in Heq. injection Heq as Hf0 Ht0. subst f0 t0.
      destruct b.
      * apply (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n vis t).
        apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj. split.
        -- apply (InB_true n g vis t). exact Eb.
        -- reflexivity.
      * apply InB_false_eq in Eb. destruct Eb as [Ef Et]. subst t.
        apply consumable_top.
    + (* entry of weakenEnv, flag vis *)
      apply In_weakenEnv_cases in HW. destruct HW as [[Hg Hfh]|Hcase].
      * apply (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n vis t).
        apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj. split; auto.
      * destruct Hcase as [t0 [Ef [Et Hing]]]. subst f t. apply consumable_wk.
  - apply In_ill_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [HE Hf]. subst f.
    apply in_app_or in HE. destruct HE as [HA|HW].
    + (* entry of newEntries, flag ill *)

        -- reflexivity.
      * apply InB_false_eq in Eb. destruct Eb as [Ef Et]. subst t.
        apply consumable_top.
    + (* entry of weakenEnv, flag ill *)

      * apply (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n ill t).
        apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj. split; auto.

Lemma removeEntry_app_notin : forall y g1 g2,
  ~ In y (domain g1) -> removeEntry y (g1 ++ g2) = g1 ++ removeEntry y g2.
Proof.
  intros y g1. induction g1 as [|h tl IH]; intros g2 H.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[n f] t]. simpl in H.
    assert (Hneq : n <> y) by (intro Heq; apply H; left; exact Heq).
    assert (Hnot : ~ In y (domain tl)) by (intro; apply H; right; exact H0).
    assert (Hy : y <> n) by (intro Heq; apply Hneq; symmetry; exact Heq).
    simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq n y Hneq). simpl. rewrite IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_app_notin_r : forall y g1 g2,
  ~ In y (domain g2) -> removeEntry y (g1 ++ g2) = removeEntry y g1 ++ g2.
Proof.
  intros y g1. induction g1 as [|h tl IH]; intros g2 H.
  - simpl. rewrite (removeEntry_notin y g2 H). reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[n f] t]. simpl. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n. simpl. reflexivity.
    + simpl. rewrite IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma TOutL_neq : forall g u p t t1 v t' t2,
  isMap g ->
  type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
  type_remove t' t t2 ->
  In ((u,vis),Chan lin p t) g -> In ((v,vis),t') g ->
  u <> v.
Proof.
  intros g u p t t1 v t' t2 Hm Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv Heq. subst v.
  assert (Ht' : t' = Chan lin p t) by

Qed.

Lemma domain_out_env : forall u v g, u <> v -> In u (domain g) -> In v (domain g) ->

Proof.

  assert (Hvu : In v (domain (removeEntry u g))) by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto).
  apply Permutation_sym. eapply perm_trans.
  - apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hu.
  - apply perm_skip. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hvu.
Qed.

Lemma domain_un_env : forall v g, In v (domain g) ->
  Permutation (v :: domain (removeEntry v g)) (domain g).
Proof.
  intros. apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_inl_env : forall u x g, u <> x -> ~ In x (domain g) -> In u (domain g) ->
  Permutation (u :: x :: domain (removeEntry u g)) (x :: domain g).
Proof.
  intros u x g Hux Hx Hu.
  eapply perm_trans.
  - apply perm_swap.
  - apply Permutation_sym. apply perm_skip. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hu.
Qed.


Lemma typeCheck_perm : forall g g' p pf pf',
