Lemma In_newEntries_tail : forall g h tl m a f t,
  In ((a,f),t) (newEntries g tl m) -> In ((a,f),t) (newEntries g (h::tl) m).
Proof.
  intros g h tl m a f t Hin. destruct h as [h1 h2]. simpl.
  destruct (InB (h1, h2) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.
  destruct b; simpl.
  - exact Hin.
  - destruct (InB (h1, h2 - m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1]; simpl. right. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma In_newEntries : forall g l m a f t,
  In a l -> ~ In a (domain g) ->
  InB (fst a, snd a - m) g = ((f,t),true) ->
  In ((a,f),t) (newEntries g l m).
Proof.
  intros g l. induction l as [|h tl IH]; intros m a f t Hin Hnot Hlook.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct h as [h1 h2]. simpl in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst a. simpl.
      destruct (InB (h1, h2) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.
      destruct b.
      * exfalso. apply Hnot.
        assert (Hinp : In ((h1,h2),f0,t0) g) by (apply (InB_true (h1,h2) g f0 t0 Eb)).
        exact (in_dom_entry g (h1,h2) f0 t0 Hinp).
      * simpl. simpl in Hlook. rewrite Hlook. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + apply (In_newEntries_tail g (h1,h2) tl m a f t).
      apply (IH m a f t Hin Hnot Hlook).
Qed.

  ~ In a l -> ~ In a (domain g) ->
  InB (fst a, snd a - m) g = ((f,t), true) ->
  newEntries g (l ++ a :: nil) m = newEntries g l m ++ ((a,f,t)::nil).
Proof.
  intros g l. induction l as [|h tl IH]; intros a m f t Hnotl Hnotg Hlook.

    + exfalso. apply Hnotg. apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f0)(t:=t0).

Lemma InB_removeEntry_neq : forall a y g,
  a <> y -> InB a (removeEntry y g) = InB a g.
Proof.
  intros a y g. induction g as [|h tl IH]; intros Hneq.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[b fb] tb]. simpl.
    destruct (pair_eq b y) eqn:Eby.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Eby. subst b.
      destruct (pair_eq a y) eqn:Eay.
      * exfalso. apply Hneq. apply pair_eq_true in Eay. exact Eay.
      * reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:Eab.
      * simpl. rewrite Eab. reflexivity.
      * simpl. rewrite Eab. simpl. apply IH. exact Hneq.
Qed.

Lemma newEntries_cons_rem : forall g n tv l m,
  (forall a, In a l -> a <> n) ->
  (forall a, In a l -> (fst a, snd a - m) <> n) ->
  newEntries ((n,vis,tv)::removeEntry n g) l m = newEntries g l m.
Proof.
  intros g n tv l. induction l as [|h tl IH]; intros m Ha Hb.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [a1 a2]. simpl in *.
    assert (Htl : forall a, In a tl -> a <> n) by (intros; apply Ha; simpl; right; auto).
    assert (Htl2 : forall a, In a tl -> (fst a, snd a - m) <> n) by (intros; apply Hb; simpl; right; auto).
    assert (Han : (a1,a2) <> n) by (apply (Ha (a1,a2)); simpl; left; reflexivity).
    assert (Hbn : (a1, a2 - m) <> n) by (apply (Hb (a1,a2)); simpl; left; reflexivity).
    simpl.
    rewrite (pair_eq_neq (a1,a2) n Han). simpl.
    rewrite (InB_removeEntry_neq (a1,a2) n g Han).
    destruct (InB (a1,a2) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.
    destruct b; simpl.
    + apply (IH m Htl Htl2).
    + rewrite (pair_eq_neq (a1,a2-m) n Hbn). simpl.
      rewrite (InB_removeEntry_neq (a1,a2-m) n g Hbn). simpl.
      * rewrite domain_app. apply in_app_iff. left. exact H.
      * rewrite domain_app. apply in_app_iff. right. rewrite domain_weakenEnv_eq. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma In_newEntries_exact_iff : forall g L m a f t,
  NoDup L -> ~ In a (domain g) ->
  (In ((a,f),t) (newEntries g L m) <->
   In a L /\ (f,t) = fst (InB (fst a, snd a - m) g)).
Proof.
  intros g L. induction L as [|h tl IH]; intros m a f t Hnd Hfresh.

    + intro H; destruct H.
    + intros [H _]; destruct H.

    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hh Htl].
    destruct (InB (h1,h2) g) as [[f0 t0] b0] eqn:Eb0.
    destruct b0; simpl.
    + (* h already in g: head skipped *)
      split.

        -- apply (proj2 (IH m a f t Htl Hfresh)). split; auto.
    + (* h not in g: head added *)
      destruct (InB (h1,h2-m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1] eqn:Eb1; simpl.
      split.
      * intro Hentry. destruct Hentry as [Heq|Hentry].
        -- injection Heq as Ha Hf Ht. subst a f t.
           split; [left; reflexivity|].
           change ((f1,t1) = fst (InB (h1, h2 - m) g)). rewrite Eb1. reflexivity.
        -- apply (proj1 (IH m a f t Htl Hfresh)) in Hentry.

      * intros [Hin Heq]. destruct Hin as [HeqA|Hin].
        -- subst a. left. change ((f,t)=fst (InB (h1,h2-m) g)) in Heq.

        -- right. apply (proj2 (IH m a f t Htl Hfresh)). split; auto.

Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInU : forall u p t x q pf1 pf2,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf2 ->
      typeCheck ( (x, vis, t) :: g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dBang (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q).

End TypeSystemRules.

Lemma pmap_rename_fresh : forall q,
  (forall g x b t pf pf',
    x <> b ->
    ~ In b (domain g) ->
    ~ In b (bv q) ->
    NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::g)) ->
    snd x < max (domain ((b,vis,wk_type t)::g)) ->
    typeCheck ((x,vis,t)::g) pf q ->
    typeCheck ((b,vis,t)::g) pf' (pmap q (fst x) (snd x) (fst b) (snd b))).
Proof.
  intros q g x b t pf pf' Hxb Hb Hbv Hnd Hmx Hty.
  assert (Hbx : b <> x) by (intro Heq; apply Hxb; symmetry; exact Heq).
  assert (Hb_xenv : ~ In b (domain ((x,vis,t)::g))).
  { intro Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
    - apply Hxb. exact Heq.
    - exact (Hb Hc). }
  assert (ndB : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,wk_type t)::(x,vis,t)::g))).
  { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb_xenv|exact Hnd]. }
  assert (Hweak : typeCheck ((b,vis,wk_type t)::(x,vis,t)::g) (isMap_nodup _ ndB) q)
    by (exact (typeCheck_weaken ((x,vis,t)::g) pf q Hnd Hty b (wk_type t) Hb_xenv Hbv (consumable_wk t) (isMap_nodup _ ndB))).
  assert (P : Permutation ((b,vis,wk_type t)::(x,vis,t)::g) ((x,vis,t)::(b,vis,wk_type t)::g))
    by (apply perm_swap).
  assert (ndX : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,vis,wk_type t)::g)))
    by (apply (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ P); exact ndB).
  assert (HX : typeCheck ((x,vis,t)::(b,vis,wk_type t)::g) (isMap_nodup _ ndX) q)

Lemma dep_relabel_dNu : forall n1 n2 body s Hnds,
  dep_relabel (dNu n1 n2 body) s Hnds =
  dNu n1 (n2 + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel body s Hnds) n1 n2 n1 (n2 + max s)).

Lemma secLabs_dep_relabel_dNu : forall n1 n2 body s Hnds,
  secLabs (dep_relabel (dNu n1 n2 body) s Hnds) =
  secLabs (dep_relabel body s Hnds) ++ ((n1, n2 + max s) :: nil).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite secLabs_dep_relabel_map.
  change (map (shift_name (max s)) (secLabs body ++ (n1, n2) :: nil) =
          secLabs (dep_relabel body s Hnds) ++ ((n1, n2 + max s) :: nil)).
  rewrite map_app. simpl.
  rewrite <- secLabs_dep_relabel_map.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_lin_inv_l : forall t0 p t t2,
  type_plus (Chan lin p t0) t t2 ->
  exists p' p2, t = Chan lin p' t0 /\ t2 = Chan lin p2 t0 /\ pol_plus p p' p2.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t t2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma no_self_chan : forall m p t, t <> Chan m p t.
Proof.
  intros m p t. induction t as [m0 p0 t0 IH |]; intro H.
  - inversion H; subst. apply IH. assumption.
  - discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma no_type_sub_self_chan : forall m p t, ~ type_sub t (Chan m p t).
Proof.
  intros m p t H. inversion H; subst; eapply no_self_chan; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_cup_absorb_r : forall p q, pol_cup p (pol_cup q p) = pol_cup q p.
Proof. intros p q. destruct p, q; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_r : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_sub b c.
Proof.

Lemma type_plus_sym : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_plus b a c.

Lemma pol_cup_mid : forall p0 p1 p3,

Lemma pol_plus_mid_mid : forall p0 p1 p2 p3 p,
  pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus p0 p3 p ->
  exists p2v, pol_plus p1 p3 p2v /\ pol_plus p0 p2v p2.
Proof.
  intros p0 p1 p2 p3 p H1 H2. destruct H2.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_mid : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
  type_plus t1 t t2 -> type_plus t0 t3 t ->
  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_plus t0 t2v t2.
Proof.
  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 H1 H2.
  destruct t as [m p t'|].
  - destruct m.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      match goal with Hp2 : pol_plus _ _ p |- _ => rename Hp2 into Hpol2 end.
      inversion H1; subst.
      match goal with Hp1 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp1 into Hpol1 end.
      destruct (pol_plus_mid_mid _ _ _ _ _ Hpol1 Hpol2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
      exists (Chan lin f t'). split.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hf.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hg.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      inversion H1; subst.
      exists (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p2) t'). split.
      * apply Tp_UnPlus.
      * assert (E : pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p2) = pol_cup p0 (pol_cup p1 p2)).
        { rewrite pol_cup_mid. reflexivity. }
        rewrite <- E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
  - inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst.
    exists Top. split; apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_det : forall a b c1 c2,

Lemma cons_proj_of : forall g pf,
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> f <> hid -> consumable t) ->
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf.
Proof.
  intros g pf H. apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply (proj1 (In_vis_proj g n f t)) in Hin. apply (H n f t).
    + exact (proj1 Hin).
    + rewrite (proj2 Hin). discriminate.
  - apply (proj1 (In_ill_proj g n f t)) in Hin. apply (H n f t).
    + exact (proj1 Hin).
    + rewrite (proj2 Hin). discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma In_dom_w2 : forall g x b (fb:flag)(tb:piType),
  NoDup (domain g) -> In x (domain g) -> In b (domain g) -> x <> b ->
  forall x0, In x0 (domain ((b,fb,tb)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g))) <->
             x0 = b \/ (In x0 (domain g) /\ x0 <> x /\ x0 <> b).
Proof.
  intros g x b fb tb Hnd Hx Hb Hxb x0. simpl.
  rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g x b Hnd Hx Hb Hxb x0).
  split.
  - intros [H|H]. left; symmetry; exact H. right; exact H.
  - intros [H|H]. left; symmetry; exact H. right; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma domE : forall x b g (t:piType)(f:flag)(t1:piType) x0,
  In x0 (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) <-> x0 = x \/ x0 = b \/ In x0 (domain g).
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros [H|[H|H]].
  - left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; right; exact H.
  - left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; right; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma split_A : forall g1 g2 g x b (f:flag)(t t1:piType) tx1 tx2 (fb1 fb2:flag) tb1 tb2 t21 t22,
  NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g1) <-> In n (domain g2)) ->
  In ((x,vis),tx1) g1 -> In ((b,fb1),tb1) g1 ->
  In ((x,vis),tx2) g2 -> In ((b,fb2),tb2) g2 ->
  x <> b ->
  forall x0, In x0 (domain ((b,vis,t21)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g1))) <->
             In x0 (domain ((b,vis,t22)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g2))).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g x b f t t1 tx1 tx2 fb1 fb2 tb1 tb2 t21 t22 Hnd nd1 nd2 HA Hx1 Hb1 Hx2 Hb2 Hxb x0.
  rewrite (In_dom_w2 g1 x b vis t21 nd1 (in_dom_entry _ x vis tx1 Hx1) (in_dom_entry _ b fb1 tb1 Hb1) Hxb x0).
  rewrite (In_dom_w2 g2 x b vis t22 nd2 (in_dom_entry _ x vis tx2 Hx2) (in_dom_entry _ b fb2 tb2 Hb2) Hxb x0).
  split; intros [H|H].
  - left; exact H.
  - right. split; [apply (proj1 (HA x0)); exact (proj1 H) | exact (proj2 H)].
  - left; exact H.
  - right. split; [apply (proj2 (HA x0)); exact (proj1 H) | exact (proj2 H)].
Qed.

Lemma split_B : forall g2 g x b (f:flag)(t t1:piType) tx2 (fb2:flag) tb2 t22 t2,
  NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g2) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g2) <-> In n (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g))) ->
  In ((x,vis),tx2) g2 -> In ((b,fb2),tb2) g2 -> x <> b ->
  forall x0, In x0 (domain ((b,vis,t22)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g2))) <->
             In x0 (domain ((b,vis,t2)::g)).
Proof.
  intros g2 g x b f t t1 tx2 fb2 tb2 t22 t2 Hnd nd2 HB Hx2 Hb2 Hxb x0.
  rewrite (In_dom_w2 g2 x b vis t22 nd2 (in_dom_entry _ x vis tx2 Hx2) (in_dom_entry _ b fb2 tb2 Hb2) Hxb x0).
  simpl.
  simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnotx Hnd'].
  apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd'. destruct Hnd' as [Hnotb Hndg].
  assert (Hnotxg : ~ In x (domain g)) by (intro Hc; apply Hnotx; simpl; right; exact Hc).
  assert (Hnotbg : ~ In b (domain g)) by exact Hnotb.
  split; intros [H|H].
  - left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right. destruct H as [Hg2 [Hnx Hnb]].
    destruct (proj1 (domE x b g t f t1 x0) (proj1 (HB x0) Hg2)) as [Heq|[Heq|Hg]].
    + subst x0; contradiction.
    + subst x0; contradiction.
    + exact Hg.
  - left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right. split.
    + apply (proj2 (HB x0)). apply (proj2 (domE x b g t f t1 x0)); right; right; exact H.
    + split.
      * intro Hc; subst x0; contradiction.
      * intro Hc; subst x0; contradiction.
Qed.

      destruct (proj1 (In_dom_remove2 g1 x b nd1 (in_dom_entry _ x vis tx1 Hx1)

Lemma dep_relabel_typing : forall p g pf,
    typeCheck g pf p ->
    forall s Hnds,
      NoDup (domain g) ->
      max (domain g) <= max s ->
      sl_pos p ->
      forall pf',
        typeCheck
          (newEntries g (secLabs (dep_relabel p s Hnds)) (max s) ++ weakenEnv g)
          pf' (dep_relabel p s Hnds).
Proof.
  intros p g pf H.
  induction H as [g pf Hc
    | g pf body n t pf1 Hi Hbody IHb
    | g pf g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2 Hspl Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t1 t2 pf1 Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t2 pf1 Hpol Hr Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q t1 pf1 Hr Hu Hfresh Hmaxx Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmaxx Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 pf2 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmaxx Hcons Hbody IHb];
    intros s Hnds Hndg Hmax Hpos pf'.
  - (* TNil *)
    simpl. apply TNil. apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
    apply In_weakenEnv_cases in Hin. destruct Hin as [[Hg Hfh]|Hcase].
    + apply (cons_entry g pf Hc n f t Hg).
    + destruct Hcase as [t0 [Ef [Et Hing]]]. subst f t. apply consumable_wk.
  - (* TNew *)
    destruct n as [n1 n2]. simpl in *.
    set (L := secLabs (dep_relabel body s Hnds)).
    set (y := (n1, n2 + max s)).
    set (W := weakenEnv (removeEntry (n1,n2) g)).
    set (A := newEntries g L (max s)).
    assert (HtyP : typeCheck g pf (dNu n1 n2 body))
      by (exact (TNew body (n1,n2) t pf1 Hi Hbody)).
    assert (Hnb : ~ In (n1,n2) (secLabs body)).
    { pose proof (typeCheck_secLabs_nodup g (dNu n1 n2 body) pf HtyP) as HndSec.
      change (NoDup (secLabs body ++ (n1,n2)::nil)) in HndSec.
      pose proof (NoDup_remove_2 (secLabs body) nil (n1,n2) HndSec) as Hc.
      simpl in Hc. exact Hc. }
    assert (Hn2le : n2 <= max (domain g)).
    { apply In_domain_snd_le_max. apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid)(t:=t). exact Hi. }
    assert (Hn2pos : n2 > 0).
    { pose proof (sl_pos_In (dNu n1 n2 body) n1 n2 Hpos (In_secLabs_dNu n1 n2 body)) as Hp.
      simpl in Hp. exact Hp. }
    assert (Hmaxpos : max s > 0) by lia.
    assert (Hnotin_l : ~ In y L).
    { intro Hc. unfold L in Hc.
      destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift body s Hnds y Hc) as [[b1 b2] [Hb Heq]].
      unfold y in Heq. unfold shift_name in Heq. simpl in Heq.
      injection Heq as H1 H2. subst b1.
      apply Nat.add_cancel_r in H2. subst b2.
      exact (Hnb Hb). }
    assert (Hnotin_g_y : ~ In y (domain g)).
    { unfold y. apply (shifted_not_in_g g n1 n2 (max s)); [exact Hn2pos | exact Hmax]. }
    assert (Hlook : InB (n1,n2) g = ((hid,t),true)).
    { apply InB_complete; [exact Hndg | exact Hi]. }
    assert (HlookY : InB (fst y, snd y - max s) g = ((hid,t),true)).
    { unfold y. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_sub. exact Hlook. }
    assert (Hndg_body : NoDup (domain (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g)))
      by (exact (proj1 (NoDup_domain_cons_reuse (n1,n2) hid t vis t g Hndg Hi))).
    assert (Hmax_body : max (domain (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g)) <= max s).
    { eapply Nat.le_trans.
      - apply (max_domain_cons_rem_le g (n1,n2) t). exact Hn2le.
      - exact Hmax. }
    assert (Hpos_body : sl_pos body).
    { intros a1 a2 Ha. apply (sl_pos_In (dNu n1 n2 body) a1 a2 Hpos).
      simpl. apply in_or_app. left. exact Ha. }
    assert (HndL : NoDup L).
    { unfold L. apply NoDup_secLabs_dep_relabel.
      apply (typeCheck_secLabs_nodup (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g) body pf1 Hbody). }
    assert (HfreshL : forall a, In a L -> ~ In a (domain (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g))).
    { intros a Ha. unfold L in Ha.
      apply (secLabs_dep_relabel_notin body s Hnds (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g) a Hpos_body Hmax_body Ha). }
    assert (HndEnvBody : NoDup (domain (newEntries (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g) L (max s) ++
                                 weakenEnv (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g)))).
    { apply NoDup_domain_newEntries_weaken; [exact Hndg_body | exact HndL | exact HfreshL]. }
    pose proof (IHb s Hnds Hndg_body Hmax_body Hpos_body (isMap_nodup _ HndEnvBody)) as HbodyTyped.
    assert (Hnew : newEntries (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g) L (max s) = A).
    { unfold A. apply newEntries_cons_rem.
      - intros [a1 a2] Ha Heq.
        unfold L in Ha.
        destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift body s Hnds (a1,a2) Ha) as [[b1 b2] [Hb Heq2]].
        unfold shift_name in Heq2. simpl in Heq2.
        inversion Heq2 as [E1 E2]. subst a1 a2.
        injection Heq as H1 H2.
        pose proof (sl_pos_In body b1 b2 Hpos_body Hb) as Hbpos. simpl in Hbpos.
        lia.
      - intros [a1 a2] Ha Heq.
        unfold L in Ha.
        destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift body s Hnds (a1,a2) Ha) as [[b1 b2] [Hb Heq2]].
        unfold shift_name in Heq2. simpl in Heq2.
        inversion Heq2 as [E1 E2]. subst a1 a2.
        simpl. rewrite Nat.add_sub. intro Hcontra.
        apply (Hnb Hb). rewrite <- Hcontra. reflexivity. }
    assert (HndE : NoDup (domain (A ++ (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: W)))).
    { rewrite Hnew in HndEnvBody. exact HndEnvBody. }
    assert (HbodyTyped2 : typeCheck (A ++ (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: W))
              (isMap_nodup _ HndE) (dep_relabel body s Hnds)).
    { rewrite Hnew in HbodyTyped.
      exact (typeCheck_pf_irrel _ _ _ HbodyTyped (isMap_nodup _ HndE)). }
    assert (Hperm1 : Permutation (A ++ (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: W))
                                ((((n1,n2),vis,t)) :: A ++ W)).
    { apply perm_cons_mid. }
    assert (HndS : NoDup (domain ((((n1,n2),vis,t)) :: A ++ W))).
    { apply (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ Hperm1). exact HndE. }
    assert (HbodyS : typeCheck ((((n1,n2),vis,t)) :: A ++ W)
              (isMap_nodup _ HndS) (dep_relabel body s Hnds)).
    { apply (typeCheck_perm (A ++ (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: W))
               ((((n1,n2),vis,t)) :: A ++ W) (dep_relabel body s Hnds)
               (isMap_nodup _ HndE) (isMap_nodup _ HndS) HndE Hperm1 HbodyTyped2). }
    assert (Hxb : (n1,n2) <> y).
    { unfold y. intro Heq. injection Heq as H1 H2. lia. }
    assert (Hb : ~ In y (domain (A ++ W))).
    { intro Hc. apply in_app_iff in Hc. destruct Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      - unfold A in Hc. exact (Hnotin_l (domain_newEntries_sub g L (max s) y Hc)).
      - unfold W in Hc. rewrite domain_weakenEnv_eq in Hc.
        apply domain_removeEntry_sub in Hc. exact (Hnotin_g_y Hc). }
    assert (Hbv : ~ In y (bv (dep_relabel body s Hnds))).
    { intro Hc. rewrite bv_dep_relabel in Hc.
      pose proof (typeCheck_bv_max (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g) body pf1 Hbody y Hc) as Hlt.
      unfold y in Hlt. simpl in Hlt.
      lia. }
    assert (Hmx : snd (n1,n2) < max (domain (((y,vis,wk_type t) :: (A ++ W))))).
    { assert (Hin : In y (domain (((y,vis,wk_type t) :: (A ++ W)))))
        by (simpl; left; reflexivity).
      pose proof (In_domain_snd_le_max (((y,vis,wk_type t) :: (A ++ W))) y Hin) as Hle.
      unfold y in Hle. simpl in Hle. lia. }
    assert (HndgAW : NoDup (domain (A ++ W))).
    { apply NoDup_cons_iff in HndS. exact (proj2 HndS). }
    assert (HndT : NoDup (domain (((y,vis,t) :: (A ++ W))))).
    { apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb | exact HndgAW]. }
    pose proof (pmap_rename_fresh (dep_relabel body s Hnds) (A ++ W)
      (n1,n2) y t (isMap_nodup _ HndS) (isMap_nodup _ HndT)
      Hxb Hb Hbv HndS Hmx HbodyS) as Hpmap.
    assert (HnL : ~ In (n1,n2) L).
    { intro Hc.
      destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift body s Hnds (n1,n2) Hc) as [[b1 b2] [Hb2 Heq]].
      unfold shift_name in Heq. simpl in Heq. injection Heq as H1 H2.
      pose proof (sl_pos_In body b1 b2 Hpos_body Hb2) as Hbpos. simpl in Hbpos.
      lia. }
    assert (Hn_rem : ~ In (n1,n2) (domain W)).
    { unfold W. rewrite domain_weakenEnv_eq.
      apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (n1,n2) g Hndg).
      apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid)(t:=t). exact Hi. }
    assert (HnAW : ~ In (n1,n2) (domain (A ++ W))).
    { intro Hc. apply in_app_iff in Hc. destruct Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      - unfold A in Hc. exact (HnL (domain_newEntries_sub g L (max s) (n1,n2) Hc)).
      - exact (Hn_rem Hc). }
    assert (HnT : ~ In (n1,n2) (domain (((y,vis,t) :: (A ++ W))))).
    { intro Hc. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
      - exact (Hxb Heq).
      - exact (HnAW Hc). }

    { rewrite bv_pmap. rewrite bv_dep_relabel.
      apply (typeCheck_bv_domain (((n1,n2),vis,t) :: removeEntry (n1,n2) g) body pf1 Hbody (n1,n2)).
      simpl. left. reflexivity. }
    assert (HndAdd : NoDup (domain ((((n1,n2),ill,wk_type t)) :: (y,vis,t) :: (A ++ W)))).
    { apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact HnT | exact HndT]. }
    pose proof (typeCheck_add_entry_consumable ((y,vis,t) :: (A ++ W))
      (isMap_nodup _ HndT) (pmap (dep_relabel body s Hnds) n1 n2 n1 (n2+max s))
      HndT Hpmap (n1,n2) ill (wk_type t) (consumable_wk t) HnT Hnvbv
      (isMap_nodup _ HndAdd)) as Hadd.
    assert (HpermSource : Permutation
      ((((n1,n2),ill,wk_type t)) :: (y,vis,t) :: (A ++ W))
      ((y,vis,t) :: (A ++ weakenEnv g))).
    { eapply perm_trans.
      - apply perm_swap.
      - eapply perm_trans.
        + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_sym.

        + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_sym.
          apply Permutation_app.
          * apply Permutation_refl.
          * apply Permutation_weakenEnv_insert_hid; auto. }

    { unfold A. intro Hc. exact (Hnotin_l (domain_newEntries_sub g L (max s) y Hc)). }
    assert (HbodyPerm : typeCheck ((y,vis,t) :: (A ++ weakenEnv g))
              (isMap_nodup _ (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ HpermSource HndAdd))
              (pmap (dep_relabel body s Hnds) n1 n2 n1 (n2 + max s))).
    { apply (typeCheck_perm ((((n1,n2),ill,wk_type t)) :: (y,vis,t) :: (A ++ W))
               ((y,vis,t) :: (A ++ weakenEnv g))
               (pmap (dep_relabel body s Hnds) n1 n2 n1 (n2 + max s))
               (isMap_nodup _ HndAdd)
               (isMap_nodup _ (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ HpermSource HndAdd))
               HndAdd HpermSource Hadd). }
    rewrite dep_relabel_dNu.
    rewrite secLabs_dep_relabel_dNu.

Lemma typeCheck_add_entry_consumable : forall g pf p,
  NoDup (domain g) -> typeCheck g pf p ->
  forall xn fx tx,
    consumable tx ->
    ~ In xn (domain g) ->
    ~ In xn (bv p) ->
    forall pf', typeCheck ((xn,fx,tx)::g) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g pf p Hnd H. induction H; intros xn fx tx Hc Hx Hbv pf'.
  - (* TNil *) apply TNil. apply (cons_insert_flag g pf xn fx tx H Hc pf').
  - (* TNew *)
    assert (Hn_g : In n (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid)(t:=t); exact H).
    assert (Hnx : xn <> n).

    assert (Hx_rem : ~ In xn (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. apply Hx.
      exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g xn) Hcc)). }

    { intro Hcc. exact (proj2 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g n) Hcc) eq_refl). }
    assert (ndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd).
    assert (ndNrem : NoDup (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hn_not_rem|exact ndRem]. }
    assert (Hx_nrem : ~ In xn (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. destruct Hcc as [Heq|Hcc].
      - apply Hnx. symmetry. exact Heq.
      - exact (Hx_rem Hcc). }
    assert (ndSource : NoDup (domain ((xn,fx,tx)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hx_nrem|exact ndNrem]. }
    assert (P : Permutation ((xn,fx,tx)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
                         ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((xn,fx,tx)::g))).

    assert (Hbv2 : ~ In xn (bv p2)).
    { intro Hcc. apply Hbv. simpl. apply in_or_app. right. exact Hcc. }

    + (* hid *)

Lemma typeCheck_weaken : forall g pf q,
  NoDup (domain g) -> typeCheck g pf q ->
  forall b tb, ~ In b (domain g) -> ~ In b (bv q) -> consumable tb ->
  forall pf', typeCheck ((b,vis,tb)::g) pf' q.
Proof.
  intros g pf q Hnd H. induction H; intros b tb Hb Hbv Hc pf'.
  - (* TNil *) apply TNil. apply (cons_insert g pf b tb H Hc pf').
  - (* TNew *)
    assert (Hn_g : In n (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid)(t:=t); exact H).
    assert (Hnb : b <> n).
    { intro Heq. apply Hb. rewrite Heq. exact Hn_g. }
    assert (Hb_rem : ~ In b (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. apply Hb.
      exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g b) Hcc)). }
    assert (Hn_not_rem : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. exact (proj2 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g n) Hcc) eq_refl). }
    assert (ndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd).
    assert (ndNrem : NoDup (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hn_not_rem|exact ndRem]. }
    assert (Hb_nrem : ~ In b (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. destruct Hcc as [Heq|Hcc].
      - apply Hnb. symmetry. exact Heq.
      - exact (Hb_rem Hcc). }
    assert (ndSource : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb_nrem|exact ndNrem]. }
    assert (P : Permutation ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
                         ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((b,vis,tb)::g))).
    { rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq b n vis tb g); [| intro Hneq; apply Hnb; exact Hneq]. apply perm_swap. }
    eapply TNew with (n := n) (t := t).
    + simpl. right. exact H.
    + exact (typeCheck_perm_auto ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
               ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((b,vis,tb)::g)) p
               (isMap_nodup _ ndSource) ndSource P
               (IHtypeCheck ndNrem b tb Hb_nrem Hbv Hc (isMap_nodup _ ndSource))).
  - (* TPar *)
    match goal with Hs : tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf |- _ => rename Hs into Hsplit end.
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hsplit Hnd) as [nd1 nd2].
    destruct (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hsplit) as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (Hb1 : ~ In b (domain g1)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hb. exact (proj1 (HB b) (proj1 (HA b) Hx)). }
    assert (Hb2 : ~ In b (domain g2)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hb. exact (proj1 (HB b) Hx). }
    assert (Hbv1 : ~ In b (bv p1)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hbv. simpl. apply in_or_app. left. exact Hx. }
    assert (Hbv2 : ~ In b (bv p2)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hbv. simpl. apply in_or_app. right. exact Hx. }
    assert (ndS1 : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::g1))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb1|exact nd1]. }
    assert (ndS2 : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::g2))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb2|exact nd2]. }
    eapply TPar with (g1 := (b,vis,tb)::g1) (g2 := (b,vis,tb)::g2).
    + assert (Hes : esplit g1 g2 g) by (apply (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hsplit)).
      eapply esplit_tEnv_split.
      * apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb1|exact nd1].
      * apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb2|exact nd2].
      * apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb|exact Hnd].
      * apply esplit_insert_common; [exact Hes|exact Hc|exact Hb1|exact Hb2].
    + exact (IHtypeCheck1 nd1 b tb Hb1 Hbv1 Hc (isMap_nodup _ ndS1)).
    + exact (IHtypeCheck2 nd2 b tb Hb2 Hbv2 Hc (isMap_nodup _ ndS2)).
  - (* TOutL *)
    destruct (pair_eq u v) eqn:Euv.
    + (* u = v vacuous *)
      apply pair_eq_true in Euv; subst v.
      assert (Ht' : t' = Chan lin p t).
      { assert (He : ((u,vis),t') = ((u,vis),Chan lin p t)).
        { apply (nodup_entry_unique g u vis t' u vis (Chan lin p t) Hnd H2 H1 eq_refl). }
        exact (f_equal (fun e : ((name*name)*flag)*piType => snd e) He). }
      subst t'. unfold type_remove in H0. destruct H0 as [Hsub _].
      exfalso. eapply no_type_sub_self_chan; exact Hsub.
    + assert (Huv : u <> v) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Euv).
      assert (Hug : In u (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis)(t:=Chan lin p t); exact H1).
      assert (Hvg : In v (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis)(t:=t'); exact H2).
      assert (Hbu : b <> u).
      { intro Hq. apply Hb. rewrite Hq. exact Hug. }
      assert (Hbv2 : b <> v).
      { intro Hq. apply Hb. rewrite Hq. exact Hvg. }
      assert (Pdom : Permutation (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) (domain g))
        by (apply domain_out_env; auto).
      assert (ndE : NoDup (domain ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))).
      { change (NoDup (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))).
        apply (NoDup_perm_list _ _ _ (Permutation_sym Pdom)).
        change (NoDup (domain g)) in Hnd. exact Hnd. }
      assert (Hb_E : ~ In b (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))).
      { intro Hx. destruct Hx as [Heq|Hx].
        - apply Hbu. symmetry. exact Heq.
        - destruct Hx as [Heq|Hx].
          + apply Hbv2. symmetry. exact Heq.
          + apply Hb.
            apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff u g Hug b)).
            right.
            apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff v (removeEntry u g)
                           (domain_removeEntry_neq u g v (fun Hq => Huv (eq_sym Hq)) Hvg) b)).
            right. exact Hx. }
      assert (ndSource : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::(u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))).
      { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb_E|exact ndE]. }
      assert (Pbody : Permutation ((b,vis,tb)::(u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))
                                  ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u ((b,vis,tb)::g)))).
      { rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq b u vis tb g); [| intro Hq; apply Hbu; exact Hq].
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq b v vis tb (removeEntry u g)); [| intro Hq; apply Hbv2; exact Hq].
        eapply perm_trans with (l' := (u,vis,t1)::(b,vis,tb)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)).
        - apply perm_swap.
        - apply perm_skip. apply perm_swap. }
      assert (ndTarget : NoDup (domain ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u ((b,vis,tb)::g)))))
        by (apply (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ Pbody); exact ndSource).
      assert (HbodyCanon : typeCheck ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u ((b,vis,tb)::g)))
                                       (isMap_nodup _ ndTarget) q)
        by (apply (typeCheck_perm ((b,vis,tb)::(u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))
                     ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u ((b,vis,tb)::g))) q
                     (isMap_nodup _ ndSource) (isMap_nodup _ ndTarget) ndSource Pbody
                     (IHtypeCheck ndE b tb Hb_E Hbv Hc (isMap_nodup _ ndSource)))).
      eapply TOutL with (u := u) (p := p) (t := t) (v := v) (t' := t') (q := q) (t1 := t1) (t2 := t2).

Lemma pol_plus_det : forall p q r1 r2, pol_plus p q r1 -> pol_plus p q r2 -> r1=r2.
Proof. intros p q r1 r2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_det : forall f g h1 h2, flag_plus f g h1 -> flag_plus f g h2 -> h1=h2.
Proof. intros f g h1 h2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_sym : forall p q r, pol_plus p q r -> pol_plus q p r.
Proof. intros p q r H. inversion H; subst; eauto using pol_plus. Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_sym : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> flag_plus g f h.
Proof. intros f g h H. inversion H; subst; eauto using flag_plus. Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_assoc : forall a b c d e, pol_plus a b c -> pol_plus c d e ->
  exists f, pol_plus b d f /\ pol_plus a f e.
Proof. intros a b c d e H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using pol_plus. Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_assoc : forall a b c d e, flag_plus a b c -> flag_plus c d e ->
  exists f, flag_plus b d f /\ flag_plus a f e.
Proof. intros a b c d e H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using flag_plus. Qed.

Inductive ecomb : (flag*piType) -> (flag*piType) -> (flag*piType) -> Prop :=
| ec_top : forall f1 f2 f, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Top) (f2,Top) (f,Top)
| ec_un : forall f1 f2 f p t, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Chan un p t) (f2,Chan un p t) (f,Chan un p t)
| ec_lin : forall f1 f2 f p1 p2 p t, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      ecomb (f1,Chan lin p1 t) (f2,Chan lin p2 t) (f,Chan lin p t).

Lemma ecomb_det : forall a b c1 c2, ecomb a b c1 -> ecomb a b c2 -> c1=c2.
Proof.
  intros a b c1 c2 H1 H2.
  destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c1 as [fc tc], c2 as [fd td].
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; simpl; f_equal;
    eauto using flag_plus_det, pol_plus_det.
  try (f_equal; eauto using pol_plus_det).
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_sym : forall a b c, ecomb a b c -> ecomb b a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc].
  inversion H; subst; simpl; eauto using ecomb, pol_plus_sym, flag_plus_sym.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_assoc : forall a b c d e, ecomb a b c -> ecomb c d e ->
  exists f, ecomb b d f /\ ecomb a f e.
Proof.
  intros a b c d e H1 H2.
  destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc], d as [fd td], e as [fe te].
  inversion H1 as [fa' fb' fc' Hfab | fa' fb' fc' p t Hfab | fa' fb' fc' p1 p2 p t Hfab Hp]; subst.
  - inversion H2 as [fc2 fd' fe' Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' pu tu Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' q1 q2 q tq Hfcd Hpq]; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (flag_plus_assoc fa fb fc fd fe Hfab Hfcd) as [fg [H5 H6]].
    exists (fg, Top). split; apply ec_top; assumption.
  - inversion H2 as [fc2 fd' fe' Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' pu tu Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' q1 q2 q tq Hfcd Hpq]; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (flag_plus_assoc fa fb fc fd fe Hfab Hfcd) as [fg [H5 H6]].
    exists (fg, Chan un p t). split; apply ec_un; assumption.
  - inversion H2 as [fc2 fd' fe' Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' pu tu Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' q1 q2 q tq Hfcd Hpq]; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (flag_plus_assoc fa fb fc fd fe Hfab Hfcd) as [fg [H5 H6]].
    destruct (pol_plus_assoc p1 p2 p q2 q Hp Hpq) as [pg [H7 H8]].
    exists (fg, Chan lin pg t). split; apply ec_lin; assumption.
Qed.

  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1' pf2' pf3'.

  intros g1 g1' g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 E H pf1'. subst.
  apply (tEnv_split_pf_irrel g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 H pf1' pf2 pf3).

Lemma In_dom_remove2 : forall g x b, NoDup (domain g) -> In x (domain g) -> In b (domain g) -> x <> b ->
  forall x0, In x0 (domain (removeEntry b (removeEntry x g))) <-> In x0 (domain g) /\ x0 <> x /\ x0 <> b.
Proof.
  intros g x b Hnd Hx Hb Hxb x0.
  assert (Hndx : NoDup (domain (removeEntry x g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hbx : In b (domain (removeEntry x g))) by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto).
  rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 b (removeEntry x g) Hndx Hbx x0).
  rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 x g Hnd Hx x0).
  tauto.
Qed.

Definition esplit (g1 g2 g3 : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g1) <-> In n (domain g2)) /\
  (forall n, In n (domain g2) <-> In n (domain g3)) /\
  (forall n f1 t1 f2 t2, In ((n,f1),t1) g1 -> In ((n,f2),t2) g2 ->
      exists f t, In ((n,f),t) g3 /\ ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t)).

Lemma nodup_cons_step : forall n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf1 pf2 pf3,
  NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In n (domain g1) -> In n (domain g2) -> In n (domain g3) ->
  NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g1)) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g2)) ->
  tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
  NoDup (domain g1) /\ NoDup (domain g2).
Proof.
  intros n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf1 pf2 pf3 Hnd3 Hn1 Hn2 Hn3 Hndr1 Hndr2 Hspl Hrem.
  assert (Hnd3' : NoDup (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3).
  assert (Hnotin3 : ~ In n (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_removeEntry_still; auto).
  pose proof (tEnv_split_esplit _ _ _ _ _ _ Hspl) as Hes.
  destruct Hes as [HA [HB HC]].
  assert (Hnot1 : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g1))).
  { intro Hc. apply Hnotin3. apply (proj1 (HB n)). apply (proj1 (HA n) Hc). }
  assert (Hnot2 : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g2))).
  { intro Hc. apply Hnotin3. apply (proj1 (HB n)). exact Hc. }
  split.
  - apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (n :: domain (removeEntry n g1)) (domain g1)).
    + apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hn1.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; auto.
  - apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (n :: domain (removeEntry n g2)) (domain g2)).
    + apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hn2.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_nodup : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
  NoDup (domain g1) /\ NoDup (domain g2).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 H.
  induction H as [g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Eg1 Eg2 Eg3
                  | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hpq Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
                  | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
                  | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty]; intro Hnd3.
  - subst. split; constructor.
  - (* SpLin *) 
    apply (nodup_cons_step n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hnd3).
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Chan lin p t); exact Hi1.
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=g) (t:=Chan lin q t); exact Hi2.
    + destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n (Chan lin p' t) Hty) as [fz Hz]; apply in_dom_entry with (f:=fz) (t:=Chan lin p' t); exact Hz.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + exact Hrec.
    + exact Hrem.
  - (* SpUn *)
    apply (nodup_cons_step n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hnd3).
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Chan un p t); exact Hi1.
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=g) (t:=Chan un p t); exact Hi2.
    + destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n (Chan un p t) Hty) as [fz Hz]; apply in_dom_entry with (f:=fz) (t:=Chan un p t); exact Hz.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + exact Hrec.
    + exact Hrem.
  - (* SpTop *)
    apply (nodup_cons_step n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hnd3).
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Top); exact Hi1.
    + apply in_dom_entry with (f:=g) (t:=Top); exact Hi2.
    + destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n Top Hty) as [fz Hz]; apply in_dom_entry with (f:=fz) (t:=Top); exact Hz.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + apply IH. rewrite <- Hrem. apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3.
    + exact Hrec.
    + exact Hrem.
Qed.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t

Lemma cons_perm : forall g g' pf pf', Permutation g g' -> cons g pf -> cons g' pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hp Hc. apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply (proj1 (cons_spec g pf) Hc n f t).
  exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hin).
Qed.

      + apply (Permutation_in x Hpdom). apply (proj1 (HB x)). exact Hx.
      + apply (proj2 (HB x)). exact (Permutation_in x (Permutation_sym Hpdom) Hx).
    - intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1 He2.

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev AuxDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Scratch development for subject reduction, parameterized by the     *)
(* relabelling typing lemma.  No admitted proofs in this file.         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1.  Elementary facts about pol_plus / flag_plus / ecomb             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma pol_plus_cup : forall p q r, pol_plus p q r -> r = pol_cup p q.
Proof.
  intros p q r H. inversion H; subst; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_cup_inv : forall p q r, r = pol_cup p q ->
  (p = empty \/ q = empty \/ (p = inp /\ q = out) \/ (p = out /\ q = inp) \/
   (p = inp /\ q = inp) \/ (p = out /\ q = out) \/ (p = io /\ q = empty) \/
   (p = empty /\ q = io)).
Proof.
  intros p q r H. subst r. destruct p, q; simpl; auto.
Qed.

(* The pure polarity cancellation used in the out/in cases. *)
Lemma pol_plus_cancel : forall t a ta b c t1,
  pol_plus t a ta -> pol_plus ta b t1 -> pol_plus t c t1 ->
  pol_plus a b c.
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
    eauto using pol_plus.
Qed.

(* The vis-only flag cancellation needed at the value name. *)
Lemma flag_plus_cancel_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
  flag_plus t a ta -> flag_plus ta b t1 -> flag_plus t c t1 ->
  flag_plus a b c.
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
    eauto using flag_plus.
Qed.

(* Combination functions witnessing the (partial) monoid operations. *)
Definition flag_comb (f g : flag) : flag :=
  match f, g with
  | hid, ill | ill, hid => hid
  | vis, vis => vis
  | ill, ill => ill
  | _, _ => hid
  end.

Definition type_comb (t1 t2 : piType) : piType :=
  match t1, t2 with
  | Top, Top => Top
  | Chan lin p1 u, Chan lin p2 _ => Chan lin (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | Chan un p1 u, Chan un p2 _ => Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | _, _ => Top
  end.

Lemma flag_plus_comb : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> h = flag_comb f g.
Proof.
  intros f g h H. inversion H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_comb : forall t1 t2 t3, type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> t3 = type_comb t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H. inversion H; subst; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (pol_plus_cup p1 p2 p H2). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_comb : forall a b c, ecomb a b c ->
  c = (flag_comb (fst a) (fst b), type_comb (snd a) (snd b)).
Proof.
  intros a b c H. destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc].
  inversion H; subst; simpl.
  - rewrite (flag_plus_comb fa fb f H). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (flag_plus_comb fa fb f H). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (flag_plus_comb fa fb f H).
    rewrite (pol_plus_cup p1 p2 p H3). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Determinacy of the combination, in the form used to rebuild splits. *)
Lemma ecomb_unique : forall a b c d, ecomb a b c -> ecomb a b d -> c = d.
Proof. intros. eapply ecomb_det; eauto. Qed.

(* A triple whose two legs combine can be completed to ecomb when the
   first-leg/third-leg combination is also given. *)
Lemma ecomb_cancel_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
  type_plus t a ta ->
  ecomb (vis, ta) (vis, b) (vis, t1) ->
  type_plus t c t1 ->
  ecomb (vis, a) (vis, b) (vis, c).
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 Hp He Hc.
  destruct t as [m1 p1 u1 |]; destruct a as [m2 p2 u2 |];
    destruct ta as [m3 p3 u3 |]; destruct b as [m4 p4 u4 |];
    destruct c as [m5 p5 u5 |]; destruct t1 as [m6 p6 u6 |];
    try (inversion Hp; fail); try (inversion He; fail); try (inversion Hc; fail).
  - inversion Hp; subst. inversion He; subst. inversion Hc; subst.
    + simpl in *. subst. apply ec_top. eapply flag_plus_cancel_vis; eauto.
    + simpl in *. subst. apply ec_un. eapply flag_plus_cancel_vis; eauto.
    + simpl in *. subst. apply ec_lin.
      * eapply flag_plus_cancel_vis; eauto.
      * eapply pol_plus_cancel; eauto.
Qed.

(* Symmetric version, in case the value leg is presented commuted. *)
Lemma ecomb_cancel_vis_sym : forall t a ta b c t1,
  type_plus t a ta ->
  ecomb (vis, ta) (vis, b) (vis, t1) ->
  type_plus t c t1 ->
  ecomb (vis, b) (vis, a) (vis, c).
Proof. intros. apply ecomb_sym. eapply ecomb_cancel_vis; eauto. Qed.

(* Combining an empty linear share with anything (in the target split,
   consumed channel names become [Chan lin empty]). *)
Lemma ecomb_empty_left : forall b c,
  ecomb (vis, Chan lin empty (snd b)) b c -> c = b.
Proof.
  intros [fb tb] c H. inversion H; subst; simpl in *.
  - inversion H1.
  - inversion H1.
  - inversion H2; subst. f_equal. eapply pol_plus_det; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_empty_right : forall a c,
  ecomb a (vis, Chan lin empty (snd a)) c -> c = a.
Proof. intros a c H. apply ecomb_sym in H. apply ecomb_empty_left in H. auto. Qed.

(* The canonical split of a consumed linear channel. *)
Lemma ecomb_lin_empty_self : forall t,
  ecomb (vis, Chan lin empty t) (vis, Chan lin empty t) (vis, Chan lin empty t).
Proof.
  intros. apply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv | apply Pp_emptyL].
Qed.

(* A triple whose two legs combine can be completed to ecomb when the
   first-leg/third-leg combination is also given. *)
Lemma ecomb_cancel_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
  type_plus t a ta ->
  ecomb (vis, ta) (vis, b) (vis, t1) ->
  type_plus t c t1 ->
  ecomb (vis, a) (vis, b) (vis, c).
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 Hp He Hc.
  destruct t as [m1 p1 u1 |]; destruct a as [m2 p2 u2 |];
    destruct ta as [m3 p3 u3 |]; destruct b as [m4 p4 u4 |];
    destruct c as [m5 p5 u5 |]; destruct t1 as [m6 p6 u6 |];
    try (inversion Hp; fail); try (inversion He; fail); try (inversion Hc; fail).
  - inversion Hp; subst. inversion He; subst. inversion Hc; subst.
    + simpl in *. subst. apply ec_top. eapply flag_plus_cancel_vis; eauto.
    + simpl in *. subst. apply ec_un. eapply flag_plus_cancel_vis; eauto.
    + simpl in *. subst. apply ec_lin.
      * eapply flag_plus_cancel_vis; eauto.
      * eapply pol_plus_cancel; eauto.
Qed.

(* Symmetric version, in case the value leg is presented commuted. *)
Lemma ecomb_cancel_vis_sym : forall t a ta b c t1,
  type_plus t a ta ->
  ecomb (vis, ta) (vis, b) (vis, t1) ->
  type_plus t c t1 ->
  ecomb (vis, b) (vis, a) (vis, c).
Proof. intros. apply ecomb_sym. eapply ecomb_cancel_vis; eauto. Qed.

(* Combining an empty linear share with anything (in the target split,
   consumed channel names become [Chan lin empty]). *)
Lemma ecomb_empty_left : forall b c,
  ecomb (vis, Chan lin empty (snd b)) b c -> c = b.
Proof.
  intros [fb tb] c H. inversion H; subst; simpl in *.
  - inversion H1.
  - inversion H1.
  - inversion H2; subst. f_equal. eapply pol_plus_det; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_empty_right : forall a c,
  ecomb a (vis, Chan lin empty (snd a)) c -> c = a.
Proof. intros a c H. apply ecomb_sym in H. apply ecomb_empty_left in H. auto. Qed.

(* The canonical split of a consumed linear channel. *)
Lemma ecomb_lin_empty_self : forall t,
  ecomb (vis, Chan lin empty t) (vis, Chan lin empty t) (vis, Chan lin empty t).

(* A triple whose two legs combine can be completed to ecomb when the
   first-leg/third-leg combination is also given.  The extra conditions
   are exactly the "no shrinking of unrestricted types" clauses of
   [type_remove]. *)
Lemma ecomb_cancel_remove_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
  type_plus t a ta ->
  ecomb (vis, ta) (vis, b) (vis, t1) ->
  type_plus t c t1 ->
  (is_unrestricted ta -> a = ta) ->
  (is_unrestricted t1 -> c = t1) ->
  ecomb (vis, a) (vis, b) (vis, c).
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 Hp He Hc Hua Huc.
  inversion Hp as [| p1 p2 p3 u Hpp | p1 p2 u]; subst.
  - (* t = a = ta = Top *)
    apply ecomb_top_inv in He. destruct He as [Hb [Ht1 Hf]]. subst.
    apply type_plus_second_top in Hc. destruct Hc as [Ha Hc]. subst.
    apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
  - (* all linear *)
    apply ecomb_lin_inv in He.
    destruct He as [q [r [Hb [Ht1 [Hf Hpq]]]]]. subst.
    inversion Hc as [| q1 q2 q3 u' Hcc | q1 q2 u' Hcc]; subst;
      try discriminate.
    apply ec_lin.
    + apply Fp_vv.
    + eapply pol_plus_cancel; eauto.
  - (* all unrestricted: the no-shrink conditions force both residual
       shares to be the common type *)
    apply ecomb_un_inv in He.
    destruct He as [Hb [Ht1 Hf]]. subst.
    inversion Hc as [| q1 q2 q3 u' Hcc | q1 q2 u' Hcc]; subst;
      try discriminate.
    assert (Ha : Chan un p2 u = Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u)
      by (apply Hua; exists (pol_cup p1 p2), u; reflexivity).
    assert (HcEq : Chan un (pol_cup p1 q2) u = Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u)
      by (apply Huc; exists (pol_cup p1 p2), u; reflexivity).
    inversion Ha; inversion HcEq; subst.
    apply ec_un. apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

(* Combining a linear empty share on the right leaves the other entry
   unchanged (this is the target shape of a consumed linear channel). *)
Lemma ecomb_empty_right : forall a t c,
  ecomb a (vis, Chan lin empty t) c -> c = a.
Proof.
  intros [fa ta] t c H. inversion H; subst; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - inversion H2.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_empty_left : forall b t c,
  ecomb (vis, Chan lin empty t) b c -> c = b.
Proof.
  intros b t c H. apply ecomb_sym in H. apply ecomb_empty_right in H. auto.
Qed.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.

    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.

  match t with
  | Chan lin p t0 => Chan lin empty t0

Lemma type_plus_wk : forall t, type_plus (wk_type t) t t.
Proof.
  intros t. destruct t as [m p t0|]; simpl.
  - destruct m.
    + apply Tp_LinPlus. apply Pp_emptyL.

        by apply Tp_UnPlus.
      rewrite (pol_cup_idem p) in H. exact H.
  - apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + simpl. right; exact H.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left; exact Heq.
      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.

The TPar constructor: needs tEnv_split gA gB E pfA pfB pf' and typeCheck gA pfA (dep_relabel p1) and typeCheck gB pfB (dep_relabel p2). We can choose gA = A1? or A2? Need align with newEntries. The natural split at E: first component maybe A2 ++ weakenEnv g2? Wait IH1 gives typeCheck (newEntries g1 L1 ++ weakenEnv g1) pf (dep_relabel p1). IH2 gives typeCheck (A2 ++ weakenEnv g2) for p2. To build a tEnv_split of E = A2 ++ (A1 ++ weakenEnv g), we want a split where component1 = A2++? etc.

Recall `esplit_newEntries_weaken : forall g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf, tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf -> NoDup... -> ... -> forall L m, NoDup L -> (forall a, In a L -> ~In a (domain g)) -> esplit (newEntries g1 L m ++ weakenEnv g1) (newEntries g2 L m ++ weakenEnv g2) (newEntries g L m ++ weakenEnv g)`.

This gives esplit for the SAME L and both g1,g2. Our E canonically is newEntries g (L2++L1) ++ weakenEnv g. We need an esplit of:
- component for p1: newEntries g1 ? ++ weakenEnv g1 where ? should be L1 (IH1 canonical)
- component for p2: newEntries g2 ? ++ weakenEnv g2 where ? should be L2
- whole E: newEntries g (L2++L1) ++ weakenEnv g.

But esplit_newEntries_weaken with L = L1 gives components A1 ++ Wg1, A1 ++ Wg2, A1 ++ Wg. Not matching p2's A2. With L=L2 gives A2 components and whole A2++Wg. To get split into different sets, need combine via esplit_insert_common etc. Summary planned: extend IH1 with newEntries g1 L2 using typeCheck_add_entries_consumable, and IH2 with newEntries g2 L1, then use esplit_newEntries_weaken? Hmm.

Let's think: We want to construct `tEnv_split` (or esplit) of E1 = A2 ++ (A1 ++ Wg1)? Wait target split components' environments must be exactly what our typeCheck proofs use. We can choose component envs freely as long as they split E.

Option: Let component1 = A2 ++ (A1 ++ Wg1) and component2 = Wg2. Does that split E = A2 ++ (A1 ++ Wg)? Splitting E into (A2 ++ A1 ++ Wg1) and Wg2 requires splitting each entry: A2 entries go to component1 (as newEntries g2 L2), A1 entries to component1 (newEntries g1 L1), and Wg splits into Wg1 + Wg2. This is plausible via esplit_newEntries_weaken with L = L2++L1? That lemma gives:
esplit (newEntries g1 (L2++L1) ++ Wg1) (newEntries g2 (L2++L1) ++ Wg2) (newEntries g (L2++L1) ++ Wg).
Not what we want (each component gets both L2 and L1 entries).

Alternative: component1 = A1 ++ Wg1 (IH1 canonical), component2 = A2 ++ Wg2 (IH2 canonical). Then split of E = A2 ++ A1 ++ Wg into A1 ++ Wg1 and A2 ++ Wg2. But ordering: component1 A1 first, component2 A2. The whole E has A2 before A1 (since secLabs dPar = L2++L1). A split of E can permute? tEnv_split is about exact envs; but esplit may include permutations? Let's inspect tEnv_split/esplit definitions and the lemmas' signatures to know what is achievable.

Lemma newEntries_app : forall g l1 l2 m,
  newEntries g (l1 ++ l2) m = newEntries g l1 m ++ newEntries g l2 m.
Proof.
  intros g l1. induction l1 as [|[a1 a2] tl IH]; intros l2 m.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (InB (a1,a2) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.
    destruct b; simpl.
    + apply IH.
    + rewrite IH. destruct (InB (a1, a2 - m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1]; simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The type produced by an ecomb is the type_plus of its two components. *)
Lemma ecomb_type_plus : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> type_plus t1 t2 t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - apply Tp_Base.
  - match goal with
    | |- type_plus (Chan un ?p ?q) (Chan un ?p ?q) (Chan un ?p ?q) =>
        pose proof (Tp_UnPlus p p q) as Htp; rewrite pol_cup_idem in Htp; exact Htp
    end.
  - eapply Tp_LinPlus; eauto.
Qed.

(* Consumability is preserved by combining two consumable components. *)
Lemma ecomb_consumable : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) ->
    consumable t1 -> consumable t2 -> consumable t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t Hec H1 H2.
  apply (consumable_plus t1 t2 t H1 H2).
  apply ecomb_type_plus with (f1:=f1) (f2:=f2) (f:=f). exact Hec.
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_ill_consumable : forall g pf p,

    | g pf pb n t pf1 Hi Hbody IHb

    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 pf2 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hcons Hbody IHb].

  flag_plus a b c.
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
    eauto using flag_plus.
Qed.

(* Combination functions witnessing the (partial) monoid operations. *)
Definition flag_comb (f g : flag) : flag :=
  match f, g with
  | hid, ill | ill, hid => hid
  | vis, vis => vis
  | ill, ill => ill
  | _, _ => hid
  end.

Definition type_comb (t1 t2 : piType) : piType :=
  match t1, t2 with
  | Top, Top => Top
  | Chan lin p1 u, Chan lin p2 _ => Chan lin (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | Chan un p1 u, Chan un p2 _ => Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | _, _ => Top
  end.

Lemma flag_plus_comb : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> h = flag_comb f g.
Proof.
  intros f g h H. inversion H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_comb : forall t1 t2 t3, type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> t3 = type_comb t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H. inversion H as [| p1 p2 p t' Hp | p1 p2 t']; subst; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (pol_plus_cup p1 p2 p Hp). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_comb : forall a b c, ecomb a b c ->
  c = (flag_comb (fst a) (fst b), type_comb (snd a) (snd b)).
Proof.
  intros a b c H. destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc].
  inversion H; subst; simpl.
  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf); reflexivity end.
  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf); rewrite pol_cup_idem; reflexivity end.
  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf);
      match goal with Hp : pol_plus ?a ?b ?c |- _ =>
        rewrite (pol_plus_cup a b c Hp); reflexivity end end.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev AuxDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Scratch development for subject reduction.                          *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* STATUS: infrastructure only; the main theorem [sr_from_dep_relabel] *)
(* is NOT completed.  The lemmas below are all Qed-completed and the   *)
(* file compiles with no admits/axioms.  See the note at the end of    *)
(* the file for the exact obstruction encountered.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1.  Elementary facts about pol_plus / flag_plus / ecomb             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma pol_plus_cup : forall p q r, pol_plus p q r -> r = pol_cup p q.
Proof.
  intros p q r H. destruct p, q; simpl in *;
    inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The pure polarity cancellation used in the out/in cases. *)
Lemma pol_plus_cancel : forall t a ta b c t1,
  pol_plus t a ta -> pol_plus ta b t1 -> pol_plus t c t1 ->
  pol_plus a b c.
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
    eauto using pol_plus.
Qed.

(* The vis-only flag cancellation needed at the value name. *)
Lemma flag_plus_cancel_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
  flag_plus t a ta -> flag_plus ta b t1 -> flag_plus t c t1 ->
  flag_plus a b c.
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
    eauto using flag_plus.
Qed.

(* Combination functions witnessing the (partial) monoid operations. *)
Definition flag_comb (f g : flag) : flag :=
  match f, g with
  | hid, ill | ill, hid => hid
  | vis, vis => vis
  | ill, ill => ill
  | _, _ => hid
  end.

Definition type_comb (t1 t2 : piType) : piType :=
  match t1, t2 with
  | Top, Top => Top
  | Chan lin p1 u, Chan lin p2 _ => Chan lin (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | Chan un p1 u, Chan un p2 _ => Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | _, _ => Top
  end.

Lemma flag_plus_comb : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> h = flag_comb f g.
Proof.
  intros f g h H. inversion H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_comb : forall t1 t2 t3, type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> t3 = type_comb t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H. inversion H as [| p1 p2 p t' Hp | p1 p2 t']; subst; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (pol_plus_cup p1 p2 p Hp). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_comb : forall a b c, ecomb a b c ->
  c = (flag_comb (fst a) (fst b), type_comb (snd a) (snd b)).
Proof.
  intros a b c H. destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc].
  inversion H; subst; simpl.
  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf); reflexivity end.
  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf); rewrite pol_cup_idem; reflexivity end.
  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf);
      match goal with Hp : pol_plus ?a ?b ?c |- _ =>
        rewrite (pol_plus_cup a b c Hp); reflexivity end end.
Qed.

(* Determinacy of the combination, in the form used to rebuild splits. *)
Lemma ecomb_unique : forall a b c d, ecomb a b c -> ecomb a b d -> c = d.
Proof. intros. eapply ecomb_det; eauto. Qed.

(* A triple whose two legs combine can be completed to ecomb when the
   first-leg/third-leg combination is also given. *)
Lemma ecomb_cancel_remove_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
  type_plus t a ta ->
  ecomb (vis, ta) (vis, b) (vis, t1) ->
  type_plus t c t1 ->
  (is_unrestricted ta -> a = ta) ->
  (is_unrestricted t1 -> c = t1) ->
  ecomb (vis, a) (vis, b) (vis, c).
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 Hp He Hc Hua Huc.
  inversion Hp as [| p1 p2 p3 u Hpp | p1 p2 u]; subst.
  - (* t = a = ta = Top *)
    apply ecomb_top_inv in He. destruct He as [Hb [Ht1 Hf]]. subst.
    inversion Hc; subst.
    apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
  - (* all linear *)
    apply ecomb_lin_inv in He.
    destruct He as [q [r [Hb [Ht1 [Hf Hpq]]]]]. subst.
    inversion Hc as [| q1 q2 q3 u' Hcc | q1 q2 u' Hcc]; subst;
      try discriminate.
    apply ec_lin.
    + apply Fp_vv.
    + eapply pol_plus_cancel; eauto.
  - (* all unrestricted: the no-shrink conditions force both residual
       shares to be the common type *)
    inversion He; subst.
    assert (Ha : Chan un p2 u = Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u)
      by (apply Hua; exists (pol_cup p1 p2), u; reflexivity).
    assert (Hc' : c = Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u)
      by (apply Huc; exists (pol_cup p1 p2), u; reflexivity).
    rewrite Ha, Hc'. apply ec_un. apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

(* Syntactic versions for the common [type_remove] hypotheses. *)
Lemma ecomb_cancel_remove : forall t a ta b c t1,
  type_remove ta t a ->
  ecomb (vis, ta) (vis, b) (vis, t1) ->
  type_remove t1 t c ->
  ecomb (vis, a) (vis, b) (vis, c).
Proof.
  intros t a ta b c t1 Hra He Hrc.
  destruct Hra as [Hsa [Hpa Hua]].
  destruct Hrc as [Hsc [Hpc Huc]].
  eapply ecomb_cancel_remove_vis; eauto.
Qed.

(* Combining a linear empty share on the right leaves the other entry
   unchanged (this is the target shape of a consumed linear channel). *)
Lemma ecomb_empty_right : forall a t c,
  ecomb a (vis, Chan lin empty t) c -> c = a.
Proof.
  intros [fa ta] t c H. inversion H; subst; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  match goal with Hp : pol_plus ?p empty ?q |- _ =>
    assert (Hq : q = p) by (inversion Hp; reflexivity); subst;
    match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x vis ?y |- _ =>
      inversion Hf; subst; reflexivity end end.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_empty_left : forall b t c,
  ecomb (vis, Chan lin empty t) b c -> c = b.
Proof.
  intros b t c H. apply ecomb_sym in H. apply ecomb_empty_right in H. auto.
Qed.

(* The canonical split of a consumed linear channel. *)
Lemma ecomb_lin_empty_self : forall t,
  ecomb (vis, Chan lin empty t) (vis, Chan lin empty t) (vis, Chan lin empty t).
Proof.
  intros. apply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv | apply Pp_emptyL].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2.  Basic algebra of environment splits                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Commutativity of the two components. *)
Lemma tEnv_split_comm : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  forall pf2' pf1', tEnv_split g2 g1 g3 pf2' pf1' pf3.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 H.
  induction H as [g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 E1 E2 E3
    | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hpq Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
    | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
    | g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty];
  intros pf2' pf1'.
  - subst. apply SpNil; auto.
  - eapply SpLin with (g1:=g2) (g2:=g1) (g3:=g3) (pf1:=pf2') (pf2:=pf1') (pf3:=pf3)
                     (n:=n) (f:=g) (f':=f') (g:=f) (p:=q) (q:=p) (p':=p') (t:=t)
                     (g''':=g''') (pf':=pf'') (pf'':=pf') (pf''':=pf''').
    + eapply flag_plus_sym; eauto.
    + eapply pol_plus_sym; eauto.
    + exact Hi2.
    + exact Hi1.
    + eapply IH with (pf2':=pf'') (pf1':=pf').
    + exact Hrem.
    + exact Hfo.
    + exact Hty.
  - eapply SpUn with (g1:=g2) (g2:=g1) (g3:=g3) (pf1:=pf2') (pf2:=pf1') (pf3:=pf3)
                    (n:=n) (f:=g) (f':=f') (g:=f) (p:=p) (t:=t)
                    (g''':=g''') (pf':=pf'') (pf'':=pf') (pf''':=pf''').
    + eapply flag_plus_sym; eauto.
    + exact Hi2.
    + exact Hi1.
    + eapply IH with (pf2':=pf'') (pf1':=pf').
    + exact Hrem.
    + exact Hfo.
    + exact Hty.
  - eapply SpTop with (g1:=g2) (g2:=g1) (g3:=g3) (pf1:=pf2') (pf2:=pf1') (pf3:=pf3)
                    (n:=n) (f:=g) (f':=f') (g:=f) (g''':=g''')
                    (pf':=pf'') (pf'':=pf') (pf''':=pf''').
    + eapply flag_plus_sym; eauto.
    + exact Hi2.
    + exact Hi1.
    + eapply IH with (pf2':=pf'') (pf1':=pf').
    + exact Hrem.
    + exact Hfo.
    + exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma esplit_comm : forall g1 g2 g3, esplit g1 g2 g3 -> esplit g2 g1 g3.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 [HA [HB HC]]. unfold esplit. split.
  - intros n; split; intro H.
    + exact (proj2 (HA n) H).
    + exact (proj1 (HA n) H).
  - split.
    + intros n; split; intro H.
      * exact (proj1 (HB n) (proj1 (HA n) H)).
      * exact (proj2 (HA n) (proj2 (HB n) H)).
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
      destruct (HC n f2 t2 f1 t1 H2 H1) as [f [t [Hi He]]].
      exists f, t. split; auto. apply ecomb_sym; auto.
Qed.

(* Removing a common name from all three components of a split. *)
Lemma esplit_remove : forall g1 g2 g3 n,
  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In n (domain g1) ->
  esplit (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 n [HA [HB HC]] nd1 nd2 nd3 Hn1.
  assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hn1).
  assert (Hn3 : In n (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hn2).
  unfold esplit. split.
  - intros x. rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g1 nd1 Hn1 x).
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x).
    rewrite (HA x). tauto.
  - split.
    + intros x. rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x).
      rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g3 nd3 Hn3 x).
      rewrite (HB x). tauto.
    + intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1 He2.
      assert (Hx1 : In x (domain (removeEntry n g1)))
        by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f1) (t:=t1); exact He1).
      assert (Hxn : x <> n).
      { intro Hxn. subst x.
        exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g1 nd1 Hn1
                 (in_dom_entry (removeEntry n g1) n f1 t1 He1)). }
      destruct (HC x f1 t1 f2 t2
                 (in_removeEntry_elim n g1 x f1 t1 He1)
                 (in_removeEntry_elim n g2 x f2 t2 He2)) as [f [t [H3 Hec]]].
      exists f, t. split; [|exact Hec].
      apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g3 x f t (fun Heq => Hxn (eq_sym Heq)) H3).
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_remove : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n,
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In n (domain g1) ->
  forall pf1' pf2' pf3',
  tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3)
             pf1' pf2' pf3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n Hs nd1 nd2 nd3 Hn1 pf1' pf2' pf3'.
  destruct (tEnv_split_esplit _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs) as [HA [HB HC]].
  assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hn1).
  assert (Hn3 : In n (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hn2).
  assert (Hes : esplit (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3))
    by (exact (esplit_remove g1 g2 g3 n
                 (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Hs) nd1 nd2 nd3 Hn1)).
  assert (Hnd1 : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g1)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hnd2 : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g2)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hnd3 : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g3)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hs' : tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3)
                   (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd3))
    by (apply (esplit_tEnv_split _ _ _
                 (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd3)
                 Hnd1 Hnd2 Hnd3 Hes)).
  exact (tEnv_split_pf_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs' pf1' pf2' pf3').
Qed.

   STATUS / BLOCKER

   The requested target is

       typeCheck g pf p ->

Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
