Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).

Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, ill, t) :: ill_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       ill_proj m
    end.

End TypeSystem.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.

Section Utilities.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
  - split.
    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
    + intros _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + simpl. right; exact H.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left; exact Heq.
      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
Proof.
  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.

Lemma pol_plus_det : forall p q r1 r2, pol_plus p q r1 -> pol_plus p q r2 -> r1=r2.
Proof. intros p q r1 r2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_det : forall f g h1 h2, flag_plus f g h1 -> flag_plus f g h2 -> h1=h2.
Proof. intros f g h1 h2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_sym : forall p q r, pol_plus p q r -> pol_plus q p r.
Proof. intros p q r H. inversion H; subst; eauto using pol_plus. Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_sym : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> flag_plus g f h.
Proof. intros f g h H. inversion H; subst; eauto using flag_plus. Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_assoc : forall a b c d e, pol_plus a b c -> pol_plus c d e ->
  exists f, pol_plus b d f /\ pol_plus a f e.
Proof. intros a b c d e H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using pol_plus. Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_assoc : forall a b c d e, flag_plus a b c -> flag_plus c d e ->
  exists f, flag_plus b d f /\ flag_plus a f e.
Proof. intros a b c d e H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using flag_plus. Qed.

Inductive ecomb : (flag*piType) -> (flag*piType) -> (flag*piType) -> Prop :=
| ec_top : forall f1 f2 f, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Top) (f2,Top) (f,Top)
| ec_un : forall f1 f2 f p t, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Chan un p t) (f2,Chan un p t) (f,Chan un p t)
| ec_lin : forall f1 f2 f p1 p2 p t, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      ecomb (f1,Chan lin p1 t) (f2,Chan lin p2 t) (f,Chan lin p t).

Lemma ecomb_det : forall a b c1 c2, ecomb a b c1 -> ecomb a b c2 -> c1=c2.
Proof.
  intros a b c1 c2 H1 H2.
  destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c1 as [fc tc], c2 as [fd td].
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; simpl; f_equal;
    eauto using flag_plus_det, pol_plus_det.
  try (f_equal; eauto using pol_plus_det).
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_sym : forall a b c, ecomb a b c -> ecomb b a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc].
  inversion H; subst; simpl; eauto using ecomb, pol_plus_sym, flag_plus_sym.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_assoc : forall a b c d e, ecomb a b c -> ecomb c d e ->
  exists f, ecomb b d f /\ ecomb a f e.
Proof.
  intros a b c d e H1 H2.
  destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc], d as [fd td], e as [fe te].
  inversion H1 as [fa' fb' fc' Hfab | fa' fb' fc' p t Hfab | fa' fb' fc' p1 p2 p t Hfab Hp]; subst.
  - inversion H2 as [fc2 fd' fe' Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' pu tu Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' q1 q2 q tq Hfcd Hpq]; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (flag_plus_assoc fa fb fc fd fe Hfab Hfcd) as [fg [H5 H6]].
    exists (fg, Top). split; apply ec_top; assumption.
  - inversion H2 as [fc2 fd' fe' Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' pu tu Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' q1 q2 q tq Hfcd Hpq]; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (flag_plus_assoc fa fb fc fd fe Hfab Hfcd) as [fg [H5 H6]].
    exists (fg, Chan un p t). split; apply ec_un; assumption.
  - inversion H2 as [fc2 fd' fe' Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' pu tu Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' q1 q2 q tq Hfcd Hpq]; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (flag_plus_assoc fa fb fc fd fe Hfab Hfcd) as [fg [H5 H6]].
    destruct (pol_plus_assoc p1 p2 p q2 q Hp Hpq) as [pg [H7 H8]].
    exists (fg, Chan lin pg t). split; apply ec_lin; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_swap : forall a b ab c d cd ac bd t,

  pol_plus ab cd t.

  intros a b ab c d cd ac bd t H1 H2 H3 H4 H5.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst; inversion H4; subst; inversion H5; subst;
    eauto using pol_plus.

  type_plus a b ab -> type_plus x y xy ->

  type_plus ax byc t2.

  intros a b x y ab xy ax byc t2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5.
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst; inversion H4; subst; inversion H5; subst;
    eauto using type_plus, pol_plus_swap.
  rewrite pol_cup_swap. apply Tp_UnPlus.

Lemma removeEntry_perm : forall n g g', Permutation g g' -> NoDup (domain g) ->
  Permutation (removeEntry n g) (removeEntry n g').
Proof.
  intros n g g' Hp. induction Hp as [|x l l' Hp IH | x y l | l l' l'' Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2]; intro Hnd.
  - apply perm_nil.
  - destruct x as [[a f] t]. cbn [removeEntry].
    destruct (pair_eq a n) eqn:E.
    + exact Hp.
    + apply perm_skip. apply IH. simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; exact (proj2 Hnd).
  - destruct x as [[ax fx] tx], y as [[ay fy] ty]. cbn [removeEntry].
    simpl in Hnd. apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; destruct Hnd as [Hnoty Hnd].
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd; destruct Hnd as [Hnotx Hndl].
    destruct (pair_eq ay n) eqn:Ey; destruct (pair_eq ax n) eqn:Ex; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply Hnoty. simpl. left.
      apply pair_eq_true in Ey. apply pair_eq_true in Ex.
      rewrite Ex, <- Ey. reflexivity.
    + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_refl.
    + apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_refl.
    + apply perm_swap.
  - apply perm_trans with (l' := removeEntry n l').
    + apply IH1; exact Hnd.
    + apply IH2. apply (NoDup_domain_perm l l' Hp1 Hnd).
Qed.


Lemma removeEntry_self_domain : forall n f t tl,
  domain (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) = domain tl.
Proof. intros. rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_perm : forall n g, In n (domain g) ->
  Permutation (domain g) (n :: domain (removeEntry n g)).
Proof.
  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros H; destruct H.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intros H.
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst x. apply Permutation_refl.
    + assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
      simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * subst x. exfalso. apply Hxn. reflexivity.
      * apply perm_trans with (l' := x :: n :: domain (removeEntry n tl)).
        -- apply perm_skip. apply IH; exact Hin.
        -- apply Permutation_sym. apply perm_swap.
Qed.

Lemma In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 : forall n g, NoDup (domain g) -> In n (domain g) ->
    forall x, In x (domain (removeEntry n g)) <-> In x (domain g) /\ x <> n.
Proof.
  intros n g Hnd Hn x. split.
  - intro H. split.
    + apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact H.
    + intro Hxn; subst x. exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g Hnd Hn H).
  - intros [Hg Hxn]. apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto.
Qed.


Lemma ecomb_top_inv : forall f1 f2 f3 t2 t3, ecomb (f1,Top) (f2,t2) (f3,t3) ->
  t2=Top /\ t3=Top /\ flag_plus f1 f2 f3.
Proof. intros. inversion H. subst. auto. Qed.
Lemma ecomb_un_inv : forall f1 f2 f3 p t t2 t3, ecomb (f1,Chan un p t) (f2,t2) (f3,t3) ->
  t2=Chan un p t /\ t3=Chan un p t /\ flag_plus f1 f2 f3.
Proof. intros. inversion H. subst. auto. Qed.
Lemma ecomb_lin_inv : forall f1 f2 f3 p t t2 t3, ecomb (f1,Chan lin p t) (f2,t2) (f3,t3) ->
  exists q r, t2=Chan lin q t /\ t3=Chan lin r t /\ flag_plus f1 f2 f3 /\ pol_plus p q r.
Proof. intros. inversion H. subst. exists p2, p0. auto. Qed.



Lemma tEnv_split_pf_irrel : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 -> forall pf1' pf2' pf3',
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1' pf2' pf3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 H. induction H; intros pf1' pf2' pf3'.
  - apply SpNil; auto.
  - eapply SpLin; eauto.
  - eapply SpUn; eauto.
  - eapply SpTop; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_env1 : forall g1 g1' g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3, g1' = g1 ->
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 -> forall pf1', tEnv_split g1' g2 g3 pf1' pf2 pf3.
Proof.
  intros g1 g1' g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 E H pf1'. subst.

Lemma In_dom_remove2 : forall g x b, NoDup (domain g) -> In x (domain g) -> In b (domain g) -> x <> b ->
  forall x0, In x0 (domain (removeEntry b (removeEntry x g))) <-> In x0 (domain g) /\ x0 <> x /\ x0 <> b.
Proof.
  intros g x b Hnd Hx Hb Hxb x0.
  assert (Hndx : NoDup (domain (removeEntry x g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hbx : In b (domain (removeEntry x g))) by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto).
  rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 b (removeEntry x g) Hndx Hbx x0).
  rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 x g Hnd Hx x0).
  tauto.
Qed.

Definition esplit (g1 g2 g3 : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g1) <-> In n (domain g2)) /\
  (forall n, In n (domain g2) <-> In n (domain g3)) /\
  (forall n f1 t1 f2 t2, In ((n,f1),t1) g1 -> In ((n,f2),t2) g2 ->
      exists f t, In ((n,f),t) g3 /\ ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t)).

Proof.

      * intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1 He2.

           destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n (Chan lin p' t) H6) as [f0 Hf0].
           destruct (flagOf_inv g3 n f' H5) as [t0 Ht0].
           destruct (pf3 n f0 (Chan lin p' t) f' t0 (conj Hf0 Ht0)) as [Hfeq Hteq].

           apply ec_lin; auto.
        -- assert (He1' : In ((x,f1),t1) (removeEntry n g1))

           assert (He2' : In ((x,f2),t2) (removeEntry n g2))

           destruct (proj2 (proj2 IHtEnv_split) x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1' He2') as [ff [tt [Hg Hec]]].
           exists ff, tt. split; [|exact Hec].

  - (* SpUn *)
    assert (Hn1 : In n (domain g1)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Chan un p t); exact H0).

      * intros x; split; intro Hx.
        -- destruct (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g2 Hn2 x) Hx) as [->|Hx'].
           ++ exact Hn3.
           ++ apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n).

           assert (Hf2 : g = f2) by (exact (proj1 (pf2 n g (Chan un p t) f2 t2 (conj H1 He2)))).
           assert (Ht2 : Chan un p t = t2) by (exact (proj2 (pf2 n g (Chan un p t) f2 t2 (conj H1 He2)))).
           subst f1 t1 f2 t2.
           destruct (typeOf_inv g3 n (Chan un p t) H5) as [f0 Hf0].

           destruct (proj2 (proj2 IHtEnv_split) x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1' He2') as [ff [tt [Hg Hec]]].
           exists ff, tt. split; [|exact Hec].
           rewrite <- H3 in Hg. exact (in_removeEntry_elim n g3 x ff tt Hg).
  - (* SpTop *)
    assert (Hn1 : In n (domain g1)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=Top); exact H0).
    assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=g) (t:=Top); exact H1).

      * destruct (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g2 Hn2 x) Hx) as [->|Hx'].
        -- exact Hn1.
        -- apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n).
           exact (proj2 (proj1 IHtEnv_split x) Hx').
    + split.
      * intros x; split; intro Hx.
        -- destruct (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g2 Hn2 x) Hx) as [->|Hx'].
           ++ exact Hn3.
           ++ apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n).

        -- destruct (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g3 Hn3 x) Hx) as [->|Hx'].

Lemma esplit_tEnv_split : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
    NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
    esplit g1 g2 g3 -> tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.
Proof.
  intros g1. induction g1 as [|e tl IH]; intros g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 nd1 nd2 nd3 Hes.
  - (* g1 = nil *)
    destruct Hes as [HA [HB HC]].
    destruct g2 as [|h2 t2].
    + destruct g3 as [|h3 t3].
      * apply SpNil; auto.
      * exfalso. destruct h3 as [[x fx] tx]. simpl in HB.
        assert (Hin : In x (domain (((x,fx),tx)::t3))) by (simpl; left; auto).
        assert (Hin0 : In x (domain nil)) by (apply (proj2 (HB x)); exact Hin).
        simpl in Hin0. exact Hin0.
    + exfalso. destruct h2 as [[x fx] tx].
      assert (Hin : In x (domain (((x,fx),tx)::t2))) by (simpl; left; auto).
      assert (Hin0 : In x (domain nil)) by (apply (proj2 (HA x)); exact Hin).
      simpl in Hin0. exact Hin0.
  - (* g1 = e :: tl *)
    destruct e as [[n f] t].
    simpl in nd1. apply NoDup_cons_iff in nd1. destruct nd1 as [Hnotn Hndtl].
    destruct Hes as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (Hn1 : In n (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
    assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hn1).
    assert (Hn3 : In n (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hn2).
    destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g2 n Hn2) as [f2 [t2 H2]].
    destruct (HC n f t f2 t2 (or_introl eq_refl) H2) as [f3 [t3 [H3 Hcomb]]].
    (* restricted esplit *)
    assert (Hes' : esplit tl (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3)).
    { unfold esplit. split.
      - intros x; split; intro Hx.
        + assert (Hx1 : In x (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; right; exact Hx).
          assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (Hnotn Hx)).
          assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA x)); exact Hx1).
          apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x)). split; auto.
        + assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact Hx).
          assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g2 nd2 Hn2 Hx)).
          assert (Hx1 : In x (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (apply (proj2 (HA x)); exact Hx2).
          simpl in Hx1. destruct Hx1 as [Hxn'|Hxt]; [exfalso; apply Hxn; symmetry; exact Hxn'|exact Hxt].
      - split.
        + intros x; split; intro Hx.
          * assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact Hx).
            assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g2 nd2 Hn2 Hx)).
            assert (Hx3 : In x (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB x)); exact Hx2).
            apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g3 nd3 Hn3 x)). split; auto.
          * assert (Hx3 : In x (domain g3)) by (apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact Hx).
            assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g3 nd3 Hn3 Hx)).
            assert (Hx2 : In x (domain g2)) by (apply (proj2 (HB x)); exact Hx3).
            apply (proj2 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x)). split; auto.
        + intros x a1 b1 a2 b2 He1 He2.
          assert (He1' : In ((x,a1),b1) (((n,f),t)::tl)) by (simpl; right; exact He1).
          assert (He2' : In ((x,a2),b2) g2) by (eapply in_removeEntry_elim; eauto).
          destruct (HC x a1 b1 a2 b2 He1' He2') as [ff [tt [Hg Hec]]].
          assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (intro Hxn; subst x; apply Hnotn; apply in_dom_entry with (f:=a1) (t:=b1); exact He1).
          exists ff, tt. split; [|exact Hec].
          apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g3 x ff tt); [|exact Hg].
          intro H; apply Hxn; symmetry; exact H.
    }
    assert (Hpf1' : isMap tl).
    { pose proof (isMap_removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl) pf1) as H; rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq in H; exact H. }
    assert (Hpf2' : isMap (removeEntry n g2)) by (apply isMap_removeEntry; exact pf2).
    assert (Hpf3' : isMap (removeEntry n g3)) by (apply isMap_removeEntry; exact pf3).
    assert (Hnd2' : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g2))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact nd2).
    assert (Hnd3' : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g3))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact nd3).
    assert (Hrec : tEnv_split tl (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3)
                               Hpf1' Hpf2' Hpf3').
    { apply (IH (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3) Hpf1' Hpf2' Hpf3'); auto. }
    destruct t as [m p0 t0 | ].
    + destruct m.
      * (* Chan lin p0 t0 *)
        destruct (ecomb_lin_inv f f2 f3 p0 t0 t2 t3 Hcomb) as [q [r [Ht2 [Ht3 [Hfp Hpp]]]]].
        subst t2 t3.
        eapply SpLin with (n:=n) (f:=f) (f':=f3) (g:=f2) (p:=p0) (q:=q) (p':=r) (t:=t0)
                          (g''':=removeEntry n g3).
        -- exact Hfp.
        -- exact Hpp.
        -- simpl; left; reflexivity.
        -- exact H2.
        -- apply (tEnv_split_env1 tl (removeEntry n (((n,f),Chan lin p0 t0)::tl)) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3) Hpf1' Hpf2' Hpf3' (removeEntry_cons_eq n f (Chan lin p0 t0) tl) Hrec (isMap_removeEntry n (((n,f),Chan lin p0 t0)::tl) pf1)).
        -- reflexivity.
        -- apply (F_Entry g3 n f3 (Chan lin r t0)); exact H3.
        -- apply (T_Entry g3 n f3 (Chan lin r t0)); exact H3.
      * (* Chan un p0 t0 *)
        destruct (ecomb_un_inv f f2 f3 p0 t0 t2 t3 Hcomb) as [Ht2 [Ht3 Hfp]].
        subst t2 t3.
        eapply SpUn with (n:=n) (f:=f) (f':=f3) (g:=f2) (p:=p0) (t:=t0)
                         (g''':=removeEntry n g3).
        -- exact Hfp.
        -- simpl; left; reflexivity.
        -- exact H2.
        -- apply (tEnv_split_env1 tl (removeEntry n (((n,f),Chan un p0 t0)::tl)) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3) Hpf1' Hpf2' Hpf3' (removeEntry_cons_eq n f (Chan un p0 t0) tl) Hrec (isMap_removeEntry n (((n,f),Chan un p0 t0)::tl) pf1)).
        -- reflexivity.
        -- apply (F_Entry g3 n f3 (Chan un p0 t0)); exact H3.
        -- apply (T_Entry g3 n f3 (Chan un p0 t0)); exact H3.
    + (* Top *)
      destruct (ecomb_top_inv f f2 f3 t2 t3 Hcomb) as [Ht2 [Ht3 Hfp]].
      subst t2 t3.
      eapply SpTop with (n:=n) (f:=f) (f':=f3) (g:=f2) (g''':=removeEntry n g3).
      * exact Hfp.
      * simpl; left; reflexivity.
      * exact H2.

Lemma nodup_cons_step : forall n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf1 pf2 pf3,
  NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In n (domain g1) -> In n (domain g2) -> In n (domain g3) ->
  NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g1)) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g2)) ->
  tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
  NoDup (domain g1) /\ NoDup (domain g2).
Proof.
  intros n g1 g2 g3 g''' pf1 pf2 pf3 Hnd3 Hn1 Hn2 Hn3 Hndr1 Hndr2 Hspl Hrem.
  assert (Hnd3' : NoDup (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3).
  assert (Hnotin3 : ~ In n (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_removeEntry_still; auto).
  pose proof (tEnv_split_esplit _ _ _ _ _ _ Hspl) as Hes.
  destruct Hes as [HA [HB HC]].
  assert (Hnot1 : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g1))).
  { intro Hc. apply Hnotin3. apply (proj1 (HB n)). apply (proj1 (HA n) Hc). }
  assert (Hnot2 : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g2))).
  { intro Hc. apply Hnotin3. apply (proj1 (HB n)). exact Hc. }
  split.
  - apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (n :: domain (removeEntry n g1)) (domain g1)).
    + apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hn1.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; auto.
  - apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (n :: domain (removeEntry n g2)) (domain g2)).
    + apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hn2.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma In_vis_proj : forall g n f t,
  In ((n,f),t) (vis_proj g) <-> In ((n,f),t) g /\ f = vis.
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH]; intros n f t.
  - simpl. split.
    + intros H; simpl in H; destruct H.
    + intros [H1 H2]; simpl in H1; destruct H1.
  - destruct h as [[[x1 x2] fx] tx]. simpl.
    destruct fx.
    + (* hid *) simpl. rewrite IH. split.
      * intros [Hin Hf]. split; [right; exact Hin | exact Hf].
      * intros [[Heq|Hin] Hf]. inversion Heq; subst; discriminate. split; auto.
    + (* ill *) simpl. rewrite IH. split.
      * intros [Hin Hf]. split; [right; exact Hin | exact Hf].
      * intros [[Heq|Hin] Hf]. inversion Heq; subst; discriminate. split; auto.
    + (* vis *) simpl. rewrite IH.
      split.
      * intros [Heq | [Hin Hf]].
        -- split; [left; exact Heq |]. inversion Heq; reflexivity.
        -- split; [right; exact Hin | exact Hf].
      * intros [[Heq|Hin] Hf].
        -- left; exact Heq.
        -- right; split; auto.
Qed.
Lemma In_ill_proj : forall g n f t,
  In ((n,f),t) (ill_proj g) <-> In ((n,f),t) g /\ f = ill.
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH]; intros n f t.
  - simpl. split.
    + intros H; simpl in H; destruct H.
    + intros [H1 H2]; simpl in H1; destruct H1.
  - destruct h as [[[x1 x2] fx] tx]. simpl.
    destruct fx.
    + (* hid *) simpl. rewrite IH. split.
      * intros [Hin Hf]. split; [right; exact Hin | exact Hf].
      * intros [[Heq|Hin] Hf]. inversion Heq; subst; discriminate. split; auto.
    + (* ill *) simpl. rewrite IH.
      split.
      * intros [Heq | [Hin Hf]].
        -- split; [left; exact Heq |]. inversion Heq; reflexivity.
        -- split; [right; exact Hin | exact Hf].
      * intros [[Heq|Hin] Hf].
        -- left; exact Heq.
        -- right; split; auto.
    + (* vis *) simpl. rewrite IH. split.
      * intros [Hin Hf]. split; [right; exact Hin | exact Hf].
      * intros [[Heq|Hin] Hf]. inversion Heq; subst; discriminate. split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_proj : forall g, isMap g -> isMap (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g).
Proof.
  intros g Hm. unfold isMap. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
  - apply in_app_or in H1. destruct H1 as [H|H].
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_vis_proj g x f1 t1) H)).
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_ill_proj g x f1 t1) H)).
  - apply in_app_or in H2. destruct H2 as [H|H].
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_vis_proj g x f2 t2) H)).
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_ill_proj g x f2 t2) H)).
Qed.

Lemma cons_proj_perm : forall g g' pf pf', Permutation g g' ->
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf -> cons (vis_proj g' ++ ill_proj g') pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hp Hc.
  apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply In_vis_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hing Hf].
    assert (Hing' : In ((n,f),t) g) by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hing)).
    assert (Hproj : In ((n,f),t) (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)).
    { subst f. apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj. split; auto. }
    exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t Hproj).
  - apply In_ill_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hing Hf].
    assert (Hing' : In ((n,f),t) g) by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hing)).
    assert (Hproj : In ((n,f),t) (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)).
    { subst f. apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj. split; auto. }
    exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t Hproj).
Qed.


Lemma cons_perm : forall g g' pf pf', Permutation g g' -> cons g pf -> cons g' pf'.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.

Section Utilities.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
  - split.
    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
    + intros _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + simpl. right; exact H.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left; exact Heq.
      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
Proof.
  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_neq : forall y g x,
    x <> y -> In x (domain g) -> In x (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. rewrite <- Heq. exact E.
      * simpl. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec z x) as [Heq2|Hne2].
        -- left; exact Heq2.
        -- right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_domain_removeEntry : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intro Hnd.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; auto.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. eapply domain_removeEntry_sub; eauto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_removeEntry_still : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> In y (domain g) -> ~ In y (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros Hnd Hin.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
    + simpl. destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
      * intro Hc. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
        -- apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
        -- exact (IH Hnd Hin Hc).
Qed.

Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.
Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_sym : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> flag_plus g f h.
Proof. intros f g h H. inversion H; subst; eauto using flag_plus. Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_assoc : forall a b c d e, pol_plus a b c -> pol_plus c d e ->
  exists f, pol_plus b d f /\ pol_plus a f e.
Proof. intros a b c d e H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using pol_plus. Qed.

Lemma flag_plus_assoc : forall a b c d e, flag_plus a b c -> flag_plus c d e ->
  exists f, flag_plus b d f /\ flag_plus a f e.
Proof. intros a b c d e H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; eauto using flag_plus. Qed.

Inductive ecomb : (flag*piType) -> (flag*piType) -> (flag*piType) -> Prop :=
| ec_top : forall f1 f2 f, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Top) (f2,Top) (f,Top)
| ec_un : forall f1 f2 f p t, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Chan un p t) (f2,Chan un p t) (f,Chan un p t)
| ec_lin : forall f1 f2 f p1 p2 p t, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      ecomb (f1,Chan lin p1 t) (f2,Chan lin p2 t) (f,Chan lin p t).

Lemma ecomb_det : forall a b c1 c2, ecomb a b c1 -> ecomb a b c2 -> c1=c2.
Proof.
  intros a b c1 c2 H1 H2.
  destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c1 as [fc tc], c2 as [fd td].
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; simpl; f_equal;
    eauto using flag_plus_det, pol_plus_det.

Proof.

  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t

      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)

      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y

      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.
Require Import Task.

Lemma pol_plus_det_r : forall p q1 q2 r, pol_plus p q1 r -> pol_plus p q2 r -> q1 = q2.
Proof.
  intros p q1 q2 r H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid : forall a b c d e,
  pol_plus inp a b -> pol_plus b c d -> pol_plus inp e d -> pol_plus a c e.
Proof.
  intros a b c d e H1 H2 H3.
  destruct (pol_plus_assoc inp a b c d H1 H2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
  assert (f = e) by (eapply pol_plus_det_r; eauto). subst. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid_sym : forall q p p1 p2 q2,
  pol_plus inp q p -> pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus inp q2 p2 -> pol_plus p1 q q2.
Proof.
  intros q p p1 p2 q2 H1 H2 H3.
  destruct (pol_plus_assoc inp q p p1 p2 H1 (pol_plus_sym _ _ _ H2)) as [f [Hf Hg]].
  assert (f = q2) by (eapply pol_plus_det_r; eauto). subst.
  apply pol_plus_sym. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid_direct : forall q p1 p p2 q2,
  pol_plus inp q p1 -> pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus inp q2 p2 -> pol_plus q p q2.
Proof.
  intros q p1 p p2 q2 H1 H2 H3.
  destruct (pol_plus_assoc inp q p1 p p2 H1 H2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
  assert (f = q2) by (eapply pol_plus_det_r; eauto). subst. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_reassoc_lin : forall t0 p1 p2 p3 q q2,
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin p3 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin p3 t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q2 t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin q2 t0).
Proof.
  intros t0 p1 p2 p3 q q2 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst. inversion H3; subst.
  eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_sym; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_reassoc_lin2 : forall t0 q p1 p p2 q2,
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin p1 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin p t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin q2 t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin q t0) (Chan lin p t0) (Chan lin q2 t0).
Proof.
  intros t0 q p1 p p2 q2 H1 H2 H3.
  inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst. inversion H3; subst.
  eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_direct; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_lin_inp : forall t0 p,
  type_sub (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin p t0) -> p = inp \/ p = io.
Proof.
  intros t0 p H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_io_r : forall p1 p p2,
  pol_plus p1 p p2 -> (p = inp \/ p = io) -> (p2 = inp \/ p2 = io).
Proof.
  intros p1 p p2 H Hp.
  destruct p.
  - destruct Hp as [Hc|Hc]; discriminate Hc.
  - inversion H; subst; auto.
  - destruct Hp as [Hc|Hc]; discriminate Hc.
  - inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_inp_exists : forall p, p = inp \/ p = io ->
  exists q, pol_plus inp q p.
Proof.
  intros p [Hpe|Hpe]; subst p.
  - exists empty. apply Pp_emptyR.
  - exists out. apply Pp_inpL.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_lin_inp : forall t0 p2 t1'',
  (p2 = inp \/ p2 = io) ->
  (exists q2, t1'' = Chan lin q2 t0 /\ pol_plus inp q2 p2) ->
  type_remove (Chan lin p2 t0) (Chan lin inp t0) t1''.
Proof.
  intros t0 p2 t1'' Hp2 [q2 [Heq Hpol]]. subst t1''.
  unfold type_remove. split.
  - destruct Hp2 as [Hp2c|Hp2c]; subst p2; constructor.
  - split.
    + eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hpol.
    + intro H; destruct H as [p' [t' Heq']]; inversion Heq'.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_remove_dist_r : forall t0 p t3 t1 t2 t1'',
  type_sub (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin p t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) t3 (Chan lin p t0) ->
  type_plus t1 (Chan lin p t0) t2 ->
  type_remove t2 (Chan lin inp t0) t1'' ->
  type_plus t1 t3 t1''.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t3 t1 t2 t1'' Hsub Hplus Htp Htr.
  destruct (type_sub_lin_inp t0 p Hsub) as [Hp|Hp]; subst p.
  - inversion Hplus; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?qq inp |- _ =>
      assert (Hqq : qq = empty) by (inversion Hh; subst; auto); subst qq; clear Hh end.
    inversion Htp; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus ?a inp ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol1 end.
    unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub2 [Hplus2 Hcond2]].
    inversion Hplus2; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?q ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol2 end.
    eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_sym; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
  - inversion Hplus; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?qq io |- _ =>
      assert (Hqq : qq = out) by (inversion Hh; subst; auto); subst qq; clear Hh end.
    inversion Htp; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus ?a io ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol1 end.
    unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub2 [Hplus2 Hcond2]].
    inversion Hplus2; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?q ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol2 end.
    eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_sym; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_remove_dist_l : forall t0 p1 p2 p t3 t1'',
  type_remove (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin inp t0) t3 ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin p t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_remove (Chan lin p2 t0) (Chan lin inp t0) t1'' ->
  type_plus t3 (Chan lin p t0) t1''.
Proof.
  intros t0 p1 p2 p t3 t1'' Htr1 Htp Htr2.
  unfold type_remove in Htr1. destruct Htr1 as [Hsub1 [Hplus1 Hc1]].

Lemma type_plus_lin_inv : forall t1 p t0 t2,
  type_plus t1 (Chan lin p t0) t2 ->
  exists p1 p2, t1 = Chan lin p1 t0 /\ t2 = Chan lin p2 t0 /\ pol_plus p1 p p2.
Proof.
  intros t1 p t0 t2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_lin_inv_l : forall t0 p t t2,
  type_plus (Chan lin p t0) t t2 ->
  exists p' p2, t = Chan lin p' t0 /\ t2 = Chan lin p2 t0 /\ pol_plus p p' p2.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t t2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma no_self_chan : forall m p t, t <> Chan m p t.
Proof.
  intros m p t. induction t as [m0 p0 t0 IH |]; intro H.
  - inversion H; subst. apply IH. assumption.
  - discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma no_type_sub_self_chan : forall m p t, ~ type_sub t (Chan m p t).
Proof.
  intros m p t H. inversion H; subst; eapply no_self_chan; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_un_inv_l : forall t0 p t t2,
  type_plus (Chan un p t0) t t2 ->
  exists pt p2, t = Chan un pt t0 /\ t2 = Chan un p2 t0 /\ p2 = pol_cup p pt.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t t2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_cup_absorb_r : forall p q, pol_cup p (pol_cup q p) = pol_cup q p.
Proof. intros p q. destruct p, q; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma type_sub_pol_plus_r : forall m p1 p2 p t,
  pol_plus p1 p2 p -> type_sub (Chan m p2 t) (Chan m p t).
Proof.
  intros m p1 p2 p t H. destruct H; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_pol_plus_l : forall m p1 p2 p t,
  pol_plus p1 p2 p -> type_sub (Chan m p1 t) (Chan m p t).
Proof.
  intros m p1 p2 p t H. destruct H; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_cup_r : forall t p1 p2,
  type_sub (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).
Proof.
  intros t p1 p2. destruct p1, p2; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_cup_l : forall t p1 p2,
  type_sub (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).
Proof.
  intros t p1 p2. destruct p1, p2; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_r : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_sub b c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Ts_id.
  - match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (type_sub_pol_plus_r lin p1 p2 p t Hp) end.
  - exact (type_sub_cup_r t p1 p2).
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_l : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_sub a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Ts_id.
  - match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (type_sub_pol_plus_l lin p1 p2 p t Hp) end.
  - exact (type_sub_cup_l t p1 p2).
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sym : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_plus b a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Tp_Base.
  - apply Tp_LinPlus. match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (pol_plus_sym _ _ _ Hp) end.
  - assert (E : pol_cup p1 p2 = pol_cup p2 p1) by (apply pol_cup_comm).
    rewrite E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_trans : forall a b c, type_sub a b -> type_sub b c -> type_sub a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H1; inversion H2; subst;
    eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma pol_cup_mid : forall p0 p1 p3,
  pol_cup p0 (pol_cup p1 p3) = pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p3).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite <- pol_cup_assoc. rewrite <- pol_cup_assoc.
  rewrite (pol_cup_comm p0 p1). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid_mid : forall p0 p1 p2 p3 p,
  pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus p0 p3 p ->
  exists p2v, pol_plus p1 p3 p2v /\ pol_plus p0 p2v p2.
Proof.
  intros p0 p1 p2 p3 p H1 H2. destruct H2.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_mid : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
  type_plus t1 t t2 -> type_plus t0 t3 t ->
  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_plus t0 t2v t2.
Proof.
  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 H1 H2.
  destruct t as [m p t'|].
  - destruct m.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      match goal with Hp2 : pol_plus _ _ p |- _ => rename Hp2 into Hpol2 end.
      inversion H1; subst.
      match goal with Hp1 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp1 into Hpol1 end.
      destruct (pol_plus_mid_mid _ _ _ _ _ Hpol1 Hpol2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
      exists (Chan lin f t'). split.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hf.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hg.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      inversion H1; subst.
      exists (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p2) t'). split.
      * apply Tp_UnPlus.
      * assert (E : pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p2) = pol_cup p0 (pol_cup p1 p2)).
        { rewrite pol_cup_mid. reflexivity. }
        rewrite <- E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
  - inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst.
    exists Top. split; apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

  type_plus a b c1 -> type_plus a b c2 -> c1 = c2.
Proof.
  intros a b c1 c2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst;
    try reflexivity; f_equal; eauto using pol_plus_det.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_unrestricted_r : forall a b c,
  type_plus a b c -> is_unrestricted c -> is_unrestricted b.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H2 as [p [t' E]]. subst c.
  inversion H1; subst; eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_unrestricted_l : forall a b c,
  type_plus a b c -> is_unrestricted c -> is_unrestricted a.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H2 as [p [t' E]]. subst c.
  inversion H1; subst; eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_plus : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
  type_remove t t0 t3 -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_remove t2 t0 t2v.
Proof.
  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htr Htp.
  unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub [Hplus Hcond]].
  destruct (type_plus_mid t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htp Hplus) as [t2v [Htv Hrest]].
  exists t2v. split; [exact Htv|].
  unfold type_remove. split.
  - eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hsub|apply (type_plus_sub_r _ _ _ Htp)].
  - split; [exact Hrest|].
    intro Hun2.
    assert (Hun_t : is_unrestricted t) by (eapply type_plus_unrestricted_r; eauto).
    assert (Hteq : t3 = t) by (eapply Hcond; exact Hun_t).
    rewrite Hteq in Htv.
    exact (type_plus_det t1 t t2v t2 Htv Htp).
Qed.

Qed.

Lemma type_plus_assoc_l : forall S a b c d,
  type_plus S a b -> type_plus b c d ->
  exists r, type_plus a c r /\ type_plus S r d.
Proof.
  intros S a b c d H1 H2.
  destruct b as [m p t'|].
  - destruct m.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      match goal with Hp2 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp2 into Hpol2 end.
      inversion H1; subst.
      match goal with Hp1 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp1 into Hpol1 end.
      destruct (pol_plus_assoc _ _ _ _ _ Hpol1 Hpol2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
      exists (Chan lin f t'). split; eapply Tp_LinPlus; eauto.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      inversion H1; subst.
      exists (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p2) t'). split.
      * apply Tp_UnPlus.
      * assert (E : pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p2) = pol_cup (pol_cup p1 p0) p2)
          by (symmetry; apply pol_cup_assoc).
        rewrite <- E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
  - inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst.
    exists Top. split; apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_assoc_l : forall S t1 t3 t t2,
  type_remove t1 S t3 -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
  exists r, type_plus t3 t r /\ type_remove t2 S r.
Proof.
  intros S t1 t3 t t2 Htr Htp.
  unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub [Hplus Hcond]].
  destruct (type_plus_assoc_l S t3 t1 t t2 Hplus Htp) as [r [Hr Hrest]].
  exists r. split; [exact Hr|].
  unfold type_remove. split.
  - eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hsub|apply (type_plus_sub_l _ _ _ Htp)].
  - split; [exact Hrest|].
    intro Hun2.
    assert (Hun1 : is_unrestricted t1) by (eapply type_plus_unrestricted_l; eauto).
    assert (H1eq : t3 = t1) by (eapply Hcond; exact Hun1).
    rewrite H1eq in Hr.
    exact (type_plus_det t1 t r t2 Hr Htp).
Qed.

Lemma isMap_perm : forall g g', Permutation g g' -> isMap g -> isMap g'.
Proof.
  intros g g' Hp Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2).
  split; apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_sym Hp)); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_perm_auto : forall g g' p pf Hnd Hp,
  typeCheck g pf p ->
  typeCheck g' (isMap_perm g g' Hp (isMap_nodup g Hnd)) p.
Proof.
  intros. eapply typeCheck_perm; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intro Hnd.

    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; auto.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. eapply domain_removeEntry_sub; eauto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros Hnd Hin.

    + subst. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).

Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,

    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.

Lemma cons_pf_irrel : forall g pf pf', cons g pf -> cons g pf'.
Proof.
  intros g pf pf' H. apply (proj2 (cons_spec g pf')). apply (proj1 (cons_spec g pf)). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_pf_irrel : forall g pf p,
  typeCheck g pf p -> forall pf', typeCheck g pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g pf p H. induction H; intros pf'.
  - apply TNil. apply (cons_pf_irrel g pf pf'); exact H.
  - eapply TNew; [exact H | exact H0].
  - eapply TPar with (pf1:=pf1) (pf2:=pf2) (pf:=pf').
    + apply (tEnv_split_pf_irrel g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf H pf1 pf2 pf').
    + exact H0.
    + exact H1.
  - eapply TOutL; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3].
  - eapply TOutUn; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3].
  - eapply TInL; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3].
  - eapply TInUn; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3].
  - eapply TInU; [exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3 | exact H4].
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_add_entries_consumable : forall es g pf p,
  NoDup (domain (es ++ g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g) ->
  typeCheck g pf p ->
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) es -> consumable t) ->
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) es -> ~ In n (domain g)) ->
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) es -> ~ In n (bv p)) ->
  forall pf', typeCheck (es ++ g) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros es. induction es as [|[ [n f] t] tl IH]; intros g pf p HndAll Hndg Hty Hcons Hfresh Hfreshbv pf'.
  - simpl. apply typeCheck_pf_irrel with (pf:=pf). exact Hty.
  - simpl in HndAll. apply NoDup_cons_iff in HndAll. destruct HndAll as [Hnotin Hndtail].
    assert (Htytl : typeCheck (tl ++ g) (isMap_nodup (tl ++ g) Hndtail) p).
    { apply (IH g pf p Hndtail Hndg Hty).
      - intros n0 f0 t0 Hin. apply Hcons with (n:=n0)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin.
      - intros n0 f0 t0 Hin. apply Hfresh with (n:=n0)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin.
      - intros n0 f0 t0 Hin. apply Hfreshbv with (n:=n0)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin. }
    apply (typeCheck_add_entry_consumable (tl ++ g) (isMap_nodup (tl ++ g) Hndtail) p Hndtail Htytl n f t).
    + apply Hcons with (n:=n)(f:=f)(t:=t). left; reflexivity.
    + exact Hnotin.
    + apply Hfreshbv with (n:=n)(f:=f)(t:=t). left; reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Export compat.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.

Notation name  := nat.

Definition nat_pair_eq_dec : forall n m : name * name, {n = m} + {n <> m} :=
  ltac:(decide equality; decide equality; decide equality).

Opaque nat_pair_eq_dec.
====
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Notation name  := nat.

Section ProcessDefinitions.

Inductive dproc : Set :=
  | dZero : dproc
  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.

Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p
    | dNu h i  p =>  secLabs p ++ (h, i) :: nil
    end.

Fixpoint fn (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      fn p1 ++  fn p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      (x1, x2) :: (y1, y2) :: fn p
    end.

Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>
      nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      (y1, y2) :: bv p
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      bv p1 ++  bv p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      bv p
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      bv p
    end.

Definition wf (p : dproc) : Prop :=
    NoDup (secLabs p) /\ disjoint (fn p) (secLabs p).

Definition pos l := forall x1 x2 : nat,
      In (x1, x2) l-> x2 > 0.

Definition sl_pos p := pos (secLabs p).

Definition mv (py pz pv : name * name)  :=
    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in
    if (y1 =? z1) && (y2 =? z2)
    then (v1, v2)
    else (y1, y2).

Fixpoint pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2 :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>  p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dBang (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2 (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dInp (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2  (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      let r1 := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      let r2 := mv (y1, y2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dOut  (fst r1) (snd r1) (fst r2) (snd r2) (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dPar p q =>
      dPar (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2) (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dNu h i q =>
      dNu h i (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    end.

Definition map_nat_nat := list (nat * nat).

Fixpoint  domain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (k, _) :: t => k :: (domain_projection t)
    end.

Fixpoint  codomain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (_, v) :: t => v :: (codomain_projection t)
    end.

Definition structure_is_map (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    NoDup (domain_projection m).

Fixpoint max (l :list (nat*nat)) : nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => 0
    | (_, x) :: t => let m := max t in
                     if x <? m then m else x
    end.

Notation dp := domain_projection.

Notation cp := codomain_projection.

Local Definition no_dup_cont (h : nat * nat) (t : list (nat * nat))
    (pf : NoDup (h :: t)) : NoDup t := ltac:(inversion pf; assumption).

Local Opaque no_dup_cont.

Fixpoint dep_map_gen_r (l :list (name * name)) (m : nat) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => fun _ => nil
    | h :: t =>
      fun pf : NoDup (h :: t)  =>
        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
    end.

Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).

Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
    match p with
    | dZero   => fun _  => p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
    | dPar p q =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
    | dNu h i p =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
    end.

End ProcessDefinitions.

Section Facts.

End Facts.
====

Lemma InB_first_consumable : forall g,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> consumable t) ->
  forall a, consumable (snd (fst (InB a g))).
Proof.
  intros g Hc. induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros a.
  - simpl. apply consumable_top.
  - simpl. destruct (pair_eq a x) eqn:E.
    + apply Hc with (n:=x)(f:=f)(t:=t). left; reflexivity.
    + apply IH. intros n f0 t0 Hin. apply Hc with (n:=n)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma newEntries_cons : forall g L m,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> consumable t) ->
  forall e, In e (newEntries g L m) -> consumable (snd e).
Proof.
  intros g L. induction L as [|h tl IH]; intros m Hc e Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - destruct h as [h1 h2]. simpl in Hin.
    destruct (InB (h1,h2) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.

    + destruct (InB (h1,h2-m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1] eqn:Eb1; simpl in Hin.

      * inversion Heq; subst e. simpl.
        pose proof (InB_first_consumable g Hc (h1,h2-m)) as Hcons.
        rewrite Eb1 in Hcons. simpl in Hcons. exact Hcons.
      * apply (IH m Hc e Hin).
Qed.

  forall e, In e (weakenEnv g) -> consumable (snd e).
Proof.

  destruct Hin as [f0 [t0 [Hg Heq]]]. simpl in Heq.
  apply Hc with (n:=n)(f:=f0)(t:=t0) in Hg.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3.  Unrestricted-entry enlargement (the flexible sibling relation)  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition un_ext (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t'.

Definition un_enlarge (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
  forall n f t, In (n, f, t) g ->
    exists t', In (n, f, t') g' /\ un_ext t t'.

Lemma un_ext_sub : forall t t', un_ext t t' -> type_sub t t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [->| [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id|exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma un_ext_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
  un_ext t1 t2 -> un_ext t2 t3 -> un_ext t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
  destruct H12 as [->| [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
  - exact H23.
  - destruct H23 as [->| [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.
      split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|]].
      eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hs1|exact Hs2].
Qed.

Lemma un_enlarge_refl : forall g, un_enlarge g g.
Proof.
  intro g. split.
  - intro n; reflexivity.
  - intros n f t Hin. exists t. split; [exact Hin|left; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma un_enlarge_trans : forall g1 g2 g3,
  un_enlarge g1 g2 -> un_enlarge g2 g3 -> un_enlarge g1 g3.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 [D12 H12] [D23 H23]. split.
  - intro n. rewrite D12. apply D23.
  - intros n f t Hin.
    destruct (H12 n f t Hin) as [t2 [Hin2 He12]].
    destruct (H23 n f t2 Hin2) as [t3 [Hin3 He23]].
    exists t3. split; [exact Hin3|]. eapply un_ext_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma un_enlarge_cons : forall n f t g g',
  un_enlarge g g' ->
  (exists t', In (n, f, t') g' /\ un_ext t t') ->
  un_enlarge ((n,f,t)::g) ((n,f,t')::g').
Proof.
  intros n f t g g' [D H] [t' [Hin He]]. split.
  - intro x. simpl. split; intro Hx.
    + destruct Hx as [->|Hx]; [left; reflexivity|right; apply (proj1 (D x)); exact Hx].
    + destruct Hx as [->|Hx]; [left; reflexivity|right; apply (proj2 (D x)); exact Hx].
  - intros m g0 u Hin.
    simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [E|Hin].
    + inversion E; subst. exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity|exact He].
    + destruct (H m g0 u Hin) as [u' [Hin' He']].
      exists u'. split; [right; exact Hin'|exact He'].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 4.  The dummy split:  g = g + dummyEnv g                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition dummyFlag (f : flag) : flag :=
  match f with hid => ill | ill => ill | vis => vis end.

Definition dummyType (t : piType) : piType :=
  match t with
  | Top => Top
  | Chan lin p u => Chan lin empty u
  | Chan un p u => Chan un p u
  end.

Definition dummyEnv (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv :=
  map (fun e => match e with (n,f,t) => (n, dummyFlag f, dummyType t) end) g.

Lemma dummy_ecomb : forall f t, ecomb (f,t) (dummyFlag f, dummyType t) (f,t).
Proof.
  intros f t. destruct f; destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m; simpl.
    + eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_hi|apply Pp_emptyR].
    + eapply ec_un; [apply Fp_hi|].
  - destruct m; simpl.
    + eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_ii|apply Pp_emptyR].
    + eapply ec_un; [apply Fp_ii|].
  - destruct m; simpl.
    + eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv|apply Pp_emptyR].
    + eapply ec_un; [apply Fp_vv|].
  - simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_hi.
  - simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_ii.
  - simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

Lemma domain_dummyEnv : forall g, domain (dummyEnv g) = domain g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[n f t] tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma In_dummyEnv_iff : forall g n f t,
  In (n,f,t) (dummyEnv g) <->
  exists f0 t0, In (n,f0,t0) g /\ f = dummyFlag f0 /\ t = dummyType t0.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[n0 f0 t0] tl IH].
  - intros n f t. simpl. split; [contradiction|].
    intros [f1 [t1 [H _]]]. contradiction.
  - intros n f t. simpl. split.
    + intro H. destruct H as [E|H].
      * inversion E; subst. exists f0, t0. split; [left; reflexivity|auto].
      * apply IH in H. destruct H as [f1 [t1 [Hin [Ef Et]]]].
        exists f1, t1. split; [right; exact Hin|auto].
    + intros [f1 [t1 [Hin [Ef Et]]]]. subst f t.
      destruct Hin as [E|Hin].
      * inversion E; subst. left; reflexivity.
      * right. apply IH. exists f1, t1. auto.
Qed.

Lemma esplit_dummy : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> esplit g (dummyEnv g) g.
Proof.
  intros g Hnd. split.
  - intro n. rewrite domain_dummyEnv. reflexivity.
  - split.
    + intro n. rewrite domain_dummyEnv. reflexivity.
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
      apply In_dummyEnv_iff in H2.
      destruct H2 as [f0 [t0 [H0 [Ef Et]]]]. subst f2 t2.
      assert (Heq : ((n,f0),t0) = ((n,f1),t1)).
      { apply (nodup_entry_unique g n f0 t0 n f1 t1 Hnd H0 H1 eq_refl). }
      inversion Heq; subst.
      exists f1, t1. split; [exact H1|apply dummy_ecomb].
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_dummy : forall g (pf : isMap g)
    (pfd : isMap (dummyEnv g)) (pfd' : isMap g),
  NoDup (domain g) -> tEnv_split g (dummyEnv g) g pf pfd pfd'.
Proof.
  intros g pf pfd pfd' Hnd.
  apply (esplit_tEnv_split g (dummyEnv g) g pf pfd pfd').
  - exact Hnd.
  - rewrite domain_dummyEnv. exact Hnd.
  - exact Hnd.
  - apply esplit_dummy; exact Hnd.
Qed.

(* 5.  Permutation and two-entry replacement for esplit                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma esplit_perm : forall g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3',
  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
  Permutation g1 g1' -> Permutation g2 g2' -> Permutation g3 g3' ->
  esplit g1' g2' g3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3' [HA [HB HC]] P1 P2 P3. split.
  - intro n. split; intro H.
    + apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)).
      apply (proj1 (HA n)).
      apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P1))); exact H.
    + apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2))); exact H.
  - split.
    + intro n. split; intro H.
      * apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)).
        apply (proj1 (HB n)).
        apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2))); exact H.
      * apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P3))); exact H.
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
      apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P1))) in H1.
      apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2))) in H2.
      destruct (HC n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2) as [f [t [H3 He]]].
      exists f, t. split; [|exact He].
      apply (Permutation_in _ (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)); exact H3.
Qed.

Definition un_ext (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t'.

Definition un_enlarge (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
  forall n f t, In (n, f, t) g ->
    exists t', In (n, f, t') g' /\ un_ext t t'.

Lemma un_ext_sub : forall t t', un_ext t t' -> type_sub t t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [->| [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id|exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma un_ext_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
  un_ext t1 t2 -> un_ext t2 t3 -> un_ext t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
  destruct H12 as [->| [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
  - exact H23.
  - destruct H23 as [->| [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.
      split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|]].
      eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hs1|exact Hs2].
Qed.

Lemma un_enlarge_refl : forall g, un_enlarge g g.
Proof.
  intro g. split.
  - intro n; reflexivity.
  - intros n f t Hin. exists t. split; [exact Hin|left; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma un_enlarge_trans : forall g1 g2 g3,
  un_enlarge g1 g2 -> un_enlarge g2 g3 -> un_enlarge g1 g3.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 [D12 H12] [D23 H23]. split.
  - intro n. rewrite D12. apply D23.
  - intros n f t Hin.
    destruct (H12 n f t Hin) as [t2 [Hin2 He12]].
    destruct (H23 n f t2 Hin2) as [t3 [Hin3 He23]].
    exists t3. split; [exact Hin3|]. eapply un_ext_trans; eauto.
Qed.
