Proof.
  intros n f t t' g g' [D H] Hin He. split.
  - intro x. simpl. split; intro Hx.
    + destruct Hx as [->|Hx]; [left; reflexivity|right; apply (proj1 (D x)); exact Hx].
    + destruct Hx as [->|Hx]; [left; reflexivity|right; apply (proj2 (D x)); exact Hx].
  - intros m g0 u Hin0.
    simpl in Hin0. destruct Hin0 as [E|Hin0].
    + inversion E; subst. exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity|exact He].
    + destruct (H m g0 u Hin0) as [u' [Hin' He']].
      exists u'. split; [right; exact Hin'|exact He'].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 4.  The dummy split:  g = g + dummyEnv g                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition dummyFlag (f : flag) : flag :=
  match f with hid => ill | ill => ill | vis => vis end.

Definition dummyType (t : piType) : piType :=
  match t with
  | Top => Top
  | Chan lin p u => Chan lin empty u
  | Chan un p u => Chan un p u
  end.

Definition dummyEnv (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv :=
  map (fun e => match e with (n,f,t) => (n, dummyFlag f, dummyType t) end) g.

Lemma dummy_ecomb : forall f t, ecomb (f,t) (dummyFlag f, dummyType t) (f,t).
Proof.
  intros f t. destruct f.
  - destruct t as [m p u|].
    + destruct m; simpl.
      * eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_hi|apply Pp_emptyR].
      * eapply ec_un; apply Fp_hi.
    + simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_hi.
  - destruct t as [m p u|].
    + destruct m; simpl.
      * eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_ii|apply Pp_emptyR].
      * eapply ec_un; apply Fp_ii.
    + simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_ii.
  - destruct t as [m p u|].
    + destruct m; simpl.
      * eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv|apply Pp_emptyR].
      * eapply ec_un; apply Fp_vv.
    + simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

Lemma domain_dummyEnv : forall g, domain (dummyEnv g) = domain g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[n f] t] tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma In_dummyEnv_iff : forall g n f t,
  In (n,f,t) (dummyEnv g) <->
  exists f0 t0, In (n,f0,t0) g /\ f = dummyFlag f0 /\ t = dummyType t0.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[n0 f0] t0] tl IH].
  - intros n f t. simpl. split; [contradiction|].
    intros [f1 [t1 [H _]]]. contradiction.
  - intros n f t. simpl. split.
    + intro H. destruct H as [E|H].
      * inversion E; subst. exists f0, t0. split; [left; reflexivity|auto].
      * apply IH in H. destruct H as [f1 [t1 [Hin [Ef Et]]]].
        exists f1, t1. split; [right; exact Hin|auto].
    + intros [f1 [t1 [Hin [Ef Et]]]]. subst f t.
      destruct Hin as [E|Hin].
      * inversion E; subst. left; reflexivity.
      * right. apply IH. exists f1, t1. auto.
Qed.

Lemma esplit_dummy : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> esplit g (dummyEnv g) g.
Proof.
  intros g Hnd. split.
  - intro n. rewrite domain_dummyEnv. reflexivity.
  - split.
    + intro n. rewrite domain_dummyEnv. reflexivity.
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
      apply In_dummyEnv_iff in H2.
      destruct H2 as [f0 [t0 [H0 [Ef Et]]]]. subst f2 t2.
      assert (Heq : ((n,f0),t0) = ((n,f1),t1)).
      { apply (nodup_entry_unique g n f0 t0 n f1 t1 Hnd H0 H1 eq_refl). }
      inversion Heq; subst.
      exists f1, t1. split; [exact H1|apply dummy_ecomb].
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_dummy : forall g (pf : isMap g)
    (pfd : isMap (dummyEnv g)) (pfd' : isMap g),
  NoDup (domain g) -> tEnv_split g (dummyEnv g) g pf pfd pfd'.
Proof.
  intros g pf pfd pfd' Hnd.
  apply (esplit_tEnv_split g (dummyEnv g) g pf pfd pfd').
  - exact Hnd.
  - rewrite domain_dummyEnv. exact Hnd.
  - exact Hnd.
  - apply esplit_dummy; exact Hnd.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 5.  Permutation and two-entry replacement for esplit                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma esplit_perm : forall g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3',
  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
  Permutation g1 g1' -> Permutation g2 g2' -> Permutation g3 g3' ->
  esplit g1' g2' g3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3' [HA [HB HC]] P1 P2 P3. split.
  - intro n. split; intro H.
    + apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)).
      apply (proj1 (HA n)).
      exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P1)) H).
    + apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P1)).
      apply (proj2 (HA n)).
      exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)) H).
  - split.
    + intro n. split; intro H.
      * apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)).
        apply (proj1 (HB n)).
        exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)) H).
      * apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)).
        apply (proj2 (HB n)).
        exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)) H).
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
      assert (H1' : In ((n,f1),t1) g1)
        by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f1),t1)
                     (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P1)) H1)).
      assert (H2' : In ((n,f2),t2) g2)
        by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f2),t2)
                     (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)) H2)).
      destruct (HC n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1' H2') as [f [t [H3 He]]].
      exists f, t. split; [|exact He].
      exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_domain _ _ P3) H3).
Qed.

(* A canonical replacement of the entries at two distinct names.  The
   lemma is phrased with the *new* entries and assumptions witnessing
   that both names occur in the old environments; all four old entries
   disappear and are replaced simultaneously. *)

Lemma esplit_repl2 : forall g1 g2 g3 a b
    fa1 ta1 fa2 ta2 fa3 ta3 fb1 tb1 fb2 tb2 fb3 tb3,
  a <> b ->
  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In a (domain g1) -> In b (domain g1) ->
  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
  ecomb (fa1,ta1) (fa2,ta2) (fa3,ta3) ->
  ecomb (fb1,tb1) (fb2,tb2) (fb3,tb3) ->
  esplit
    ((a,fa1,ta1) :: (b,fb1,tb1) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g1))
    ((a,fa2,ta2) :: (b,fb2,tb2) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g2))
    ((a,fa3,ta3) :: (b,fb3,tb3) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g3)).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 a b fa1 ta1 fa2 ta2 fa3 ta3 fb1 tb1 fb2 tb2 fb3 tb3
         Hab Hnd1 Hnd2 Hnd3 Ha1 Hb1 [HA [HB HC]] Hea Heb.
  assert (Ha2 : In a (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA a)); exact Ha1).
  assert (Hb2 : In b (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA b)); exact Hb1).
  assert (Ha3 : In a (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB a)); exact Ha2).
  assert (Hb3 : In b (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB b)); exact Hb2).
  assert (Hdom1 : forall x,
    In x (domain ((a,fa1,ta1) :: (b,fb1,tb1) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g1)))
    <-> In x (domain g1)).
  { intro x. simpl. rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g1 a b Hnd1 Ha1 Hb1 Hab x).
    split.
    - intros [->|[->|[Hx [_ _]]]]; assumption.
    - intro Hx. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x a) as [->|Hxa].
      + left; reflexivity.
      + destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x b) as [->|Hxb].
        * right; left; reflexivity.
        * right; right. split; [exact Hx|split; auto]. }
  assert (Hdom2 : forall x,
    In x (domain ((a,fa2,ta2) :: (b,fb2,tb2) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g2)))
    <-> In x (domain g2)).
  { intro x. simpl. rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g2 a b Hnd2 Ha2 Hb2 Hab x).
    split.
    - intros [->|[->|[Hx [_ _]]]]; assumption.
    - intro Hx. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x a) as [->|Hxa].
      + left; reflexivity.
      + destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x b) as [->|Hxb].
        * right; left; reflexivity.
        * right; right. split; [exact Hx|split; auto]. }
  assert (Hdom3 : forall x,
    In x (domain ((a,fa3,ta3) :: (b,fb3,tb3) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g3)))
    <-> In x (domain g3)).
  { intro x. simpl. rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g3 a b Hnd3 Ha3 Hb3 Hab x).
    split.
    - intros [->|[->|[Hx [_ _]]]]; assumption.
    - intro Hx. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x a) as [->|Hxa].
      + left; reflexivity.
      + destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x b) as [->|Hxb].
        * right; left; reflexivity.
        * right; right. split; [exact Hx|split; auto]. }
  assert (Hnota : forall gi, NoDup (domain gi) -> In a (domain gi) ->
      In b (domain gi) -> ~ In a (domain (removeEntry b (removeEntry a gi)))).
  { intros gi Hnd Ha Hb Hc.
    apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still a gi Hnd Ha).
    exact (domain_removeEntry_sub b (removeEntry a gi) a Hc). }
  assert (Hnotb : forall gi, NoDup (domain gi) -> In a (domain gi) ->
      In b (domain gi) -> ~ In b (domain (removeEntry b (removeEntry a gi)))).
  { intros gi Hnd Ha Hb Hc.
    apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still b gi Hnd Hb).
    rewrite <- (removeEntry_removeEntry_other a b gi Hab).
    exact (domain_removeEntry_sub a (removeEntry b gi) b Hc). }
  split.
  - intro x. split; intro Hx.
    + rewrite <- Hdom2. rewrite <- Hdom1.
      exact (proj1 (HA x) (proj1 (Hdom1 x) Hx)).
    + rewrite Hdom2. rewrite Hdom1.
      exact (proj2 (HA x) (proj2 (Hdom2 x) Hx)).
  - split.
    + intro x. split; intro Hx.
      * rewrite <- Hdom3. rewrite <- Hdom2.
        exact (proj1 (HB x) (proj1 (Hdom2 x) Hx)).
      * rewrite Hdom3. rewrite Hdom2.
        exact (proj2 (HB x) (proj2 (Hdom3 x) Hx)).
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 Hin1 Hin2.
      simpl in Hin1, Hin2.
      destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec n a) as [->|Hna].
      * destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec n b) as [->|Hnb].
        -- exfalso; apply Hab; reflexivity.
        -- (* n = a, n <> b *)
           destruct Hin1 as [E1|[E1|Ht1]].
           ++ destruct Hin2 as [E2|[E2|Ht2]].
              ** injection E1 as Hn1 Ht1eq; injection Hn1 as _ Hf1.
                 injection E2 as Hn2 Ht2eq; injection Hn2 as _ Hf2.
                 exists fa3, ta3. split; [left; reflexivity|].
                 subst. exact Hea.
              ** injection E2 as Hn2 _; injection Hn2 as Hba _. exfalso; apply Hnb; symmetry; exact Hba.
              ** exfalso; exact (Hnota g2 Hnd2 Ha2 Hb2 Ht2).
           ++ injection E1 as Hn1 _; injection Hn1 as Hba _. exfalso; apply Hnb; symmetry; exact Hba.
           ++ exfalso; exact (Hnota g1 Hnd1 Ha1 Hb1 Ht1).
      * destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec n b) as [->|Hnb].
        -- (* n = b, n <> a *)
           destruct Hin1 as [E1|[E1|Ht1]].
           ++ injection E1 as Hn1 _; injection Hn1 as Hab' _. exfalso; apply Hna; symmetry; exact Hab'.
           ++ destruct Hin2 as [E2|[E2|Ht2]].
              ** injection E2 as Hn2 _; injection Hn2 as Hab'' _. exfalso; apply Hna; symmetry; exact Hab''.
              ** injection E1 as Hn1 Ht1eq; injection Hn1 as _ Hf1.
                 injection E2 as Hn2 Ht2eq; injection Hn2 as _ Hf2.
                 exists fb3, tb3. split; [right; left; reflexivity|].
                 subst. exact Heb.
              ** exfalso; exact (Hnotb g2 Hnd2 Ha2 Hb2 Ht2).
           ++ exfalso; exact (Hnotb g1 Hnd1 Ha1 Hb1 Ht1).
        -- (* n differs from both *)
           assert (Htail1 : In ((n,f1),t1) (removeEntry b (removeEntry a g1))).
           { destruct Hin1 as [E1|[E1|Ht1]].
             - injection E1 as Hn1 _; injection Hn1 as Hna' _. exfalso; apply Hna; symmetry; exact Hna'.
             - injection E1 as Hn1 _; injection Hn1 as Hnb' _. exfalso; apply Hnb; symmetry; exact Hnb'.
             - exact Ht1. }
           assert (Htail2 : In ((n,f2),t2) (removeEntry b (removeEntry a g2))).
           { destruct Hin2 as [E2|[E2|Ht2]].
             - injection E2 as Hn2 _; injection Hn2 as Hna' _. exfalso; apply Hna; symmetry; exact Hna'.
             - injection E2 as Hn2 _; injection Hn2 as Hnb' _. exfalso; apply Hnb; symmetry; exact Hnb'.
             - exact Ht2. }
           assert (Hg1 : In ((n,f1),t1) g1).
           { apply (in_removeEntry_elim a g1 n f1 t1).
             apply (in_removeEntry_elim b (removeEntry a g1) n f1 t1).
             exact Htail1. }
           assert (Hg2 : In ((n,f2),t2) g2).
           { apply (in_removeEntry_elim a g2 n f2 t2).
             apply (in_removeEntry_elim b (removeEntry a g2) n f2 t2).
             exact Htail2. }
           destruct (HC n f1 t1 f2 t2 Hg1 Hg2) as [f [t [Hg3 Hec]]].
           exists f, t. split; [|exact Hec].
           right; right.
           apply (in_removeEntry_intro b (removeEntry a g3) n f t); [exact Hnb|].
           apply (in_removeEntry_intro a g3 n f t); [exact Hna|exact Hg3].
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev AuxDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Capability enlargement monotonicity for typeCheck.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Only unrestricted channel entries (and Top entries, which must stay  *)
(* literally equal) may be enlarged, by increasing their polarity along *)
(* [type_sub].                                                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Section UnLe.

Definition un_le (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  (exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t').

Lemma un_le_refl : forall t, un_le t t.
Proof. intro t; left; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma un_le_sub : forall t t', un_le t t' -> type_sub t t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id | exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
  un_le t1 t2 -> un_le t2 t3 -> un_le t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
  destruct H12 as [-> | [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
  - exact H23.
  - destruct H23 as [-> | [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.
      split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity |]].
      eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_consumable : forall t t',
  un_le t t' -> consumable t -> consumable t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> _]]]]]] Hc; auto.
  apply consumable_un.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_lin_eq : forall p u t', un_le (Chan lin p u) t' -> t' = Chan lin p u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_top_eq : forall t', un_le Top t' -> t' = Top.
Proof.
  intros t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_un_inv : forall p u t',
  un_le (Chan un p u) t' -> exists p', t' = Chan un p' u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E1 [E2 _]]]]]].
  - exists p; reflexivity.
  - inversion E1; subst. exists p1; exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_of_sub_un : forall p u t',
  type_sub (Chan un p u) t' -> un_le (Chan un p u) t'.
Proof.
  intros p u t' Hs. destruct Hs.
  - left; reflexivity.
  - right; exists empty, q, t. split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity | apply Ts_empty]].
  - right; exists inp, io, t. split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity | apply Ts_inp]].
  - right; exists out, io, t. split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity | apply Ts_out]].
Qed.

Lemma un_sub_io_inp : forall p p' t,
  type_sub (Chan un p t) (Chan un p' t) ->
  (p = io \/ p = inp) -> (p' = io \/ p' = inp).
Proof.
  intros p p' t Hs Hp. inversion Hs; subst; auto;
    destruct Hp as [H|H]; discriminate H.

(* Environment-level enlargement relation. *)
Definition un_env (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g ->
     exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t').

Lemma un_env_refl : forall g, un_env g g.
Proof.
  intro g. split.
  - intro n; reflexivity.
  - intros n f t Hin. exists t. split; [exact Hin | apply un_le_refl].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_dom1 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g').
Proof. intros g g' n [H _] Hin. exact (proj1 (H n) Hin). Qed.

Lemma un_env_dom2 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g).
Proof. intros g g' n [H _] Hin. exact (proj2 (H n) Hin). Qed.

Lemma un_env_cons : forall n f t t' g g',
  un_le t t' -> un_env g g' ->
  un_env ((n,f,t)::g) ((n,f,t')::g').
Proof.
  intros n f t t' g g' Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x. simpl. rewrite (Hdom x). tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hin. simpl in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [E | Hin].
    + inversion E; subst. exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin) as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].
Qed.

  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((n,f),t) g -> un_le t t' ->
  un_env (removeEntry n g) gtail ->
  un_env g ((n,f,t')::gtail).
Proof.
  intros g n f t t' gtail Hnd Hin Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x.
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g (in_dom_entry g n f t Hin) x).
    rewrite (Hdom x). simpl. tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hinx.
    destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x n) as [Hxn | Hxn].
    + subst x.
      assert (Heq : ((n,fx),tx) = ((n,f),t))
        by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g n fx tx n f t Hnd Hinx Hin eq_refl)).
      inversion Heq; subst.
      exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + assert (Hin' : In ((x,fx),tx) (removeEntry n g))
        by (apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g x fx tx); auto).
      destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin') as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_removeEntry : forall n g g',
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g') ->
  un_env g g' -> un_env (removeEntry n g) (removeEntry n g').
Proof.
  intros n g g' Hnd Hnd' Hn Hn' [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x.
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn x).
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g' Hnd' Hn' x).
    rewrite (Hdom x). tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hinx.
    assert (Hing : In ((x,fx),tx) g) by (apply (in_removeEntry_elim n g x fx tx); exact Hinx).
    destruct (Hent x fx tx Hing) as [u [Hinu He]].
    assert (Hxn : x <> n).
    { intro Hc. subst x.
      exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g Hnd Hn
               (in_dom_entry (removeEntry n g) n fx tx Hinx) (eq_refl)). }
    exists u. split; [| exact He].
    apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g' x fx u); auto.
Qed.

(* Max of the domain is determined by membership. *)
Lemma max_domain_mem_eq : forall g g',
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) ->
  max (domain g) = max (domain g').
Proof.
  intros g g' Hdom. apply Nat.le_antisymm.
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec (domain g) (max (domain g')))).
    intros a x Hin.
    assert (Hin' : In (a,x) (domain g')) by (apply (proj1 (Hdom (a,x))); exact Hin).
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec (domain g') (max (domain g'))) (le_refl _) a x Hin').
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec (domain g') (max (domain g)))).
    intros a x Hin.
    assert (Hin' : In (a,x) (domain g)) by (apply (proj2 (Hdom (a,x))); exact Hin).
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec (domain g) (max (domain g))) (le_refl _) a x Hin').
Qed.

Lemma un_env_fresh : forall g g' x,
  un_env g g' -> ~ In x (domain g) -> ~ In x (domain g').
Proof.
  intros g g' x [Hdom _] Hx Hin. apply Hx. exact (proj2 (Hdom x) Hin).
Qed.

End UnEnv.

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev AuxDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Capability enlargement monotonicity for typeCheck.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Only unrestricted channel entries (and Top entries, which must stay  *)
(* literally equal) may be enlarged, by increasing their polarity along *)
(* [type_sub].                                                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Section UnLe.

Definition un_le (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  (exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t').

Lemma un_le_refl : forall t, un_le t t.
Proof. intro t; left; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma un_le_sub : forall t t', un_le t t' -> type_sub t t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id | exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
  un_le t1 t2 -> un_le t2 t3 -> un_le t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
  destruct H12 as [-> | [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
  - exact H23.
  - destruct H23 as [-> | [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.
      split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity |]].
      eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_consumable : forall t t',
  un_le t t' -> consumable t -> consumable t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> _]]]]]] Hc; auto.
  apply consumable_un.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_lin_eq : forall p u t', un_le (Chan lin p u) t' -> t' = Chan lin p u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_top_eq : forall t', un_le Top t' -> t' = Top.
Proof.
  intros t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_un_inv : forall p u t',
  un_le (Chan un p u) t' -> exists p', t' = Chan un p' u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [E | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E1 [E2 _]]]]]].
  - subst t'. exists p; reflexivity.
  - injection E1 as Hp Hu. subst p0 u0. exists p1; exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma un_sub_io_inp : forall p p' t,
  type_sub (Chan un p t) (Chan un p' t) ->
  (p = io \/ p = inp) -> (p' = io \/ p' = inp).
Proof.
  intros p p' t Hs Hp. inversion Hs; subst; auto;
    destruct Hp as [H|H]; discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma un_sub_io_out : forall p p' t,
  type_sub (Chan un p t) (Chan un p' t) ->
  (p = io \/ p = out) -> (p' = io \/ p' = out).
Proof.
  intros p p' t Hs Hp. inversion Hs; subst; auto;
    destruct Hp as [H|H]; discriminate H.
Qed.

End UnLe.

(* Environment-level enlargement relation. *)
Definition un_env (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g ->
     exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t').

Section UnEnv.

Lemma un_env_refl : forall g, un_env g g.
Proof.
  intro g. split.
  - intro n; reflexivity.
  - intros n f t Hin. exists t. split; [exact Hin | apply un_le_refl].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_dom1 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g').
Proof. intros g g' n [H _] Hin. exact (proj1 (H n) Hin). Qed.

Lemma un_env_dom2 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g).
Proof. intros g g' n [H _] Hin. exact (proj2 (H n) Hin). Qed.

Lemma un_env_cons : forall n f t t' g g',
  un_le t t' -> un_env g g' ->
  un_env ((n,f,t)::g) ((n,f,t')::g').

Lemma max_le_spec : forall l m, max l <= m <-> (forall a x, In (a,x) l -> x <= m).
Proof.
  intros l. induction l as [|h t IH]; intros m.

      split.
      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.

           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).

      * intros H. apply (H a x). left; reflexivity.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf

      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Lemma esplit_remove : forall g1 g2 g3 n,
  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In n (domain g1) ->
  esplit (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 n [HA [HB HC]] nd1 nd2 nd3 Hn1.
  assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hn1).
  assert (Hn3 : In n (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hn2).
  unfold esplit. split.
  - intros x. rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g1 nd1 Hn1 x).
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x).
    rewrite (HA x). tauto.
  - split.
    + intros x. rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x).
      rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g3 nd3 Hn3 x).
      rewrite (HB x). tauto.
    + intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1 He2.
      assert (Hx1 : In x (domain (removeEntry n g1)))
        by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f1) (t:=t1); exact He1).
      assert (Hxn : x <> n).
      { intro Hxn. subst x.
        exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g1 nd1 Hn1
                 (in_dom_entry (removeEntry n g1) n f1 t1 He1)). }
      destruct (HC x f1 t1 f2 t2
                 (in_removeEntry_elim n g1 x f1 t1 He1)
                 (in_removeEntry_elim n g2 x f2 t2 He2)) as [f [t [H3 Hec]]].
      exists f, t. split; [|exact Hec].
      apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g3 x f t (fun Heq => Hxn (eq_sym Heq)) H3).
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_remove : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n,
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
  In n (domain g1) ->
  forall pf1' pf2' pf3',
  tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3)
             pf1' pf2' pf3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n Hs nd1 nd2 nd3 Hn1 pf1' pf2' pf3'.
  destruct (tEnv_split_esplit _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs) as [HA [HB HC]].
  assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hn1).
  assert (Hn3 : In n (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hn2).
  assert (Hes : esplit (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3))

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).

Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, ill, t) :: ill_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       ill_proj m
    end.

End TypeSystem.

Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInU : forall u p t x q pf1 pf2,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf2 ->
      typeCheck ( (x, vis, t) :: g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dBang (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q).

End TypeSystemRules.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.

Section Utilities.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
  - split.
    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
    + intros _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + simpl. right; exact H.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left; exact Heq.
      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
Proof.
  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_neq : forall y g x,
    x <> y -> In x (domain g) -> In x (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. rewrite <- Heq. exact E.
      * simpl. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec z x) as [Heq2|Hne2].
        -- left; exact Heq2.
        -- right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_domain_removeEntry : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intro Hnd.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; auto.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. eapply domain_removeEntry_sub; eauto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_removeEntry_still : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> In y (domain g) -> ~ In y (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros Hnd Hin.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
    + simpl. destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
      * intro Hc. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
        -- apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
        -- exact (IH Hnd Hin Hc).
Qed.

Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_nodup : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> isMap g.
Proof.
  intros g Hnd. unfold isMap. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  assert (H := nodup_entry_unique g x f1 t1 x f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 eq_refl).
  inversion H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_removeEntry : forall y g, isMap g -> isMap (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f1 t1 H1).
  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f2 t2 H2).
Qed.

Lemma isMap_sub : forall g1 g2, isMap g2 ->
    (forall x f t, In ((x,f),t) g1 -> In ((x,f),t) g2) -> isMap g1.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 Hm Hsub. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Permutation_domain : forall g g', Permutation g g' -> Permutation (domain g) (domain g').

Lemma Permutation_reinsert2 : forall g x b tx tb fx fb,
  In ((x,fx),tx) g -> In ((b,fb),tb) g -> x <> b -> NoDup (domain g) ->
  Permutation ((x,fx,tx)::(b,fb,tb)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g)) g.
Proof.
  intros g x b tx tb fx fb Hx Hb Hxb Hnd.
  assert (Hndx : NoDup (domain (removeEntry x g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hbx : In ((b,fb),tb) (removeEntry x g)).
  { apply (in_removeEntry_intro x g b fb tb); [exact Hxb | exact Hb]. }
  assert (P2 : Permutation ((b,fb,tb)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g)) (removeEntry x g))

Lemma ecomb_redistribute :

Lemma removeEntry_self_domain : forall n f t tl,

Lemma domain_removeEntry_perm : forall n g, In n (domain g) ->

Lemma max_le_spec : forall l m, max l <= m <-> (forall a x, In (a,x) l -> x <= m).
Proof.
  intros l. induction l as [|h t IH]; intros m.
  - simpl. split; intros HH. { intros a x Hin; simpl in Hin; destruct Hin. } lia.
  - destruct h as [a x]. simpl.
    remember (max t) as mt eqn:E.
    destruct (x <? mt) eqn:Elt.
    + apply Nat.ltb_lt in Elt.
      split.
      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
      * intros H. apply (proj2 (IH m)). intros a0 x0 Hin. apply (H a0 x0). right; exact Hin.
    + apply Nat.ltb_ge in Elt.
      split.
      * intros Hm a0 x0 [Heq|Hin].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. lia.
        -- assert (Hle : mt <= m) by lia.
           exact (proj1 (IH m) Hle a0 x0 Hin).
      * intros H. apply (H a x). left; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma max_perm : forall l l', Permutation l l' -> max l = max l'.
Proof.
  intros l l' Hp. apply Nat.le_antisymm.
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l (max l'))). intros a x Hin.
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l' (max l')) (le_n (max l')) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) Hp Hin)).
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l' (max l))). intros a x Hin.
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l (max l)) (le_n (max l)) a x (Permutation_in (a,x) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hin)).
Qed.

Lemma max_cons_lt : forall (x:name*name) l, snd x < max l -> max (x :: l) = max l.
Proof.
  intros [x1 x2] l H. cbn in H. cbn [max].
  destruct (x2 <? max l) eqn:E.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply Nat.ltb_ge in E. exfalso. lia.
Qed.

Lemma max_le_of_in : forall (l l':list (name*name)),
  (forall x, In x l -> In x l') -> max l <= max l'.
Proof.
  intros l l' H. apply (proj2 (max_le_spec l (max l'))). intros a x Hin.
  exact (proj1 (max_le_spec l' (max l')) (le_n (max l')) a x (H (a,x) Hin)).
Qed.

Lemma In_dom_removeEntry_iff : forall n g, In n (domain g) ->
    forall x, In x (domain g) <-> x = n \/ In x (domain (removeEntry n g)).

  - intros Hx. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x n) as [->|Hne].
    + left; reflexivity.
    + right. apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto.
  - intros [->|H].
    + exact Hn.
    + apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact H.
Qed.

Lemma In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 : forall n g, NoDup (domain g) -> In n (domain g) ->
    forall x, In x (domain (removeEntry n g)) <-> In x (domain g) /\ x <> n.

  - intro H. split.
    + apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=n); exact H.
    + intro Hxn; subst x. exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g Hnd Hn H).
  - intros [Hg Hxn]. apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto.
Qed.

Definition consumable (t : piType) : Prop :=
  t = Top \/ (exists p t', t = Chan un p t') \/ (exists t', t = Chan lin empty t').

Lemma consumable_top : consumable Top.
Proof. left; auto. Qed.

Lemma consumable_un : forall p t, consumable (Chan un p t).
Proof. intros; right; left; eauto. Qed.

Lemma consumable_lin_empty : forall t, consumable (Chan lin empty t).
Proof. intros; right; right; eauto. Qed.

Lemma typeOf_inv : forall g n t, typeOf g n t -> exists f, In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof. intros g n t H. destruct H as [g' n' f t' Hin]. exists f. exact Hin. Qed.

Lemma cons_entry : forall g pf, cons g pf ->

Proof.

      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.

  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan un p t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
      unfold isMap in Him.
      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan un p t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
      subst t0. apply consumable_un.
    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * exact Hin.
  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.

    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan lin empty t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].

    (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t) -> cons g pf.
Proof.

        exact (Co_lin (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) pf n t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
Qed.

  - apply cons_entry.
  - apply entry_cons.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_proj : forall g, isMap g -> isMap (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g).
Proof.
  intros g Hm. unfold isMap. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
  - apply in_app_or in H1. destruct H1 as [H|H].
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_vis_proj g x f1 t1) H)).
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_ill_proj g x f1 t1) H)).
  - apply in_app_or in H2. destruct H2 as [H|H].
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_vis_proj g x f2 t2) H)).
    + exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_ill_proj g x f2 t2) H)).
Qed.

Lemma cons_proj_perm : forall g g' pf pf', Permutation g g' ->
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf -> cons (vis_proj g' ++ ill_proj g') pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hp Hc.
  apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply In_vis_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hing Hf].
    assert (Hing' : In ((n,f),t) g) by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hing)).
    assert (Hproj : In ((n,f),t) (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)).
    { subst f. apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj. split; auto. }
    exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t Hproj).
  - apply In_ill_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hing Hf].
    assert (Hing' : In ((n,f),t) g) by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hing)).
    assert (Hproj : In ((n,f),t) (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)).
    { subst f. apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj. split; auto. }
    exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t Hproj).
Qed.


Lemma cons_perm : forall g g' pf pf', Permutation g g' -> cons g pf -> cons g' pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hp Hc. apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply (proj1 (cons_spec g pf) Hc n f t).
  exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) (Permutation_sym Hp) Hin).
Qed.

  - recurses on the tails,

    esplit g11 g12 g1 -> esplit g1 g2 g ->
    NoDup (domain g11) -> NoDup (domain g12) -> NoDup (domain g1) ->
    NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g) ->
    exists h, esplit g12 g2 h /\ esplit g11 h g.
  ```
  The `NoDup` assumptions are needed by `esplit_remove` and are supplied by the lts derivation in the intended use. A `tEnv_split` wrapper is not yet added, but this is exactly the target statement in its usable form.

Lemma ecomb_type_plus : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,

Lemma ecomb_consumable : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) ->
    consumable t1 -> consumable t2 -> consumable t.

  apply (consumable_plus t1 t2 t H1 H2).
  apply ecomb_type_plus with (f1:=f1) (f2:=f2) (f:=f). exact Hec.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Section PairEq.

Definition pair_eq (p1 p2 : name * name) :=
    (fst p1 =? fst p2) && (snd p1 =? snd p2).

Fixpoint In2 a l :=
    match l with
    | nil => false
    | b :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then true else In2 a m
    end.

End PairEq.

Theorem sr :
  forall g p a g' p' nd_pf pf pf',
    sl_pos p ->

Proof.
  admit.

====RULES
Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInU : forall u p t x q pf1 pf2,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf2 ->
      typeCheck ( (x, vis, t) :: g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dBang (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q).

End TypeSystemRules.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).

Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, ill, t) :: ill_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       ill_proj m
    end.

End TypeSystem.
====

Lemma cons_un_env : forall g g' pf pf',
  NoDup (domain g') -> un_env g g' -> cons g pf -> cons g' pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hnd' Hun Hc.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec g' pf')).
  intros n f t' Hin'.
  assert (Hn : In n (domain g))
    by (apply (un_env_dom2 g g' n Hun); apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=t'); exact Hin').
  destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g n Hn) as [f0 [t0 Hin0]].
  destruct (proj2 Hun n f0 t0 Hin0) as [t1 [Hin1 Hle]].
  assert (Heq : ((n,f0),t1) = ((n,f),t'))
    by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g' n f0 t1 n f t' Hnd' Hin1 Hin' eq_refl)).
  inversion Heq; subst.
  apply (un_le_consumable t0 t' Hle).
  exact (proj1 (cons_spec g pf) Hc n f0 t0 Hin0).
Qed.

Lemma cons_proj_un_env : forall g g' pf pf',

18	Lemma pol_plus_cup : forall p q r, pol_plus p q r -> r = pol_cup p q.
19	Proof.
20	  intros p q r H. destruct p, q; simpl in *;
21	    inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
22	Qed.

24	(* The pure polarity cancellation used in the out/in cases. *)
25	Lemma pol_plus_cancel : forall t a ta b c t1,
26	  pol_plus t a ta -> pol_plus ta b t1 -> pol_plus t c t1 ->
27	  pol_plus a b c.
28	Proof.
29	  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
30	  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
31	    eauto using pol_plus.
32	Qed.

34	(* The vis-only flag cancellation needed at the value name. *)
35	Lemma flag_plus_cancel_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
36	  flag_plus t a ta -> flag_plus ta b t1 -> flag_plus t c t1 ->
37	  flag_plus a b c.
38	Proof.
39	  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
40	  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
41	    eauto using flag_plus.
42	Qed.

44	(* Combination functions witnessing the (partial) monoid operations. *)
45	Definition flag_comb (f g : flag) : flag :=
46	  match f, g with
47	  | hid, ill | ill, hid => hid
48	  | vis, vis => vis
49	  | ill, ill => ill
50	  | _, _ => hid
51	  end.
52	
53	Definition type_comb (t1 t2 : piType) : piType :=
54	  match t1, t2 with
55	  | Top, Top => Top
56	  | Chan lin p1 u, Chan lin p2 _ => Chan lin (pol_cup p1 p2) u
57	  | Chan un p1 u, Chan un p2 _ => Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u
58	  | _, _ => Top
59	  end.
60	
61	Lemma flag_plus_comb : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> h = flag_comb f g.
62	Proof.
63	  intros f g h H. inversion H; reflexivity.
64	Qed.
65	
66	Lemma type_plus_comb : forall t1 t2 t3, type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> t3 = type_comb t1 t2.
67	Proof.
68	  intros t1 t2 t3 H. inversion H as [| p1 p2 p t' Hp | p1 p2 t']; subst; simpl.
69	  - reflexivity.
70	  - rewrite (pol_plus_cup p1 p2 p Hp). reflexivity.
71	  - reflexivity.
72	Qed.
73	
74	Lemma ecomb_comb : forall a b c, ecomb a b c ->
75	  c = (flag_comb (fst a) (fst b), type_comb (snd a) (snd b)).
76	Proof.
77	  intros a b c H. destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc].
78	  inversion H; subst; simpl.
79	  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
80	      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf); reflexivity end.

96	  type_plus t a ta ->

98	  type_plus t c t1 ->
99	  (is_unrestricted ta -> a = ta) ->
100	  (is_unrestricted t1 -> c = t1) ->
101	  ecomb (vis, a) (vis, b) (vis, c).

103	  intros t a ta b c t1 Hp He Hc Hua Huc.
104	  inversion Hp as [| p1 p2 p3 u Hpp | p1 p2 u]; subst.
105	  - (* t = a = ta = Top *)

242	                 (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd3)
243	                 Hnd1 Hnd2 Hnd3 Hes)).
244	  exact (tEnv_split_pf_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs' pf1' pf2' pf3').

248	(* 3.  Unrestricted-entry enlargement (the flexible sibling relation)  *)
249	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
250	
251	Definition un_ext (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
252	  t = t' \/
253	  exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t'.
254	
255	Definition un_enlarge (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
256	  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
257	  forall n f t, In (n, f, t) g ->
258	    exists t', In (n, f, t') g' /\ un_ext t t'.
259	
260	Lemma un_ext_sub : forall t t', un_ext t t' -> type_sub t t'.
261	Proof.
262	  intros t t' [->| [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id|exact Hsub].
263	Qed.
264	
265	Lemma un_ext_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
266	  un_ext t1 t2 -> un_ext t2 t3 -> un_ext t1 t3.
267	Proof.
268	  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
269	  destruct H12 as [->| [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
270	  - exact H23.
271	  - destruct H23 as [->| [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
272	    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
273	    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
274	      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.
275	      split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|]].
276	      eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hs1|exact Hs2].
277	Qed.
278	
279	Lemma un_enlarge_refl : forall g, un_enlarge g g.
280	Proof.
281	  intro g. split.
282	  - intro n; reflexivity.
283	  - intros n f t Hin. exists t. split; [exact Hin|left; reflexivity].
284	Qed.
285	
286	Lemma un_enlarge_trans : forall g1 g2 g3,
287	  un_enlarge g1 g2 -> un_enlarge g2 g3 -> un_enlarge g1 g3.
288	Proof.
289	  intros g1 g2 g3 [D12 H12] [D23 H23]. split.
290	  - intro n. rewrite D12. apply D23.
291	  - intros n f t Hin.
292	    destruct (H12 n f t Hin) as [t2 [Hin2 He12]].
293	    destruct (H23 n f t2 Hin2) as [t3 [Hin3 He23]].
294	    exists t3. split; [exact Hin3|]. eapply un_ext_trans; eauto.
295	Qed.
296	
297	Lemma un_enlarge_cons : forall n f t t' g g',
298	  un_enlarge g g' ->
299	  In (n, f, t') g' -> un_ext t t' ->
300	  un_enlarge ((n,f,t)::g) ((n,f,t')::g').
301	Proof.
302	  intros n f t t' g g' [D H] Hin He. split.
303	  - intro x. simpl. split; intro Hx.
304	    + destruct Hx as [->|Hx]; [left; reflexivity|right; apply (proj1 (D x)); exact Hx].
305	    + destruct Hx as [->|Hx]; [left; reflexivity|right; apply (proj2 (D x)); exact Hx].
306	  - intros m g0 u Hin0.
307	    simpl in Hin0. destruct Hin0 as [E|Hin0].
308	    + inversion E; subst. exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity|exact He].
309	    + destruct (H m g0 u Hin0) as [u' [Hin' He']].
310	      exists u'. split; [right; exact Hin'|exact He'].
311	Qed.

314	(* 4.  The dummy split:  g = g + dummyEnv g                           *)
315	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
316	
317	Definition dummyFlag (f : flag) : flag :=
318	  match f with hid => ill | ill => ill | vis => vis end.
319	
320	Definition dummyType (t : piType) : piType :=
321	  match t with
322	  | Top => Top
323	  | Chan lin p u => Chan lin empty u
324	  | Chan un p u => Chan un p u
325	  end.
326	
327	Definition dummyEnv (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv :=
328	  map (fun e => match e with (n,f,t) => (n, dummyFlag f, dummyType t) end) g.
329	
330	Lemma dummy_ecomb : forall f t, ecomb (f,t) (dummyFlag f, dummyType t) (f,t).
331	Proof.
332	  intros f t. destruct f.
333	  - destruct t as [m p u|].
334	    + destruct m; simpl.
335	      * eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_hi|apply Pp_emptyR].
336	      * eapply ec_un; apply Fp_hi.
337	    + simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_hi.
338	  - destruct t as [m p u|].
339	    + destruct m; simpl.
340	      * eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_ii|apply Pp_emptyR].
341	      * eapply ec_un; apply Fp_ii.
342	    + simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_ii.
343	  - destruct t as [m p u|].
344	    + destruct m; simpl.
345	      * eapply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv|apply Pp_emptyR].
346	      * eapply ec_un; apply Fp_vv.
347	    + simpl. apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
348	Qed.
349	
350	Lemma domain_dummyEnv : forall g, domain (dummyEnv g) = domain g.
351	Proof.
352	  induction g as [|[[n f] t] tl IH].
353	  - reflexivity.
354	  - simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
355	Qed.
356	
357	Lemma In_dummyEnv_iff : forall g n f t,
358	  In (n,f,t) (dummyEnv g) <->
359	  exists f0 t0, In (n,f0,t0) g /\ f = dummyFlag f0 /\ t = dummyType t0.
360	Proof.
361	  induction g as [|[[n0 f0] t0] tl IH].
362	  - intros n f t. simpl. split; [contradiction|].
363	    intros [f1 [t1 [H _]]]. contradiction.
364	  - intros n f t. simpl. split.
365	    + intro H. destruct H as [E|H].
366	      * inversion E; subst. exists f0, t0. split; [left; reflexivity|auto].
367	      * apply IH in H. destruct H as [f1 [t1 [Hin [Ef Et]]]].
368	        exists f1, t1. split; [right; exact Hin|auto].
369	    + intros [f1 [t1 [Hin [Ef Et]]]]. subst f t.
370	      destruct Hin as [E|Hin].
371	      * inversion E; subst. left; reflexivity.
372	      * right. apply IH. exists f1, t1. auto.
373	Qed.
374	
375	Lemma esplit_dummy : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> esplit g (dummyEnv g) g.
376	Proof.
377	  intros g Hnd. split.
378	  - intro n. rewrite domain_dummyEnv. reflexivity.
379	  - split.
380	    + intro n. rewrite domain_dummyEnv. reflexivity.
381	    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
382	      apply In_dummyEnv_iff in H2.
383	      destruct H2 as [f0 [t0 [H0 [Ef Et]]]]. subst f2 t2.
384	      assert (Heq : ((n,f0),t0) = ((n,f1),t1)).
385	      { apply (nodup_entry_unique g n f0 t0 n f1 t1 Hnd H0 H1 eq_refl). }
386	      inversion Heq; subst.
387	      exists f1, t1. split; [exact H1|apply dummy_ecomb].
388	Qed.

390	Lemma tEnv_split_dummy : forall g (pf : isMap g)
391	    (pfd : isMap (dummyEnv g)) (pfd' : isMap g),
392	  NoDup (domain g) -> tEnv_split g (dummyEnv g) g pf pfd pfd'.
393	Proof.
394	  intros g pf pfd pfd' Hnd.
395	  apply (esplit_tEnv_split g (dummyEnv g) g pf pfd pfd').
396	  - exact Hnd.
397	  - rewrite domain_dummyEnv. exact Hnd.
398	  - exact Hnd.
399	  - apply esplit_dummy; exact Hnd.
400	Qed.

403	(* 5.  Permutation and two-entry replacement for esplit                *)
404	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
405	
406	Lemma esplit_perm : forall g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3',
407	  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
408	  Permutation g1 g1' -> Permutation g2 g2' -> Permutation g3 g3' ->
409	  esplit g1' g2' g3'.
410	Proof.
411	  intros g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3' [HA [HB HC]] P1 P2 P3. split.
412	  - intro n. split; intro H.
413	    + apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)).
414	      apply (proj1 (HA n)).
415	      exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P1)) H).
416	    + apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P1)).
417	      apply (proj2 (HA n)).
418	      exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)) H).
419	  - split.
420	    + intro n. split; intro H.
421	      * apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)).
422	        apply (proj1 (HB n)).
423	        exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)) H).
424	      * apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)).
425	        apply (proj2 (HB n)).
426	        exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)) H).
427	    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
428	      assert (H1' : In ((n,f1),t1) g1)
429	        by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f1),t1) (Permutation_sym P1) H1)).
430	      assert (H2' : In ((n,f2),t2) g2)
431	        by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f2),t2) (Permutation_sym P2) H2)).
432	      destruct (HC n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1' H2') as [f [t [H3 He]]].
433	      exists f, t. split; [|exact He].
434	      exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) P3 H3).
435	Qed.

437	(* A canonical replacement of the entries at two distinct names.  The
438	   lemma is phrased with the *new* entries and assumptions witnessing
439	   that both names occur in the old environments; all four old entries
440	   disappear and are replaced simultaneously. *)
441	
442	Lemma esplit_repl2 : forall g1 g2 g3 a b
443	    fa1 ta1 fa2 ta2 fa3 ta3 fb1 tb1 fb2 tb2 fb3 tb3,
444	  a <> b ->
445	  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g3) ->
446	  In a (domain g1) -> In b (domain g1) ->
447	  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
448	  ecomb (fa1,ta1) (fa2,ta2) (fa3,ta3) ->
449	  ecomb (fb1,tb1) (fb2,tb2) (fb3,tb3) ->
450	  esplit
451	    ((a,fa1,ta1) :: (b,fb1,tb1) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g1))
452	    ((a,fa2,ta2) :: (b,fb2,tb2) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g2))
453	    ((a,fa3,ta3) :: (b,fb3,tb3) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g3)).
454	Proof.
455	  intros g1 g2 g3 a b fa1 ta1 fa2 ta2 fa3 ta3 fb1 tb1 fb2 tb2 fb3 tb3
456	         Hab Hnd1 Hnd2 Hnd3 Ha1 Hb1 [HA [HB HC]] Hea Heb.
457	  assert (Ha2 : In a (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA a)); exact Ha1).
458	  assert (Hb2 : In b (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA b)); exact Hb1).
459	  assert (Ha3 : In a (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB a)); exact Ha2).
460	  assert (Hb3 : In b (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB b)); exact Hb2).
461	  assert (Hdom1 : forall x,
462	    In x (domain ((a,fa1,ta1) :: (b,fb1,tb1) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g1)))
463	    <-> In x (domain g1)).
464	  { intro x. simpl. rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g1 a b Hnd1 Ha1 Hb1 Hab x).
465	    split.
466	    - intros [->|[->|[Hx [_ _]]]]; assumption.
467	    - intro Hx. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x a) as [->|Hxa].
468	      + left; reflexivity.
469	      + destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x b) as [->|Hxb].
470	        * right; left; reflexivity.
471	        * right; right. split; [exact Hx|split; auto]. }
472	  assert (Hdom2 : forall x,
473	    In x (domain ((a,fa2,ta2) :: (b,fb2,tb2) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g2)))
474	    <-> In x (domain g2)).
475	  { intro x. simpl. rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g2 a b Hnd2 Ha2 Hb2 Hab x).
476	    split.
477	    - intros [->|[->|[Hx [_ _]]]]; assumption.
478	    - intro Hx. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x a) as [->|Hxa].
479	      + left; reflexivity.
480	      + destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x b) as [->|Hxb].
481	        * right; left; reflexivity.
482	        * right; right. split; [exact Hx|split; auto]. }
483	  assert (Hdom3 : forall x,
484	    In x (domain ((a,fa3,ta3) :: (b,fb3,tb3) :: removeEntry b (removeEntry a g3)))
485	    <-> In x (domain g3)).
486	  { intro x. simpl. rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g3 a b Hnd3 Ha3 Hb3 Hab x).
487	    split.
488	    - intros [->|[->|[Hx [_ _]]]]; assumption.
489	    - intro Hx. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x a) as [->|Hxa].
490	      + left; reflexivity.
491	      + destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x b) as [->|Hxb].
492	        * right; left; reflexivity.
493	        * right; right. split; [exact Hx|split; auto]. }
494	  assert (Hnota : forall gi, NoDup (domain gi) -> In a (domain gi) ->
495	      In b (domain gi) -> ~ In a (domain (removeEntry b (removeEntry a gi)))).
496	  { intros gi Hnd Ha Hb Hc.
497	    apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still a gi Hnd Ha).
498	    exact (domain_removeEntry_sub b (removeEntry a gi) a Hc). }
499	  assert (Hnotb : forall gi, NoDup (domain gi) -> In a (domain gi) ->
500	      In b (domain gi) -> ~ In b (domain (removeEntry b (removeEntry a gi)))).
501	  { intros gi Hnd Ha Hb Hc.
502	    apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still b gi Hnd Hb).
503	    rewrite <- (removeEntry_removeEntry_other a b gi Hab) in Hc.
504	    exact (domain_removeEntry_sub a (removeEntry b gi) b Hc). }
505	  split.
506	  - intro x. split; intro Hx.
507	    + apply (proj2 (Hdom2 x)).
508	      apply (proj1 (HA x)).
509	      exact (proj1 (Hdom1 x) Hx).
510	    + apply (proj2 (Hdom1 x)).
511	      apply (proj2 (HA x)).
512	      exact (proj1 (Hdom2 x) Hx).
513	  - split.
514	    + intro x. split; intro Hx.
515	      * apply (proj2 (Hdom3 x)).
516	        apply (proj1 (HB x)).
517	        exact (proj1 (Hdom2 x) Hx).
518	      * apply (proj2 (Hdom2 x)).
519	        apply (proj2 (HB x)).
520	        exact (proj1 (Hdom3 x) Hx).
521	    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 Hin1 Hin2.
522	      simpl in Hin1, Hin2.
523	      destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec n a) as [Ena|Hna];
524	        destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec n b) as [Enb|Hnb].
525	      * exfalso; apply Hab; transitivity n; [symmetry; exact Ena|exact Enb].
526	      * (* n = a, n <> b *)
527	        subst a.
528	        destruct Hin1 as [E1|[E1|Ht1]].
529	        -- destruct Hin2 as [E2|[E2|Ht2]].
530	           ++ inversion E1; subst. inversion E2; subst.
531	              exists fa3, ta3. split; [left; reflexivity|exact Hea].
532	           ++ inversion E2; subst. exfalso; apply Hnb; reflexivity.
533	           ++ exfalso; exact (Hnota g2 Hnd2 Ha2 Hb2
534	              (in_dom_entry _ n f2 t2 Ht2)).
535	        -- inversion E1; subst. exfalso; apply Hnb; reflexivity.
536	        -- exfalso; exact (Hnota g1 Hnd1 Ha1 Hb1
537	              (in_dom_entry _ n f1 t1 Ht1)).
538	      * (* n = b, n <> a *)
539	        subst b.
540	        destruct Hin1 as [E1|[E1|Ht1]].
541	        -- inversion E1; subst. exfalso; apply Hna; reflexivity.
542	        -- destruct Hin2 as [E2|[E2|Ht2]].
543	           ++ inversion E2; subst. exfalso; apply Hna; reflexivity.
544	           ++ inversion E1; subst. inversion E2; subst.
545	              exists fb3, tb3. split; [right; left; reflexivity|exact Heb].
546	           ++ exfalso; exact (Hnotb g2 Hnd2 Ha2 Hb2
547	              (in_dom_entry _ n f2 t2 Ht2)).
548	        -- exfalso; exact (Hnotb g1 Hnd1 Ha1 Hb1
549	              (in_dom_entry _ n f1 t1 Ht1)).
550	      * (* n differs from both *)
551	        assert (Htail1 : In ((n,f1),t1) (removeEntry b (removeEntry a g1))).
552	        { destruct Hin1 as [E1|[E1|Ht1]].
553	          - inversion E1; subst. exfalso; apply Hna; reflexivity.
554	          - inversion E1; subst. exfalso; apply Hnb; reflexivity.
555	          - exact Ht1. }
556	        assert (Htail2 : In ((n,f2),t2) (removeEntry b (removeEntry a g2))).
557	        { destruct Hin2 as [E2|[E2|Ht2]].
558	          - inversion E2; subst. exfalso; apply Hna; reflexivity.
559	          - inversion E2; subst. exfalso; apply Hnb; reflexivity.
560	          - exact Ht2. }
561	        assert (Hg1 : In ((n,f1),t1) g1).
562	        { apply (in_removeEntry_elim a g1 n f1 t1).
563	          apply (in_removeEntry_elim b (removeEntry a g1) n f1 t1).
564	          exact Htail1. }
565	        assert (Hg2 : In ((n,f2),t2) g2).
566	        { apply (in_removeEntry_elim a g2 n f2 t2).
567	          apply (in_removeEntry_elim b (removeEntry a g2) n f2 t2).
568	          exact Htail2. }
569	        destruct (HC n f1 t1 f2 t2 Hg1 Hg2) as [f [t [Hg3 Hec]]].
570	        exists f, t. split; [|exact Hec].
571	        right; right.
572	        apply (in_removeEntry_intro b (removeEntry a g3) n f t);
573	          [intro Hc; exact (Hnb (eq_sym Hc))|].
574	        apply (in_removeEntry_intro a g3 n f t);
575	          [intro Hc; exact (Hna (eq_sym Hc))|exact Hg3].
576	Qed.

582	(* Insert a common fresh name with an arbitrary ecomb-compatible triple
583	   of entries.  This generalises SubstDev's esplit_insert_consumable
584	   (which requires the same type in all three components). *)
585	
586	Lemma esplit_insert_comb : forall g1 g2 g3 b f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
587	  esplit g1 g2 g3 -> ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) ->
588	  ~ In b (domain g1) -> ~ In b (domain g2) -> ~ In b (domain g3) ->
589	  esplit ((b,f1,t1)::g1) ((b,f2,t2)::g2) ((b,f,t)::g3).
590	Proof.
591	  intros g1 g2 g3 b f1 t1 f2 t2 f t [HA [HB HC]] Hec Hb1 Hb2 Hb3.
592	  split.
593	  - intros x; simpl. split; intro Hx; destruct Hx as [Heq|Hx].
594	    + left; exact Heq.
595	    + right; apply (proj1 (HA x)); exact Hx.
596	    + left; exact Heq.
597	    + right; apply (proj2 (HA x)); exact Hx.
598	  - split.
599	    + intros x; simpl. split; intro Hx; destruct Hx as [Heq|Hx].
600	      * left; exact Heq.
601	      * right; apply (proj1 (HB x)); exact Hx.
602	      * left; exact Heq.
603	      * right; apply (proj2 (HB x)); exact Hx.
604	    + intros n g1f t1' g2f t2' Hin1 Hin2.
605	      simpl in Hin1, Hin2.
606	      destruct Hin1 as [H1|H1]; destruct Hin2 as [H2|H2].
607	      * inversion H1; inversion H2; subst.
608	        exists f, t. split; [left; reflexivity|exact Hec].
609	      * inversion H1; subst. exfalso. apply Hb2.
610	        exact (in_dom_entry g2 n g2f t2' H2).
611	      * inversion H2; subst. exfalso. apply Hb1.
612	        exact (in_dom_entry g1 n g1f t1' H1).
613	      * destruct (HC n g1f t1' g2f t2' H1 H2) as [fc [tc [Hin3 He]]].
614	        exists fc, tc. split; [right; exact Hin3|exact He].
615	Qed.

617	(* Auxiliary merge lemma by induction on the length of the left-most
618	   component.  All environments are assumed to have NoDup domains,
619	   which is exactly what the lts induction supplies. *)
620	
621	Lemma esplit_assoc_merge_aux : forall k g11 g12 g1 g2 g,
622	  length g11 = k ->
623	  esplit g11 g12 g1 -> esplit g1 g2 g ->
624	  NoDup (domain g11) -> NoDup (domain g12) -> NoDup (domain g1) ->
625	  NoDup (domain g2) -> NoDup (domain g) ->
626	  exists h, esplit g12 g2 h /\ esplit g11 h g.
627	Proof.
628	  induction k as [|k IH]; intros g11 g12 g1 g2 g Hlen Hin Hout
629	    Hnd11 Hnd12 Hnd1 Hnd2 Hndg.
630	  - destruct g11 as [|[[n f11] t11] tail11].
631	    + (* g11 = nil: all five environments are empty *)
632	      destruct Hin as [HA [HB HC]].
633	      assert (Hg12 : g12 = nil).
634	      { destruct g12 as [|[[m fm] tm] tl].
635	        - reflexivity.
636	        - simpl in HA. exfalso.
637	          assert (Hm : In m (domain (((m,fm),tm)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
638	          exact (proj2 (HA m) Hm). }
639	      subst g12.
640	      assert (Hg1 : g1 = nil).
641	      { destruct g1 as [|[[m fm] tm] tl].
642	        - reflexivity.
643	        - simpl in HB. exfalso.
644	          assert (Hm : In m (domain (((m,fm),tm)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
645	          exact (proj2 (HB m) Hm). }
646	      subst g1.
647	      destruct Hout as [HAo [HBo HCo]].
648	      assert (Hg2 : g2 = nil).
649	      { destruct g2 as [|[[m fm] tm] tl].
650	        - reflexivity.
651	        - simpl in HAo. exfalso.
652	          assert (Hm : In m (domain (((m,fm),tm)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
653	          exact (proj2 (HAo m) Hm). }
654	      subst g2.
655	      assert (Hg : g = nil).
656	      { destruct g as [|[[m fm] tm] tl].
657	        - reflexivity.
658	        - simpl in HBo. exfalso.
659	          assert (Hm : In m (domain (((m,fm),tm)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
660	          exact (proj2 (HBo m) Hm). }
661	      subst g.
662	      exists nil. split.
663	      * unfold esplit; simpl. split.
664	        -- intros n; tauto.
665	        -- split.
666	           ++ intros n; tauto.
667	           ++ intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2; contradiction.
668	      * unfold esplit; simpl. split.
669	        -- intros n; tauto.
