unfold type_remove. split.
  - destruct Hp2 as [Hp2c|Hp2c]; subst p2; constructor.
  - split.
    + eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hpol.
    + intro H; destruct H as [p' [t' Heq']]; inversion Heq'.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_remove_dist_r : forall t0 p t3 t1 t2 t1'',
  type_sub (Chan lin inp t0) (Chan lin p t0) ->
  type_plus (Chan lin inp t0) t3 (Chan lin p t0) ->
  type_plus t1 (Chan lin p t0) t2 ->
  type_remove t2 (Chan lin inp t0) t1'' ->
  type_plus t1 t3 t1''.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t3 t1 t2 t1'' Hsub Hplus Htp Htr.
  destruct (type_sub_lin_inp t0 p Hsub) as [Hp|Hp]; subst p.
  - inversion Hplus; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?qq inp |- _ =>
      assert (Hqq : qq = empty) by (inversion Hh; subst; auto); subst qq; clear Hh end.
    inversion Htp; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus ?a inp ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol1 end.
    unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub2 [Hplus2 Hcond2]].
    inversion Hplus2; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?q ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol2 end.
    eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_sym; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
  - inversion Hplus; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?qq io |- _ =>
      assert (Hqq : qq = out) by (inversion Hh; subst; auto); subst qq; clear Hh end.
    inversion Htp; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus ?a io ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol1 end.
    unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub2 [Hplus2 Hcond2]].
    inversion Hplus2; subst.
    match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?q ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol2 end.
    eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_sym; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_remove_dist_l : forall t0 p1 p2 p t3 t1'',
  type_remove (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin inp t0) t3 ->
  type_plus (Chan lin p1 t0) (Chan lin p t0) (Chan lin p2 t0) ->
  type_remove (Chan lin p2 t0) (Chan lin inp t0) t1'' ->
  type_plus t3 (Chan lin p t0) t1''.
Proof.
  intros t0 p1 p2 p t3 t1'' Htr1 Htp Htr2.
  unfold type_remove in Htr1. destruct Htr1 as [Hsub1 [Hplus1 Hc1]].
  unfold type_remove in Htr2. destruct Htr2 as [Hsub2 [Hplus2 Hc2]].
  inversion Hplus1; subst.
  match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?q ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpolq end.
  inversion Htp; subst.
  match goal with Hh : pol_plus p1 ?p ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpolh end.
  inversion Hplus2; subst.
  match goal with Hh : pol_plus inp ?q ?c |- _ => rename Hh into Hpol2 end.
  eapply Tp_LinPlus. eapply pol_plus_mid_direct; eauto using Pp_emptyL, Pp_emptyR, Pp_inpL, Pp_inpR.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_lin_inv : forall t1 p t0 t2,
  type_plus t1 (Chan lin p t0) t2 ->
  exists p1 p2, t1 = Chan lin p1 t0 /\ t2 = Chan lin p2 t0 /\ pol_plus p1 p p2.
Proof.
  intros t1 p t0 t2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_lin_inv_l : forall t0 p t t2,
  type_plus (Chan lin p t0) t t2 ->
  exists p' p2, t = Chan lin p' t0 /\ t2 = Chan lin p2 t0 /\ pol_plus p p' p2.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t t2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma no_self_chan : forall m p t, t <> Chan m p t.
Proof.
  intros m p t. induction t as [m0 p0 t0 IH |]; intro H.
  - inversion H; subst. apply IH. assumption.
  - discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma no_type_sub_self_chan : forall m p t, ~ type_sub t (Chan m p t).
Proof.
  intros m p t H. inversion H; subst; eapply no_self_chan; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_un_inv_l : forall t0 p t t2,
  type_plus (Chan un p t0) t t2 ->
  exists pt p2, t = Chan un pt t0 /\ t2 = Chan un p2 t0 /\ p2 = pol_cup p pt.
Proof.
  intros t0 p t t2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma pol_cup_absorb_r : forall p q, pol_cup p (pol_cup q p) = pol_cup q p.
Proof. intros p q. destruct p, q; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma type_sub_pol_plus_r : forall m p1 p2 p t,
  pol_plus p1 p2 p -> type_sub (Chan m p2 t) (Chan m p t).
Proof.
  intros m p1 p2 p t H. destruct H; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_pol_plus_l : forall m p1 p2 p t,
  pol_plus p1 p2 p -> type_sub (Chan m p1 t) (Chan m p t).
Proof.
  intros m p1 p2 p t H. destruct H; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_cup_r : forall t p1 p2,
  type_sub (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).
Proof.
  intros t p1 p2. destruct p1, p2; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_cup_l : forall t p1 p2,
  type_sub (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).
Proof.
  intros t p1 p2. destruct p1, p2; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_r : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_sub b c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Ts_id.
  - match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (type_sub_pol_plus_r lin p1 p2 p t Hp) end.
  - exact (type_sub_cup_r t p1 p2).
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_l : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_sub a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Ts_id.
  - match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (type_sub_pol_plus_l lin p1 p2 p t Hp) end.
  - exact (type_sub_cup_l t p1 p2).
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sym : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_plus b a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Tp_Base.
  - apply Tp_LinPlus. match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (pol_plus_sym _ _ _ Hp) end.
  - assert (E : pol_cup p1 p2 = pol_cup p2 p1) by (apply pol_cup_comm).
    rewrite E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_trans : forall a b c, type_sub a b -> type_sub b c -> type_sub a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H1; inversion H2; subst;
    eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma pol_cup_mid : forall p0 p1 p3,
  pol_cup p0 (pol_cup p1 p3) = pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p3).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite <- pol_cup_assoc. rewrite <- pol_cup_assoc.
  rewrite (pol_cup_comm p0 p1). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid_mid : forall p0 p1 p2 p3 p,
  pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus p0 p3 p ->
  exists p2v, pol_plus p1 p3 p2v /\ pol_plus p0 p2v p2.
Proof.
  intros p0 p1 p2 p3 p H1 H2. destruct H2.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_mid : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
  type_plus t1 t t2 -> type_plus t0 t3 t ->
  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_plus t0 t2v t2.
Proof.
  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 H1 H2.
  destruct t as [m p t'|].
  - destruct m.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      match goal with Hp2 : pol_plus _ _ p |- _ => rename Hp2 into Hpol2 end.
      inversion H1; subst.
      match goal with Hp1 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp1 into Hpol1 end.
      destruct (pol_plus_mid_mid _ _ _ _ _ Hpol1 Hpol2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
      exists (Chan lin f t'). split.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hf.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hg.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      inversion H1; subst.
      exists (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p2) t'). split.
      * apply Tp_UnPlus.
      * assert (E : pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p2) = pol_cup p0 (pol_cup p1 p2)).
        { rewrite pol_cup_mid. reflexivity. }
        rewrite <- E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
  - inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst.
    exists Top. split; apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_det : forall a b c1 c2,
  type_plus a b c1 -> type_plus a b c2 -> c1 = c2.
Proof.
  intros a b c1 c2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst;
    try reflexivity; f_equal; eauto using pol_plus_det.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_unrestricted_r : forall a b c,
  type_plus a b c -> is_unrestricted c -> is_unrestricted b.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H2 as [p [t' E]]. subst c.
  inversion H1; subst; eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_unrestricted_l : forall a b c,
  type_plus a b c -> is_unrestricted c -> is_unrestricted a.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H2 as [p [t' E]]. subst c.
  inversion H1; subst; eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_plus : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
  type_remove t t0 t3 -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_remove t2 t0 t2v.
Proof.
  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htr Htp.
  unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub [Hplus Hcond]].
  destruct (type_plus_mid t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htp Hplus) as [t2v [Htv Hrest]].
  exists t2v. split; [exact Htv|].
  unfold type_remove. split.
  - eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hsub|apply (type_plus_sub_r _ _ _ Htp)].
  - split; [exact Hrest|].
    intro Hun2.
    assert (Hun_t : is_unrestricted t) by (eapply type_plus_unrestricted_r; eauto).
    assert (Hteq : t3 = t) by (eapply Hcond; exact Hun_t).
    rewrite Hteq in Htv.
    exact (type_plus_det t1 t t2v t2 Htv Htp).
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_self_payload_false : forall m p t0 r,
  ~ type_remove (Chan m p t0) t0 r.
Proof.
  intros m p t0 r H. unfold type_remove in H. destruct H as [Hsub _].
  eapply no_type_sub_self_chan; exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_assoc_l : forall S a b c d,
  type_plus S a b -> type_plus b c d ->
  exists r, type_plus a c r /\ type_plus S r d.
Proof.
  intros S a b c d H1 H2.
  destruct b as [m p t'|].
  - destruct m.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      match goal with Hp2 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp2 into Hpol2 end.
      inversion H1; subst.
      match goal with Hp1 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp1 into Hpol1 end.
      destruct (pol_plus_assoc _ _ _ _ _ Hpol1 Hpol2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
      exists (Chan lin f t'). split; eapply Tp_LinPlus; eauto.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      inversion H1; subst.
      exists (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p2) t'). split.
      * apply Tp_UnPlus.
      * assert (E : pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p2) = pol_cup (pol_cup p1 p0) p2)
          by (symmetry; apply pol_cup_assoc).
        rewrite <- E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
  - inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst.
    exists Top. split; apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_assoc_l : forall S t1 t3 t t2,
  type_remove t1 S t3 -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
  exists r, type_plus t3 t r /\ type_remove t2 S r.
Proof.
  intros S t1 t3 t t2 Htr Htp.
  unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub [Hplus Hcond]].
  destruct (type_plus_assoc_l S t3 t1 t t2 Hplus Htp) as [r [Hr Hrest]].
  exists r. split; [exact Hr|].
  unfold type_remove. split.
  - eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hsub|apply (type_plus_sub_l _ _ _ Htp)].
  - split; [exact Hrest|].
    intro Hun2.
    assert (Hun1 : is_unrestricted t1) by (eapply type_plus_unrestricted_l; eauto).
    assert (H1eq : t3 = t1) by (eapply Hcond; exact Hun1).
    rewrite H1eq in Hr.
    exact (type_plus_det t1 t r t2 Hr Htp).
Qed.

Lemma isMap_perm : forall g g', Permutation g g' -> isMap g -> isMap g'.
Proof.
  intros g g' Hp Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2).

Lemma typeCheck_weaken : forall g pf q,

  forall b tb, ~ In b (domain g) -> ~ In b (bv q) -> consumable tb ->
  forall pf', typeCheck ((b,vis,tb)::g) pf' q.
Proof.
  intros g pf q Hnd H. induction H; intros b tb Hb Hbv Hc pf'.
  - (* TNil *) apply TNil. apply (cons_insert g pf b tb H Hc pf').
  - (* TNew *)
    assert (Hn_g : In n (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid)(t:=t); exact H).
    assert (Hnb : b <> n).
    { intro Heq. apply Hb. rewrite Heq. exact Hn_g. }
    assert (Hb_rem : ~ In b (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. apply Hb.
      exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g b) Hcc)). }
    assert (Hn_not_rem : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. exact (proj2 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g n) Hcc) eq_refl). }
    assert (ndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd).
    assert (ndNrem : NoDup (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hn_not_rem|exact ndRem]. }
    assert (Hb_nrem : ~ In b (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. destruct Hcc as [Heq|Hcc].
      - apply Hnb. symmetry. exact Heq.
      - exact (Hb_rem Hcc). }
    assert (ndSource : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb_nrem|exact ndNrem]. }
    assert (P : Permutation ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
                         ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((b,vis,tb)::g))).
    { rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq b n vis tb g); [| intro Hneq; apply Hnb; exact Hneq]. apply perm_swap. }
    eapply TNew with (n := n) (t := t).
    + simpl. right. exact H.
    + exact (typeCheck_perm_auto ((b,vis,tb)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
               ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((b,vis,tb)::g)) p
               (isMap_nodup _ ndSource) ndSource P
               (IHtypeCheck ndNrem b tb Hb_nrem Hbv Hc (isMap_nodup _ ndSource))).
  - (* TPar *)
    match goal with Hs : tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf |- _ => rename Hs into Hsplit end.
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hsplit Hnd) as [nd1 nd2].
    destruct (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hsplit) as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (Hb1 : ~ In b (domain g1)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hb. exact (proj1 (HB b) (proj1 (HA b) Hx)). }
    assert (Hb2 : ~ In b (domain g2)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hb. exact (proj1 (HB b) Hx). }
    assert (Hbv1 : ~ In b (bv p1)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hbv. simpl. apply in_or_app. left. exact Hx. }
    assert (Hbv2 : ~ In b (bv p2)).
    { intro Hx. apply Hbv. simpl. apply in_or_app. right. exact Hx. }
    assert (ndS1 : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::g1))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb1|exact nd1]. }
    assert (ndS2 : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,tb)::g2))).

    eapply TPar with (g1 := (b,vis,tb)::g1) (g2 := (b,vis,tb)::g2).
    + assert (Hes : esplit g1 g2 g) by (apply (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hsplit)).
      eapply esplit_tEnv_split.
      * apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb1|exact nd1].
      * apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb2|exact nd2].
      * apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hb|exact Hnd].

    + exact (IHtypeCheck2 nd2 b tb Hb2 Hbv2 Hc (isMap_nodup _ ndS2)).

    destruct (pair_eq u v) eqn:Euv.
    + (* u = v vacuous *)

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev AuxDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Capability enlargement monotonicity for typeCheck.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Only unrestricted channel entries (and Top entries, which must stay  *)
(* literally equal) may be enlarged, by increasing their polarity along *)
(* [type_sub].                                                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Section UnLe.

Definition un_le (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  (exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t').

Lemma un_le_refl : forall t, un_le t t.
Proof. intro t; left; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma un_le_sub : forall t t', un_le t t' -> type_sub t t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id | exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
  un_le t1 t2 -> un_le t2 t3 -> un_le t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
  destruct H12 as [-> | [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
  - exact H23.
  - destruct H23 as [-> | [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.
      split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity |]].
      eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_consumable : forall t t',
  un_le t t' -> consumable t -> consumable t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> _]]]]]] Hc; auto.
  apply consumable_un.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_lin_eq : forall p u t', un_le (Chan lin p u) t' -> t' = Chan lin p u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_top_eq : forall t', un_le Top t' -> t' = Top.
Proof.
  intros t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_un_inv : forall p u t',
  un_le (Chan un p u) t' -> exists p', t' = Chan un p' u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [E | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E1 [E2 _]]]]]].
  - subst t'. exists p; reflexivity.
  - injection E1 as Hp Hu. subst p0 u0. exists p1; exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma un_sub_io_inp : forall p p' t,
  type_sub (Chan un p t) (Chan un p' t) ->
  (p = io \/ p = inp) -> (p' = io \/ p' = inp).
Proof.
  intros p p' t Hs Hp. inversion Hs; subst; auto;
    destruct Hp as [H|H]; discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma un_sub_io_out : forall p p' t,
  type_sub (Chan un p t) (Chan un p' t) ->
  (p = io \/ p = out) -> (p' = io \/ p' = out).
Proof.
  intros p p' t Hs Hp. inversion Hs; subst; auto;
    destruct Hp as [H|H]; discriminate H.
Qed.

(* Environment-level enlargement relation. *)
Definition un_env (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g ->
     exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t').

Section UnEnv.

Lemma un_env_refl : forall g, un_env g g.
Proof.
  intro g. split.
  - intro n; reflexivity.
  destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g n Hn) as [f0 [t0 Hs0]].
  destruct (proj2 Hun n f0 t0 Hs0) as [t1 [Hin1 Hle]].
  assert (Heq : ((n,f0),t1) = ((n,f),t'))
    by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g' n f0 t1 n f t' Hnd' Hin1 HinG' eq_refl)).
  inversion Heq; subst.
  assert (Hproj : In ((n,f),t0) (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)).
  { destruct Hfcase as [Ef|Ef]; subst f.
    - apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj. split; auto.
    - apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj. split; auto. }
  apply (un_le_consumable t0 t' Hle).
  exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t0 Hproj).
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_env2 : forall g1 g2 g2' g3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
  g2' = g2 -> tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  forall pf2', tEnv_split g1 g2' g3 pf1 pf2' pf3.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g2' g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 E H pf2'. subst g2'.
  apply (tEnv_split_pf_irrel g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 H pf1 pf2' pf3).
Qed.

Lemma un_env_split : forall G1 G2 G3 pf1 pf2 pf3,
  tEnv_split G1 G2 G3 pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  NoDup (domain G1) -> NoDup (domain G2) -> NoDup (domain G3) ->
  forall G', un_env G3 G' -> NoDup (domain G') ->
  exists G1' G2' pf1' pf2' pf3',
    tEnv_split G1' G2' G' pf1' pf2' pf3' /\
    un_env G1 G1' /\ un_env G2 G2'.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 G3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Hspl.
  induction Hspl as [G1 G2 G3 pf1 pf2 pf3 E1 E2 E3
    | G1 G2 G3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hpq Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
    | G1 G2 G3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty
    | G1 G2 G3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''' Hfp Hi1 Hi2 Hrec IH Hrem Hfo Hty];
    intros Hnd1 Hnd2 Hnd3 G' Hun Hnd'.
  - (* SpNil *)
    subst G1. subst G2. subst G3.
    assert (HG' : G' = nil).
    { destruct G' as [|h tl].
      - reflexivity.
      - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. exfalso.
        assert (Hin : In x (domain (((x,fx),tx)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
        destruct (proj2 (proj1 Hun x) Hin). }
    subst G'.
    exists nil, nil.
    exists (isMap_nodup nil (@NoDup_nil (name * name))).
    exists (isMap_nodup nil (@NoDup_nil (name * name))).
    exists (isMap_nodup nil (@NoDup_nil (name * name))).
    split.
    + apply SpNil; reflexivity.
    + split; apply un_env_refl.
  - (* SpLin *)
    destruct (typeOf_inv G3 n (Chan lin p' t) Hty) as [f0 Hf0].
    destruct (flagOf_inv G3 n f' Hfo) as [t0 Ht0].
    destruct (pf3 n f0 (Chan lin p' t) f' t0 (conj Hf0 Ht0)) as [Hfeq Hteq].
    subst f0. subst t0.
    destruct (proj2 Hun n f' (Chan lin p' t) Hf0) as [tG' [HinG' HleG']].
    assert (EtG : tG' = Chan lin p' t) by (apply (un_le_lin_eq p' t tG'); exact HleG').
    subst tG'.
    assert (Hn3 : In n (domain G3)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f') (t:=Chan lin p' t); exact Hf0).
    assert (Hn3' : In n (domain G')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f') (t:=Chan lin p' t); exact HinG').
    assert (HunRem : un_env (removeEntry n G3) (removeEntry n G'))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry n G3 G'); auto).
    rewrite Hrem in HunRem.
    assert (Hnd3''' : NoDup (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3).
    assert (HndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n G'))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd').
    destruct (IH (NoDup_domain_removeEntry n G1 Hnd1)
                 (NoDup_domain_removeEntry n G2 Hnd2)
                 Hnd3''' (removeEntry n G') HunRem HndRem)
      as [G1' [G2' [pf1' [pf2' [pf3' [Hspl' [Hun1 Hun2]]]]]]].
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup G1' G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl' HndRem) as [Hnd1' Hnd2'].
    destruct (tEnv_split_esplit G1' G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl') as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (HnotinRem : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n G')))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still n G' Hnd' Hn3')).
    assert (Hnotn1 : ~ In n (domain G1'))
      by (intro Hc; apply HnotinRem; apply (proj1 (HB n)); apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hc).
    assert (Hnotn2 : ~ In n (domain G2'))
      by (intro Hc; apply HnotinRem; apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hc).
    assert (HndNew1 : NoDup (domain ((n,f,Chan lin p t)::G1')))
      by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    assert (HndNew2 : NoDup (domain ((n,g,Chan lin q t)::G2')))
      by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    exists ((n,f,Chan lin p t)::G1'), ((n,g,Chan lin q t)::G2').
    exists (isMap_nodup _ HndNew1), (isMap_nodup _ HndNew2).
    exists (isMap_nodup G' Hnd').
    split.
    + eapply SpLin with (n:=n) (f:=f) (f':=f') (g:=g) (p:=p) (q:=q) (p':=p') (t:=t) (g''':=removeEntry n G').
      * exact Hfp.
      * exact Hpq.
      * left; reflexivity.
      * left; reflexivity.
      * apply (tEnv_split_env2 (removeEntry n ((n,f,Chan lin p t)::G1'))
                 G2' (removeEntry n ((n,g,Chan lin q t)::G2')) (removeEntry n G')
                 pf1' pf2' pf3' (removeEntry_cons_eq n g (Chan lin q t) G2')
                 (tEnv_split_env1 G1' (removeEntry n ((n,f,Chan lin p t)::G1'))
                    G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3'
                    (removeEntry_cons_eq n f (Chan lin p t) G1') Hspl'
                    (isMap_removeEntry n (((n,f),Chan lin p t)::G1')
                       (isMap_nodup _ HndNew1)))
                 (isMap_removeEntry n (((n,g),Chan lin q t)::G2')
                    (isMap_nodup _ HndNew2))).
      * reflexivity.
      * apply F_Entry; exact HinG'.
      * apply T_Entry; exact HinG'.
    + split.
      * apply (un_env_replace G1 n f (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin p t) G1' Hnd1 Hi1 (un_le_refl _) Hun1).
      * apply (un_env_replace G2 n g (Chan lin q t) (Chan lin q t) G2' Hnd2 Hi2 (un_le_refl _) Hun2).
  - (* SpUn *)
    destruct (typeOf_inv G3 n (Chan un p t) Hty) as [f0 Hf0].
    destruct (flagOf_inv G3 n f' Hfo) as [t0 Ht0].
    destruct (pf3 n f0 (Chan un p t) f' t0 (conj Hf0 Ht0)) as [Hfeq Hteq].
    subst f0. subst t0.
    destruct (proj2 Hun n f' (Chan un p t) Hf0) as [tG' [HinG' HleG']].
    destruct (un_le_un_inv p t tG' HleG') as [p'' Ep].
    subst tG'.
    assert (Hn3 : In n (domain G3)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f') (t:=Chan un p t); exact Hf0).
    assert (Hn3' : In n (domain G')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f') (t:=Chan un p'' t); exact HinG').
    assert (HunRem : un_env (removeEntry n G3) (removeEntry n G'))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry n G3 G'); auto).
    rewrite Hrem in HunRem.
    assert (Hnd3''' : NoDup (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3).
    assert (HndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n G'))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd').
    destruct (IH (NoDup_domain_removeEntry n G1 Hnd1)
                 (NoDup_domain_removeEntry n G2 Hnd2)
                 Hnd3''' (removeEntry n G') HunRem HndRem)
      as [G1' [G2' [pf1' [pf2' [pf3' [Hspl' [Hun1 Hun2]]]]]]].
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup G1' G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl' HndRem) as [Hnd1' Hnd2'].
    destruct (tEnv_split_esplit G1' G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl') as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (HnotinRem : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n G')))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still n G' Hnd' Hn3')).
    assert (Hnotn1 : ~ In n (domain G1'))
      by (intro Hc; apply HnotinRem; apply (proj1 (HB n)); apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hc).
    assert (Hnotn2 : ~ In n (domain G2'))
      by (intro Hc; apply HnotinRem; apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hc).
    assert (HndNew1 : NoDup (domain ((n,f,Chan un p'' t)::G1')))
      by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    assert (HndNew2 : NoDup (domain ((n,g,Chan un p'' t)::G2')))
      by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    exists ((n,f,Chan un p'' t)::G1'), ((n,g,Chan un p'' t)::G2').
    exists (isMap_nodup _ HndNew1), (isMap_nodup _ HndNew2).
    exists (isMap_nodup G' Hnd').
    split.
    + eapply SpUn with (n:=n) (f:=f) (f':=f') (g:=g) (p:=p'') (t:=t) (g''':=removeEntry n G').
      * exact Hfp.
      * left; reflexivity.
      * left; reflexivity.
      * apply (tEnv_split_env2 (removeEntry n ((n,f,Chan un p'' t)::G1'))
                 G2' (removeEntry n ((n,g,Chan un p'' t)::G2')) (removeEntry n G')
                 pf1' pf2' pf3' (removeEntry_cons_eq n g (Chan un p'' t) G2')
                 (tEnv_split_env1 G1' (removeEntry n ((n,f,Chan un p'' t)::G1'))
                    G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3'
                    (removeEntry_cons_eq n f (Chan un p'' t) G1') Hspl'
                    (isMap_removeEntry n (((n,f),Chan un p'' t)::G1')
                       (isMap_nodup _ HndNew1)))
                 (isMap_removeEntry n (((n,g),Chan un p'' t)::G2')
                    (isMap_nodup _ HndNew2))).
      * reflexivity.
      * apply F_Entry; exact HinG'.
      * apply T_Entry; exact HinG'.
    + split.
      * apply (un_env_replace G1 n f (Chan un p t) (Chan un p'' t) G1' Hnd1 Hi1 HleG' Hun1).
      * apply (un_env_replace G2 n g (Chan un p t) (Chan un p'' t) G2' Hnd2 Hi2 HleG' Hun2).
  - (* SpTop *)
    destruct (typeOf_inv G3 n Top Hty) as [f0 Hf0].
    destruct (flagOf_inv G3 n f' Hfo) as [t0 Ht0].
    destruct (pf3 n f0 Top f' t0 (conj Hf0 Ht0)) as [Hfeq Hteq].
    subst f0. subst t0.
    destruct (proj2 Hun n f' Top Hf0) as [tG' [HinG' HleG']].
    assert (EtG : tG' = Top) by (apply un_le_top_eq; exact HleG').
    subst tG'.
    assert (Hn3 : In n (domain G3)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f') (t:=Top); exact Hf0).
    assert (Hn3' : In n (domain G')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f') (t:=Top); exact HinG').
    assert (HunRem : un_env (removeEntry n G3) (removeEntry n G'))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry n G3 G'); auto).
    rewrite Hrem in HunRem.
    assert (Hnd3''' : NoDup (domain g''')) by (rewrite <- Hrem; apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd3).
    assert (HndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n G'))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd').
    destruct (IH (NoDup_domain_removeEntry n G1 Hnd1)
                 (NoDup_domain_removeEntry n G2 Hnd2)
                 Hnd3''' (removeEntry n G') HunRem HndRem)
      as [G1' [G2' [pf1' [pf2' [pf3' [Hspl' [Hun1 Hun2]]]]]]].
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup G1' G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl' HndRem) as [Hnd1' Hnd2'].
    destruct (tEnv_split_esplit G1' G2' (removeEntry n G') pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl') as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (HnotinRem : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n G')))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still n G' Hnd' Hn3')).
    assert (Hnotn1 : ~ In n (domain G1'))
      by (intro Hc; apply HnotinRem; apply (proj1 (HB n)); apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hc).
    assert (Hnotn2 : ~ In n (domain G2'))
      by (intro Hc; apply HnotinRem; apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hc).
    assert (HndNew1 : NoDup (domain ((n,f,Top)::G1')))
      by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).

Lemma un_env_dom1 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g').

Lemma un_env_dom2 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g).

Lemma un_env_cons : forall n f t t' g g',
  un_le t t' -> un_env g g' ->
  un_env ((n,f,t)::g) ((n,f,t')::g').
Proof.
  intros n f t t' g g' Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x. simpl. rewrite (Hdom x). tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hin. simpl in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [E | Hin].
    + inversion E; subst. exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin) as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_replace : forall g n f t t' gtail,
  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((n,f),t) g -> un_le t t' ->
  un_env (removeEntry n g) gtail ->
  un_env g ((n,f,t')::gtail).
Proof.
  intros g n f t t' gtail Hnd Hin Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x.
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g (in_dom_entry g n f t Hin) x).
    rewrite (Hdom x). simpl.
    split; intros [E | H]; [left; symmetry; exact E | right; exact H | left; symmetry; exact E | right; exact H].
  - intros x fx tx Hinx.
    destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x n) as [Hxn | Hxn].
    + subst x.
      assert (Heq : ((n,fx),tx) = ((n,f),t))
        by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g n fx tx n f t Hnd Hinx Hin eq_refl)).
      inversion Heq; subst.
      exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + assert (Hin' : In ((x,fx),tx) (removeEntry n g))
        by (apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g x fx tx); auto).
      destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin') as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_removeEntry : forall n g g',
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g') ->
  un_env g g' -> un_env (removeEntry n g) (removeEntry n g').
Proof.
  intros n g g' Hnd Hnd' Hn Hn' [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x.
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn x).
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g' Hnd' Hn' x).
    rewrite (Hdom x). tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hinx.
    assert (Hing : In ((x,fx),tx) g) by (apply (in_removeEntry_elim n g x fx tx); exact Hinx).
    destruct (Hent x fx tx Hing) as [u [Hinu He]].
    assert (Hxn : x <> n).
    { intro Hc. subst x.
      exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g Hnd Hn
               (in_dom_entry (removeEntry n g) n fx tx Hinx)). }
    exists u. split; [| exact He].
    apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g' x fx u); auto.
Qed.

(* Max of the domain is determined by membership. *)
Lemma max_domain_mem_eq : forall g g',
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) ->
  max (domain g) = max (domain g').
Proof.
  intros g g' Hdom. apply Nat.le_antisymm.
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec (domain g) (max (domain g')))).
    intros a x Hin.
    assert (Hin' : In (a,x) (domain g')) by (apply (proj1 (Hdom (a,x))); exact Hin).
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec (domain g') (max (domain g'))) (Nat.le_refl _) a x Hin').
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec (domain g') (max (domain g)))).
    intros a x Hin.
    assert (Hin' : In (a,x) (domain g)) by (apply (proj2 (Hdom (a,x))); exact Hin).
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec (domain g) (max (domain g))) (Nat.le_refl _) a x Hin').
Qed.

Lemma un_env_fresh : forall g g' x,
  un_env g g' -> ~ In x (domain g) -> ~ In x (domain g').
Proof.
  intros g g' x [Hdom _] Hx Hin. apply Hx. exact (proj2 (Hdom x) Hin).
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_self_lin : forall t p u t'',
  type_plus t (Chan lin p u) (Chan lin p u) ->
  type_sub (Chan lin p u) t'' -> type_plus t t'' t''.
Proof.
  intros t p u t'' Hp Hs.
  inversion Hp; subst.
  inversion Hs; subst.
  - apply Tp_LinPlus; assumption.

  type_plus t (Chan un p u) (Chan un p u) ->

  inversion Hs; subst.

Lemma type_plus_sub_self : forall t t' t'',
  type_plus t t' t' -> type_sub t' t'' -> type_plus t t'' t''.
Proof.
  intros t t' t'' Hp Hs.
  destruct t' as [m p u | ].

    + apply (type_plus_sub_self_un t p u t''); assumption.

Lemma cons_un_env : forall g g' pf pf',
  NoDup (domain g') -> un_env g g' -> cons g pf -> cons g' pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hnd' Hun Hc.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec g' pf')).
  intros n f t' Hin'.
  assert (Hn : In n (domain g))
    by (apply (un_env_dom2 g g' n Hun); apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=t'); exact Hin').
  destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g n Hn) as [f0 [t0 Hin0]].
  destruct (proj2 Hun n f0 t0 Hin0) as [t1 [Hin1 Hle]].
  assert (Heq : ((n,f0),t1) = ((n,f),t'))
    by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g' n f0 t1 n f t' Hnd' Hin1 Hin' eq_refl)).
  inversion Heq; subst.
  apply (un_le_consumable t0 t' Hle).
  exact (proj1 (cons_spec g pf) Hc n f t0 Hin0).
Qed.

Lemma cons_proj_un_env : forall g g' pf pf',
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  un_env g g' ->
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf ->
  cons (vis_proj g' ++ ill_proj g') pf'.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' Hnd Hnd' Hun Hc.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec (vis_proj g' ++ ill_proj g') pf')).
  intros n f t' Hin'.
  pose proof Hin' as Hcopy.
  apply in_app_or in Hcopy.
  assert (HinG' : In ((n,f),t') g').
  { destruct Hcopy as [H|H].
    - exact (proj1 ((proj1 (In_vis_proj g' n f t')) H)).
    - exact (proj1 ((proj1 (In_ill_proj g' n f t')) H)). }
  assert (Hfcase : f = vis \/ f = ill).
  { destruct Hcopy as [H|H].
    - left. exact (proj2 ((proj1 (In_vis_proj g' n f t')) H)).
    - right. exact (proj2 ((proj1 (In_ill_proj g' n f t')) H)). }
  assert (Hn' : In n (domain g')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=t'); exact HinG').
  assert (Hn : In n (domain g)) by (apply (un_env_dom2 g g' n Hun); exact Hn').
  destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g n Hn) as [f0 [t0 Hs0]].
  destruct (proj2 Hun n f0 t0 Hs0) as [t1 [Hin1 Hle]].
  assert (Heq : ((n,f0),t1) = ((n,f),t'))
    by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g' n f0 t1 n f t' Hnd' Hin1 HinG' eq_refl)).
  inversion Heq; subst.
  assert (Hproj : In ((n,f),t0) (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)).
  { destruct Hfcase as [Ef|Ef]; subst f.
    - apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj. split; auto.
    - apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj. split; auto. }
  apply (un_le_consumable t0 t' Hle).
  exact (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc n f t0 Hproj).
Qed.

Theorem typeCheck_un_enlarge : forall g g' pf pf' p,
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t') ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g')) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  typeCheck g pf p -> typeCheck g' pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' p Hent Hdom1 Hdom2 Hnd Hnd' Hty.
  assert (Hun : un_env g g')
    by (split; [intro n; split; [apply Hdom1 | apply Hdom2] | exact Hent]).
  exact (typeCheck_un_enlarge_aux g pf p Hty g' pf' Hnd Hnd' Hun).
Qed.

Theorem typeCheck_un_enlarge : forall g g' pf pf' p,
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t') ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g')) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  typeCheck g pf p -> typeCheck g' pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' p Hent Hdom1 Hdom2 Hnd Hnd' Hty.
  assert (Hun : un_env g g')
    by (split; [intro n; split; [apply Hdom1 | apply Hdom2] | exact Hent]).
  exact (typeCheck_un_enlarge_aux g pf p Hty g' pf' Hnd Hnd' Hun).
Qed.

Lemma pmap_typing : forall q,
  (forall g x b t t1 t2 f pf pf',
    x <> b -> f <> hid -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
    snd x < max (domain ((b,f,t1) :: g)) ->
    NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t) :: (b,f,t1) :: g)) ->
    typeCheck ((x,vis,t) :: (b,f,t1) :: g) pf q ->
    typeCheck ((b,vis,t2) :: g) pf' (pmap q (fst x) (snd x) (fst b) (snd b))).
Proof.
  induction q as [| u1 u2 z1 z2 q IHq | q1 IH1 q2 IH2 | n1 n2 q IHq | u1 u2 z1 z2 q IHq | u1 u2 v1 v2 q IHq];
    intros g x b t t1 t2 f pf pf' Hxb Hf Htp Hmx Hnd Hty.
  - (* dZero *)
    simpl. inversion Hty; subst. apply TNil. apply cons_spec. intros n f0 t0 Hin.
    simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. apply (consumable_plus t1 t).
      * eapply cons_entry; [exact H | simpl; right; left; reflexivity].
      * eapply cons_entry; [exact H | simpl; left; reflexivity].
      * exact Htp.
    + apply (cons_entry _ _ H n f0 t0). simpl; right; right; exact Hin.
  - (* dBang *)
    inversion Hty; subst.
    match goal with H : typeCheck ((x0,vis,t0)::(x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) _ q |- _ => rename H into Hbody end.
    match goal with H : cons (vis_proj ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) ++ ill_proj ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) _ |- _ => rename H into Hcons end.
    match goal with H : snd x0 < max (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) |- _ => rename H into Hmax0 end.
    match goal with H : ~ In x0 (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) |- _ => rename H into Hfresh end.
    match goal with H : In (u,vis,Chan un p t0) ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) |- _ => rename H into Hin end.
    match goal with H : isMap ((x0,vis,t0)::(x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) |- _ => rename H into Hpf1 end.
    match goal with H : p = io \/ p = inp |- _ => rename H into Hpol end.
    destruct (pair_eq u x) eqn:Eux.
    + (* u = x *)
      apply pair_eq_true in Eux; subst u.
      assert (Ht : t = Chan un p t0).
      { assert (He : ((x,vis),t) = ((x,vis),Chan un p t0)).
        { apply (nodup_entry_unique ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g) x vis t x vis (Chan un p t0) Hnd
                  (or_introl eq_refl) Hin eq_refl). }
        exact (f_equal (fun e : ((name*name)*flag)*piType => snd e) He). }
      subst t.
      destruct (type_plus_second_un t1 p t0 t2 Htp) as [q0 [Et1 Et2]]. subst t1 t2.
      simpl.
      assert (Hmv : mv (fst x, snd x) (fst x, snd x) (fst b, snd b) = (fst b, snd b))
        by (apply mv_eq; apply pair_eq_refl).
      rewrite Hmv. simpl.
      destruct (nodup_E_bounds x b g (Chan un p t0) f (Chan un q0 t0) Hnd) as [Hnotxg Hnotbg].
      assert (Hndg : NoDup (domain g)).
      { pose proof Hnd as H'. simpl in H'. apply NoDup_cons_iff in H'. destruct H' as [_ H'].
        apply NoDup_cons_iff in H'. exact (proj2 H'). }
      assert (ndW : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,Chan un (pol_cup q0 p) t0)::g))).
      { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hnotbg|exact Hndg]. }
      assert (Hx0b : x0 <> b).
      { intro H. apply Hfresh. rewrite H. simpl. right. left. reflexivity. }
      assert (Hx0g : ~ In x0 (domain g)).
      { intro Hc. apply Hfresh. simpl. right. right. exact Hc. }
      assert (ndT0 : NoDup (domain ((b,vis,Chan un (pol_cup q0 p) t0)::(x0,vis,t0)::g))).
      { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
        - intro Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
          + apply Hx0b. exact Heq.
          + exact (Hnotbg Hc).
        - apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hx0g|exact Hndg]. }
      assert (ndS : NoDup (domain ((x0,vis,t0)::(x,vis,Chan un p t0)::(b,f,Chan un q0 t0)::g))).
      { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hfresh|exact Hnd]. }
      assert (Pcanon : Permutation ((x0,vis,t0)::(x,vis,Chan un p t0)::(b,f,Chan un q0 t0)::g)

                                 (isMap_nodup _ ndCanon) q)
Lemma bv_pmap : forall p z1 z2 v1 v2,
  bv (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2) = bv p.
Proof.
  induction p; intros; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHp. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHp1, IHp2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHp. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHp. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHp. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma bv_dep_relabel : forall p s pf,
  bv (dep_relabel p s pf) = bv p.
Proof.

  - rewrite IHp. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHp1, IHp2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite bv_pmap. rewrite IHp. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHp. reflexivity.

Lemma typeCheck_add_entry_consumable : forall g pf p,
  NoDup (domain g) -> typeCheck g pf p ->
  forall xn fx tx,
    consumable tx ->
    ~ In xn (domain g) ->
    ~ In xn (bv p) ->
    forall pf', typeCheck ((xn,fx,tx)::g) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g pf p Hnd H. induction H; intros xn fx tx Hc Hx Hbv pf'.
  - (* TNil *) apply TNil. apply (cons_insert_flag g pf xn fx tx H Hc pf').
  - (* TNew *)
    assert (Hn_g : In n (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid)(t:=t); exact H).
    assert (Hnx : xn <> n).
    { intro Heq. apply Hx. rewrite Heq. exact Hn_g. }
    assert (Hx_rem : ~ In xn (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. apply Hx.
      exact (proj1 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g xn) Hcc)). }
    assert (Hn_not_rem : ~ In n (domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. exact (proj2 (proj1 (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn_g n) Hcc) eq_refl). }
    assert (ndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry n g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd).
    assert (ndNrem : NoDup (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hn_not_rem|exact ndRem]. }
    assert (Hx_nrem : ~ In xn (n :: domain (removeEntry n g))).
    { intro Hcc. destruct Hcc as [Heq|Hcc].
      - apply Hnx. symmetry. exact Heq.
      - exact (Hx_rem Hcc). }
    assert (ndSource : NoDup (domain ((xn,fx,tx)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_cons_iff. split; [exact Hx_nrem|exact ndNrem]. }
    assert (P : Permutation ((xn,fx,tx)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
                         ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((xn,fx,tx)::g))).
    { rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq xn n fx tx g); [| exact Hnx]. apply perm_swap. }
    eapply TNew with (n := n) (t := t).
    + simpl. right. exact H.
    + exact (typeCheck_perm_auto ((xn,fx,tx)::(n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)
               ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n ((xn,fx,tx)::g)) p
               (isMap_nodup _ ndSource) ndSource P
               (IHtypeCheck ndNrem xn fx tx Hc Hx_nrem Hbv (isMap_nodup _ ndSource))).
  - (* TPar *)
    match goal with Hs : tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf |- _ => rename Hs into Hsplit end.
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hsplit Hnd) as [nd1 nd2].

No `Admitted`, `admit`, `Abort`, `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`; `Print Assumptions typeCheck_un_enlarge` reports “Closed under the global context”.

Exact final theorem:

```coq
Theorem typeCheck_un_enlarge : forall g g' pf pf' p,
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g ->
     exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t') ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g')) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  typeCheck g pf p -> typeCheck g' pf' p.
```

`un_le` is exactly the requested relation:

```coq
Definition un_le (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  (exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t').
```

Supporting results proved in the file:

- `un_le_refl`, `un_le_sub`, `un_le_trans`, `un_le_consumable`, and inversion lemmas showing linear and `Top` entries cannot change.
- `un_env`, the environment-level relation combining domain equality and entrywise `un_le`.
- `un_env_replace`, `un_env_removeEntry`, `un_env_fresh`, `max_domain_mem_eq`.
- `type_plus_sub_self_lin`, `type_plus_sub_self_un`, `type_plus_sub_self`.
- `type_remove_un_enlarge`: enlarging the full type of the outgoing value preserves a residual witness.
- `cons_un_env` and `cons_proj_un_env`: consumability and the `TInU` projection condition transfer to the enlarged environment.
- `tEnv_split_env2` and `un_env_split`: given a source split and an enlarged third environment, construct target halves and a target split, preserving `un_env` in both halves. The `SpUn` case instantiates the target split with the enlarged polarity obtained from `un_le_un_inv`.
- `typeCheck_un_enlarge_aux`, proved by induction on `typeCheck`, with the internal form using `un_env` directly.

Caveat on strength: the requested statement without `NoDup` was not established. The proof adds `NoDup (domain g)` and `NoDup (domain g')`. These are used to make `removeEntry` erase the binding, compare entries through `nodup_entry_unique`, and produce `isMap` witnesses for reconstructed environments. `isMap` alone permits duplicate identical entries, so that reasoning is unavailable without `NoDup`. I did not determine whether the unadorned statement is false or merely needs a different multiplicity-aware argument; there is no remaining blocker for the stated `NoDup` variant.

Lemma typeCheck_un_enlarge_aux : forall G pf p,
  typeCheck G pf p ->
  forall G' pf', NoDup (domain G) -> NoDup (domain G') ->
  un_env G G' -> typeCheck G' pf' p.
Proof.
  intros G pf p Hty.
  induction Hty as [g pf Hc
    | g pf pb n t pf1 Hi Hbody IHb
    | g pf g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2 Hspl Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t1 t2 pf1 Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t2 pf1 Hpol Hr Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q t1 pf1 Hr Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 pf2 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hcons Hbody IHb];
    intros G' pf' HndG HndG' Hun.
  - (* TNil *)
    apply TNil. apply (cons_un_env g G' pf pf' HndG' Hun Hc).
  - (* TNew *)
    destruct (proj2 Hun n hid t Hi) as [t' [Hi' Hle]].
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g)))
      by (apply (proj1 (NoDup_domain_cons_reuse n hid t vis t g HndG Hi))).
    assert (HndBodyT : NoDup (domain ((n,vis,t')::removeEntry n G')))
      by (apply (proj1 (NoDup_domain_cons_reuse n hid t' vis t' G' HndG' Hi'))).
    assert (HunRem : un_env (removeEntry n g) (removeEntry n G'))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry n g G');
          [exact HndG | exact HndG'
          | apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid) (t:=t); exact Hi
          | apply in_dom_entry with (f:=hid) (t:=t'); exact Hi'
          | exact Hun]).
    assert (HunBody : un_env ((n,vis,t)::removeEntry n g) ((n,vis,t')::removeEntry n G'))
      by (apply (un_env_cons n vis t t'); [exact Hle | exact HunRem]).
    eapply TNew; [exact Hi' | apply (IHb ((n,vis,t')::removeEntry n G') (isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT) HndBodyS HndBodyT HunBody)].
  - (* TPar *)
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hspl HndG) as [Hnd1 Hnd2].
    destruct (un_env_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hspl Hnd1 Hnd2 HndG G' Hun HndG')
      as [g1' [g2' [pf1' [pf2' [pf3' [Hspl' [Hun1 Hun2]]]]]]].
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1' g2' G' pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl' HndG') as [Hnd1' Hnd2'].
    eapply TPar with (g1:=g1') (g2:=g2') (pf1:=pf1') (pf2:=pf2').
    + apply (tEnv_split_pf_irrel g1' g2' G' pf1' pf2' pf3' Hspl' pf1' pf2' pf').
    + apply (IH1 g1' pf1' Hnd1 Hnd1' Hun1).
    + apply (IH2 g2' pf2' Hnd2 Hnd2' Hun2).
  - (* TOutL *)
    destruct (proj2 Hun u vis (Chan lin p0 t) Hu) as [tu [Hinu Hleu]].
    assert (Htu : tu = Chan lin p0 t) by (apply (un_le_lin_eq p0 t tu); exact Hleu).
    subst tu.
    destruct (proj2 Hun v vis t' Hv) as [t'' [Hinv Hlev]].
    destruct (type_remove_un_enlarge t' t t2 Hr2 t'' Hlev) as [t2' [Hr2' Hle2]].
    assert (Huv : u <> v)
      by (apply (TOutL_neq g u p0 t t1 v t' t2); [apply isMap_nodup; exact HndG | exact Hr1 | exact Hr2 | exact Hu | exact Hv]).
    assert (Huu : In u (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=Chan lin p0 t); exact Hu).
    assert (Hvu : In v (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t'); exact Hv).
    assert (Huu' : In u (domain G')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=Chan lin p0 t); exact Hinu).
    assert (Hvu' : In v (domain G')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t''); exact Hinv).
    assert (HunU : un_env (removeEntry u g) (removeEntry u G'))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry u g G'); [exact HndG | exact HndG' | exact Huu | exact Huu' | exact Hun]).
    assert (HndU : NoDup (domain (removeEntry u g))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact HndG).
    assert (HndU' : NoDup (domain (removeEntry u G'))) by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact HndG').
    assert (HvU : In v (domain (removeEntry u g)))
      by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq; [intro Heq; apply Huv; symmetry; exact Heq | exact Hvu]).
    assert (HvU' : In v (domain (removeEntry u G')))
      by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq; [intro Heq; apply Huv; symmetry; exact Heq | exact Hvu']).
    assert (HunUV : un_env (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)) (removeEntry v (removeEntry u G')))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry v (removeEntry u g) (removeEntry u G'));
          [exact HndU | exact HndU' | exact HvU | exact HvU' | exact HunU]).
    assert (HunBody : un_env ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))
                             ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2')::removeEntry v (removeEntry u G')))
      by (apply (un_env_cons u vis t1 t1); [apply un_le_refl
          | apply (un_env_cons v vis t2 t2'); [exact Hle2 | exact HunUV]]).
    assert (HpermS : Permutation (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) (domain g))
      by (apply domain_out_env; auto).
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (domain g)
        (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) (Permutation_sym HpermS) HndG). }
    assert (HpermT : Permutation (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u G'))) (domain G'))
      by (apply domain_out_env; auto).
    assert (HndBodyT : NoDup (domain ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2')::removeEntry v (removeEntry u G')))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (domain G')
        (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u G'))) (Permutation_sym HpermT) HndG'). }
    eapply TOutL with (u:=u) (p:=p0) (t:=t) (v:=v) (t':=t'') (t2:=t2')
                       (pf1:=isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT).
    + exact Hr1.
    + exact Hr2'.
    + exact Hinu.
    + exact Hinv.
    + apply (IHb ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2')::removeEntry v (removeEntry u G')) (isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT) HndBodyS HndBodyT HunBody).
  - (* TOutUn *)
    destruct (proj2 Hun u vis (Chan un p0 t) Hu) as [tu [Hinu Hleu]].
    destruct (un_le_un_inv p0 t tu Hleu) as [p' Ep]. subst tu.
    assert (Hpol' : p' = io \/ p' = out)
      by (apply (un_sub_io_out p0 p' t);
          [apply (un_le_sub (Chan un p0 t) (Chan un p' t)); exact Hleu | exact Hpol]).
    destruct (proj2 Hun v vis t' Hv) as [t'' [Hinv Hlev]].
    destruct (type_remove_un_enlarge t' t t2 Hr t'' Hlev) as [t2' [Hr' Hle2]].
    assert (Hvu : In v (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t'); exact Hv).
    assert (Hvu' : In v (domain G')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t''); exact Hinv).
    assert (HunRem : un_env (removeEntry v g) (removeEntry v G'))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry v g G'); [exact HndG | exact HndG' | exact Hvu | exact Hvu' | exact Hun]).
    assert (HunBody : un_env ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v g) ((v,vis,t2')::removeEntry v G'))
      by (apply (un_env_cons v vis t2 t2'); [exact Hle2 | exact HunRem]).
    assert (HpermS : Permutation (v :: domain (removeEntry v g)) (domain g))
      by (apply domain_un_env; exact Hvu).
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v g))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (domain g)
        (v :: domain (removeEntry v g)) (Permutation_sym HpermS) HndG). }
    assert (HpermT : Permutation (v :: domain (removeEntry v G')) (domain G'))
      by (apply domain_un_env; exact Hvu').
    assert (HndBodyT : NoDup (domain ((v,vis,t2')::removeEntry v G'))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (domain G')
        (v :: domain (removeEntry v G')) (Permutation_sym HpermT) HndG'). }
    eapply TOutUn with (u:=u) (p:=p') (t:=t) (v:=v) (t':=t'') (t2:=t2')
                        (pf1:=isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT).
    + exact Hpol'.
    + exact Hr'.
    + exact Hinu.
    + exact Hinv.
    + apply (IHb ((v,vis,t2')::removeEntry v G') (isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT) HndBodyS HndBodyT HunBody).
  - (* TInL *)
    destruct (proj2 Hun u vis (Chan lin p0 t) Hu) as [tu [Hinu Hleu]].
    assert (Htu : tu = Chan lin p0 t) by (apply (un_le_lin_eq p0 t tu); exact Hleu).
    subst tu.
    assert (Huu : In u (domain g)) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=Chan lin p0 t); exact Hu).
    assert (Huu' : In u (domain G')) by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=Chan lin p0 t); exact Hinu).
    assert (HunRem : un_env (removeEntry u g) (removeEntry u G'))
      by (apply (un_env_removeEntry u g G'); [exact HndG | exact HndG' | exact Huu | exact Huu' | exact Hun]).
    assert (Hfresh' : ~ In x (domain G')) by (apply (un_env_fresh g G' x Hun); exact Hfresh).
    assert (HmaxEq : max (domain g) = max (domain G'))
      by (apply max_domain_mem_eq; apply (proj1 Hun)).
    assert (Hmax' : snd x < max (domain G')) by (rewrite <- HmaxEq; exact Hmax).
    assert (Hux : u <> x) by (intro E; subst x; apply Hfresh; exact Huu).
    assert (HunBody : un_env ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g)
                             ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u G'))
      by (apply (un_env_cons u vis t1 t1); [apply un_le_refl
          | apply (un_env_cons x vis t t); [apply un_le_refl | exact HunRem]]).
    assert (HndSx : NoDup (x :: domain g)) by (apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    assert (HpermS : Permutation (u :: x :: domain (removeEntry u g)) (x :: domain g))
      by (apply domain_inl_env; auto).
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (x :: domain g)
        (u :: x :: domain (removeEntry u g)) (Permutation_sym HpermS) HndSx). }
    assert (HndTx : NoDup (x :: domain G')) by (apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    assert (HpermT : Permutation (u :: x :: domain (removeEntry u G')) (x :: domain G'))
      by (apply domain_inl_env; auto).
    assert (HndBodyT : NoDup (domain ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u G'))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (x :: domain G')
        (u :: x :: domain (removeEntry u G')) (Permutation_sym HpermT) HndTx). }
    eapply TInL with (u:=u) (p:=p0) (t:=t) (x:=x) (t1:=t1)
                      (pf1:=isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT).
    + exact Hr.
    + exact Hinu.
    + exact Hfresh'.
    + exact Hmax'.
    + apply (IHb ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u G') (isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT) HndBodyS HndBodyT HunBody).
  - (* TInUn *)
    destruct (proj2 Hun u vis (Chan un p0 t) Hu) as [tu [Hinu Hleu]].
    destruct (un_le_un_inv p0 t tu Hleu) as [p' Ep]. subst tu.
    assert (Hpol' : p' = io \/ p' = inp)
      by (apply (un_sub_io_inp p0 p' t);
          [apply (un_le_sub (Chan un p0 t) (Chan un p' t)); exact Hleu | exact Hpol]).
    assert (Hfresh' : ~ In x (domain G')) by (apply (un_env_fresh g G' x Hun); exact Hfresh).
    assert (HmaxEq : max (domain g) = max (domain G'))
      by (apply max_domain_mem_eq; apply (proj1 Hun)).
    assert (Hmax' : snd x < max (domain G')) by (rewrite <- HmaxEq; exact Hmax).
    assert (HunBody : un_env ((x,vis,t)::g) ((x,vis,t)::G'))
      by (apply (un_env_cons x vis t t); [apply un_le_refl | exact Hun]).
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::g))) by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    assert (HndBodyT : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::G'))) by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    eapply TInUn with (u:=u) (p:=p') (t:=t) (x:=x)
                       (pf1:=isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT).
    + exact Hpol'.
    + exact Hinu.
    + exact Hfresh'.
    + exact Hmax'.
    + apply (IHb ((x,vis,t)::G') (isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT) HndBodyS HndBodyT HunBody).
  - (* TInU *)
    destruct (proj2 Hun u vis (Chan un p0 t) Hu) as [tu [Hinu Hleu]].
    destruct (un_le_un_inv p0 t tu Hleu) as [p' Ep]. subst tu.
    assert (Hpol' : p' = io \/ p' = inp)
      by (apply (un_sub_io_inp p0 p' t);
          [apply (un_le_sub (Chan un p0 t) (Chan un p' t)); exact Hleu | exact Hpol]).
    assert (Hfresh' : ~ In x (domain G')) by (apply (un_env_fresh g G' x Hun); exact Hfresh).
    assert (HmaxEq : max (domain g) = max (domain G'))
      by (apply max_domain_mem_eq; apply (proj1 Hun)).
    assert (Hmax' : snd x < max (domain G')) by (rewrite <- HmaxEq; exact Hmax).
    assert (HunBody : un_env ((x,vis,t)::g) ((x,vis,t)::G'))
      by (apply (un_env_cons x vis t t); [apply un_le_refl | exact Hun]).
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::g))) by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    assert (HndBodyT : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::G'))) by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons_iff; split; auto).
    assert (Hcons' : cons (vis_proj G' ++ ill_proj G') (isMap_proj G' pf'))
      by (apply (cons_proj_un_env g G' pf2 (isMap_proj G' pf')); auto).
    eapply TInU with (u:=u) (p:=p') (t:=t) (x:=x)
                      (pf1:=isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT) (pf2:=isMap_proj G' pf').
    + exact Hpol'.
    + exact Hinu.
    + exact Hfresh'.
    + exact Hmax'.
    + exact Hcons'.
    + apply (IHb ((x,vis,t)::G') (isMap_nodup _ HndBodyT) HndBodyS HndBodyT HunBody).
Qed.

Theorem typeCheck_un_enlarge : forall g g' pf pf' p,
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t') ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g')) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  typeCheck g pf p -> typeCheck g' pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' p Hent Hdom1 Hdom2 Hnd Hnd' Hty.
  assert (Hun : un_env g g')
    by (split; [intro n; split; [apply Hdom1 | apply Hdom2] | exact Hent]).
  exact (typeCheck_un_enlarge_aux g pf p Hty g' pf' Hnd Hnd' Hun).
Qed.

End TypeCheckMono.

Lemma cons_proj_of : forall g pf,
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> f <> hid -> consumable t) ->
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf.
Proof.
  intros g pf H. apply cons_spec. intros n f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply (proj1 (In_vis_proj g n f t)) in Hin. apply (H n f t).
    + exact (proj1 Hin).
    + rewrite (proj2 Hin). discriminate.
  - apply (proj1 (In_ill_proj g n f t)) in Hin. apply (H n f t).
    + exact (proj1 Hin).
    + rewrite (proj2 Hin). discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma In_dom_w2 : forall g x b (fb:flag)(tb:piType),
  NoDup (domain g) -> In x (domain g) -> In b (domain g) -> x <> b ->
  forall x0, In x0 (domain ((b,fb,tb)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g))) <->
             x0 = b \/ (In x0 (domain g) /\ x0 <> x /\ x0 <> b).
Proof.
  intros g x b fb tb Hnd Hx Hb Hxb x0. simpl.
  rewrite (In_dom_remove2 g x b Hnd Hx Hb Hxb x0).
  split.
  - intros [H|H]. left; symmetry; exact H. right; exact H.
  - intros [H|H]. left; symmetry; exact H. right; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma domE : forall x b g (t:piType)(f:flag)(t1:piType) x0,
  In x0 (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) <-> x0 = x \/ x0 = b \/ In x0 (domain g).
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros [H|[H|H]].
  - left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; right; exact H.
  - left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; left; symmetry; exact H.
  - right; right; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma split_A : forall g1 g2 g x b (f:flag)(t t1:piType) tx1 tx2 (fb1 fb2:flag) tb1 tb2 t21 t22,
  NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::(b,f,t1)::g)) ->
  NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain g1) <-> In n (domain g2)) ->
  In ((x,vis),tx1) g1 -> In ((b,fb1),tb1) g1 ->
  In ((x,vis),tx2) g2 -> In ((b,fb2),tb2) g2 ->
  x <> b ->
  forall x0, In x0 (domain ((b,vis,t21)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g1))) <->
             In x0 (domain ((b,vis,t22)::removeEntry b (removeEntry x g2))).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g x b f t t1 tx1 tx2 fb1 fb2 tb1 tb2 t21 t22 Hnd nd1 nd2 HA Hx1 Hb1 Hx2 Hb2 Hxb x0.
  rewrite (In_dom_w2 g1 x b vis t21 nd1 (in_dom_entry _ x vis tx1 Hx1) (in_dom_entry _ b fb1 tb1 Hb1) Hxb x0).
  rewrite (In_dom_w2 g2 x b vis t22 nd2 (in_dom_entry _ x vis tx2 Hx2) (in_dom_entry _ b fb2 tb2 Hb2) Hxb x0).
  split; intros [H|H].
  - left; exact H.
  - right. split; [apply (proj1 (HA x0)); exact (proj1 H) | exact (proj2 H)].
  - left; exact H.
  - right. split; [apply (proj2 (HA x0)); exact (proj1 H) | exact (proj2 H)].
Qed.

Proof.

Definition weakenEntry (e : flag * piType) : flag * piType :=
  match e with
  | (hid, t) => (ill, wk_type t)
  | _ => e
  end.

Lemma weakenEntry_hid : forall t, weakenEntry (hid,t) = (ill, wk_type t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma weakenEntry_vis : forall t, weakenEntry (vis,t) = (vis,t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma weakenEntry_ill : forall t, weakenEntry (ill,t) = (ill,t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma In_weakenEnv_iff : forall g n f t,

  exists f0 t0, In ((n,f0),t0) g /\ (f,t) = weakenEntry (f0,t0).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f t; simpl.
  - split.
    + intro H; destruct H.
    + intros [f0 [t0 [H _]]]; destruct H.
  - destruct fx.
    + (* hid *) simpl. split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. eexists; eexists. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
        -- apply IH in Hin. destruct Hin as [f0 [t0 [Hin Heq]]].

      * intros [f0 [t0 [Hin Heq]]]. destruct Hin as [Heq0|Hin].

        -- inversion Heq0; subst. left. inversion Heq; subst; reflexivity.
        -- right. apply IH. exists f0, t0. split; auto.
    + (* ill *) simpl. split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. eexists; eexists. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
        -- apply IH in Hin. destruct Hin as [f0 [t0 [Hin Heq]]].

Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t He Hc1 Hc2.
  inversion He; subst.
  - (* top *) inversion H0; subst; simpl; apply ec_top; constructor.
  - (* un *) inversion H0; subst; simpl; apply ec_un; constructor.
  - (* lin *)

    + (* hid, ill -> hid *)

    + (* vis,vis -> vis *)

      destruct Hc1' as [Htop|[[p0 [t' Ht] ]|[t' Ht]]].
      * discriminate.
      * discriminate.

        destruct Hc2' as [Htop2|[[p02 [t2' Ht2] ]|[t2' Ht2]]].

(* Determinacy of type_remove in its result component.  This is the
   arithmetic fact that lets a component share consume its capability
   without changing the globally dictated residual type. *)
Lemma type_remove_det : forall t1 t r1 r2,
  type_remove t1 t r1 -> type_remove t1 t r2 -> r1 = r2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t r1 r2 [Hs1 [Hp1 Hc1]] [Hs2 [Hp2 Hc2]].
  destruct t1 as [m p u|].
  - destruct t as [m' q u'|].
    + destruct m.
      * (* both linear *)
        inversion Hp1; subst; inversion Hp2; subst;
          try (f_equal; eauto using pol_plus_det).
      * (* t1 unrestricted, t linear: impossible *)
        inversion Hs1.
      * (* t = Top, t1 a channel: impossible *)
        inversion Hs1.
    + destruct m.
      * inversion Hs1.
      * (* t1 unrestricted *)
        assert (H1 : r1 = Chan un p u) by (apply Hc1; exists p, u; reflexivity).
        assert (H2 : r2 = Chan un p u) by (apply Hc2; exists p, u; reflexivity).
        congruence.
  - (* t1 = Top *)
    inversion Hs1; subst. inversion Hs2; subst.
    inversion Hp1; subst. inversion Hp2; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_det_r : forall p q1 q2 r, pol_plus p q1 r -> pol_plus p q2 r -> q1 = q2.

Lemma pol_plus_mid : forall a b c d e,
  pol_plus inp a b -> pol_plus b c d -> pol_plus inp e d -> pol_plus a c e.
Proof.
  intros a b c d e H1 H2 H3.

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.

Lemma type_sub_plus_self_r : forall t1 t2 t3,
  type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> type_sub t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H. induction H as [|p1 p2 p t Hp|p1 p2 t].
  - apply Ts_id.
  - destruct p1, p2, p; simpl in Hp; inversion Hp; subst; simpl;
      eauto using type_sub.
  - destruct p1, p2; simpl; eauto using type_sub.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_plus_self_l : forall t1 t2 t3,
  type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> type_sub t2 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H. eapply type_sub_plus_self_r.
  apply type_plus_sym. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_un_left : forall a b c,
  type_plus a b c -> is_unrestricted c -> is_unrestricted a.
Proof.
  intros a b c H Hun. inversion H; subst.
  - destruct Hun as [p0 [u0 Hu0]]. discriminate Hu0.
  - destruct Hun as [p0 [u0 Hu0]]. discriminate Hu0.
  - exists p1, t. reflexivity.
Qed.

  match f, g with
  | hid, ill | ill, hid => hid
  | vis, vis => vis
  | ill, ill => ill
  | _, _ => hid
  end.

Definition type_comb (t1 t2 : piType) : piType :=
  match t1, t2 with
  | Top, Top => Top
  | Chan lin p1 u, Chan lin p2 _ => Chan lin (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | Chan un p1 u, Chan un p2 _ => Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u
  | _, _ => Top
  end.

Lemma flag_plus_comb : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> h = flag_comb f g.
Proof.
  intros f g h H. inversion H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_comb : forall t1 t2 t3, type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> t3 = type_comb t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H. inversion H as [| p1 p2 p t' Hp | p1 p2 t']; subst; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (pol_plus_cup p1 p2 p Hp). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_comb : forall a b c, ecomb a b c ->
  c = (flag_comb (fst a) (fst b), type_comb (snd a) (snd b)).
Proof.
  intros t p1 p2. destruct p1, p2; simpl; eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_r : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_sub b c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Ts_id.
  - match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (type_sub_pol_plus_r lin p1 p2 p t Hp) end.
  - exact (type_sub_cup_r t p1 p2).
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sub_l : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_sub a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Ts_id.
  - match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (type_sub_pol_plus_l lin p1 p2 p t Hp) end.
  - exact (type_sub_cup_l t p1 p2).
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_sym : forall a b c, type_plus a b c -> type_plus b a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply Tp_Base.
  - apply Tp_LinPlus. match goal with Hp : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => exact (pol_plus_sym _ _ _ Hp) end.
  - assert (E : pol_cup p1 p2 = pol_cup p2 p1) by (apply pol_cup_comm).
    rewrite E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_trans : forall a b c, type_sub a b -> type_sub b c -> type_sub a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H1; inversion H2; subst;
    eauto using Ts_id, Ts_empty, Ts_inp, Ts_out.
Qed.

Lemma pol_cup_mid : forall p0 p1 p3,
  pol_cup p0 (pol_cup p1 p3) = pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p3).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite <- pol_cup_assoc. rewrite <- pol_cup_assoc.
  rewrite (pol_cup_comm p0 p1). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pol_plus_mid_mid : forall p0 p1 p2 p3 p,
  pol_plus p1 p p2 -> pol_plus p0 p3 p ->
  exists p2v, pol_plus p1 p3 p2v /\ pol_plus p0 p2v p2.
Proof.
  intros p0 p1 p2 p3 p H1 H2. destruct H2.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
  - inversion H1; subst; eexists; split; eauto using pol_plus.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_mid : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
  type_plus t1 t t2 -> type_plus t0 t3 t ->
  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_plus t0 t2v t2.
Proof.
  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 H1 H2.
  destruct t as [m p t'|].
  - destruct m.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      match goal with Hp2 : pol_plus _ _ p |- _ => rename Hp2 into Hpol2 end.
      inversion H1; subst.
      match goal with Hp1 : pol_plus _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hp1 into Hpol1 end.
      destruct (pol_plus_mid_mid _ _ _ _ _ Hpol1 Hpol2) as [f [Hf Hg]].
      exists (Chan lin f t'). split.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hf.
      * eapply Tp_LinPlus. exact Hg.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      inversion H1; subst.
      exists (Chan un (pol_cup p0 p2) t'). split.
      * apply Tp_UnPlus.
      * assert (E : pol_cup p1 (pol_cup p0 p2) = pol_cup p0 (pol_cup p1 p2)).
        { rewrite pol_cup_mid. reflexivity. }
        rewrite <- E. apply Tp_UnPlus.
  - inversion H1; subst. inversion H2; subst.
    exists Top. split; apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_det : forall a b c1 c2,
  type_plus a b c1 -> type_plus a b c2 -> c1 = c2.
Proof.
  intros a b c1 c2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst;
    try reflexivity; f_equal; eauto using pol_plus_det.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_unrestricted_r : forall a b c,
  type_plus a b c -> is_unrestricted c -> is_unrestricted b.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H2 as [p [t' E]]. subst c.
  inversion H1; subst; eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_unrestricted_l : forall a b c,
  type_plus a b c -> is_unrestricted c -> is_unrestricted a.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. destruct H2 as [p [t' E]]. subst c.
  inversion H1; subst; eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_plus : forall t0 t1 t t2 t3,
  type_remove t t0 t3 -> type_plus t1 t t2 ->
  exists t2v, type_plus t1 t3 t2v /\ type_remove t2 t0 t2v.
Proof.
  intros t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htr Htp.
  unfold type_remove in Htr. destruct Htr as [Hsub [Hplus Hcond]].
  destruct (type_plus_mid t0 t1 t t2 t3 Htp Hplus) as [t2v [Htv Hrest]].
  exists t2v. split; [exact Htv|].
  unfold type_remove. split.
  - eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hsub|apply (type_plus_sub_r _ _ _ Htp)].
  - split; [exact Hrest|].
    intro Hun2.
    assert (Hun_t : is_unrestricted t) by (eapply type_plus_unrestricted_r; eauto).
    assert (Hteq : t3 = t) by (eapply Hcond; exact Hun_t).
    rewrite Hteq in Htv.
    exact (type_plus_det t1 t t2v t2 Htv Htp).
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_self_payload_false : forall m p t0 r,
  ~ type_remove (Chan m p t0) t0 r.
Proof.
  intros m p t0 r H. unfold type_remove in H. destruct H as [Hsub _].
  eapply no_type_sub_self_chan; exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_assoc_l : forall S a b c d,
  type_plus S a b -> type_plus b c d ->
  exists r, type_plus a c r /\ type_plus S r d.
Proof.
  intros S a b c d H1 H2.
  destruct b as [m p t'|].

| ec_top : forall f1 f2 f, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Top) (f2,Top) (f,Top)
| ec_un : forall f1 f2 f p t, flag_plus f1 f2 f -> ecomb (f1,Chan un p t) (f2,Chan un p t) (f,Chan un p t)

Lemma ecomb_det : forall a b c1 c2, ecomb a b c1 -> ecomb a b c2 -> c1=c2.
Proof.
  intros a b c1 c2 H1 H2.
  destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c1 as [fc tc], c2 as [fd td].
  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; simpl; f_equal;
    eauto using flag_plus_det, pol_plus_det.
  try (f_equal; eauto using pol_plus_det).
Qed.

  - inversion H2 as [fc2 fd' fe' Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' pu tu Hfcd | fc2 fd' fe' q1 q2 q tq Hfcd Hpq]; subst; try discriminate.

Qed.

Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.
Qed.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Notation name  := nat.

Section ProcessDefinitions.

Inductive dproc : Set :=
  | dZero : dproc
  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.

Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p
    | dNu h i  p =>  secLabs p ++ (h, i) :: nil
    end.

Fixpoint fn (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      fn p1 ++  fn p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      (x1, x2) :: (y1, y2) :: fn p
    end.

Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>
      nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      (y1, y2) :: bv p
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      bv p1 ++  bv p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      bv p
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      bv p
    end.

Definition wf (p : dproc) : Prop :=
    NoDup (secLabs p) /\ disjoint (fn p) (secLabs p).

Definition pos l := forall x1 x2 : nat,
      In (x1, x2) l-> x2 > 0.

Definition sl_pos p := pos (secLabs p).

Definition mv (py pz pv : name * name)  :=
    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in
    if (y1 =? z1) && (y2 =? z2)
    then (v1, v2)
    else (y1, y2).

Fixpoint pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2 :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>  p
        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
    end.

Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).

Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
    match p with
    | dZero   => fun _  => p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
    | dPar p q =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
    | dNu h i p =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
    end.

End ProcessDefinitions.

Section Facts.

End Facts.

Lemma sr_lIn :
  forall g pf p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 t t1 t2 pf',
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    typeCheck g pf (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) ->
    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
    (b1,b2) <> (a1,a2) ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin inp t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) g ->
    typeCheck
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))
      pf' (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2).
Proof.
  intros g pf p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 t t1 t2 pf' Hnd Hty Htp Hba HinA HinB.
  inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* TInL *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct x as [x1' x2']. simpl in *.
    assert (HuA : ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin p0 t0) = ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin inp t)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin p0 t0)
               (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin inp t) Hnd H5 HinA); reflexivity. }
    inversion HuA; subst p0 t0.
    assert (Htres : t3 = Chan lin empty t).
    { exact (type_remove_lin_inp_self t t3 H4). }
    subst t3.
    (* abbreviations for the three names *)
    assert (Hxb : (x1',x2') <> (b1,b2)).
    { intro E. apply H6. rewrite E.
      apply (in_dom_entry g (b1,b2) vis t1); exact HinB. }
    assert (Hba' : (u1,u2) <> (b1,b2)) by (intro E; exact (Hba (eq_sym E))).
    assert (Hbx : In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) (removeEntry (u1,u2) g)).
    { apply in_removeEntry_intro; [exact Hba'|exact HinB]. }
    assert (HndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (u1,u2) g)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hnd).
    assert (Hga : In (u1,u2) (domain g))
      by (apply (in_dom_entry g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin inp t)); exact HinA).
    assert (Harema : ~ In (u1,u2) (domain (removeEntry (u1,u2) g)))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (u1,u2) g Hnd Hga)).
    assert (Hxrema : ~ In (x1',x2') (domain (removeEntry (u1,u2) g))).
    { intro Hc. apply H6. exact (domain_removeEntry_sub (u1,u2) g (x1',x2') Hc). }
    assert (Hax : (u1,u2) <> (x1',x2')).
    { intro E. apply H6. rewrite <- E. exact Hga. }
    assert (HndBody : NoDup
      (domain ((u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t)
               :: (x1',x2',vis,t) :: removeEntry (u1,u2) g))).
    { simpl. apply NoDup_domain_cons2; auto. }
    set (rest := removeEntry (u1,u2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)).
    assert (Hrest : removeEntry (b1,b2) (removeEntry (u1,u2) g) = rest).
    { unfold rest. symmetry.
      apply (removeEntry_removeEntry_other (u1,u2) (b1,b2) g Hba'). }
    assert (P1 : Permutation
      (((b1,b2),vis,t1) :: rest) (removeEntry (u1,u2) g)).
    { rewrite <- Hrest. apply Permutation_cons_removeEntry; auto. }
    assert (Pbody : Permutation
      ((u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t)
       :: (x1',x2',vis,t) :: removeEntry (u1,u2) g)
      ((x1',x2',vis,t) :: ((b1,b2),vis,t1)
       :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest)).
    { eapply perm_trans.
      - apply perm_skip. apply perm_skip. apply Permutation_sym. exact P1.
      - eapply perm_trans.
        + apply perm_swap.
        + apply perm_skip. apply perm_swap. }
    assert (HndEpmap : NoDup (domain
      ((x1',x2',vis,t) :: ((b1,b2),vis,t1)
       :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest)))
      by (apply (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ Pbody); exact HndBody).
    assert (HtyEpmap : typeCheck
      ((x1',x2',vis,t) :: ((b1,b2),vis,t1)
       :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest)
      (isMap_nodup _ HndEpmap) p).
    { apply (typeCheck_perm _ _ _ pf1 _ HndBody Pbody). exact H8. }
    (* max of (b,t1)::rest equals max of domain g *)
    assert (P1d : Permutation (domain (((b1,b2),vis,t1) :: rest))
                             (domain (removeEntry (u1,u2) g)))
      by (apply Permutation_domain; exact P1).
    assert (Pdom : Permutation
      (domain (((b1,b2),vis,t1) :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest))
      (domain g)).
    { simpl.
      eapply perm_trans with (l' := (u1,u2) :: (b1,b2) :: domain rest).
      - apply perm_swap.
      - eapply perm_trans with (l' := (u1,u2)
                                    :: domain (removeEntry (u1,u2) g)).
        + apply perm_skip. simpl in P1d. exact P1d.
        + apply Permutation_sym. apply domain_removeEntry_perm; exact Hga. }
    assert (HmaxEq : max (domain
      (((b1,b2),vis,t1) :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest))
      = max (domain g))
      by (apply max_perm; exact Pdom).
    assert (Hmax2 : x2' < max (domain
      (((b1,b2),vis,t1) :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest))).
    { rewrite HmaxEq. exact H7. }
    assert (HndMid : NoDup (domain
      (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest))).
    { inversion HndEpmap as [|? ? Hnot Htail]; subst.
      simpl in Htail |- *. exact Htail. }
    assert (HtyMid : typeCheck
      (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest)
      (isMap_nodup _ HndMid) (pmap p x1' x2' b1 b2)).
    { eapply (pmap_typing p ((u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t)::rest) (x1',x2') (b1,b2) t t1 t2 vis
                (isMap_nodup _ HndEpmap) (isMap_nodup _ HndMid)).
      - exact Hxb.
      - discriminate.
      - exact Htp.
      - exact Hmax2.
      - exact HndEpmap.
      - exact HtyEpmap. }
    assert (Pfinal : Permutation
      (((b1,b2,vis,t2) :: (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: rest))
      ((u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: (b1,b2,vis,t2) :: rest))
      by (apply perm_swap).
    assert (HndFinal : NoDup (domain
      ((u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t) :: (b1,b2,vis,t2) :: rest))).
    { apply (NoDup_domain_perm _ _ Pfinal). exact HndMid. }
    apply (typeCheck_perm _ _ _ (isMap_nodup _ HndMid) pf' HndMid Pfinal HtyMid).
  - (* TInUn impossible *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct x as [x1' x2']. simpl in *.
    assert (HuA : ((u1,u2),vis,Chan un p0 t0)
                  = ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin inp t)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g (u1,u2) vis (Chan un p0 t0)
               (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin inp t) Hnd H5 HinA); reflexivity. }
    inversion HuA.
Qed.

Lemma sr_uIn :
  forall g pf p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 f pol t t1 t2 pf',
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    typeCheck g pf (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) ->
    (pol = inp \/ pol = io) ->
    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
    f <> hid ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan un pol t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),f,t1) g ->
    typeCheck
      (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g)
      pf' (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2).
Proof.
  intros g pf p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 f pol t t1 t2 pf'
