In n (domain g1) ->
  esplit (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) (removeEntry n g3).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 n [HA [HB HC]] nd1 nd2 nd3 Hn1.
  assert (Hn2 : In n (domain g2)) by (apply (proj1 (HA n)); exact Hn1).
  assert (Hn3 : In n (domain g3)) by (apply (proj1 (HB n)); exact Hn2).
  unfold esplit. split.
  - intros x. rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g1 nd1 Hn1 x).
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x).
    rewrite (HA x). tauto.
  - split.
    + intros x. rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g2 nd2 Hn2 x).
      rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g3 nd3 Hn3 x).
      rewrite (HB x). tauto.
    + intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1 He2.
      assert (Hx1 : In x (domain (removeEntry n g1)))
        by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f1) (t:=t1); exact He1).
      assert (Hxn : x <> n).
      { intro Hxn. subst x.
        exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g1 nd1 Hn1
                 (in_dom_entry (removeEntry n g1) n f1 t1 He1)). }
      destruct (HC x f1 t1 f2 t2
                 (in_removeEntry_elim n g1 x f1 t1 He1)
                 (in_removeEntry_elim n g2 x f2 t2 He2)) as [f [t [H3 Hec]]].
      exists f, t. split; [|exact Hec].
      apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g3 x f t (fun Heq => Hxn (eq_sym Heq)) H3).
Qed.

Proof.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task.

(* flag_plus can produce `ill` only from ill+ill *)
Lemma flag_plus_ill_result : forall f1 f2 : flag,
    flag_plus f1 f2 ill -> f1 = ill /\ f2 = ill.
Proof.
  intros f1 f2 H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

(* The type produced by an ecomb is the type_plus of its two components. *)
Lemma ecomb_type_plus : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> type_plus t1 t2 t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t H.
  inversion H; subst.
  - apply Tp_Base.
  - match goal with
    | |- type_plus (Chan un ?p ?q) (Chan un ?p ?q) (Chan un ?p ?q) =>
        pose proof (Tp_UnPlus p p q) as Htp; rewrite pol_cup_idem in Htp; exact Htp
    end.
  - eapply Tp_LinPlus; eauto.
Qed.

(* Consumability is preserved by combining two consumable components. *)
Lemma ecomb_consumable : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) ->
    consumable t1 -> consumable t2 -> consumable t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t Hec H1 H2.
  apply (consumable_plus t1 t2 t H1 H2).
  apply ecomb_type_plus with (f1:=f1) (f2:=f2) (f:=f). exact Hec.
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_ill_consumable : forall g pf p,
    typeCheck g pf p ->
    forall n t, In ((n,ill),t) g -> consumable t.
Proof.
  intros g pf p Htc.
  induction Htc as [g pf Hc
    | g pf pb n t pf1 Hi Hbody IHb
    | g pf g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2 Hspl Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t1 t2 pf1 Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t v t' q t2 pf1 Hpol Hr Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q t1 pf1 Hr Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 pf2 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hcons Hbody IHb].
  - (* TNil *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0. exact (cons_entry g pf Hc n0 ill t0 Hin0).
  - (* TNew *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0.
    assert (Hneq : n <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst n.
      destruct (pf n0 hid t ill t0 (conj Hi Hin0)) as [Hf _]. discriminate Hf. }
    apply (IHb n0 t0). simpl. right.
    exact (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 ill t0 Hneq Hin0).
  - (* TPar *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0.
    destruct (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hspl) as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (Hn3 : In n0 (domain g))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=ill) (t:=t0); exact Hin0).
    assert (Hn2 : In n0 (domain g2)) by (apply (proj2 (HB n0)); exact Hn3).
    assert (Hn1 : In n0 (domain g1)) by (apply (proj2 (HA n0)); exact Hn2).
    destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g1 n0 Hn1) as [f1 [t1 H1]].
    destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g2 n0 Hn2) as [f2 [t2 H2]].
    destruct (HC n0 f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2) as [f [tt [H3 Hec]]].
    destruct (pf n0 f tt ill t0 (conj H3 Hin0)) as [Hfe Hte]. subst f tt.
    assert (Hfp : flag_plus f1 f2 ill)
      by (exact (ecomb_flag_plus f1 t1 f2 t2 ill t0 Hec)).
    destruct (flag_plus_ill_result f1 f2 Hfp) as [E1 E2]. subst f1 f2.
    exact (ecomb_consumable ill t1 ill t2 ill t0 Hec
             (IH1 n0 t1 H1) (IH2 n0 t2 H2)).
  - (* TOutL *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0.
    assert (Hnu : u <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst u.
      destruct (pf n0 vis (Chan lin p0 t) ill t0 (conj Hu Hin0)) as [Hf _].
      discriminate Hf. }
    assert (Hnv : v <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst v.
      destruct (pf n0 vis t' ill t0 (conj Hv Hin0)) as [Hf _]. discriminate Hf. }
    apply (IHb n0 t0). simpl. right. right.
    exact (in_removeEntry_intro v (removeEntry u g) n0 ill t0 Hnv
             (in_removeEntry_intro u g n0 ill t0 Hnu Hin0)).
  - (* TOutUn *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0.
    assert (Hnv : v <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst v.
      destruct (pf n0 vis t' ill t0 (conj Hv Hin0)) as [Hf _]. discriminate Hf. }
    apply (IHb n0 t0). simpl. right.
    exact (in_removeEntry_intro v g n0 ill t0 Hnv Hin0).
  - (* TInL *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0.
    assert (Hnu : u <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst u.
      destruct (pf n0 vis (Chan lin p0 t) ill t0 (conj Hu Hin0)) as [Hf _].
      discriminate Hf. }
    apply (IHb n0 t0). simpl. right. right.
    exact (in_removeEntry_intro u g n0 ill t0 Hnu Hin0).
  - (* TInUn *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0.
    apply (IHb n0 t0). simpl. right. exact Hin0.
  - (* TInU *)
    intros n0 t0 Hin0.
    apply (IHb n0 t0). simpl. right. exact Hin0.
Qed.

  cons g pf -> forall pf', cons (removeEntry n g) pf'.
Proof.
  intros g pf n Hc pf'.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec (removeEntry n g) pf')).
  intros x f t Hin.
  apply (proj1 (cons_spec g pf) Hc x f t).

  g = g' -> typeCheck g pf p -> typeCheck g' pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g g' pf pf' p E H. subst g'.
  exact (typeCheck_pf_irrel g pf p H pf').
Qed.

  reflexivity.

  v <> n ->
  removeEntry n ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v g)

  rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq v n vis t2 (removeEntry v g) Hv).
  rewrite (removeEntry_removeEntry_other n v g (eq_sym Hv)).

Qed.

  x <> n ->
  removeEntry n ((x,vis,t)::g) = (x,vis,t)::removeEntry n g.
Proof.
  intros n x t g Hx. apply removeEntry_cons_neq; exact Hx.
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_new_env : forall n nb tb g,
  nb <> n ->
  removeEntry n ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g)

Proof.

  rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq nb n vis tb (removeEntry nb g) Hnb).
  rewrite (removeEntry_removeEntry_other n nb g (eq_sym Hnb)).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

End RemoveIll.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
        exact (Co_top (((n,f),Top)::tl) pf n Hpf' HTy Hrec).
      * subst t.
        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n (Chan un p t')).
        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n f (Chan un p t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
        exact (Co_un (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) pf n p t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
      * subst t.
        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n (Chan lin empty t')).
        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n f (Chan lin empty t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
        exact (Co_lin (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) pf n t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma cons_spec : forall g pf, cons g pf <-> (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t).
Proof.
  intros g pf. split.
  - apply cons_entry.
  - apply entry_cons.
Qed.

Proof.

  destruct H1 as [-> | [[p1 [u1 ->]] | [u1 ->]]];
  destruct H2 as [-> | [[p2 [u2 ->]] | [u2 ->]]];
  inversion Hp; subst; simpl; auto using consumable_top, consumable_un, consumable_lin_empty.
  all: try (inversion H4; subst; auto using consumable_lin_empty).
Qed.

using NoDup-domain uniqueness to identify the action entries,
       type_remove_det / type_remove_lin_out_self /
       type_remove_lin_inp_self to identify residual types, and, for
       the input rules, typeCheck_perm plus SubstDev's pmap_typing.

   Remaining rules / exact obstructions:

   (0) uRin plan (partially assembled).  RemainderDev is imported
       and gives exists_consumable_type_plus_r/l.  The helpers
       dummy_ecomb_sym, consumable_dummyType and consumable_wk_type
       are proved here.  The intended split of the uRin target
         E' = newEntries g (secLabs q) (max (domain g))
                ++ ((b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)
       (with A := newEntries g (secLabs q) (max (domain g))) is:
         E_pmap = dummyEnv A ++ (b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g
         E_bang = (b,vis,r) :: A ++ removeEntry b (weakenEnv g)
       where r is the consumable right remainder of t2.  For A entries
       use dummy_ecomb_sym; for the b entry use
       exists_consumable_type_plus_r with flag_plus vis vis = vis;
       for a hidden c in removeEntry b g use dummy_ecomb at c; for a
       visible/ill c use typeCheck t::t = t (TInU's cons premise says
       the visible/ill entries of g are consumable).  The pmap share
       then needs the consumable dummyEnv A entries added, and the
       bang share needs the old ill b entry removed and the fresh
       consumable vis r entry added.  This requires the NotDup version
       of typeCheck_remove_ill, which is currently being proved in
       RemoveDev.v.  NOTE: RemoveDev.v imports SrDev.v, so SrDev.v
       cannot import RemoveDev.v without a cycle; the final lemma must
       be copied/merged into SrDev.v, or RemoveDev.v must be reworked
       downstream of a different base.  RemoveDev.v did not compile
       at the last check.

   (1) uRin.  The TInU typing gives the bang body p under
       (x,t)::g.  The target is
         newEntries g (secLabs q) (max (domain g))
           ++ ((b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)
       with q = dep_relabel p (domain g), and both
         pmap p x b   and   dBang a x q
       must be typed in a tEnv_split of that target.  The natural
       bang share is A ++ weakenEnv g (A = the newEntries part), for
       which DepDev.dep_relabel_typing supplies the typing, while the
       pmap share is (b,t2)::remove b g.  For a source entry b with
       flag ill, however, weakenEnv leaves it ill, and ecomb of a
       share (vis,t2) with (ill,_) has result flag hid, never the
       target flag vis (flag_plus vis ill = hid).  There is no
       flag-monotonicity (ill -> vis) for typeCheck in the corpus.
       For f = vis the per-entry arithmetic goes through
       (dummy_ecomb / consumability from TInU's cons premise), but
       the ill case needs either a stronger invariant or an extra
       monotonicity lemma.

Lemma max_domain_eq_of_dom_iff : forall g g',
  (forall x, In x (domain g) <-> In x (domain g')) ->
  max (domain g) = max (domain g').

  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' m f t Hmn; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst x.
      split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply Hmn. reflexivity.
        -- exact H.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply Hmn. reflexivity.
        -- right. exact H.
    + split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- left. exact Heq.
        -- right. exact (proj1 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- left. exact Heq.
        -- right. exact (proj2 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
Qed.

Lemma In_replaceEntry_hit : forall g n f' t' f t,
  In ((n,f),t) (replaceEntry n f' t' g) -> f = f' /\ t = t'.
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' f t Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. split; reflexivity.
      * exact (IH n f' t' f t Hin).
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply (pair_eq_false x n E). reflexivity.
      * exact (IH n f' t' f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_in_entry : forall g n t f' t',
  In ((n,ill),t) g -> In ((n,f'),t') (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n t f' t' Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. simpl. destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + left. f_equal. apply (pair_eq_true x n E).
      (* goal ((n,f'),t') = ((x,f'),t') *)
      apply pair_eq_true in E. subst x. reflexivity.
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply (pair_eq_false x n E). reflexivity.
      * right. exact (IH n t f' t' Hin).
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_removeEntry : forall g n f' t' m,
  m <> n ->
  removeEntry m (replaceEntry n f' t' g)
  = replaceEntry n f' t' (removeEntry m g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' m Hmn; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (pair_eq x m) eqn:Em.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Em; subst x.
      assert (En : pair_eq m n = false)
        by (apply pair_eq_neq; intro Heq; apply Hmn; symmetry; exact Heq).
      rewrite En. reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:En.
      * apply pair_eq_true in En; subst x.
        simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq m n Hmn). reflexivity.
      * simpl. rewrite Em, En. apply IH. exact Hmn.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Consumability and cons preservation.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma cons_replaceEntry : forall g pf n t',
  cons g pf -> consumable t' ->
  forall pf', cons (replaceEntry n vis t' g) pf'.
Proof.
  intros g pf n t' Hc Hcons pf'.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec (replaceEntry n vis t' g) pf')).
  intros x f t Hin.
  destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
  - assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
    destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g n vis t' f t Hin) as [Ef Et].
    subst f t. exact Hcons.
  - assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
    apply (proj1 (cons_spec g pf) Hc x f t).
    exact (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f t Hxn) Hin).
Qed.

Lemma cons_proj_replaceEntry : forall g pf n t',
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf -> consumable t' ->
  forall pf',
  cons (vis_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g) ++
        ill_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g)) pf'.
Proof.
  intros g pf n t' Hc Hcons pf'.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec
    (vis_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g) ++
     ill_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g)) pf')).
  intros x f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply In_vis_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin Hf].
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
      destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g n vis t' f t Hin) as [Ef Et].
      subst f t. exact Hcons.
    + assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
      apply (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc x f t).
      apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj.
      split; auto. exact (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f t Hxn) Hin).
  - apply In_ill_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin Hf].
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
      destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g n vis t' f t Hin) as [Ef Et].
      subst f t. exact Hcons.
    + assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
      apply (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc x f t).
      apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj.
      split; auto. exact (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f t Hxn) Hin).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Body-environment commutation lemmas.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma replaceEntry_out_env : forall n f' t' u v t1 t2 g,
  u <> n -> v <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))
  = (u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u (replaceEntry n f' t' g)).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq u vis t1
             ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq v vis t2
             (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)) n f' t' H0).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_removeEntry (removeEntry u g) n f' t' v H0).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' u H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_un_env : forall n f' t' v t2 g,
  v <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v g)
  = (v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq v vis t2 (removeEntry v g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' v H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_inl_env : forall n f' t' u x t1 t g,
  u <> n -> x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g)
  = (u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq u vis t1
             ((x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq x vis t
             (removeEntry u g) n f' t' H0).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' u H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_inun_env : forall n f' t' x t g,
  x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((x,vis,t)::g)
  = (x,vis,t)::replaceEntry n f' t' g.
Proof.
  intros. apply replaceEntry_cons_neq; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_new_env : forall n f' t' nb tb g,
  nb <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g)
  = (nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq nb vis tb (removeEntry nb g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' nb H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Split replacement.                                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma ecomb_vis_self : forall t, ecomb (vis,t) (vis,t) (vis,t).
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u | ].
  - destruct m; apply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv| apply Pp_emptyR].
  - apply ec_un. apply Fp_vv.
  - apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

Lemma esplit_replace_R : forall g1 g2 g n t t',
  esplit g1 g2 g -> In ((n,ill),t) g ->
  esplit (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
         (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
         (replaceEntry n vis t' g).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g n t t' [HA [HB HC]] Hin.
  unfold esplit. split.
  - intro x. rewrite !replaceEntry_domain. apply HA.
  - split.
    + intro x. rewrite !replaceEntry_domain. apply HB.
    + intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1 He2.
      destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
      * assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
        destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g1 n vis t' f1 t1 He1) as [Ef1 Et1].
        destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g2 n vis t' f2 t2 He2) as [Ef2 Et2].
        subst f1 t1 f2 t2.
        exists vis, t'. split.
        -- exact (replaceEntry_in_entry g n t vis t' Hin).
        -- apply ecomb_vis_self.
      * assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
        destruct (HC x f1 t1 f2 t2
          (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g1 n vis t' x f1 t1 Hxn) He1)
          (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g2 n vis t' x f2 t2 Hxn) He2))
          as [f [tt [H3 Hec]]].
        exists f, tt. split; [|exact Hec].
        exact (proj2 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f tt Hxn) H3).
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_replace_R : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n t t',
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  NoDup (domain g3) -> In ((n,ill),t) g3 ->
  forall pf1' pf2' pf3',
  tEnv_split (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
             (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
             (replaceEntry n vis t' g3) pf1' pf2' pf3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n t t' Hs Hnd Hin pf1' pf2' pf3'.
  destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Hs Hnd) as [Hnd1 Hnd2].
  assert (Hnd1' : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd1).
  assert (Hnd2' : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd2).
  assert (Hnd3' : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n vis t' g3)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd).
  assert (Hes : esplit (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
                       (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
                       (replaceEntry n vis t' g3))
    by (apply (esplit_replace_R g1 g2 g3 n t t'
                 (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Hs) Hin)).
  assert (Hs' : tEnv_split (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
                           (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
                           (replaceEntry n vis t' g3)
                   (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd3'))
    by (apply (esplit_tEnv_split _ _ _
                 (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd3')
                 Hnd1' Hnd2' Hnd3' Hes)).
  exact (tEnv_split_pf_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs' pf1' pf2' pf3').
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev DepDev RemoveDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Replacing the entry at a name, preserving its position.            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint replaceEntry (n : name * name) (f' : flag) (t' : piType) (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv :=
  match g with
  | nil => nil
  | ((x,f),t) :: tl =>
      if pair_eq x n
      then ((x,f'),t') :: replaceEntry n f' t' tl
      else ((x,f),t) :: replaceEntry n f' t' tl
  end.

Lemma replaceEntry_domain : forall g n f' t',
  domain (replaceEntry n f' t' g) = domain g.
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t'; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (pair_eq x n); simpl; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_domain_replaceEntry : forall g n f' t',
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n f' t' g)).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite replaceEntry_domain. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_cons_neq : forall x f t g n f' t',
  x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' (((x,f),t)::g)
  = ((x,f),t) :: replaceEntry n f' t' g.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq x n H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma In_replaceEntry_neq : forall g n f' t' m f t,
  m <> n ->
  (In ((m,f),t) (replaceEntry n f' t' g) <-> In ((m,f),t) g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' m f t Hmn; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst x.
      split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply Hmn. reflexivity.
        -- right. exact (proj1 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply Hmn. reflexivity.
        -- right. exact (proj2 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
    + split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- left. exact Heq.
        -- right. exact (proj1 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- left. exact Heq.
        -- right. exact (proj2 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
Qed.

Lemma In_replaceEntry_hit : forall g n f' t' f t,
  In ((n,f),t) (replaceEntry n f' t' g) -> f = f' /\ t = t'.
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' f t Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. split; reflexivity.
      * exact (IH n f' t' f t Hin).
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. rewrite pair_eq_refl in E. discriminate E.
      * exact (IH n f' t' f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_in_entry : forall g n t f' t',
  In ((n,ill),t) g -> In ((n,f'),t') (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n t f' t' Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. simpl. destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E. subst x. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. rewrite pair_eq_refl in E. discriminate E.
      * right. exact (IH n t f' t' Hin).
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_removeEntry : forall g n f' t' m,
  m <> n ->
  removeEntry m (replaceEntry n f' t' g)
  = replaceEntry n f' t' (removeEntry m g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' m Hmn; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (pair_eq x m) eqn:Em.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Em; subst x.
      assert (En : pair_eq m n = false)
        by (apply pair_eq_neq; intro Heq; exact (Hmn Heq)).
      rewrite En. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:En.
      * apply pair_eq_true in En; subst x.
        simpl. rewrite Em. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. f_equal. apply IH. exact Hmn.
      * simpl. rewrite Em, En. f_equal. apply IH. exact Hmn.
Qed.

(* Consumability and cons preservation.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma cons_replaceEntry : forall g pf n t',
  cons g pf -> consumable t' ->
  forall pf', cons (replaceEntry n vis t' g) pf'.
Proof.
  intros g pf n t' Hc Hcons pf'.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec (replaceEntry n vis t' g) pf')).
  intros x f t Hin.
  destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
  - assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
    destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g n vis t' f t Hin) as [Ef Et].
    subst f t. exact Hcons.
  - assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
    apply (proj1 (cons_spec g pf) Hc x f t).
    exact (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f t Hxn) Hin).
Qed.

Lemma cons_proj_replaceEntry : forall g pf n t',
  cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf -> consumable t' ->
  forall pf',
  cons (vis_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g) ++
        ill_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g)) pf'.
Proof.
  intros g pf n t' Hc Hcons pf'.
  apply (proj2 (cons_spec
    (vis_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g) ++
     ill_proj (replaceEntry n vis t' g)) pf')).
  intros x f t Hin.
  apply in_app_or in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply In_vis_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin Hf].
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
      destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g n vis t' f t Hin) as [Ef Et].
      subst f t. exact Hcons.
    + assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
      apply (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc x f t).
      apply in_or_app. left. apply In_vis_proj.
      split; auto. exact (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f t Hxn) Hin).
  - apply In_ill_proj in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin Hf].
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
      destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g n vis t' f t Hin) as [Ef Et].
      subst f t. exact Hcons.
    + assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
      apply (proj1 (cons_spec (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf) Hc x f t).
      apply in_or_app. right. apply In_ill_proj.
      split; auto. exact (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f t Hxn) Hin).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Body-environment commutation lemmas.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma replaceEntry_out_env : forall n f' t' u v t1 t2 g,
  u <> n -> v <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))
  = (u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u (replaceEntry n f' t' g)).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq u vis t1
             ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq v vis t2
             (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)) n f' t' H0).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry (removeEntry u g) n f' t' v H0).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' u H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_un_env : forall n f' t' v t2 g,
  v <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v g)
  = (v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq v vis t2 (removeEntry v g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' v H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_inl_env : forall n f' t' u x t1 t g,
  u <> n -> x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g)
  = (u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq u vis t1
             ((x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq x vis t
             (removeEntry u g) n f' t' H0).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' u H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_inun_env : forall n f' t' x t g,
  x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((x,vis,t)::g)
  = (x,vis,t)::replaceEntry n f' t' g.
Proof.
  intros. apply replaceEntry_cons_neq; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_new_env : forall n f' t' nb tb g,
  nb <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g)
  = (nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq nb vis tb (removeEntry nb g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' nb H).
  reflexivity.

Lemma ecomb_vis_self : forall t, consumable t -> ecomb (vis,t) (vis,t) (vis,t).
Proof.
  intros t Hc. destruct Hc as [-> | [[p u ->] | [u ->]]].
  - apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
  - apply ec_un. apply Fp_vv.
  - apply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv | apply Pp_emptyL].
Qed.

Lemma esplit_replace_R : forall g1 g2 g n t t',
  esplit g1 g2 g -> In ((n,ill),t) g -> consumable t' ->
  esplit (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
         (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
         (replaceEntry n vis t' g).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g n t t' [HA [HB HC]] Hin Hcons.
  unfold esplit. split.
  - intro x. rewrite !replaceEntry_domain. apply HA.
  - split.
    + intro x. rewrite !replaceEntry_domain. apply HB.
    + intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 He1 He2.
      destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
      * assert (Hx : x = n) by (apply pair_eq_true; exact E). subst x.
        destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g1 n vis t' f1 t1 He1) as [Ef1 Et1].
        destruct (In_replaceEntry_hit g2 n vis t' f2 t2 He2) as [Ef2 Et2].
        subst f1 t1 f2 t2.
        exists vis, t'. split.
        -- exact (replaceEntry_in_entry g n t vis t' Hin).
        -- apply ecomb_vis_self. exact Hcons.
      * assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
        destruct (HC x f1 t1 f2 t2
          (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g1 n vis t' x f1 t1 Hxn) He1)
          (proj1 (In_replaceEntry_neq g2 n vis t' x f2 t2 Hxn) He2))
          as [f [tt [H3 Hec]]].
        exists f, tt. split; [|exact Hec].
        exact (proj2 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n vis t' x f tt Hxn) H3).
Qed.

Lemma tEnv_split_replace_R : forall g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n t t',
  tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 ->
  NoDup (domain g3) -> In ((n,ill),t) g3 -> consumable t' ->
  forall pf1' pf2' pf3',
  tEnv_split (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
             (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
             (replaceEntry n vis t' g3) pf1' pf2' pf3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 n t t' Hs Hnd Hin Hcons pf1' pf2' pf3'.
  destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Hs Hnd) as [Hnd1 Hnd2].
  assert (Hnd1' : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd1).
  assert (Hnd2' : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd2).
  assert (Hnd3' : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n vis t' g3)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd).
  assert (Hes : esplit (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
                       (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
                       (replaceEntry n vis t' g3))
    by (apply (esplit_replace_R g1 g2 g3 n t t'
                 (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3 Hs) Hin Hcons)).
  assert (Hs' : tEnv_split (replaceEntry n vis t' g1)
                           (replaceEntry n vis t' g2)
                           (replaceEntry n vis t' g3)
                   (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd3'))
    by (apply (esplit_tEnv_split _ _ _
                 (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2') (isMap_nodup _ Hnd3')
                 Hnd1' Hnd2' Hnd3' Hes)).
  exact (tEnv_split_pf_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs' pf1' pf2' pf3').
Qed.

uRin target env exactly `newEntries g (secLabs q) (max(domain g)) ++ ((b,vis,t2)::removeEntry b g)`. We want split E_pmap and E_bang. Our split lemma's A should be newEntries block, target A++((b,t2)::remove g). Yes.

We need typeCheck of `pmap p x b` in pmap share `dummyEnv A ++ (b,t2)::remove b g`, and typeCheck of `dBang a x q` in bang share `A ++ (b,r)::remove b (weaken g)`. This is what uRin needs.

Now, source typeCheck g pf (dBang a x p) gives TInU:
- p=io/inp
- In a vis Chan un p t g
- ~In x domain g
- snd x < max domain g
- cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g)
- typeCheck ((x,vis,t)::g) pf1 p

DepDev.dep_relabel_typing gives typeCheck (newEntries g (secLabs q) (max s) ++ weakenEnv g) ... q when NoDup domain g, max domain g <= max s, sl_pos p. In uRin, q=dep_relabel p (domain g) pf, s=domain g. Thus A = newEntries g (secLabs q) (max (domain g)) and typeCheck (A ++ weakenEnv g) pf' q. Actually dep_relabel uses s=domain g and Hnds from pf? Need exact statement.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Main replacement theorem.                                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Theorem typeCheck_replace_ill : forall g pf p n t f' t',
  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((n,ill),t) g -> consumable t' ->
  typeCheck g pf p ->
  forall pf', typeCheck (replaceEntry n vis t' g) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g pf p n t f' t' Hnd Hin Hcst Hty.
  revert n t Hnd Hin Hcst.
  induction Hty as [g pf Hc
    | g pf pb nb tb pf1 Hi Hbody IHb
    | g pf g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2 Hspl Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | g pf u p0 t v t'0 q t1 t2 pf1 Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t v t'0 q t2 pf1 Hpol Hr Hu Hv Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q t1 pf1 Hr Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb
    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 pf2 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hcons Hbody IHb];
    intros n0 t0 Hnd Hin Hcst pf'.
  - (* TNil *)
    apply TNil. exact (cons_replaceEntry g pf n0 t0 Hc Hcst pf').
  - (* TNew *)
    assert (Hbn : nb <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst nb.
      destruct (pf n0 hid tb ill t0 (conj Hi Hin)) as [Hf _]. discriminate Hf. }
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g)))
      by (apply (proj1 (NoDup_domain_cons_reuse nb hid tb vis tb g Hnd Hi))).
    assert (HinBody : In ((n0,ill),t0) ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g)).
    { simpl. right. apply (in_removeEntry_intro nb g n0 ill t0 Hbn Hin). }
    assert (E : replaceEntry n0 vis t0 ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g)
              = (nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g))
      by (apply replaceEntry_new_env; exact Hbn).
    assert (Hi' : In ((nb,hid),tb) (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g))
      by (exact (proj2 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n0 vis t0 nb hid tb Hbn) Hi)).
    set (pfR := isMap_nodup (replaceEntry n0 vis t0
                  ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g))
                  (NoDup_domain_replaceEntry _ _ _ _ HndBodyS)).
    set (pfT := isMap_eq _ _ E pfR).
    assert (HbodyT : typeCheck ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g)) pfT pb)
      by (apply (typeCheck_env_eq
                   (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g))
                   ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g))
                   pfR pfT pb E);
          exact (IHb n0 t0 HndBodyS HinBody Hcst pfR)).
    eapply TNew; [exact Hi' | exact HbodyT].
  - (* TPar *)
    destruct (tEnv_split_nodup g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hspl Hnd) as [Hnd1 Hnd2].
    destruct (tEnv_split_esplit g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf Hspl) as [HA [HB HC]].
    assert (Hn3 : In n0 (domain g))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=ill) (t:=t0); exact Hin).
    assert (Hn2 : In n0 (domain g2)) by (apply (proj2 (HB n0)); exact Hn3).
    assert (Hn1 : In n0 (domain g1)) by (apply (proj2 (HA n0)); exact Hn2).
    destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g1 n0 Hn1) as [f1 [t1 H1]].
    destruct (In_dom_entry_rev g2 n0 Hn2) as [f2 [t2 H2]].
    destruct (HC n0 f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2) as [f [tt [H3 Hec]]].
    assert (Heq : ((n0,f),tt) = ((n0,ill),t0))
      by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g n0 f tt n0 ill t0 Hnd H3 Hin eq_refl)).
    inversion Heq; subst f tt.
    assert (Hfp : flag_plus f1 f2 ill)
      by (exact (ecomb_flag_plus f1 t1 f2 t2 ill t0 Hec)).
    destruct (flag_plus_ill_result f1 f2 Hfp) as [E1 E2]. subst f1 f2.
    assert (Hnd1R : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g1)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd1).
    assert (Hnd2R : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g2)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd2).
    assert (HsplR : tEnv_split (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g1)
                      (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g2)
                      (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g)
                      (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1R) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2R) pf')
      by (apply (tEnv_split_replace_R g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf n0 t0 t0
                   Hspl Hnd Hin Hcst
                   (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1R) (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2R) pf')).
    eapply TPar with (g1:=replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g1)
                     (g2:=replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g2)
                     (pf1:=isMap_nodup _ Hnd1R)
                     (pf2:=isMap_nodup _ Hnd2R) (pf:=pf').
    + exact HsplR.
    + exact (IH1 n0 t1 Hnd1 H1 Hcst (isMap_nodup _ Hnd1R)).
    + exact (IH2 n0 t2 Hnd2 H2 Hcst (isMap_nodup _ Hnd2R)).
  - (* TOutL *)
    assert (Hnu : u <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst u.
      destruct (pf n0 vis (Chan lin p0 t) ill t0 (conj Hu Hin)) as [Hf _].
      discriminate Hf. }
    assert (Hnv : v <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst v.
      destruct (pf n0 vis t'0 ill t0 (conj Hv Hin)) as [Hf _]. discriminate Hf. }
    assert (Huu : In u (domain g))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=Chan lin p0 t); exact Hu).
    assert (Hvu : In v (domain g))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t'0); exact Hv).
    assert (Huv : u <> v)
      by (apply (TOutL_neq g u p0 t t1 v t'0 t2 (isMap_nodup g Hnd)
                   Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv)).
    assert (HpermS : Permutation (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))
                                  (domain g))
      by (apply domain_out_env; auto).
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain
      ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (domain g)
        (u :: v :: domain (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))
        (Permutation_sym HpermS) Hnd). }
    assert (HinBody : In ((n0,ill),t0)
      ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))).
    { simpl. right. right.
      apply (in_removeEntry_intro v (removeEntry u g) n0 ill t0 Hnv).
      apply (in_removeEntry_intro u g n0 ill t0 Hnu Hin). }
    assert (E : replaceEntry n0 vis t0
                 ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))
              = (u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g)))
      by (apply replaceEntry_out_env; auto).
    set (pfR := isMap_nodup (replaceEntry n0 vis t0
                  ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))
                  (NoDup_domain_replaceEntry _ _ _ _ HndBodyS)).
    set (pfT := isMap_eq _ _ E pfR).
    assert (HbodyT : typeCheck
      ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g)))
      pfT q)
      by (apply (typeCheck_env_eq
                   (replaceEntry n0 vis t0
                     ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)))
                   ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g)))
                   pfR pfT q E);
          exact (IHb n0 t0 HndBodyS HinBody Hcst pfR)).
    assert (Hu' : In (u,vis,Chan lin p0 t) (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g))
      by (exact (proj2 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n0 vis t0 u vis (Chan lin p0 t) Hnu) Hu)).
    assert (Hv' : In (v,vis,t'0) (replaceEntry n0 vis t0 g))
      by (exact (proj2 (In_replaceEntry_neq g n0 vis t0 v vis t'0 Hnv) Hv)).
    eapply TOutL with (u:=u) (p:=p0) (t:=t) (v:=v) (t':=t'0) (t2:=t2)
                       (pf1:=pfT).
    + exact Hr1.
    + exact Hr2.
    + exact Hu'.
    + exact Hv'.
    + exact HbodyT.
  - (* TOutUn *)
    assert (Hnu : u <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst u.
      destruct (pf n0 vis (Chan un p0 t) ill t0 (conj Hu Hin)) as [Hf _].
      discriminate Hf. }
    assert (Hnv : v <> n0).
    { intro Heq. subst v.
      destruct (pf n0 vis t'0 ill t0 (conj Hv Hin)) as [Hf _]. discriminate Hf. }
    assert (Hvu : In v (domain g))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t'0); exact Hv).
    assert (HpermS : Permutation (v :: domain (removeEntry v g)) (domain g))
      by (apply domain_un_env; exact Hvu).
    assert (HndBodyS : NoDup (domain ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v g))).
    { simpl. apply (NoDup_perm_list (name*name) (domain g)
        (v :: domain (removeEntry v g)) (Permutation_sym HpermS) Hnd). }

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev AuxDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Capability enlargement monotonicity for typeCheck.                  *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* Only unrestricted channel entries (and Top entries, which must stay  *)
(* literally equal) may be enlarged, by increasing their polarity along *)
(* [type_sub].                                                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Section UnLe.

Definition un_le (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  (exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t').

Lemma un_le_refl : forall t, un_le t t.
Proof. intro t; left; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma un_le_sub : forall t t', un_le t t' -> type_sub t t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id | exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
  un_le t1 t2 -> un_le t2 t3 -> un_le t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
  destruct H12 as [-> | [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
  - exact H23.
  - destruct H23 as [-> | [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.
      split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity |]].
      eapply type_sub_trans; [exact Hs1 | exact Hs2].
Qed.

Lemma un_le_consumable : forall t t',
  un_le t t' -> consumable t -> consumable t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [-> | [p [p' [u [-> [-> _]]]]]] Hc; auto.
  apply consumable_un.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_lin_eq : forall p u t', un_le (Chan lin p u) t' -> t' = Chan lin p u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_top_eq : forall t', un_le Top t' -> t' = Top.
Proof.
  intros t' [-> | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E _]]]]]; auto. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma un_le_un_inv : forall p u t',
  un_le (Chan un p u) t' -> exists p', t' = Chan un p' u.
Proof.
  intros p u t' [E | [p0 [p1 [u0 [E1 [E2 _]]]]]].
  - subst t'. exists p; reflexivity.
  - injection E1 as Hp Hu. subst p0 u0. exists p1; exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma un_sub_io_inp : forall p p' t,
  type_sub (Chan un p t) (Chan un p' t) ->
  (p = io \/ p = inp) -> (p' = io \/ p' = inp).
Proof.
  intros p p' t Hs Hp. inversion Hs; subst; auto;
    destruct Hp as [H|H]; discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma un_sub_io_out : forall p p' t,
  type_sub (Chan un p t) (Chan un p' t) ->
  (p = io \/ p = out) -> (p' = io \/ p' = out).
Proof.
  intros p p' t Hs Hp. inversion Hs; subst; auto;
    destruct Hp as [H|H]; discriminate H.
Qed.

End UnLe.

(* Environment-level enlargement relation. *)
Definition un_env (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g ->
     exists t', In ((n,f),t') g' /\ un_le t t').

Section UnEnv.

Lemma un_env_refl : forall g, un_env g g.
Proof.
  intro g. split.
  - intro n; reflexivity.
  - intros n f t Hin. exists t. split; [exact Hin | apply un_le_refl].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_dom1 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g').
Proof. intros g g' n [H _] Hin. exact (proj1 (H n) Hin). Qed.

Lemma un_env_dom2 : forall g g' n,
  un_env g g' -> In n (domain g') -> In n (domain g).
Proof. intros g g' n [H _] Hin. exact (proj2 (H n) Hin). Qed.

Lemma un_env_cons : forall n f t t' g g',
  un_le t t' -> un_env g g' ->
  un_env ((n,f,t)::g) ((n,f,t')::g').
Proof.
  intros n f t t' g g' Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x. simpl. rewrite (Hdom x). tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hin. simpl in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [E | Hin].
    + inversion E; subst. exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin) as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_replace : forall g n f t t' gtail,
  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((n,f),t) g -> un_le t t' ->
  un_env (removeEntry n g) gtail ->
  un_env g ((n,f,t')::gtail).
Proof.
  intros g n f t t' gtail Hnd Hin Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x.
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g (in_dom_entry g n f t Hin) x).
    rewrite (Hdom x). simpl.
    split; intros [E | H]; [left; symmetry; exact E | right; exact H | left; symmetry; exact E | right; exact H].
  - intros x fx tx Hinx.
    destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x n) as [Hxn | Hxn].
    + subst x.
      assert (Heq : ((n,fx),tx) = ((n,f),t))
        by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g n fx tx n f t Hnd Hinx Hin eq_refl)).
      inversion Heq; subst.
      exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + assert (Hin' : In ((x,fx),tx) (removeEntry n g))
        by (apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g x fx tx); auto).
      destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin') as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_removeEntry : forall n g g',
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g') ->
  In n (domain g) -> In n (domain g') ->
  un_env g g' -> un_env (removeEntry n g) (removeEntry n g').
Proof.
  intros n g g' Hnd Hnd' Hn Hn' [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x.
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g Hnd Hn x).
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff2 n g' Hnd' Hn' x).
    rewrite (Hdom x). tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hinx.
    assert (Hing : In ((x,fx),tx) g) by (apply (in_removeEntry_elim n g x fx tx); exact Hinx).
    destruct (Hent x fx tx Hing) as [u [Hinu He]].
    assert (Hxn : x <> n).
    { intro Hc. subst x.
      exact (NoDup_removeEntry_still n g Hnd Hn
               (in_dom_entry (removeEntry n g) n fx tx Hinx)). }
    exists u. split; [| exact He].
    apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g' x fx u); auto.
Qed.

(* Max of the domain is determined by membership. *)
Lemma max_domain_mem_eq : forall g g',
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) ->
  max (domain g) = max (domain g').
Proof.
  intros g g' Hdom. apply Nat.le_antisymm.
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec (domain g) (max (domain g')))).
    intros a x Hin.
    assert (Hin' : In (a,x) (domain g')) by (apply (proj1 (Hdom (a,x))); exact Hin).
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec (domain g') (max (domain g'))) (Nat.le_refl _) a x Hin').
  - apply (proj2 (max_le_spec (domain g') (max (domain g)))).
    intros a x Hin.
    assert (Hin' : In (a,x) (domain g)) by (apply (proj2 (Hdom (a,x))); exact Hin).
    exact (proj1 (max_le_spec (domain g) (max (domain g))) (Nat.le_refl _) a x Hin').
Qed.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.

Lemma type_plus_wk_self : forall t, type_plus t (wk_type t) t.
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply Tp_LinPlus. apply Pp_emptyR.
    + simpl. pose proof (Tp_UnPlus p p u) as H.
      rewrite pol_cup_idem in H. exact H.
  - simpl. apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_vis_wk_self : forall t,
  ecomb (vis,t) (vis,wk_type t) (vis,t).
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply ec_lin with (p1:=p) (p2:=empty) (p:=p);
        [apply Fp_vv|apply Pp_emptyR].
    + simpl. apply ec_un with (p:=p); apply Fp_vv.
  - simpl. apply ec_top; apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_un_cup_l : forall p q u,

Fixpoint dep_map_gen_r (l :list (name * name)) (m : nat) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => fun _ => nil
    | h :: t =>
      fun pf : NoDup (h :: t)  =>
        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
    end.

Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).

Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
    match p with
    | dZero   => fun _  => p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
    | dPar p q =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
    | dNu h i p =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
    end.

End ProcessDefinitions.

Section Facts.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section Semantics.

Inductive action : Set :=
  | aIn : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aOut : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aTau : nat -> nat -> action.

Fixpoint InB a g : ((flag * piType) * bool) :=
    match g with
    | nil => ((ill, Top), false)
    | (b, f, t) :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then ((f, t), true) else InB a m
    end.

Fixpoint newEntries (g : typeEnv) (l : list (name * name)) (max : nat) : typeEnv :=
    match l with
    | (a1, a2) :: tail =>
      let (_, notNew) := InB (a1, a2) g in
      if notNew
      then newEntries g tail max
      else
        let (pair, _) := InB (a1, a2 - max) g in
        ((a1, a2), fst pair, snd pair) :: newEntries g tail max
    | nil => nil
    end.

Definition notHidden c1 c2 act :=
    match act with
    | aIn a1 a2 b1 b2
    | aOut a1 a2 b1 b2 =>
      (a1, a2)<> (c1, c2) /\ (b1, b2) <> (c1, c2)
    | aTau _ _ => True
    end.

Lemma In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift : forall p s pf a,
  In a (secLabs (dep_relabel p s pf)) ->
  exists b, In b (secLabs p) /\ a = shift_name (max s) b.
Proof.
  intros p s pf a H.
  rewrite secLabs_dep_relabel_map in H.
  apply In_shift_name in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma In_secLabs_dep_relabel_snd_gt : forall p s pf a,
  sl_pos p ->
  In a (secLabs (dep_relabel p s pf)) ->
  snd a > max s.
Proof.
  intros p s pf a Hpos Hin.
  destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift p s pf a Hin) as [b [Hb Heq]].
  subst a. destruct b as [b1 b2]. unfold shift_name. simpl.
  pose proof (sl_pos_In p b1 b2 Hpos Hb). simpl in H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma secLabs_dep_relabel_notin : forall p s pf g a,
  sl_pos p ->
  max (domain g) <= max s ->
  In a (secLabs (dep_relabel p s pf)) ->
  ~ In a (domain g).
Proof.
  intros p s pf g a Hpos Hm Hin.
  destruct (In_secLabs_dep_relabel_shift p s pf a Hin) as [[b1 b2] [Hb Heq]].
  subst a. unfold shift_name. simpl.
  apply (shifted_not_in_g g b1 b2 (max s)).
  - pose proof (sl_pos_In p b1 b2 Hpos Hb). simpl in H. exact H.
  - exact Hm.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_wk_self : forall t, type_plus t (wk_type t) t.
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply Tp_LinPlus. apply Pp_emptyR.
    + simpl. pose proof (Tp_UnPlus p p u) as H.
      rewrite pol_cup_idem in H. exact H.
  - simpl. apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_vis_wk_self : forall t,
  ecomb (vis,t) (vis,wk_type t) (vis,t).
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply ec_lin with (p1:=p) (p2:=empty) (p:=p);
        [apply Fp_vv|apply Pp_emptyR].
    + simpl. apply ec_un with (p:=p); apply Fp_vv.
  - simpl. apply ec_top; apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_un_cup_l : forall p q u,
  type_sub (Chan un p u) (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u).
Proof.
  intros p q u. destruct p; destruct q; simpl; eauto using type_sub.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_consumable_wk_un_le : forall t1 t t2,
  type_plus t1 t t2 -> consumable t1 -> un_le t1 (wk_type t2).
Proof.
  intros t1 t t2 Htp Hc.
  destruct Hc as [Htop | [[p1 [u Ht1]] | [u Ht1]]]; subst t1.
  - inversion Htp; subst. left. reflexivity.
  - inversion Htp; subst. simpl. left. reflexivity.
  - inversion Htp; subst. simpl.
    right. exists p1, (pol_cup p1 p2), u. simpl.
    split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|apply type_sub_un_cup_l]].
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_absent : forall g n f' t',
  ~ In n (domain g) -> replaceEntry n f' t' g = g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t' H.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. assert (E : pair_eq x n = false).
    { apply pair_eq_neq. intro Heq. apply H. simpl. left. symmetry. exact Heq. }
    rewrite E. simpl. rewrite IH; auto.
    intro Hc. apply H. simpl. right. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_perm_remove : forall g n f' t',
  NoDup (domain g) -> In n (domain g) ->

Proof.
  induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t' Hnd Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. simpl.
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.

      destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * exfalso. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * simpl. apply perm_skip. apply IH; auto.

Lemma replaceEntry_app_absent : forall L R n f' t',
  ~ In n (domain L) ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' (L ++ R) = L ++ replaceEntry n f' t' R.
Proof.

  - reflexivity.

Lemma uRin_target_split : forall A g b t2,
  NoDup (domain A) -> NoDup (domain g) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain A) -> In n (domain g) -> False) ->
  In b (domain g) ->
  (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> f <> hid -> consumable t) ->
  exists r, consumable r /\
    esplit (dummyEnv A ++ (b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)
           (A ++ (b,vis,r) :: removeEntry b (weakenEnv g))
           (A ++ (b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g).
Proof.
  intros A g b t2 HndA Hndg Hdisj Hb Hcons.
  assert (HndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry b g)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact Hndg).
  assert (HconsRem : forall n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry b g) -> f <> hid -> consumable t).
  { intros n f t Hin Hf. apply Hcons with (n:=n) (f:=f) (t:=t); auto.
    exact (in_removeEntry_elim b g n f t Hin). }
  assert (HesRestW : esplit (removeEntry b g)
      (weakenEnv (removeEntry b g)) (removeEntry b g))
    by (apply esplit_weakenEnv_consumable; auto).
  assert (Hbrem : ~ In b (domain (removeEntry b g)))
    by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still b g Hndg Hb)).
  assert (Hbwk : ~ In b (domain (weakenEnv (removeEntry b g))))
    by (rewrite domain_weakenEnv_eq; exact Hbrem).
  destruct (ecomb_vis_remainder_r t2) as [r [Hcr [Htp Hec]]].
  exists r. split; [exact Hcr|].
  assert (HesB : esplit ((b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)
                         ((b,vis,r) :: weakenEnv (removeEntry b g))
                         ((b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)).
  { eapply esplit_insert_comb.
    - exact HesRestW.
    - exact Hec.
    - exact Hbrem.
    - exact Hbwk.
    - exact Hbrem. }
  assert (HesA : esplit (dummyEnv A) A A)
    by (apply esplit_dummy_left; exact HndA).
  assert (HdisjAB : forall n, In n (domain A) ->
      In n (domain ((b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)) -> False).
  { intros n HnA HnB. apply Hdisj with (n:=n); auto.
    simpl in HnB. destruct HnB as [E|HnB].
    + subst n. exact Hb.
    + apply (domain_removeEntry_sub b g n HnB). }
  assert (HesB' : esplit ((b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)
      ((b,vis,r) :: removeEntry b (weakenEnv g))
      ((b,vis,t2) :: removeEntry b g)).
  { rewrite <- (weakenEnv_removeEntry b g). exact HesB. }
  eapply esplit_app_disjoint; [exact HesA|exact HesB'|exact HdisjAB].
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_wk_self : forall t, type_plus t (wk_type t) t.
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply Tp_LinPlus. apply Pp_emptyR.
    + simpl. pose proof (Tp_UnPlus p p u) as H.
      rewrite pol_cup_idem in H. exact H.
  - simpl. apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_vis_wk_self : forall t,
  ecomb (vis,t) (vis,wk_type t) (vis,t).
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply ec_lin with (p1:=p) (p2:=empty) (p:=p);
        [apply Fp_vv|apply Pp_emptyR].
    + simpl. apply ec_un with (p:=p); apply Fp_vv.
  - simpl. apply ec_top; apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_un_cup_l : forall p q u,
  type_sub (Chan un p u) (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u).
Proof.
  intros p q u. destruct p; destruct q; simpl; eauto using type_sub.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_consumable_wk_un_le : forall t1 t t2,
  type_plus t1 t t2 -> consumable t1 -> un_le t1 (wk_type t2).
Proof.
  intros t1 t t2 Htp Hc.
  destruct Hc as [Htop | [[p1 [u Ht1]] | [u Ht1]]]; subst t1.
  - inversion Htp; subst. left. reflexivity.
  - inversion Htp; subst. simpl.
    right. exists p1, (pol_cup p1 p2), u. simpl.
    split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|apply type_sub_un_cup_l]].
  - inversion Htp; subst. simpl. left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_absent : forall g n f' t',
  ~ In n (domain g) -> replaceEntry n f' t' g = g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t' H.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. assert (E : pair_eq x n = false).
    { apply pair_eq_neq. intro Heq. apply H. simpl. left. exact Heq. }
    rewrite E. simpl. rewrite IH; auto.
    intro Hc. apply H. simpl. right. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_perm_remove : forall g n f' t',
  NoDup (domain g) -> In n (domain g) ->
  Permutation (replaceEntry n f' t' g) ((n,f',t') :: removeEntry n g).
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t' Hnd Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. simpl.
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E. subst x.
      assert (Hnot : ~ In n (domain tl)).
      { apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. exact (proj1 Hnd). }
      rewrite (replaceEntry_absent tl n f' t' Hnot).
      apply Permutation_refl.
    + assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
      apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hx Hndtl].
      destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * exfalso. apply Hxn. exact Heq.
      * eapply perm_trans.
        -- apply perm_skip. apply IH; auto.
        -- apply perm_swap.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_app_absent : forall L R n f' t',
  ~ In n (domain L) ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' (L ++ R) = L ++ replaceEntry n f' t' R.
Proof.
  induction L as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros R n f' t' H.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. assert (Hxn : x <> n).
    { intro Heq. apply H. simpl. left. exact Heq. }

Definition un_ext (t t' : piType) : Prop :=
  t = t' \/
  exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t'.

Definition un_enlarge (g g' : typeEnv) : Prop :=
  (forall n, In n (domain g) <-> In n (domain g')) /\
  forall n f t, In (n, f, t) g ->
    exists t', In (n, f, t') g' /\ un_ext t t'.

Lemma un_ext_sub : forall t t', un_ext t t' -> type_sub t t'.
Proof.
  intros t t' [->| [p [p' [u [-> [-> Hsub]]]]]]; [apply Ts_id|exact Hsub].
Qed.

Lemma un_ext_trans : forall t1 t2 t3,
  un_ext t1 t2 -> un_ext t2 t3 -> un_ext t1 t3.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 t3 H12 H23.
  destruct H12 as [->| [p1 [p2 [u [E1 [E2 Hs1]]]]]].
  - exact H23.
  - destruct H23 as [->| [q2 [q3 [u' [E2' [E3 Hs2]]]]]].
    + right. exists p1, p2, u. auto.
    + right. exists p1, q3, u.
      inversion E2; subst. inversion E2'; subst.

Qed.

Lemma share_lOut :
  forall g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
    esplit g1 g2 g ->
    typeCheck g1 pf1 (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) ->
    type_remove t1 t t2 ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin out t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) g ->
    exists g1' pf1',
      esplit g1' g2

           :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
           :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)) /\
      typeCheck g1' pf1' p.

  intros g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2
         Hnd Hnd1 Hnd2 Hes Hty Hr HinA HinB.

    assert (E3a : f3a = vis /\ t3a = Chan lin out t).

    destruct E3a as [Ef3a Et3a]; subst f3a t3a.
    inversion Heca; subst.
    + inversion H2.
    + inversion H2.
    + (* linear combination; rule out p0 = empty *)

      { destruct p0; simpl in *.
        - exfalso. exact (type_sub_lin_out_empty_false t0 H0).
        - inversion H3; reflexivity.
        - inversion H3; reflexivity.
        - inversion H3; reflexivity. }
      subst p0.
      assert (Et0 : t0 = t).
      { inversion H; reflexivity. }
      subst t0.
      assert (Hf2a : f2a = vis) by (inversion H2; reflexivity).
      subst f2a.
      assert (Ep2 : p2 = empty).
      { inversion H3; reflexivity. }
      subst p2.
      (* t2a is empty t, simplify it *)
      assert (Et2a : t2a = Chan lin empty t).
      { inversion H; reflexivity. }
      subst t2a.
      assert (EresA : t3 = Chan lin empty t)
        by (apply (type_remove_lin_out_self t t3); exact H4).
      subst t3.

        as [f2b [t2b [f3b [t3b [Hin2b [Hin3b Hecb]]]]]].
      assert (E3b : f3b = vis /\ t3b = t1).
      { apply nodup_entry_eq_same with (g:=g) (n:=(v1,v2)); auto. }
      destruct E3b as [Ef3b Et3b]; subst f3b t3b.
      (* relate the b remainders *)

      assert (Hecomb_b : ecomb (vis,t4) (vis,t2b) (vis,t2)).

      assert (HnotuAB1 : ~ In (u1,u2) (domain
          (removeEntry (u1,u2) (removeEntry (v1,v2) g1))))
        by (apply NoDup_removeEntry_still;
            [apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact (NoDup_domain_removeEntry (v1,v2) g1 Hnd1)|
             apply domain_removeEntry_neq;
             [intro E; apply Huv; exact E| apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis)(t:=Chan lin out t); exact H6]]).
      assert (HnotuAB2 : ~ In (u1,u2) (domain
          (removeEntry (u1,u2) (removeEntry (v1,v2) g2))))
        by (apply NoDup_removeEntry_still;
            [apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; exact (NoDup_domain_removeEntry (v1,v2) g2 Hnd2)|

        by (apply NoDup_removeEntry_still;
            [exact (NoDup_domain_removeEntry (u1,u2) (removeEntry (v1,v2) g)

             apply domain_removeEntry_neq;

Lemma esplit_perm : forall g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3',
  esplit g1 g2 g3 ->
  Permutation g1 g1' -> Permutation g2 g2' -> Permutation g3 g3' ->
  esplit g1' g2' g3'.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 g1' g2' g3' [HA [HB HC]] P1 P2 P3. split.
  - intro n. split; intro H.
    + apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)).
      apply (proj1 (HA n)).
      exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P1)) H).
    + apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P1)).
      apply (proj2 (HA n)).
      exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)) H).
  - split.
    + intro n. split; intro H.
      * apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)).
        apply (proj1 (HB n)).
        exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)) H).
      * apply (Permutation_in n (Permutation_domain _ _ P2)).
        apply (proj2 (HB n)).
        exact (Permutation_in n (Permutation_sym (Permutation_domain _ _ P3)) H).
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
      assert (H1' : In ((n,f1),t1) g1)
        by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f1),t1) (Permutation_sym P1) H1)).
      assert (H2' : In ((n,f2),t2) g2)
        by (exact (Permutation_in ((n,f2),t2) (Permutation_sym P2) H2)).
      destruct (HC n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1' H2') as [f [t [H3 He]]].
      exists f, t. split; [|exact He].
      exact (Permutation_in ((n,f),t) P3 H3).
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + simpl. right; exact H.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left; exact Heq.
      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_empty_right : forall a t c,
  ecomb a (vis, Chan lin empty t) c -> c = a.
Proof.
  intros [fa ta] t c H. inversion H; subst; simpl in *; try discriminate.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Theorem typeCheck_replace_ill : forall g pf p n t (f' : flag) t',
  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((n,ill),t) g -> consumable t' ->
  typeCheck g pf p ->
  forall pf', typeCheck (replaceEntry n vis t' g) pf' p.

  intros g pf p n t f' t' Hnd Hin Hcst Hty.
  revert n t Hnd Hin Hcst.
  induction Hty as [g pf Hc
    | g pf pb nb tb pf1 Hi Hbody IHb
    | g pf g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2 Hspl Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | g pf u p0 t v t'0 q t1 t2 pf1 Hr1 Hr2 Hu Hv Hbody IHb

    | g pf u p0 t x q t1 pf1 Hr Hu Hfresh Hmax Hbody IHb

    | g pf u p0 t x q pf1 pf2 Hpol Hu Hfresh Hmax Hcons Hbody IHb];
    intros n0 t0 Hnd Hin Hcst pf'.
  - (* TNil *)
    apply TNil. exact (cons_replaceEntry g pf n0 t' Hc Hcst pf').

    assert (Hbn : nb <> n0).

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev AuxDev DepDev RemoveDev ReplaceDev MonoDev DistDev RemainderDev SrDev.

Lemma ecomb_plus_target :
  forall f1 f2 f tA tB t1 t t2,
    ecomb (f1,tA) (f2,tB) (f,t1) ->
    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
    exists r1 r2,
      type_plus tA t r1 /\
      type_plus r1 r2 t2 /\
      ecomb (vis,r1) (vis,r2) (vis,t2) /\
      (consumable tB -> consumable r2).
Proof.
  intros f1 f2 f tA tB t1 t t2 Hec Htp.
  inversion Hec; subst.
  - (* Top *)
    inversion Htp; subst.
    exists Top, Top. split.
    + apply Tp_Base.
    + split.
      * apply Tp_Base.
      * split.
        -- apply ec_top; apply Fp_vv.
        -- intro Hc; apply consumable_top.
  - (* un *)
    destruct t as [m q u|].
    + destruct m.
      * inversion Htp.
      * inversion Htp; subst.
        exists (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u), (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u).
        split.
        -- apply Tp_UnPlus.
        -- split.
           ++ replace (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u)
                with (Chan un (pol_cup (pol_cup p q) (pol_cup p q)) u).
              ** apply Tp_UnPlus.
              ** f_equal. apply pol_cup_idem.
           ++ split.
              ** apply ec_un; apply Fp_vv.
              ** intro Hc; apply consumable_un.
    + inversion Htp.
  - (* lin *)
    destruct t as [m q u|].
    + destruct m.
      * inversion Htp; subst.
        match goal with Hc : pol_plus p1 p2 p |- _ => rename Hc into Hpol end.
        match goal with Hc : pol_plus p q p4 |- _ => rename Hc into Hout end.
        destruct (pol_plus_assoc p2 p1 p q p4
                    (pol_plus_sym p1 p2 p Hpol) Hout)
          as [r1p [Hr1p Hr2p]].
        exists (Chan lin r1p u), (Chan lin p2 u).
        split.
        -- apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr1p.
        -- split.
           ++ apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr2p.
           ++ split.
              ** apply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv|exact Hr2p].
              ** intro Hc; exact Hc.
      * inversion Htp.
    + inversion Htp.
Qed.

Lemma esplit_app_disjoint :
  forall g1 g2 g3 h1 h2 h3,
    esplit g1 g2 g3 -> esplit h1 h2 h3 ->
    (forall n, In n (domain g3) -> In n (domain h3) -> False) ->
    esplit (g1 ++ h1) (g2 ++ h2) (g3 ++ h3).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g3 h1 h2 h3
    [HA [HB HC]] [HD [HE HF]] Hdisj.
  split.
  - intro n. rewrite !domain_app. split.
    + intro H. apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
      * apply in_app_iff. left. exact (proj1 (HA n) H).
      * apply in_app_iff. right. exact (proj1 (HD n) H).
    + intro H. apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
      * apply in_app_iff. left. exact (proj2 (HA n) H).
      * apply in_app_iff. right. exact (proj2 (HD n) H).
  - split.
    + intro n. rewrite !domain_app. split.
      * intro H. apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
        -- apply in_app_iff. left. exact (proj1 (HB n) H).
        -- apply in_app_iff. right. exact (proj1 (HE n) H).
      * intro H. apply in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
        -- apply in_app_iff. left. exact (proj2 (HB n) H).
        -- apply in_app_iff. right. exact (proj2 (HE n) H).
    + intros n f1 t1 f2 t2 Hin1 Hin2.
      apply in_app_iff in Hin1. apply in_app_iff in Hin2.
      destruct Hin1 as [Hin1|Hin1]; destruct Hin2 as [Hin2|Hin2].
      * destruct (HC n f1 t1 f2 t2 Hin1 Hin2) as [f [t [Hin He]]].
        exists f, t. split; [apply in_app_iff; left; exact Hin | exact He].
      * exfalso. apply (Hdisj n).
        -- apply (proj1 (HB n)). apply (proj1 (HA n)).
           apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f1) (t:=t1); exact Hin1.
        -- apply (proj1 (HE n)). apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f2) (t:=t2); exact Hin2.
      * exfalso. apply (Hdisj n).
        -- apply (proj1 (HB n)). apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f2) (t:=t2); exact Hin2.
        -- apply (proj1 (HE n)). apply (proj1 (HD n)).
           apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f1) (t:=t1); exact Hin1.
      * destruct (HF n f1 t1 f2 t2 Hin1 Hin2) as [f [t [Hin He]]].
        exists f, t. split; [apply in_app_iff; right; exact Hin | exact He].
Qed.

  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((n,f1),t1) g -> In ((n,f2),t2) g ->
  f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Lemma share_lOut :
  forall g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
    esplit g1 g2 g ->

    type_remove t1 t t2 ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin out t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) g ->
    exists g1' pf1',
      esplit g1' g2
        (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
           :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
           :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)) /\
      typeCheck g1' pf1' p.

  intros g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2
         Hnd Hnd1 Hnd2 Hes Hty Hr HinA HinB.
  inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* TOutL *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct v as [v1 v2]. simpl in *.
    (* identify the action entry in g1 with the whole g entry *)
    destruct (esplit_entry_comb g1 g2 g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin p0 t0) Hes H6)
      as [f2a [t2a [f3a [t3a [Hin2a [Hin3a Heca]]]]]].
    assert (E3a : f3a = vis /\ t3a = Chan lin out t).
    { apply nodup_entry_eq_same with (g:=g) (n:=(u1,u2)); auto. }
    destruct E3a as [Ef3a Et3a]; subst f3a t3a.
    inversion Heca; subst.
    (* only the linear combination survives *)
    assert (Hp0 : p0 = out).
    { destruct p0; simpl in *.
      - exfalso. exact (type_sub_lin_out_empty_false t (proj1 H4)).
      - inversion H13.
      - reflexivity.
      - inversion H13. }
    subst p0.
    assert (Hf2a : f2a = vis) by (inversion H1; reflexivity).
    subst f2a.
    assert (Ep2 : p2 = empty).
    { inversion H13; reflexivity. }
    subst p2.
    assert (HIn2a' : In ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin empty t) g2) by exact Hin2a.
    assert (EresA : t3 = Chan lin empty t)
      by (apply (type_remove_lin_out_self t t3); exact H4).
    subst t3.
      (* extract the b entry *)
      destruct (esplit_entry_comb g1 g2 g (v1,v2) vis t' Hes H7)
        as [f2b [t2b [f3b [t3b [Hin2b [Hin3b Hecb]]]]]].
      assert (E3b : f3b = vis /\ t3b = t1).
      { apply nodup_entry_eq_same with (g:=g) (n:=(v1,v2)); auto. }
      destruct E3b as [Ef3b Et3b]; subst f3b t3b.
      (* relate the b remainders *)
      assert (Et4 : type_remove t' t t4) by exact H5.
      assert (Hecomb_b : ecomb (vis,t4) (vis,t2b) (vis,t2)).
      { eapply ecomb_remove_plus; eauto. }
      assert (Ef2b : f2b = vis).
      { inversion Hecb; subst;
          match goal with H : flag_plus vis f2b vis |- _ =>
            inversion H; reflexivity end. }
      subst f2b.
    assert (E3a : f3a = vis /\ t3a = Chan lin out t).
    { apply nodup_entry_eq_same with (g:=g) (n:=(u1,u2)); auto. }
    destruct E3a as [Ef3a Et3a]; subst f3a t3a.
    inversion Heca.
Qed.

Lemma sr_lOut :
  forall g pf p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2 pf',
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    typeCheck g pf (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) ->
    type_remove t1 t t2 ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin out t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) g ->
    typeCheck
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g pf p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2 pf' Hnd Hty Hr HinA HinB.
  inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* TOutL *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct v as [v1 v2]. simpl in *.
    assert (HuA : ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin p0 t0) = ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin out t)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin p0 t0) (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin out t) Hnd H6 HinA); reflexivity. }
    inversion HuA; subst.
    assert (HvB : ((v1,v2),vis,t') = ((v1,v2),vis,t1)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g (v1,v2) vis t' (v1,v2) vis t1 Hnd H7 HinB); reflexivity. }
    inversion HvB; subst.
    assert (Eres : t3 = Chan lin empty t).
    { exact (type_remove_lin_out_self t t3 H4). }
    subst t3.
    assert (E2 : t4 = t2) by (eapply type_remove_det; eauto).
    subst t4.
    assert (Huv : (u1,u2) <> (v1,v2)).
    { intro E. inversion E; subst v1 v2.
      pose proof (nodup_entry_unique g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin out t)
                    (u1,u2) vis t1 Hnd H6 H7 eq_refl) as Hentry.
      inversion Hentry; subst t1. destruct Hr as [Hsub _].
      exact (no_sub_into_self t lin out Hsub). }
    apply (typeCheck_env_eq_all _ _ p

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,

  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).
