Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
Proof.
  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

  esplit g1 g2 g3 -> In ((n,f1),t1) g1 ->
  exists f2 t2 f3 t3,

            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil

    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>

From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
Require Import pairEq operations header pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task SubstDev DepDev RemoveDev.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Replacing the entry at a name, preserving its position.            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint replaceEntry (n : name * name) (f' : flag) (t' : piType) (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv :=
  match g with
  | nil => nil
  | ((x,f),t) :: tl =>
      if pair_eq x n
      then ((x,f'),t') :: replaceEntry n f' t' tl
      else ((x,f),t) :: replaceEntry n f' t' tl
  end.

Lemma replaceEntry_domain : forall g n f' t',
  domain (replaceEntry n f' t' g) = domain g.
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t'; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (pair_eq x n); simpl; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_domain_replaceEntry : forall g n f' t',
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (replaceEntry n f' t' g)).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite replaceEntry_domain. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_cons_neq : forall x f t g n f' t',
  x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' (((x,f),t)::g)
  = ((x,f),t) :: replaceEntry n f' t' g.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq x n H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma In_replaceEntry_neq : forall g n f' t' m f t,
  m <> n ->
  (In ((m,f),t) (replaceEntry n f' t' g) <-> In ((m,f),t) g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' m f t Hmn; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst x.
      split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply Hmn. reflexivity.
        -- right. exact (proj1 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- inversion Heq; subst. exfalso. apply Hmn. reflexivity.
        -- right. exact (proj2 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
    + split.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- left. exact Heq.
        -- right. exact (proj1 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
      * intro H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
        -- left. exact Heq.
        -- right. exact (proj2 (IH n f' t' m f t Hmn) H).
Qed.

Lemma In_replaceEntry_hit : forall g n f' t' f t,
  In ((n,f),t) (replaceEntry n f' t' g) -> f = f' /\ t = t'.
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' f t Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. split; reflexivity.
      * exact (IH n f' t' f t Hin).
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. rewrite pair_eq_refl in E. discriminate E.
      * exact (IH n f' t' f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_in_entry : forall g n t f' t',
  In ((n,ill),t) g -> In ((n,f'),t') (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n t f' t' Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. simpl. destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E. subst x. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. rewrite pair_eq_refl in E. discriminate E.
      * right. exact (IH n t f' t' Hin).
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_removeEntry : forall g n f' t' m,
  m <> n ->
  removeEntry m (replaceEntry n f' t' g)
  = replaceEntry n f' t' (removeEntry m g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|[[x fx] tx] tl IH]; intros n f' t' m Hmn; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (pair_eq x m) eqn:Em.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Em; subst x.
      assert (En : pair_eq m n = false)
        by (apply pair_eq_neq; intro Heq; exact (Hmn Heq)).
      rewrite En. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:En.
      * apply pair_eq_true in En; subst x.
        simpl. rewrite Em. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. f_equal. apply IH. exact Hmn.
      * simpl. rewrite Em, En. f_equal. apply IH. exact Hmn.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Consumability and cons preservation.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma cons_replaceEntry : forall g pf n t',
  cons g pf -> consumable t' ->
  forall pf', cons (replaceEntry n vis t' g) pf'.
Proof.
(* ================================================================== *)
(* Body-environment commutation lemmas.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma replaceEntry_out_env : forall n f' t' u v t1 t2 g,
  u <> n -> v <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))
  = (u,vis,t1)::(v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u (replaceEntry n f' t' g)).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq u vis t1
             ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq v vis t2
             (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g)) n f' t' H0).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry (removeEntry u g) n f' t' v H0).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' u H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_un_env : forall n f' t' v t2 g,
  v <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v g)
  = (v,vis,t2)::removeEntry v (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq v vis t2 (removeEntry v g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' v H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_inl_env : forall n f' t' u x t1 t g,
  u <> n -> x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g)
  = (u,vis,t1)::(x,vis,t)::removeEntry u (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq u vis t1
             ((x,vis,t)::removeEntry u g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq x vis t
             (removeEntry u g) n f' t' H0).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' u H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_inun_env : forall n f' t' x t g,
  x <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((x,vis,t)::g)
  = (x,vis,t)::replaceEntry n f' t' g.
Proof.
  intros. apply replaceEntry_cons_neq; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_new_env : forall n f' t' nb tb g,
  nb <> n ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' ((nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb g)
  = (nb,vis,tb)::removeEntry nb (replaceEntry n f' t' g).
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite (replaceEntry_cons_neq nb vis tb (removeEntry nb g) n f' t' H).
  rewrite <- (replaceEntry_removeEntry g n f' t' nb H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Split replacement.                                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma ecomb_vis_self : forall t, consumable t -> ecomb (vis,t) (vis,t) (vis,t).
Proof.
  intros t Hc. destruct Hc as [-> | Hrest].
  - apply ec_top. apply Fp_vv.
  - destruct Hrest as [Hun | Hlin].
    + destruct Hun as [p [u Hu]]. subst t. apply ec_un. apply Fp_vv.
    + destruct Hlin as [u Hu]. subst t.
      apply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv | apply Pp_emptyL].
Qed.
Proof.
  intros n f t t' g g' Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x. simpl. rewrite (Hdom x). tauto.
  - intros x fx tx Hin. simpl in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [E | Hin].
    + inversion E; subst. exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin) as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].
Qed.

Lemma un_env_replace : forall g n f t t' gtail,
  NoDup (domain g) -> In ((n,f),t) g -> un_le t t' ->
  un_env (removeEntry n g) gtail ->
  un_env g ((n,f,t')::gtail).
Proof.
  intros g n f t t' gtail Hnd Hin Hle [Hdom Hent]. split.
  - intro x.
    rewrite (In_dom_removeEntry_iff n g (in_dom_entry g n f t Hin) x).
    rewrite (Hdom x). simpl.
    split; intros [E | H]; [left; symmetry; exact E | right; exact H | left; symmetry; exact E | right; exact H].
  - intros x fx tx Hinx.
    destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec x n) as [Hxn | Hxn].
    + subst x.
      assert (Heq : ((n,fx),tx) = ((n,f),t))
        by (apply (nodup_entry_unique g n fx tx n f t Hnd Hinx Hin eq_refl)).
      inversion Heq; subst.
      exists t'. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hle].
    + assert (Hin' : In ((x,fx),tx) (removeEntry n g))
        by (apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g x fx tx); auto).
      destruct (Hent x fx tx Hin') as [u [Hinu He]].
      exists u. split; [right; exact Hinu | exact He].

  t = t' \/
  exists p p' u, t = Chan un p u /\ t' = Chan un p' u /\ type_sub t t'.

Lemma typeCheck_b_relabel :
  forall g pf q b f t r,
    NoDup (domain g) -> In ((b,f),t) g -> f <> hid ->
    un_ext t r -> (consumable t -> consumable r) ->
    typeCheck g pf q ->
    forall pf', typeCheck (((b,vis,r) :: removeEntry b g)) pf' q.
Proof.
  intros g pf q b f t r Hnd Hin Hf Hue Hcons Hty pf'.
  destruct f.
  - (* hid *) exfalso; exact (Hf eq_refl).
  - (* ill *)
    assert (Hct : consumable t)
      by (eapply (typeCheck_ill_consumable g pf q); eauto).
    assert (Hcr : consumable r) by (apply Hcons; exact Hct).
    assert (HndRep : NoDup (domain (replaceEntry b vis r g)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_replaceEntry; exact Hnd).
    assert (HtyRep : typeCheck (replaceEntry b vis r g)
                       (isMap_nodup _ HndRep) q).
    { eapply (typeCheck_replace_ill g pf q b t vis r); eauto. }
    assert (HinRep : In ((b,vis),r) (replaceEntry b vis r g)).
    { apply (replaceEntry_in_entry g b t vis r). exact Hin. }
    assert (Hperm : Permutation
      (((b,vis,r) :: removeEntry b g)) (replaceEntry b vis r g)).
    { rewrite <- (removeEntry_replaceEntry_same g b vis r Hnd).
      apply (Permutation_cons_removeEntry (replaceEntry b vis r g)
               b vis r); auto. }
    exact (typeCheck_perm (replaceEntry b vis r g)
             (((b,vis,r) :: removeEntry b g)) q
             (isMap_nodup _ HndRep) pf' HndRep
             (Permutation_sym Hperm) HtyRep).
  - (* vis *)
    assert (Hbd : In b (domain g))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t); exact Hin).
    assert (Hbabs : ~ In b (domain (removeEntry b g)))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still b g); auto).
    assert (HndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry b g)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
    assert (HndHead : NoDup (domain (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g))))
      by (simpl; apply NoDup_cons; auto).
    assert (Hperm1 : Permutation
      (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g)) g)
      by (apply (Permutation_cons_removeEntry g b vis t); auto).
    assert (HtyHead : typeCheck (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g))
                        (isMap_nodup _ HndHead) q).
    { exact (typeCheck_perm g (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g)) q
               pf (isMap_nodup _ HndHead) Hnd
               (Permutation_sym Hperm1) Hty). }
    assert (Hun : un_env (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g))
                       (((b,vis,r) :: removeEntry b g))).
    { assert (Hrem : removeEntry b (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g))
                    = removeEntry b g)
        by (apply removeEntry_cons_eq).
      assert (Hinner : un_env (removeEntry b (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g)))
                              (removeEntry b g))
        by (exact (eq_rect _ (fun X => un_env X (removeEntry b g))
                     (un_env_refl (removeEntry b g)) _ (eq_sym Hrem))).
      exact (un_env_replace (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g))
               b vis t r (removeEntry b g)
               HndHead (or_introl eq_refl) Hue Hinner). }
    eapply (typeCheck_un_enlarge_apply _ _ (isMap_nodup _ HndHead) pf'
              q Hun HndHead).
    { simpl; apply NoDup_cons; auto. }
    exact HtyHead.
Qed.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.

Section Utilities.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
  - split.
    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
    + intros _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + simpl. right; exact H.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left; exact Heq.
      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
Proof.
  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
      * assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ex).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t tl Hzy).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t tl Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z x f t (removeEntry y tl) Hzx).
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq z y f t (removeEntry x tl) Hzy).
        f_equal. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_sub : forall y g x,
    In x (domain (removeEntry y g)) -> In x (domain g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + destruct H as [->|H]; [left|right]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma domain_removeEntry_neq : forall y g x,
    x <> y -> In x (domain g) -> In x (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros x Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. rewrite <- Heq. exact E.
      * simpl. left. exact Heq.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. destruct (nat_pair_eq_dec z x) as [Heq2|Hne2].
        -- left; exact Heq2.
        -- right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_domain_removeEntry : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intro Hnd.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst; auto.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff. split.
      * intro Hc. apply Hnot. eapply domain_removeEntry_sub; eauto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_removeEntry_still : forall y g,
    NoDup (domain g) -> In y (domain g) -> ~ In y (domain (removeEntry y g)).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros Hnd Hin.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
    + simpl. destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. intro Hc; exact (Hnot Hc).
      * intro Hc. simpl in Hc. destruct Hc as [Heq|Hc].
        -- apply pair_eq_false in E; contradiction.
        -- exact (IH Hnd Hin Hc).
Qed.

Lemma nodup_entry_unique : forall g n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    In ((n1,f1),t1) g -> In ((n2,f2),t2) g -> n1 = n2 ->
    ((n1,f1),t1) = ((n2,f2),t2).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros; contradiction.
  - destruct h as [[a fa] ta]. simpl. intros n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 Hn.
    apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hnot Hnd].
    destruct H1 as [E1|I1]; destruct H2 as [E2|I2].
    + rewrite <- E1, <- E2. reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n2) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n2 f2 t2 I2).
    + exfalso. apply Hnot.
      assert (Ha : a = n1) by congruence.
      rewrite Ha. exact (in_dom_entry tl n1 f1 t1 I1).
    + apply (IH n1 f1 t1 n2 f2 t2); auto.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_nodup : forall g, NoDup (domain g) -> isMap g.
Proof.
  intros g Hnd. unfold isMap. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  assert (H := nodup_entry_unique g x f1 t1 x f2 t2 Hnd H1 H2 eq_refl).
  inversion H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma isMap_removeEntry : forall y g, isMap g -> isMap (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g Hm. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f1 t1 H1).
  - exact (in_removeEntry_elim y g x f2 t2 H2).
Qed.

Lemma isMap_sub : forall g1 g2, isMap g2 ->
    (forall x f t, In ((x,f),t) g1 -> In ((x,f),t) g2) -> isMap g1.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 Hm Hsub. unfold isMap in *. intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2].
  apply (Hm x f1 t1 f2 t2). split; auto.
Qed.

  end.

Proof.
  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].

Lemma share_uOut :
  forall g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 b1 b2 pol t t1 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
    esplit g1 g2 g ->
    typeCheck g1 pf1 (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) ->
    (pol = out \/ pol = io) ->
    type_remove t1 t t2 ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan un pol t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) g ->
    exists g1' pf1',
      esplit g1' g2 (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g) /\
      typeCheck g1' pf1' p.
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 b1 b2 pol t t1 t2
         Hnd Hnd1 Hnd2 Hes Hty Hpol Hr HinA HinB.
  inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* TOutL impossible *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct v as [v1 v2]. simpl in *.
    destruct (esplit_entry_comb g1 g2 g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin p0 t0) Hes H6)
      as [f2a [t2a [f3a [t3a [Hin2a [Hin3a Heca]]]]]].
    assert (E3a : f3a = vis /\ t3a = Chan un pol t).
    { apply nodup_entry_eq_same with (g:=g) (n:=(u1,u2)); auto. }
    destruct E3a as [Ef3a Et3a]; subst f3a t3a.

Lemma share_lIn :
  forall g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 t t1 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
    esplit g1 g2 g ->
    typeCheck g1 pf1 (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) ->
    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
    (b1,b2) <> (a1,a2) ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin inp t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) g ->
    exists g1' g2' pf1',
      esplit g1' g2' 
        (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
           :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
           :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)) /\
      typeCheck g1' pf1' (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 t t1 t2
         Hnd Hnd1 Hnd2 Hes Hty Htp Hba HinA HinB.
  (* b entry across the split *)
  destruct (esplit_entry_comb_g g1 g2 g (b1,b2) vis t1 Hes Hnd HinB)
    as [f1b [t1b [f2b [t2b [HinB1 [HinB2 Hecb]]]]]].
  assert (Hf1b : f1b = vis) by
    (inversion Hecb; subst;
     match goal with H : flag_plus f1b _ vis |- _ =>
       inversion H; reflexivity end).
  subst f1b.
  assert (Hf2b : f2b = vis) by
    (inversion Hecb; subst;
     match goal with H : flag_plus _ f2b vis |- _ =>
       inversion H; reflexivity end).
  subst f2b.
  (* action entry across the split *)
  destruct (esplit_entry_comb_g g1 g2 g (a1,a2) vis (Chan lin inp t) Hes Hnd HinA)
    as [f1a [t1a [f2a [t2a [HinA1 [HinA2 Heca]]]]]].
  assert (Hf1a : f1a = vis) by
    (inversion Heca; subst;
     match goal with H : flag_plus f1a _ vis |- _ =>
       inversion H; reflexivity end).
  subst f1a.
  inversion Heca; subst.
  (* Hty exposes the action entry in the first share; comparison with
     HinA1 forces it to be the input view.  Abstract the action name and
     bound name first so inversion does not erase them. *)
  pose proof Hty as Hty0.
  inversion Hty.
  - (* TInL *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct x as [x1' x2']. simpl in *.
    subst u1 u2 x1' x2'.
    assert (Eact : ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin p0 t0)
                   = ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin p1 t)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g1 (a1,a2) vis (Chan lin p0 t0)
               (a1,a2) vis (Chan lin p1 t) Hnd1 H6 HinA1); reflexivity. }
    inversion Eact; subst p0 t0.
    assert (Hp1 : p1 = inp).
    { destruct H5 as [Hsub _].
      destruct p1.
      - simpl in Hsub; inversion Hsub.
      - reflexivity.
      - destruct p2; simpl in H7; try discriminate; inversion H7.
      - destruct p2; simpl in H7; try discriminate; inversion H7. }
    subst p1.
    (* target relation for the b entry *)
    destruct (ecomb_plus_target vis vis vis t1b t2b t1 t t2 Hecb Htp)
      as [r1 [r2 [Hr1 [Hr2 [HecT [Hcons _]]]]]].
    assert (Hab_e : (a1,a2) <> (b1,b2)) by (intro E; apply Hba; symmetry; exact E).
    assert (HdomA1_e : In (a1,a2) (domain g1))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=Chan lin inp t); exact HinA1).
    assert (HdomB1_e : In (b1,b2) (domain g1))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t1b); exact HinB1).
    assert (Hnd1b_e : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
    assert (HdomA1b_e : In (a1,a2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
      by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto).
    assert (Habs1_e : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g1); auto).
    assert (HndG1t : NoDup (domain
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,r1)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))).
    { apply NoDup_domain_cons2.
      - exact Hab_e.
      - intro Hc. apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (a1,a2)
          (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1) Hnd1b_e HdomA1b_e Hc).
      - intro Hc. apply Habs1_e.
        eapply domain_removeEntry_sub. exact Hc.
      - apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry. exact Hnd1b_e. }
    assert (HtyG1 : typeCheck
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,r1)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1))
      (isMap_nodup _ HndG1t) (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2)).
    { eapply (sr_lIn g1 pf1 p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 vis t t1b r1
                (isMap_nodup _ HndG1t)).
      - exact Hnd1.
      - exact Hty0.
      - exact Hr1.
      - exact Hba.
      - discriminate.
      - exact HinA1.
      - exact HinB1. }
    (* build the target split: remove b, remove a, insert b, insert a *)
    assert (HdomA1 : In (a1,a2) (domain g1))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=Chan lin inp t); exact HinA1).
    assert (HdomB1 : In (b1,b2) (domain g1))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t1b); exact HinB1).
    assert (HdomB2 : In (b1,b2) (domain g2))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t2b); exact HinB2).
    assert (HdomB : In (b1,b2) (domain g))
      by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=vis) (t:=t1); exact HinB).
    assert (Hab : (a1,a2) <> (b1,b2)) by (intro E; apply Hba; symmetry; exact E).
    assert (Hesb : esplit (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)
                    (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))
      by (apply (esplit_remove g1 g2 g (b1,b2)); auto).
    assert (Hnd1b : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
    assert (Hnd2b : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
    assert (Hndb : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)))
      by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
    assert (HdomA1b : In (a1,a2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
      by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq; auto).
    assert (HdomA2b : In (a1,a2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)))
      by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq;
          [auto|apply (proj1 (proj1 Hes (a1,a2))); exact HdomA1]).
    assert (HdomAb : In (a1,a2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)))
      by (apply domain_removeEntry_neq;
          [auto|apply (proj1 (proj1 (proj2 Hes) (a1,a2)));
                 apply domain_removeEntry_sub with (y:=(b1,b2)); exact HdomA2b]).
    (* get A domain in g2/g from split *)
    assert (HdomA2 : In (a1,a2) (domain g2))
      by (apply (proj1 (proj1 Hes (a1,a2))); exact HdomA1).
    assert (HdomA : In (a1,a2) (domain g))
      by (apply (proj1 (proj1 (proj2 Hes) (a1,a2))); exact HdomA2).
    assert (Hesab : esplit
      (removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1))
      (removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2))
      (removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)))
      by (apply (esplit_remove (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)
                   (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)
                   (a1,a2)); auto).
    assert (Habs1 : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g1); auto).
    assert (Habs2 : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g2); auto).
    assert (Habs : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)))
      by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g); auto).
    assert (Hesbi : esplit
      (((b1,b2),vis,r1) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1))
      (((b1,b2),vis,r2) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2))
      (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))).
    { eapply (esplit_insert_comb
        (removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1))
        (removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2))
        (removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))
        (b1,b2) vis r1 vis r2 vis t2).
      - exact Hesab.
      - exact HecT.
      - intro Hc. apply Habs1.
        eapply domain_removeEntry_sub. exact Hc.
      - intro Hc. apply Habs2.
        eapply domain_removeEntry_sub. exact Hc.
      - intro Hc. apply Habs.
        eapply domain_removeEntry_sub. exact Hc. }
    assert (HabsA1 : ~ In (a1,a2) (domain
      (((b1,b2),vis,r1) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))).
    { simpl. intro Hc. destruct Hc as [E|Hc].
      - apply Hab. symmetry. exact E.
      - apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)
                 Hnd1b HdomA1b Hc). }
    assert (HabsA2 : ~ In (a1,a2) (domain
      (((b1,b2),vis,r2) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)))).
    { simpl. intro Hc. destruct Hc as [E|Hc].
      - apply Hab. symmetry. exact E.
      - apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)
                 Hnd2b HdomA2b Hc). }
    assert (HabsA : ~ In (a1,a2) (domain
      (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)))).
    { simpl. intro Hc. destruct Hc as [E|Hc].
      - apply Hab. symmetry. exact E.
      - apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)
                 Hndb HdomAb Hc). }
    assert (HesFinal : esplit
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,r1)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1))
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,r2)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2))
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))).
    { eapply (esplit_insert_comb
        (((b1,b2),vis,r1) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1))
        (((b1,b2),vis,r2) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2))
        (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))
        (a1,a2) vis (Chan lin empty t) vis (Chan lin empty t)
        vis (Chan lin empty t)).
      - exact Hesbi.
      - eapply ec_lin.
        + apply Fp_vv.
        + apply Pp_emptyL.
      - exact HabsA1.
      - exact HabsA2.
      - exact HabsA. }
    exists (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
              :: ((b1,b2),vis,r1)
              :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)).
    exists (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
              :: ((b1,b2),vis,r2)
              :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)).
    exists (isMap_nodup _ HndG1t).
    split; [exact HesFinal|exact HtyG1].
  - (* TInUn impossible: the action entry is linear in the first share *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct x as [x1' x2']. simpl in *.
    subst u1 u2 x1' x2'.
    assert (Eact : ((a1,a2),vis,Chan un p0 t0)
                   = ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin p1 t)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g1 (a1,a2) vis (Chan un p0 t0)
               (a1,a2) vis (Chan lin p1 t) Hnd1 H6 HinA1); reflexivity. }
    inversion Eact.
Qed.

  forall g pf p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 f t t1 t2 pf',
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    typeCheck g pf (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) ->
    type_plus t1 t t2 ->

      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))

Proof.

Lemma sr_uIn :

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).

Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

Lemma type_plus_wk_self : forall t, type_plus t (wk_type t) t.
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply Tp_LinPlus. apply Pp_emptyR.
    + simpl. pose proof (Tp_UnPlus p p u) as H.
      rewrite pol_cup_idem in H. exact H.
  - simpl. apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_vis_wk_self : forall t,
  ecomb (vis,t) (vis,wk_type t) (vis,t).
Proof.
  intro t. destruct t as [m p u|].
  - destruct m.
    + simpl. apply ec_lin with (p1:=p) (p2:=empty) (p:=p);
        [apply Fp_vv|apply Pp_emptyR].
    + simpl. apply ec_un with (p:=p); apply Fp_vv.
  - simpl. apply ec_top; apply Fp_vv.
Qed.

Lemma type_sub_un_cup_l : forall p q u,
  type_sub (Chan un p u) (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u).
Proof.
  intros p q u. destruct p; destruct q; simpl; eauto using type_sub.
Qed.

Lemma type_plus_consumable_wk_un_le : forall t1 t t2,
  type_plus t1 t t2 -> consumable t1 -> un_le t1 (wk_type t2).
Proof.
  intros t1 t t2 Htp Hc.
  destruct Hc as [Htop | [[p1 [u Ht1]] | [u Ht1]]]; subst t1.
  - inversion Htp; subst. left. reflexivity.
  - inversion Htp; subst. simpl.
    right. exists p1, (pol_cup p1 p2), u. simpl.
    split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|apply type_sub_un_cup_l]].
  - inversion Htp; subst. simpl. left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_absent : forall g n f' t',
  ~ In n (domain g) -> replaceEntry n f' t' g = g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t' H.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. assert (E : pair_eq x n = false).
    { apply pair_eq_neq. intro Heq. apply H. simpl. left. exact Heq. }
    rewrite E. simpl. rewrite IH; auto.
    intro Hc. apply H. simpl. right. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_perm_remove : forall g n f' t',
  NoDup (domain g) -> In n (domain g) ->
  Permutation (replaceEntry n f' t' g) ((n,f',t') :: removeEntry n g).
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros n f' t' Hnd Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. simpl.
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E. subst x.
      assert (Hnot : ~ In n (domain tl)).
      { apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. exact (proj1 Hnd). }
      rewrite (replaceEntry_absent tl n f' t' Hnot).
      apply Permutation_refl.
    + assert (Hxn : x <> n) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact E).
      apply NoDup_cons_iff in Hnd. destruct Hnd as [Hx Hndtl].
      destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * exfalso. apply Hxn. exact Heq.
      * eapply perm_trans.
        -- apply perm_skip. apply IH; auto.
        -- apply perm_swap.
Qed.

Lemma replaceEntry_app_absent : forall L R n f' t',
  ~ In n (domain L) ->
  replaceEntry n f' t' (L ++ R) = L ++ replaceEntry n f' t' R.
Proof.
  induction L as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros R n f' t' H.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. assert (Hxn : x <> n).
    { intro Heq. apply H. simpl. left. exact Heq. }
    rewrite (pair_eq_neq x n Hxn). simpl.
    rewrite (IH R n f' t'); auto.
    intro Hc. apply H. simpl. right. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma typeCheck_add_dummyEnv : forall A g pf p,
  NoDup (domain A) -> NoDup (domain g) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain A) -> In n (domain g) -> False) ->
  (forall n, In n (domain A) -> ~ In n (bv p)) ->
  typeCheck g pf p ->
  forall pf', typeCheck (dummyEnv A ++ g) pf' p.
Proof.
  induction A as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros g pf p HndA Hndg Hdisj Hbv Hty pf'.
  - simpl. exact (typeCheck_pf_irrel g pf p Hty pf').
  - apply NoDup_cons_iff in HndA. destruct HndA as [Hnotx Hndtl].
    simpl.
    assert (HxNotG : ~ In x (domain g)).
    { intro Hc. apply (Hdisj x). simpl. left. reflexivity. exact Hc. }
    assert (Hdisj_tl : forall n, In n (domain tl) -> In n (domain g) -> False).
    { intros n Hn Hg. apply (Hdisj n). simpl. right. exact Hn. exact Hg. }
    assert (Hbv_tl : forall n, In n (domain tl) -> ~ In n (bv p)).
    { intros n Hn Hc. apply (Hbv n). simpl. right. exact Hn. exact Hc. }
    assert (HndCur : NoDup (domain (dummyEnv tl ++ g))).
    { rewrite domain_app, domain_dummyEnv.
      apply NoDup_app.
      - exact Hndtl.
      - exact Hndg.
      - intros n Hn1 Hn2. apply (Hdisj_tl n); auto. }
    assert (HtyTl : typeCheck (dummyEnv tl ++ g)
      (isMap_nodup _ HndCur) p).
    { exact (IH g pf p Hndtl Hndg Hdisj_tl Hbv_tl Hty (isMap_nodup _ HndCur)). }
    assert (HxCur : ~ In x (domain (dummyEnv tl ++ g))).
    { rewrite domain_app, domain_dummyEnv. intro Hc. apply in_app_or in Hc.
      destruct Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      - exact (Hnotx Hc).
      - exact (HxNotG Hc). }
    assert (Hbvx : ~ In (x) (bv p)) by (apply (Hbv x); simpl; left; reflexivity).
    exact (typeCheck_add_entry_consumable (dummyEnv tl ++ g)
             (isMap_nodup _ HndCur) p HndCur HtyTl
             x (dummyFlag f) (dummyType t) (consumable_dummyType t)
             HxCur Hbvx pf').
Qed.

Lemma InB_first_consumable : forall g,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> consumable t) ->
  forall a, consumable (snd (fst (InB a g))).
Proof.
  intros g Hc. induction g as [|[[x f] t] tl IH]; intros a.
  - simpl. apply consumable_top.
  - simpl. destruct (pair_eq a x) eqn:E.
    + apply Hc with (n:=x)(f:=f)(t:=t). left; reflexivity.
    + apply IH. intros n f0 t0 Hin. apply Hc with (n:=n)(f:=f0)(t:=t0). right; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma newEntries_cons : forall g L m,
  (forall n f t, In (n,f,t) g -> consumable t) ->
  forall e, In e (newEntries g L m) -> consumable (snd e).
Proof.
  intros g L. induction L as [|h tl IH]; intros m Hc e Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - destruct h as [h1 h2]. simpl in Hin.
    destruct (InB (h1,h2) g) as [[f0 t0] b] eqn:Eb.
    destruct b; simpl in Hin.
    + apply (IH m Hc e Hin).
    + destruct (InB (h1,h2-m) g) as [[f1 t1] b1] eqn:Eb1; simpl in Hin.
      destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst e. simpl.
        pose proof (InB_first_consumable g Hc (h1,h2-m)) as Hcons.
        rewrite Eb1 in Hcons. simpl in Hcons. exact Hcons.
      * apply (IH m Hc e Hin).
Qed.

Lemma share_uIn :
  forall g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 f pol t t1 t2,
    NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain g1) -> NoDup (domain g2) ->
    esplit g1 g2 g ->
    typeCheck g1 pf1 (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) ->
    (pol = inp \/ pol = io) ->
    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
    f <> hid ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan un pol t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),f,t1) g ->
    exists g1' g2' pf1',
      esplit g1' g2' (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g) /\
      typeCheck g1' pf1' (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2).
Proof.
  intros g1 g2 g pf1 p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 f pol t t1 t2
         Hnd Hnd1 Hnd2 Hes Hty Hpol Htp Hf HinA HinB.
  (* b entry across the split *)
  destruct (esplit_entry_comb_g g1 g2 g (b1,b2) f t1 Hes Hnd HinB)
    as [f1b [t1b [f2b [t2b [HinB1 [HinB2 Hecb]]]]]].
  assert (Hf1b : f1b <> hid).
  { assert (Hfc : f = ill \/ f = vis)
      by (destruct f; auto; contradiction).
    destruct Hfc as [-> | ->]; intro E; subst f1b;
      inversion Hecb; subst;
      match goal with
      | Hfp : flag_plus hid _ ill |- _ => inversion Hfp
      | Hfp : flag_plus hid _ vis |- _ => inversion Hfp
      end. }
  assert (HplusB : type_plus t1b t2b t1)
    by (eapply ecomb_type_plus; exact Hecb).
  (* action entry across the split: unrestricted in both shares *)
  destruct (esplit_entry_comb_g g1 g2 g (a1,a2) vis (Chan un pol t) Hes Hnd HinA)
    as [f1a [t1a [f2a [t2a [HinA1 [HinA2 Heca]]]]]].
  inversion Heca; subst.
  match goal with Hfp : flag_plus f1a f2a vis |- _ =>
    assert (Hf1a : f1a = vis) by (inversion Hfp; reflexivity);
    subst f1a end.
  (* split the target entry *)
  destruct (ecomb_plus_target f1b f2b f t1b t2b t1 t t2 Hecb Htp)
    as [r1 [r2 [Hr1 [Hr2 [HecT [Hcons HunT]]]]]].
  (* typing of the first transformed share *)
  assert (HndRem : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (HdomB1 : In (b1,b2) (domain g1))
    by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f1b) (t:=t1b); exact HinB1).
  assert (Habs : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
    by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g1); auto).
  assert (HndG1t : NoDup (domain
    (((b1,b2),vis,r1) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g1))).
  { simpl. apply NoDup_cons; [exact Habs|exact HndRem]. }
  assert (HtyG1 : typeCheck
    (((b1,b2),vis,r1) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)
    (isMap_nodup _ HndG1t) (pmap p x1 x2 b1 b2)).
  { eapply (sr_uIn g1 pf1 p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 f1b pol t t1b r1
              (isMap_nodup _ HndG1t)).
    - exact Hnd1.
    - exact Hty.
    - exact Hpol.
    - exact Hr1.
    - exact Hf1b.
    - exact HinA1.
    - exact HinB1. }
  (* build the target split *)
  assert (HdomB2 : In (b1,b2) (domain g2))
    by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f2b) (t:=t2b); exact HinB2).
  assert (HdomB : In (b1,b2) (domain g))
    by (apply in_dom_entry with (f:=f) (t:=t1); exact HinB).
  assert (Hesb : esplit (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)
                  (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g))
    by (apply (esplit_remove g1 g2 g (b1,b2)); auto).
  assert (Hnd1b : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hnd2b : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Hndb : NoDup (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)))
    by (apply NoDup_domain_removeEntry; auto).
  assert (Habs1 : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)))
    by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g1); auto).
  assert (Habs2 : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)))
    by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g2); auto).
  assert (HabsG : ~ In (b1,b2) (domain (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)))
    by (apply (NoDup_removeEntry_still (b1,b2) g); auto).
  assert (HesFinal : esplit
    (((b1,b2),vis,r1) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g1)
    (((b1,b2),vis,r2) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)
    (((b1,b2),vis,t2) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g)).
  { eapply (esplit_insert_comb
      (removeEntry (b1,b2) g1) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g2)
      (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)
      (b1,b2) vis r1 vis r2 vis t2).
    - exact Hesb.
    - exact HecT.
    - exact Habs1.
    - exact Habs2.
    - exact HabsG. }
  exists (((b1,b2),vis,r1) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g1).
  exists (((b1,b2),vis,r2) :: removeEntry (b1,b2) g2).
  exists (isMap_nodup _ HndG1t).
  split; [exact HesFinal|exact HtyG1].
Qed.

Definition wk_type (t : piType) : piType :=
  match t with
  | Chan lin p t0 => Chan lin empty t0
  | Chan un p t0 => Chan un p t0
  | Top => Top
  end.

Lemma type_plus_wk : forall t, type_plus (wk_type t) t t.
Proof.
  intros t. destruct t as [m p t0|]; simpl.
  - destruct m.
    + apply Tp_LinPlus. apply Pp_emptyL.
    + assert (H : type_plus (Chan un p t0) (Chan un p t0) (Chan un (pol_cup p p) t0))
        by apply Tp_UnPlus.
      rewrite (pol_cup_idem p) in H. exact H.
  - apply Tp_Base.
Qed.

Lemma consumable_wk : forall t, consumable (wk_type t).
Proof.
  intros t. destruct t as [m p t0|]; simpl.
  - destruct m; [apply consumable_lin_empty | apply consumable_un].
  - apply consumable_top.
Qed.

Lemma sr_lOut :
  forall g pf p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2 pf',
    NoDup (domain g) ->
    typeCheck g pf (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) ->
    type_remove t1 t t2 ->
    In ((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin out t) g ->
    In ((b1,b2),vis,t1) g ->
    typeCheck
      (((a1,a2),vis,Chan lin empty t)
         :: ((b1,b2),vis,t2)
         :: removeEntry (a1,a2) (removeEntry (b1,b2) g)) pf' p.
Proof.
  intros g pf p a1 a2 b1 b2 t t1 t2 pf' Hnd Hty Hr HinA HinB.
  inversion Hty; subst.
  - (* TOutL *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct v as [v1 v2]. simpl in *.
    assert (HuA : ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin p0 t0) = ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin out t)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin p0 t0) (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin out t) Hnd H6 HinA); reflexivity. }
    inversion HuA; subst.
    assert (HvB : ((v1,v2),vis,t') = ((v1,v2),vis,t1)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g (v1,v2) vis t' (v1,v2) vis t1 Hnd H7 HinB); reflexivity. }
    inversion HvB; subst.
    assert (Eres : t3 = Chan lin empty t).
    { exact (type_remove_lin_out_self t t3 H4). }
    subst t3.
    assert (E2 : t4 = t2) by (eapply type_remove_det; eauto).
    subst t4.
    assert (Huv : (u1,u2) <> (v1,v2)).
    { intro E. inversion E; subst v1 v2.
      pose proof (nodup_entry_unique g (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin out t)
                    (u1,u2) vis t1 Hnd H6 H7 eq_refl) as Hentry.
      inversion Hentry; subst t1. destruct Hr as [Hsub _].
      exact (no_sub_into_self t lin out Hsub). }
    apply (typeCheck_env_eq_all _ _ p
             (f_equal (fun l => (u1,u2,vis,Chan lin empty t)
                                :: (v1,v2,vis,t2) :: l)
                (eq_sym (removeEntry_removeEntry_other (u1,u2) (v1,v2) g Huv)))
             (fun pf0 => typeCheck_pf_irrel _ _ _ H8 pf0) pf').
  - (* TOutUn impossible *)
    destruct u as [u1 u2]. destruct v as [v1 v2]. simpl in *.
    assert (HuA : ((u1,u2),vis,Chan un p0 t0) = ((u1,u2),vis,Chan lin out t)).
    { apply (nodup_entry_unique g (u1,u2) vis (Chan un p0 t0) (u1,u2) vis (Chan lin out t) Hnd H6 HinA); reflexivity. }
    inversion HuA.
Qed.

What does go through (confirming the coordinator's first point):

- For linear communication `lcomL`, the global entry at `a` is `Chan lin io t`. If the input component `q1` is typed in share `gq`, its `TInL` action entry must be `Chan lin inp t` (the `TInL` residual calculation forces polarity `inp`, exactly as in `sr_lIn`). Since `pol_plus` is partial and has no `io + inp` case (only `empty+x`, `x+empty`, `inp+out`, `out+inp`), `ecomb` at `a` then forces the output share `gp` to have precisely `Chan lin out t`. So `gp` already carries the `Eout` action entry. This part of the action-view transfer is indeed derivable, not a new lemma.
- For unrestricted communication the polarity issue is weaker (`pol_cup` is total), but `Chan un io` in the output share and `Chan un inp` in the input share are already valid `sr_uOut`/`sr_uIn` inputs, so no transfer is needed there.
- For `lclsL`, the same argument applies, and the hide at `b` can be handled by `TNew` with `typeCheck_b_relabel` for the sibling `ill -> vis` entry.

The remaining obstruction is not the action entry but the rest of the component environments:

- The sub-lts for `p1` runs in `Eout = a:out t :: b:s :: g0`, where `g0` is the full environment. The typed share `gp`, however, is only one half of the original split: at `b` it has the complementary residual (e.g. `t1p` with `type_plus t1p t1q s`), and on `g0` it has an arbitrary share, not the full type. `sr_lOut` can be applied directly to `gp` only when `p1` is syntactically a `dOut`; for a nested communication the invariant would have to be applied to `p1`'s sub-lts at `Eout`, which requires a typing of `p1` in a share of `Eout` — i.e. an enlargement from share types (`lin empty`, residuals) to the full types in `g0`.
- The same issue appears on the input side and in the `uRin` `newEntries`/`weakenEnv` case.
- The needed principle is a typing monotonicity/relabelling lemma of the form: if `typeCheck g pf p` and `g'` is obtained from `g` by replacing entries with `type_plus`-enlargements (`t` by `t + q`, and flags appropriately), then `typeCheck g' pf' p`. This is not in `Task.v`/`SubstDev.v`/`ReplaceDev.v`; `typeCheck_add_entry_consumable` only adds fresh consumable entries, and `typeCheck_un_enlarge_apply` only covers unrestricted `un_ext` enlargement. 1	Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.
2	
3	Section Semantics.
4	
5	Inductive action : Set :=
6	  | aIn : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
7	  | aOut : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
8	  | aTau : nat -> nat -> action.
9	
10	Fixpoint InB a g : ((flag * piType) * bool) :=
11	    match g with
12	    | nil => ((ill, Top), false)
13	    | (b, f, t) :: m =>
14	      if pair_eq a b then ((f, t), true) else InB a m
15	    end.
16	
17	Fixpoint newEntries (g : typeEnv) (l : list (name * name)) (max : nat) : typeEnv :=
18	    match l with
19	    | (a1, a2) :: tail =>
20	      let (_, notNew) := InB (a1, a2) g in
21	      if notNew
22	      then newEntries g tail max
23	      else
24	        let (pair, _) := InB (a1, a2 - max) g in
25	        ((a1, a2), fst pair, snd pair) :: newEntries g tail max
26	    | nil => nil
27	    end.
28	
29	Definition notHidden c1 c2 act :=
30	    match act with
31	    | aIn a1 a2 b1 b2
32	    | aOut a1 a2 b1 b2 =>
33	      (a1, a2)<> (c1, c2) /\ (b1, b2) <> (c1, c2)
34	    | aTau _ _ => True
35	    end.
36	
37	Inductive lts (g : typeEnv) :
38	    dproc ->  action -> typeEnv -> dproc -> NoDup (domain g) -> Prop :=
39	  | parL : forall p1 a g' q p2 pf,
40	      lts g p1 a g' p2 pf ->
41	      lts g (dPar p1 q) a g' (dPar p2 q) pf
42	  | lOut : forall p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
43	      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
44	      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin out t) g ->
45	      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
46	      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
47	          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
48	             :: ((b1, b2), vis, t2)
49	             :: (removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g))) p pf
50	  | uOut : forall pol p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
51	      pol = out \/ pol = io ->
52	      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
53	      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
54	      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
55	      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
56	          (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g) p pf
57	  | lIn : forall p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
58	      type_plus t1 t t2->
59	      f <> hid ->
60	      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin inp t) g ->
61	      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
62	      lts g (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
63	          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
64	             :: ((b1, b2), vis, t2)

5	Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
6	  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
7	  | Co_top : forall n pf',
8	      typeOf g n Top ->
9	      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
10	      cons g pf
11	  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
12	      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
13	      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
14	      cons g pf
15	  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
16	      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
17	      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
18	      cons g pf.
19	
20	Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
21	  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
22	  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
23	      In (n, hid, t) g ->
24	      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
25	      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
26	  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
27	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
28	      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
29	      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
30	      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
31	  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
32	      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
33	      type_remove t' t t2 ->
34	      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
35	      In (v, vis, t') g ->
36	      typeCheck
37	        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
38	      typeCheck
39	        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
40	  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
41	      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
42	      type_remove t' t t2 ->
43	      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
44	      In (v, vis, t') g ->
45	      typeCheck
46	        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
47	      typeCheck
48	        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
49	  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
50	      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
51	      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
52	      ~In x (domain g) ->
53	      snd x < max (domain g) ->
54	      typeCheck
55	        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
56	      typeCheck
57	        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
58	  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
59	      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
60	      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
61	      ~In x (domain g) ->
62	      snd x < max (domain g) ->
63	      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
64	      typeCheck
65	        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)

1	Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.
2	
3	Section TypeSystem.
4	
5	Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.
6	
7	Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.
8	
9	Inductive piType : Set :=
10	  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
11	  | Top : piType.
12	
13	Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.
14	
15	Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
16	    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
17	      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
18	      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.
19	
20	Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).
21	
22	Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
23	    match p1, p2 with
24	    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
25	    | _, _  => false
26	    end.
27	
28	Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
29	    match m1, m2 with
30	    | lin, lin | un, un => true
31	    | _, _ => false
32	    end.
33	
34	Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
35	    match t1, t2 with
36	    | Top, Top => true
37	    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
38	      if mode_eq m1 m2
39	      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
40	      else false
41	    | _, _ => false
42	    end.
43	
44	Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
45	    match f1, f2 with
46	    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
47	    | _, _  => false
48	    end.
49	
50	Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
51	    match g with
52	    | nil => nil
53	    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
54	      if pair_eq x y
55	      then
56	        tail
57	      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
58	    end.
59	
60	Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
61	  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
62	      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.
63	
64	Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
65	  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
66	      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.
67	
68	Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
69	    match p1, p2 with
70	    | empty, _ => p2
71	    | io, _ => io
72	    | _, io => io
73	    | out, inp => io
74	    | out, _ => out
75	    | inp, out => io
76	    | inp, _ => inp
77	    end.
78	
79	Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
80	  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
81	  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
82	  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
83	  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.
84	
85	Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
86	  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
87	  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
88	      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
89	      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
90	  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
91	      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).
92	
93	Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
94	    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.
95	
96	Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
97	    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.
98	
99	Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
100	  | Ts_id : forall t,
101	      type_sub t t
102	  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
103	      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
104	  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
105	      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
106	  | Ts_out : forall m t,
107	      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).
108	
109	Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
110	    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).
111	
112	Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
113	  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
114	  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
115	  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
116	  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.
117	
118	Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
119	            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
120	  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
121	            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
122	  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
123	      flag_plus f g f'->
124	      pol_plus p q p' ->
125	      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
126	      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
127	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
128	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
129	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
130	      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
131	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
132	  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
133	      flag_plus f g f'->
134	      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
135	      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
136	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
137	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
138	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
139	      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
140	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
141	  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
142	      flag_plus f g f'->
143	      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
144	      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
145	      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
146	      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
147	      flagOf g3 n f' ->
148	      typeOf g3 n Top ->
149	      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.
150	
151	Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
152	    match g with
153	    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
154	    | nil => nil
155	    end.
156

3	Notation name  := nat.

7	Inductive dproc : Set :=
8	  | dZero : dproc
9	  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
10	  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
11	  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
12	  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
13	  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.
14	
15	Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
16	    match p with
17	    | dZero  => nil
18	    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
19	    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p

24	    match p with
25	    | dZero  => nil

27	    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
28	      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)

30	      fn p1 ++  fn p2
31	    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
32	      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
33	    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>

35	    end.

37	Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
38	    match p with
39	    | dZero  =>
40	      nil
41	    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
42	    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
43	      (y1, y2) :: bv p

50	    end.

61	    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
62	    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
63	    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in

20	Lemma pol_plus_cup : forall p q r, pol_plus p q r -> r = pol_cup p q.
21	Proof.
22	  intros p q r H. destruct p, q; simpl in *;
23	    inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
24	Qed.

26	(* The pure polarity cancellation used in the out/in cases. *)
27	Lemma pol_plus_cancel : forall t a ta b c t1,
28	  pol_plus t a ta -> pol_plus ta b t1 -> pol_plus t c t1 ->
29	  pol_plus a b c.
30	Proof.
31	  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
32	  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
33	    eauto using pol_plus.
34	Qed.

37	Lemma flag_plus_cancel_vis : forall t a ta b c t1,
38	  flag_plus t a ta -> flag_plus ta b t1 -> flag_plus t c t1 ->
39	  flag_plus a b c.
40	Proof.
41	  intros t a ta b c t1 H1 H2 H3.
42	  inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; inversion H3; subst;
43	    eauto using flag_plus.
44	Qed.

46	(* Combination functions witnessing the (partial) monoid operations. *)
47	Definition flag_comb (f g : flag) : flag :=
48	  match f, g with
49	  | hid, ill | ill, hid => hid
50	  | vis, vis => vis
51	  | ill, ill => ill
52	  | _, _ => hid
53	  end.
54	
55	Definition type_comb (t1 t2 : piType) : piType :=
56	  match t1, t2 with
57	  | Top, Top => Top
58	  | Chan lin p1 u, Chan lin p2 _ => Chan lin (pol_cup p1 p2) u
59	  | Chan un p1 u, Chan un p2 _ => Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) u
60	  | _, _ => Top
61	  end.
62	
63	Lemma flag_plus_comb : forall f g h, flag_plus f g h -> h = flag_comb f g.
64	Proof.
65	  intros f g h H. inversion H; reflexivity.
66	Qed.
67	
68	Lemma type_plus_comb : forall t1 t2 t3, type_plus t1 t2 t3 -> t3 = type_comb t1 t2.
69	Proof.
70	  intros t1 t2 t3 H. inversion H as [| p1 p2 p t' Hp | p1 p2 t']; subst; simpl.
71	  - reflexivity.
72	  - rewrite (pol_plus_cup p1 p2 p Hp). reflexivity.
73	  - reflexivity.
74	Qed.

76	Lemma ecomb_comb : forall a b c, ecomb a b c ->
77	  c = (flag_comb (fst a) (fst b), type_comb (snd a) (snd b)).
78	Proof.
79	  intros a b c H. destruct a as [fa ta], b as [fb tb], c as [fc tc].
80	  inversion H; subst; simpl.
81	  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
82	      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf); reflexivity end.
83	  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
84	      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf); rewrite pol_cup_idem; reflexivity end.
85	  - match goal with Hf : flag_plus ?x ?y ?z |- _ =>
86	      rewrite (flag_plus_comb x y z Hf);
87	      match goal with Hp : pol_plus ?a ?b ?c |- _ =>
88	        rewrite (pol_plus_cup a b c Hp); reflexivity end end.

100	  type_plus t c t1 ->
101	  (is_unrestricted ta -> a = ta) ->
102	  (is_unrestricted t1 -> c = t1) ->
103	  ecomb (vis, a) (vis, b) (vis, c).

105	  intros t a ta b c t1 Hp He Hc Hua Huc.
106	  inversion Hp as [| p1 p2 p3 u Hpp | p1 p2 u]; subst.
107	  - (* t = a = ta = Top *)
108	    apply ecomb_top_inv in He. destruct He as [Hb [Ht1 Hf]]. subst.

Hmm, so how can the comm rule be sound? Perhaps the lts semantics intends `g` as a "shared global environment" where the two components can each independently see capabilities up to what the environment provides, not a linear split. But typeCheck is linear. Subject reduction would then be false if the lts lets both components use the same capability. Let's try to construct a concrete counterexample!

Idea: Let g have a:io, b:s where s = t + s1 with both t and s1 nonempty. The whole process dPar p1 q1 is typed: p1 outputs on a and uses b as payload; q1 inputs on a and receives into b. Let's make p1's share b:s (full), so q1's share b:empty. Then the lts chooses message b with Ein b:s1. For the lts to be *enabled* it just needs s1 in Ein. But subject reduction asks to type q2 under b:s. q2 = q[b/x]. q typed under x:t and b:empty; so q2 typed under b:t (combining x and b). Is typeCheck of q2 under an env with b:s possible? Maybe not if b is used as a channel with capability t vs s. But typeCheck is not invariant under changing b's type. We can choose q to actually use b (the old b) as a channel requiring some capability. Let's design q to force the type.

Simplest: Let q = dZero. Then q typed under a:empty, x:t, b:empty requires cons of that env: a:empty lin consumable, x:t requires t consumable (Top/un/lin empty), b:empty consumable. Choose t = Chan lin empty u (consumable? Chan lin empty is consumable in cons? cons Co_lin: typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) yes consumable). Then q2 = dZero, and target Ein_target has a:empty, b:s = t+s1. Need cons: s must be consumable. If s1=empty, s=t=lin empty consumable. If s1 nonempty, s = t + s1; choose s1 = un? type_plus requires same mode. For lin: t=empty, s1=inp => s=inp, not consumable. So dZero would fail! But wait, p1 and q1 are the whole process: the continuation q after input is dZero. The whole process dPar p1 q1 with q1 = dInp a x dZero. TypeCheck: q1 typed under g2 where a:inp and b:empty and x:t. But we can make q use b:t (after substitution) versus required b:s. Let's think: q typed under x:t and b:empty; q2 typed under b:t (combining). Target has b:s. If s ≠ t, typeCheck q2 under b:s may fail if q2 uses b in a way needing t-specific capability. But q2 uses b in place of x; can we force capability requirement t? For example x must be a channel with capability out; q inputs on x. 2246	(* Splitting a combined global entry after adding a common action type:
2247	   if the two share types combine to t1 and t1+t is t2, and the pmap
2248	   share contributes tA+t=r1, then the sibling's remainder r2 satisfies
2249	   r1+r2=t2.  The resulting visible entries recombine to the visible
2250	   target entry. *)
2251	Lemma ecomb_plus_target :
2252	  forall f1 f2 f tA tB t1 t t2,
2253	    ecomb (f1,tA) (f2,tB) (f,t1) ->
2254	    type_plus t1 t t2 ->
2255	    exists r1 r2,
2256	      type_plus tA t r1 /\
2257	      type_plus r1 r2 t2 /\
2258	      ecomb (vis,r1) (vis,r2) (vis,t2) /\
2259	      (consumable tB -> consumable r2) /\
2260	      un_ext tB r2.
2261	Proof.
2262	  intros f1 f2 f tA tB t1 t t2 Hec Htp.
2263	  inversion Hec; subst.
2264	  - (* Top *)
2265	    inversion Htp; subst.
2266	    exists Top, Top. split.
2267	    + apply Tp_Base.
2268	    + split.
2269	      * apply Tp_Base.
2270	      * split.
2271	        -- apply ec_top; apply Fp_vv.
2272	        -- split.
2273	           ++ intro Hc; apply consumable_top.
2274	           ++ left; reflexivity.
2275	  - (* un *)
2276	    destruct t as [m q u|].
2277	    + destruct m.
2278	      * inversion Htp.
2279	      * inversion Htp; subst.
2280	        exists (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u), (Chan un (pol_cup p q) u).
2281	        refine (conj _ (conj _ (conj _ (conj _ _)))).
2282	        -- apply Tp_UnPlus.
2283	        -- pose proof (Tp_UnPlus (pol_cup p q) (pol_cup p q) u) as Hu.
2284	           rewrite pol_cup_idem in Hu. exact Hu.
2285	        -- apply ec_un; apply Fp_vv.
2286	        -- intro Hc; apply consumable_un.
2287	        -- right. exists p, (pol_cup p q), u.
2288	           split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|apply un_sub_cup]].
2289	    + inversion Htp.
2290	  - (* lin *)
2291	    destruct t as [m q u|].
2292	    + destruct m.
2293	      * inversion Htp; subst.
2294	        match goal with Hc : pol_plus p1 p2 p |- _ => rename Hc into Hpol end.
2295	        match goal with Hc : pol_plus p q p4 |- _ => rename Hc into Hout end.
2296	        destruct (pol_plus_assoc p2 p1 p q p4
2297	                    (pol_plus_sym p1 p2 p Hpol) Hout)
2298	          as [r1p [Hr1p Hr2p]].
2299	        exists (Chan lin r1p u), (Chan lin p2 u).
2300	        refine (conj _ (conj _ (conj _ (conj _ _)))).
2301	        -- apply Tp_LinPlus; exact Hr1p.
2302	        -- apply Tp_LinPlus; apply pol_plus_sym; exact Hr2p.
2303	        -- apply ec_lin; [apply Fp_vv|apply pol_plus_sym; exact Hr2p].
2304	        -- intro Hc; exact Hc.
2305	        -- left; reflexivity.
2306	      * inversion Htp.
2307	    + inversion Htp.
2308	Qed.

2366	             (((b,vis,r) :: removeEntry b g)) q

2378	    assert (Hperm1 : Permutation
2379	      (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g)) g)
2380	      by (apply (Permutation_cons_removeEntry g b vis t); auto).
2381	    assert (HtyHead : typeCheck (((b,vis,t) :: removeEntry b g))
2382	                        (isMap_nodup _ HndHead) q).

OK. These are helpers.

Now let's seriously attempt to find a counterexample. The theorem as stated is quite strong. Let me try to falsify using the laxity of lts: the lts rule lOut requires channel a type Chan lin out t and object b type t1 with type_remove t1 t t2. But typeCheck of the process dOut a b body under g requires TOutL with type_remove (Chan lin p t)(Chan lin out t) t1ch and type_remove t' t t2b, In a with p, In b with t'. If g has a: Chan lin out t (lts condition), then TOutL needs p=out (since type_sub out ≤ p and p must be ≥out; p could be out only? p could be io? type_sub (Chan lin out t)(Chan lin io t) holds via Ts_out, and type_plus (Chan lin out t) residual (Chan lin io t) => residual = inp. So p=io is possible even though lts requires In a out! Wait lts condition In (a,vis,Chan lin out t) g forces g's a entry to be exactly out. TOutL with p=io would require In (a,vis,Chan lin io t) g, not matching out. If g has out, then TOutL's In must have p=out (isMap uniqueness, if g NoDup domain). But the theorem does NOT assume NoDup (domain g)! It only assumes typeCheck g pf p and lts g p ... nd_pf, where nd_pf : NoDup (domain g) — yes lts carries nd_pf as an argument! Great, so NoDup (domain g) is available. Good.

So g is NoDup. Then lts In a out and TOutL In a p with isMap g (pf : isMap g) gives uniqueness of entry type: p=out. Good.

Now, what if g contains multiple entries with the same name but different flags/types? isMap prevents; NoDup prevents.

Let me think about a potential counterexample from *ill* entries. The lts rules don't check flags on the action channel except `vis` required in some, and `f <> hid` for message name. Consider lOut requires In (b,vis,t1) g: message name must be vis. TOutL requires In (v,vis,t') g. Same. Fine.

uOut requires In b vis t1 and channel un pol t. TOutUn requires In v vis t'. Fine.

lIn requires In (b,f,t1) with f<>hid, and result sets b vis. TInL binds fresh x, doesn't require b in the typing; so b can be ill in g. In lts lIn, the message b could be an ill entry. Result b becomes vis with t2 = t1 + t. In the typed share, the fresh x is vis; if b is ill in the typed share, substitution combines x:vis with b:ill — flag_plus vis ill is undefined! This is exactly why typeCheck_ill_consumable + ReplaceDev.typeCheck_replace_ill handles it: an ill entry must be consumable, and then can be "relabelled" to vis with consumable type. But lts sets b's type to t2 = t1 + t, and requires typeCheck of pmap body under b:vis t2. The SrDev sr_lIn lemma handles arbitrary f≠hid, and uses Hcons/HunT. Let's look at sr_lIn statement to see if it's complete without NoDup? It was proven. Let me read it.

Lemma lookup_isMap : forall g, isMap g -> forall n f1 t1 f2 t2,
    lookup n g = Some (f1,t1) -> lookup n g = Some (f2,t2) -> f1=f2 /\ t1=t2.
Proof.
  intros g Him n f1 t1 f2 t2 H1 H2.
  apply (Him n f1 t1 f2 t2). split.
  - apply lookup_Some_In in H1; exact H1.
  - apply lookup_Some_In in H2; exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma length_removeEntry : forall n g, In n (domain g) -> length (removeEntry n g) = length g - 1.
Proof.
  intros n g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros H; destruct H.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intros H.
    destruct (pair_eq x n) eqn:E.
    + simpl. lia.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * apply pair_eq_false in E. contradiction.
      * assert (Hpos : length tl >= 1) by (destruct tl as [|h2 tl2]; simpl in *; [contradiction| simpl; lia]).
        specialize (IH Hin). simpl. rewrite IH. lia.
Qed.

End Utilities.

Section ConsSpec.

Definition consumable (t : piType) : Prop :=
  t = Top \/ (exists p t', t = Chan un p t') \/ (exists t', t = Chan lin empty t').

Lemma consumable_top : consumable Top.
Proof. left; auto. Qed.

Lemma consumable_un : forall p t, consumable (Chan un p t).
Proof. intros; right; left; eauto. Qed.

Lemma consumable_lin_empty : forall t, consumable (Chan lin empty t).
Proof. intros; right; right; eauto. Qed.

Lemma typeOf_inv : forall g n t, typeOf g n t -> exists f, In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof. intros g n t H. destruct H as [g' n' f t' Hin]. exists f. exact Hin. Qed.

Lemma flagOf_inv : forall g n f, flagOf g n f -> exists t, In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof. intros g n f H. destruct H as [g' n' f' t' Hin]. exists t'. exact Hin. Qed.

Lemma cons_entry : forall g pf, cons g pf ->
    forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t.
Proof.
  intros g pf H.
  induction H as [g pf Eg | g pf n pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n p t pf' Ht Hc IH | g pf n t pf' Ht Hc IH].
  - subst; intros; contradiction.
  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
      destruct (typeOf_inv g n Top Ht) as [f0 Htop].
      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
      unfold isMap in Him.
      destruct (Him n f0 Top f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
      subst t0. apply consumable_top.
    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * exact Hin.
  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan un p t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
      unfold isMap in Him.
      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan un p t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
      subst t0. apply consumable_un.
    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * exact Hin.
  - intros n0 f t0 Hin.
    destruct (pair_eq n0 n) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst n0.
      destruct (typeOf_inv g n (Chan lin empty t) Ht) as [f0 Htop].
      assert (Him : isMap g) by exact pf.
      unfold isMap in Him.
      destruct (Him n f0 (Chan lin empty t) f t0 (conj Htop Hin)) as [_ Ht'].
      subst t0. apply consumable_lin_empty.
    + apply (IH n0 f t0). apply (in_removeEntry_intro n g n0 f t0).
      * intro Heq. apply pair_eq_false in E. apply E. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma entry_cons : forall g pf,
    (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t) -> cons g pf.
Proof.
  intros g. remember (length g) as k eqn:Ek. revert g Ek.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros g Ek pf Hall.
  - destruct g as [|h tl].
    + apply Co_nil; auto.
    + simpl in Ek. discriminate.
  - destruct g as [|h tl].
    + apply Co_nil; auto.
    + destruct h as [[n f] t].
      pose proof (Hall n f t (or_introl eq_refl)) as Hc.
      assert (Hin : In n (domain (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (simpl; left; auto).
      assert (Hpf' : isMap (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl))) by (apply isMap_removeEntry; exact pf).
      assert (Hlen : length (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) = k).
      { rewrite length_removeEntry; [|exact Hin]. simpl in Ek. simpl. lia. }
      assert (Hall' : forall n0 f0 t0, In ((n0,f0),t0) (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) -> consumable t0).
      { intros n0 f0 t0 H0. apply (Hall n0 f0 t0). apply in_removeEntry_elim with (y:=n). exact H0. }
      assert (Hrec : cons (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) Hpf').
      { apply (IH (removeEntry n (((n,f),t)::tl)) (eq_sym Hlen) Hpf' Hall'). }
      destruct Hc as [Ht | [[p [t' Ht]] | [t' Ht]]].
      * subst t.
        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Top)::tl) n Top).
        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Top)::tl) n f Top). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
        exact (Co_top (((n,f),Top)::tl) pf n Hpf' HTy Hrec).
      * subst t.
        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n (Chan un p t')).
        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) n f (Chan un p t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
        exact (Co_un (((n,f),Chan un p t')::tl) pf n p t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
      * subst t.
        assert (HTy : typeOf (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n (Chan lin empty t')).
        { apply (T_Entry (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) n f (Chan lin empty t')). simpl; left; reflexivity. }
        exact (Co_lin (((n,f),Chan lin empty t')::tl) pf n t' Hpf' HTy Hrec).
Qed.

Lemma cons_spec : forall g pf, cons g pf <-> (forall n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> consumable t).

  - apply entry_cons.

Lemma consumable_plus : forall t1 t t2, consumable t1 -> consumable t -> type_plus t1 t t2 -> consumable t2.

    eauto using flag_plus_det, pol_plus_det.

    destruct (pol_plus_assoc p1 p2 p q2 q Hp Hpq) as [pg [H7 H8]].
    exists (fg, Chan lin pg t). split; apply ec_lin; assumption.
