Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section Semantics.

Inductive action : Set :=
  | aIn : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aOut : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aTau : nat -> nat -> action.

Fixpoint InB a g : ((flag * piType) * bool) :=
    match g with
    | nil => ((ill, Top), false)
    | (b, f, t) :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then ((f, t), true) else InB a m
    end.

Fixpoint newEntries (g : typeEnv) (l : list (name * name)) (max : nat) : typeEnv :=
    match l with
    | (a1, a2) :: tail =>
      let (_, notNew) := InB (a1, a2) g in
      if notNew
      then newEntries g tail max
      else
        let (pair, _) := InB (a1, a2 - max) g in
        ((a1, a2), fst pair, snd pair) :: newEntries g tail max
    | nil => nil
    end.

Definition notHidden c1 c2 act :=
    match act with
    | aIn a1 a2 b1 b2
    | aOut a1 a2 b1 b2 =>
      (a1, a2)<> (c1, c2) /\ (b1, b2) <> (c1, c2)
    | aTau _ _ => True
    end.

Inductive lts (g : typeEnv) :
    dproc ->  action -> typeEnv -> dproc -> NoDup (domain g) -> Prop :=
  | parL : forall p1 a g' q p2 pf,
      lts g p1 a g' p2 pf ->
      lts g (dPar p1 q) a g' (dPar p2 q) pf
  | lOut : forall p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin out t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)
             :: ((b1, b2), vis, t2)
             :: (removeEntry (a1, a2) (removeEntry (b1, b2) g))) p pf
  | uOut : forall pol p a1 a2 b1 b2 pf t t1 t2,
      pol = out \/ pol = io ->
      type_remove t1 t t2 ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan un pol t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), vis, t1) g ->
      lts g (dOut a1 a2 b1 b2 p) (aOut a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((b1, b2), vis, t2) :: removeEntry (b1, b2) g) p pf
  | lIn : forall p a1 a2 x1 x2 b1 b2 pf f t t1 t2,
      type_plus t1 t t2->
      f <> hid ->
      In ((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin inp t) g ->
      In ((b1, b2), f, t1) g ->
      lts g (dInp a1 a2 x1 x2 p) (aIn a1 a2 b1 b2)
          (((a1, a2), vis, Chan lin empty t)

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).

Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, ill, t) :: ill_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       ill_proj m
    end.

End TypeSystem.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Notation name  := nat.

Section ProcessDefinitions.

Inductive dproc : Set :=
  | dZero : dproc
  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.

Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p
    | dNu h i  p =>  secLabs p ++ (h, i) :: nil
    end.

Fixpoint fn (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      fn p1 ++  fn p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      (x1, x2) :: (y1, y2) :: fn p
    end.

Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>
      nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      (y1, y2) :: bv p
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      bv p1 ++  bv p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      bv p
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      bv p
    end.

Definition wf (p : dproc) : Prop :=
    NoDup (secLabs p) /\ disjoint (fn p) (secLabs p).

Definition pos l := forall x1 x2 : nat,
      In (x1, x2) l-> x2 > 0.

Definition sl_pos p := pos (secLabs p).

Definition mv (py pz pv : name * name)  :=
    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in
    if (y1 =? z1) && (y2 =? z2)
    then (v1, v2)
    else (y1, y2).

Fixpoint pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2 :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>  p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dBang (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2 (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dInp (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2  (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      let r1 := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      let r2 := mv (y1, y2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dOut  (fst r1) (snd r1) (fst r2) (snd r2) (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dPar p q =>
      dPar (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2) (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dNu h i q =>
      dNu h i (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    end.

Definition map_nat_nat := list (nat * nat).

Fixpoint  domain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (k, _) :: t => k :: (domain_projection t)
    end.

Fixpoint  codomain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (_, v) :: t => v :: (codomain_projection t)
    end.

Definition structure_is_map (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    NoDup (domain_projection m).

Fixpoint max (l :list (nat*nat)) : nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => 0
    | (_, x) :: t => let m := max t in
                     if x <? m then m else x
    end.

Notation dp := domain_projection.

Notation cp := codomain_projection.

Local Definition no_dup_cont (h : nat * nat) (t : list (nat * nat))
    (pf : NoDup (h :: t)) : NoDup t := ltac:(inversion pf; assumption).

Local Opaque no_dup_cont.

Fixpoint dep_map_gen_r (l :list (name * name)) (m : nat) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => fun _ => nil
    | h :: t =>
      fun pf : NoDup (h :: t)  =>
        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
    end.

Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).

Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
    match p with
    | dZero   => fun _  => p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
    | dPar p q =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
    | dNu h i p =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
    end.

End ProcessDefinitions.

Section Facts.

End Facts.
====
Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInU : forall u p t x q pf1 pf2,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf2 ->
      typeCheck ( (x, vis, t) :: g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dBang (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q).

End TypeSystemRules.

We need both hasIn and hasOut mutually. Define them as Fixpoints with two functions? In Rocq, define `hasAct` maybe. We can define two Fixpoints separately referring to each other—not allowed directly, but can define hasIn and hasOut by structural recursion where each only needs itself? For dOut, hasIn should look into its continuation (input can be in the body), and not count the output channel as input. For hasOut, dOut's channel is an output; dInp's continuation may contain outputs; dBang's channel is input (bang is an input-like replication!) — dBang x y ... p is a replicated input on (x,y), so hasIn should count it; hasOut shouldn't count x but should look in p. dNu only body; dPar both.

So:
```
Fixpoint hasIn (a) p :=
 match p with
 | dZero => False
 | dBang x y z w q | dInp x y z w q => (x,y)=a \/ hasIn a q
 | dOut x y z w q => hasIn a q
 | dPar p q => hasIn a p \/ hasIn a q

 end.
Fixpoint hasOut (a) p :=
 match p with
 | dZero => False
 | dBang x y z w q | dInp x y z w q => hasOut a q
 | dOut x y z w q => (x,y)=a \/ hasOut a q
 | dPar p q => hasOut a p \/ hasOut a q

```
These are independent.

So p∈{inp,io}. For un, TInUn requires p=io or inp directly. So supportInp := (exists f t, In (a,f,Chan lin inp t) g \/ In (a,f,Chan lin io t) g \/ In (a,f,Chan un inp t) g \/ In (a,f,Chan un io t) g). But also mode matters: a linear dInp can only be typed with a linear channel; a un dInp with un. The process constructor dInp doesn't carry mode, so either. Good.

Similarly supportOut := In a (Chan lin out) \/ Chan lin io \/ Chan un out \/ Chan un io.

But note: typeCheck's environment g has exactly one entry per name (isMap). So "In" suffices.

```

If a≠n, the support entry in body env is from removeEntry n g (or at n; but a≠n so not n), so in removeEntry n g, hence in g (in_removeEntry_elim). Good.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics.

Section Utilities.

Lemma pair_eq_true : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros [a1 a2] [b1 b2]. unfold pair_eq. simpl.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_false : forall (a b : name * name), pair_eq a b = false <-> a <> b.
Proof.
  intros a b. destruct (pair_eq a b) eqn:E.
  - split; [discriminate|]. intro H; exfalso; apply H; apply pair_eq_true; exact E.
  - split.
    + intros _ Heq. apply pair_eq_true in Heq. rewrite Heq in E. discriminate.
    + intros _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_refl : forall a, pair_eq a a = true.
Proof. intros []; unfold pair_eq; simpl; rewrite !Nat.eqb_refl; auto. Qed.

Lemma pair_eq_neq : forall a b, a <> b -> pair_eq a b = false.
Proof. intros a b H. apply pair_eq_false. auto. Qed.

Lemma in_dom_entry : forall g n f t, In ((n,f),t) g -> In n (domain g).
Proof.
  intros g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[x fx] tx]. intros n f t H. simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left; auto.
    + simpl. right. exact (IH n f t Hin).
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_notin : forall y g, ~ In y (domain g) -> removeEntry y g = g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[x f] t]. simpl. intro H.
    destruct (pair_eq x y) eqn:E.
    + apply pair_eq_true in E; subst. exfalso; apply H. simpl. left; auto.
    + f_equal. apply IH. intro Hc. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_elim : forall y g n f t,
    In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g) -> In ((n,f),t) g.
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. intros n f t H. exact H.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t H.
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
    + simpl. right; exact H.
    + simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left; exact Heq.
      * right; apply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma in_removeEntry_intro : forall y g n f t,
    y <> n -> In ((n,f),t) g -> In ((n,f),t) (removeEntry y g).
Proof.
  intros y g. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - simpl. auto.
  - destruct h as [[z fz] tz]. simpl. intros n f t Hne Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. destruct (pair_eq n y) eqn:E.
      * apply pair_eq_true in E. exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact E.
      * simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:E.
      * exact Hin.
      * simpl. right. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_eq : forall y f t tl,
    removeEntry y (((y,f),t) :: tl) = tl.
Proof. intros. simpl. rewrite pair_eq_refl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_cons_neq : forall z y f t tl, z <> y ->
    removeEntry y (((z,f),t) :: tl) = ((z,f),t) :: removeEntry y tl.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (pair_eq_neq z y); [reflexivity|auto].
Qed.

Lemma removeEntry_removeEntry_other : forall x y g, x <> y ->
    removeEntry x (removeEntry y g) = removeEntry y (removeEntry x g).
Proof.
  intros x y g Hne. induction g as [|h tl IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct h as [[z f] t].
    destruct (pair_eq z y) eqn:Ey.
    + apply pair_eq_true in Ey. subst z.
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.
      rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq y x f t tl (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (apply pair_eq_false; exact Ey).
      destruct (pair_eq z x) eqn:Ex.
      * apply pair_eq_true in Ex. subst z.
        rewrite (removeEntry_cons_neq x y f t tl Hne).
        rewrite removeEntry_cons_eq.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import pairEq operations header.
Require Import pi_syntax type_system type_system_rules semantics Task.

(* ============================================================
   Part 1. Capability support predicates.

   `suppIn t`  : t is a channel type that can be used as the
                 subject of a linear/un input lts rule (pol inp or io).
   `suppOut t` : t is a channel type that can be used as the
                 subject of a linear/un output lts rule (pol out or io).

   The key point is that polarities are tracked exactly: a linear
   channel with pol `out` cannot be used for input, etc.
   ============================================================ *)

Inductive suppIn : piType -> Prop :=
| SI_lin_inp : forall t, suppIn (Chan lin inp t)
| SI_lin_io  : forall t, suppIn (Chan lin io t)
| SI_un_inp  : forall t, suppIn (Chan un inp t)
| SI_un_io   : forall t, suppIn (Chan un io t).

Inductive suppOut : piType -> Prop :=
| SO_lin_out : forall t, suppOut (Chan lin out t)
| SO_lin_io  : forall t, suppOut (Chan lin io t)
| SO_un_out  : forall t, suppOut (Chan un out t)
| SO_un_io   : forall t, suppOut (Chan un io t).

Definition hasSupp (g : typeEnv) (a : name * name)
    (P : piType -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists f t, In ((a,f),t) g /\ P t.

(* ecomb preserves input-support on either side *)
Lemma ecomb_suppIn_l : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> suppIn t1 -> suppIn t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t Hec Hsi.
  inversion Hec; subst.
  - inversion Hsi.
  - inversion Hsi; subst; apply SI_un_inp || apply SI_un_io.
  - inversion Hsi; subst.
    + (* p1 = inp *) inversion H2; subst; apply SI_lin_inp || apply SI_lin_io.
    + (* p1 = io *) inversion H2; subst; apply SI_lin_io.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_suppIn_r : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> suppIn t2 -> suppIn t.
Proof.
  intros. apply ecomb_suppIn_l with (f1:=f2) (t1:=t2) (f2:=f1) (t2:=t1).
  - apply ecomb_sym; auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_suppOut_l : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> suppOut t1 -> suppOut t.
Proof.
  intros f1 t1 f2 t2 f t Hec Hso.
  inversion Hec; subst.
  - inversion Hso.
  - inversion Hso; subst; apply SO_un_out || apply SO_un_io.
  - inversion Hso; subst.
    + (* p1 = out *) inversion H2; subst; apply SO_lin_out || apply SO_lin_io.
    + (* p1 = io *) inversion H2; subst; apply SO_lin_io.
Qed.

Lemma ecomb_suppOut_r : forall f1 t1 f2 t2 f t,
    ecomb (f1,t1) (f2,t2) (f,t) -> suppOut t2 -> suppOut t.
Proof.
  intros. apply ecomb_suppOut_l with (f1:=f2) (t1:=t2) (f2:=f1) (t2:=t1).
  - apply ecomb_sym; auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* a removable component supporting input/output implies the whole does *)
Lemma type_remove_suppIn : forall t s r,
    type_remove t s r -> suppIn r -> suppIn t.
Proof.
  intros t s r [_ [Hplus _]] Hsi.
  inversion Hsi; subst.
  - (* r = Chan lin inp t0 *) inversion Hplus; subst; apply SI_lin_inp || apply SI_lin_io.
  - (* r = Chan lin io t0 *) inversion Hplus; subst; apply SI_lin_io.
  - (* r = Chan un inp t0 *) inversion Hplus; subst; apply SI_un_inp || apply SI_un_io.
  - (* r = Chan un io t0 *) inversion Hplus; subst; apply SI_un_io.
Qed.

Lemma type_remove_suppOut : forall t s r,
    type_remove t s r -> suppOut r -> suppOut t.
Proof.
  intros t s r [_ [Hplus _]] Hso.
  inversion Hso; subst.
  - inversion Hplus; subst; apply SO_lin_out || apply SO_lin_io.
  - inversion Hplus; subst; apply SO_lin_io.
  - inversion Hplus; subst; apply SO_un_out || apply SO_un_io.
  - inversion Hplus; subst; apply SO_un_io.
Qed.
